theorem bumpCorrectionHessianHolder (curve : DFP.TwoLeg.SlowCurve) :
    ∃ εbar ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 4), ∃ L > 0,
      ∀ ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 εbar,
        let orbit := DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.ofSlowCurve curve.shape curve.high ε₀
        ∀ Clim : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ (orbit.state j).center) atTop (𝓝 Clim) →
            ∀ Glim > 0,
              Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ (orbit.state j).amplitude) atTop (𝓝 Glim) →
                ∀ u v,
                  ‖EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim) u -
                      EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim) v‖ ≤
                    L * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨ηRadius, hηRadius, hRadius⟩ := curve.interpolationRadius_pos
  obtain ⟨ηShrink, hηShrink, hShrink⟩ := curve.interpolationRadiusTendstoZero
  obtain ⟨ηCluster, hηCluster, hCluster⟩ := curve.endpointClusterPt_mem_limitCircle
  obtain ⟨ηBalls, hηBalls, hBalls⟩ := curve.pairwiseDisjointInterpolationClosedBalls
  obtain ⟨ηCircle, hηCircle, hCircle⟩ :=
    curve.interpolationClosedBallDisjointLimitCircle
  obtain ⟨ηJets, hηJets, hJets⟩ := curve.endpointBumpSecondOrderJetsVanish
  obtain ⟨ηHolder, hηHolder, Llocal, hLlocal, hHolder⟩ :=
    endpointBumpHessianHolder curve
  let εbar := min ηRadius
    (min ηShrink (min ηCluster (min ηBalls (min ηCircle (min ηJets ηHolder)))))
  have hεbarPos : 0 < εbar := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact lt_min hηRadius.1
      (lt_min hηShrink.1 (lt_min hηCluster.1
        (lt_min hηBalls.1 (lt_min hηCircle.1 (lt_min hηJets.1 hηHolder.1)))))
  have hεbarLt : εbar < (1 / 4 : ℝ) :=
    (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt hηRadius.2
  have hεbarLeRadius : εbar ≤ ηRadius := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hεbarLeShrink : εbar ≤ ηShrink := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hεbarLeCluster : εbar ≤ ηCluster := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hεbarLeBalls : εbar ≤ ηBalls := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
  have hεbarLeCircle : εbar ≤ ηCircle := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))))
  have hεbarLeJets : εbar ≤ ηJets := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact (((((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans
      (min_le_right _ _)).trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans
      (min_le_right _ _)).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hεbarLeHolder : εbar ≤ ηHolder := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact (((((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans
      (min_le_right _ _)).trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans
      (min_le_right _ _)).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  let L := 2 * Llocal
  have hL : 0 < L := by
    dsimp only [L]
    linarith
  refine ⟨εbar, ⟨hεbarPos, hεbarLt⟩, L, hL, ?_⟩
  intro ε₀ hε₀
  dsimp only
  let orbit := DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.ofSlowCurve curve.shape curve.high ε₀
  have hεRadius : ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ηRadius :=
    ⟨hε₀.1, hε₀.2.trans hεbarLeRadius⟩
  have hεShrink : ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ηShrink :=
    ⟨hε₀.1, hε₀.2.trans hεbarLeShrink⟩
  have hεCluster : ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ηCluster :=
    ⟨hε₀.1, hε₀.2.trans hεbarLeCluster⟩
  have hεBalls : ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ηBalls :=
    ⟨hε₀.1, hε₀.2.trans hεbarLeBalls⟩
  have hεCircle : ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ηCircle :=
    ⟨hε₀.1, hε₀.2.trans hεbarLeCircle⟩
  have hεJets : ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ηJets :=
    ⟨hε₀.1, hε₀.2.trans hεbarLeJets⟩
  have hεHolder : ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ηHolder :=
    ⟨hε₀.1, hε₀.2.trans hεbarLeHolder⟩
  intro Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto u v
  have hRadiusPos : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < orbit.interpolationRadius Clim Glim k := by
    simpa only [orbit] using
      hRadius ε₀ hεRadius Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto
  have hRadiusZero : Tendsto
      (fun k : ℕ ↦ orbit.interpolationRadius Clim Glim k) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [orbit] using
      hShrink ε₀ hεShrink Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto
  have hBallsData : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint (fun k : ℕ ↦
      Metric.closedBall (orbit.endpoint k)
        (orbit.interpolationRadius Clim Glim k)) := by
    simpa only [orbit] using
      hBalls ε₀ hεBalls Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto
  have hCircleData : ∀ k : ℕ, Disjoint
      (Metric.closedBall (orbit.endpoint k)
        (orbit.interpolationRadius Clim Glim k))
      (DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.limitCircle Clim Glim) := by
    simpa only [orbit] using
      hCircle ε₀ hεCircle Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto
  let Γ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
    DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.limitCircle Clim Glim
  have hClosed : IsClosed Γ := by
    simpa only [Γ] using DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.isClosed_limitCircle Clim Glim hGlim
  have hClusterData : ∀ y, MapClusterPt y atTop orbit.endpoint → y ∈ Γ := by
    intro y hy
    simpa only [Γ, orbit] using
      (hCluster ε₀ hεCluster Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto y hy)
  have hSupport (k : ℕ) : tsupport (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) ⊆
      Metric.closedBall (orbit.endpoint k)
        (orbit.interpolationRadius Clim Glim k) :=
    DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.endpointBump_tsupport_subset_interpolationClosedBall
      orbit Clim Glim hRadiusPos k
  have hTwoLe : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by
    have hTwoNat : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤ := le_top
    exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr hTwoNat
  have hSmooth (k : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) :=
    (DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.contDiff_endpointBump orbit Clim Glim k).of_le hTwoLe
  have hJetsData := hJets ε₀ hεJets Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto
  have hValueDecay : ∀ η > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ k z,
      z ∈ Γᶜ → z ∈ tsupport (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) →
        Metric.infDist z Γ < δ →
          ‖orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k z‖ / Metric.infDist z Γ ^ 2 < η := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := hJetsData η hη
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    intro k z _ hz hzδ
    simpa only [Γ, orbit] using (hbound k z hz hzδ).1
  have hGradientDecay : ∀ η > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ k z,
      z ∈ Γᶜ → z ∈ tsupport (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) →
        Metric.infDist z Γ < δ →
          ‖fderiv ℝ (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) z‖ /
              Metric.infDist z Γ < η := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := hJetsData η hη
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    intro k z _ hz hzδ
    simpa only [Γ, orbit] using (hbound k z hz hzδ).2.1
  have hValueDecayIterated : ∀ η > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ k z,
      z ∈ Γᶜ → z ∈ tsupport (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) →
        Metric.infDist z Γ < δ →
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) z‖ /
              Metric.infDist z Γ ^ 2 < η := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := hValueDecay η hη
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    intro k z hzΓ hzk hzδ
    simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] using hbound k z hzΓ hzk hzδ
  have hGradientDecayIterated : ∀ η > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ k z,
      z ∈ Γᶜ → z ∈ tsupport (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) →
        Metric.infDist z Γ < δ →
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) z‖ /
              Metric.infDist z Γ ^ 1 < η := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := hGradientDecay η hη
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    intro k z hzΓ hzk hzδ
    simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, pow_one] using hbound k z hzΓ hzk hzδ
  have hvalueIterated := tendsto_norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_div_infDist_pow
    2 0 2 Γ orbit.endpoint (fun k ↦ orbit.interpolationRadius Clim Glim k)
      (fun k ↦ orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) hClosed hClusterData
      (fun k ↦ (hRadiusPos k).le) hRadiusZero hBallsData hSupport hSmooth
      (by omega) hValueDecayIterated
  have hderivIterated := tendsto_norm_iteratedFDeriv_finsum_div_infDist_pow
    2 1 1 Γ orbit.endpoint (fun k ↦ orbit.interpolationRadius Clim Glim k)
      (fun k ↦ orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) hClosed hClusterData
      (fun k ↦ (hRadiusPos k).le) hRadiusZero hBallsData hSupport hSmooth
      (by omega) hGradientDecayIterated
  have hvalue : Tendsto
      (fun z ↦ ‖∑ᶠ k, orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k z‖ /
        Metric.infDist z Γ ^ 2)
      (Filter.comap (fun z ↦ Metric.infDist z Γ) (𝓝 0) ⊓ Filter.principal Γᶜ)
      (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] using hvalueIterated
  have hderiv : Tendsto
      (fun z ↦ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w ↦ ∑ᶠ k, orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k w) z‖ /
        Metric.infDist z Γ)
      (Filter.comap (fun z ↦ Metric.infDist z Γ) (𝓝 0) ⊓ Filter.principal Γᶜ)
      (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, pow_one] using hderivIterated
  have hsmoothOutside : ContDiffOn ℝ 2
      (fun z ↦ ∑ᶠ k, orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k z) Γᶜ :=
    contDiffOn_finsum_outside 2 Γ orbit.endpoint
      (fun k ↦ orbit.interpolationRadius Clim Glim k)
      (fun k ↦ orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) hClosed hClusterData hRadiusZero
      hSupport hSmooth
  have hFderivEq := IsClosed.fderiv_fderiv_indicator_compl Γ
      (fun z ↦ ∑ᶠ k, orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k z) hClosed hsmoothOutside
      hvalue hderiv
  have hFunctionEq :
      Γᶜ.indicator (fun z ↦ ∑ᶠ k, orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k z) =
        orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim := by
    funext z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ Γ
    · have hzComplement : z ∉ Γᶜ := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] using hz
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hzComplement]
      have hZero (k : ℕ) : orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k z = 0 := by
        by_contra hk
        have hzSupport : z ∈ tsupport (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) :=
          subset_tsupport (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) hk
        have hzBall := hSupport k hzSupport
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hCircleData k) hzBall hz
      rw [DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.bumpCorrection_apply]
      exact (finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun k ↦ hZero k)).symm
    · have hzComplement : z ∈ Γᶜ := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff] using hz
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hzComplement]
      exact (DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.bumpCorrection_apply orbit Clim Glim z).symm
  have hHessianEq :
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim)) =
        Γᶜ.indicator (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ
          (fun z ↦ ∑ᶠ k, orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k z))) := by
    calc
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim)) =
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ
            (Γᶜ.indicator (fun z ↦ ∑ᶠ k, orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k z))) := by
        rw [hFunctionEq]
      _ = _ := hFderivEq
  have hdisjointΓ : ∀ k, Disjoint
      (tsupport (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k)) Γ := by
    intro k
    exact Set.disjoint_of_subset_left (hSupport k) (hCircleData k)
  have hlocal : ∀ k a b, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ
      (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k)) a -
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k)) b‖ ≤
      Llocal * ‖a - b‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    intro k a b
    simpa only [orbit] using
      hHolder ε₀ hεHolder Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto k a b
  have hgeneric := holder_of_disjoint_finsum_hessian
    Γ orbit.endpoint (fun k ↦ orbit.interpolationRadius Clim Glim k)
      (fun k ↦ orbit.endpointBump Clim Glim k) (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim)
      Llocal hClosed hClusterData hRadiusZero hBallsData hSupport hdisjointΓ hHessianEq
      hlocal hLlocal.le u v
  calc
    ‖EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim) u -
        EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim) v‖ =
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim)) u -
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim)) v‖ :=
      norm_euclideanHessian_sub_eq_norm_secondFDeriv_sub
        (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim) u v
    _ ≤ 2 * Llocal * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := hgeneric
    _ = L * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by rfl

theorem realizedObjectiveHessianHolder (curve : DFP.TwoLeg.SlowCurve) :
    ∃ εbar ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 4), ∃ L > 0,
      ∀ ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 εbar,
        let orbit := DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.ofSlowCurve curve.shape curve.high ε₀
        ∀ Clim : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
          Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ (orbit.state j).center) atTop (𝓝 Clim) →
            ∀ Glim > 0,
              Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ (orbit.state j).amplitude) atTop (𝓝 Glim) →
                ∀ u v,
                  ‖EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.realizedObjective Clim Glim) u -
                      EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.realizedObjective Clim Glim) v‖ ≤
                    L * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨ηHolder, hηHolder, L, hL, hHolder⟩ := bumpCorrectionHessianHolder curve
  obtain ⟨ηRegular, hηRegular, hRegular⟩ :=
    curve.bumpCorrectionContDiffTwoAndZeroJets
  let εbar := min ηHolder ηRegular
  have hεbarPos : 0 < εbar := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact lt_min hηHolder.1 hηRegular.1
  have hεbarLt : εbar < (1 / 4 : ℝ) :=
    (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt hηHolder.2
  have hεbarLeHolder : εbar ≤ ηHolder := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hεbarLeRegular : εbar ≤ ηRegular := by
    dsimp only [εbar]
    exact min_le_right _ _
  refine ⟨εbar, ⟨hεbarPos, hεbarLt⟩, L, hL, ?_⟩
  intro ε₀ hε₀
  dsimp only
  let orbit := DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.ofSlowCurve curve.shape curve.high ε₀
  have hεHolder : ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ηHolder :=
    ⟨hε₀.1, hε₀.2.trans hεbarLeHolder⟩
  have hεRegular : ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ηRegular :=
    ⟨hε₀.1, hε₀.2.trans hεbarLeRegular⟩
  intro Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto u v
  have hPsi : ContDiff ℝ 2 (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim) := by
    simpa only [orbit] using
      (hRegular ε₀ hεRegular Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto).1
  have hobj : orbit.realizedObjective Clim Glim =
      (fun z ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖z - Clim‖ ^ 2 + orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim z) := by
    funext z
    exact DFP.TwoPhaseOrbit.realizedObjective_apply orbit Clim Glim z
  have hHessianObj (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
      EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.realizedObjective Clim Glim) z =
        (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) +
          EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim) z := by
    calc
      EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.realizedObjective Clim Glim) z =
          fderiv ℝ (gradient (orbit.realizedObjective Clim Glim)) z := by
            rw [EuclideanPlane.hessian_def]
      _ = fderiv ℝ (gradient
          (fun y ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖y - Clim‖ ^ 2 +
            orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim y)) z := by rw [hobj]
      _ = 1 + fderiv ℝ (gradient (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim)) z :=
        HessianPerturbation.fderiv_gradient_halfNormSq_sub_add Clim
          (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim) z hPsi
      _ = (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) +
          EuclideanPlane.hessian (orbit.bumpCorrection Clim Glim) z := by
        rw [EuclideanPlane.hessian_def]
  rw [hHessianObj u, hHessianObj v]
  simpa only [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub] using
    (hHolder ε₀ hεHolder Clim hClim Glim hGlim hGlimTendsto u v)

    ∃ curve : DFP.TwoLeg.SlowCurve,
      ∃ εbar ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 4), ∃ L > 0,
        ∀ ε₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 εbar,

theorem hessianLowerBound_of_strongConvex {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] {f : F → ℝ} {μ : ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hstrong : StrongConvexOn Set.univ μ f) (x v : F) :
    μ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (gradient f) x v) v := by
  have horder : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) = (1 : ℕ∞) + 1 := by norm_num
  have hgradient : Differentiable ℝ (gradient f) := by
    rw [horder] at hf
    exact hf.gradient_succ.differentiable_one
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.differentiable two_ne_zero
  have hconvex := strongConvexOn_iff_convex.mp hstrong
  have hlineConvex : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ f (x + t • v) - μ / 2 * ‖x + t • v‖ ^ 2) := by
    have h := hconvex.comp_affineMap (AffineMap.lineMap x (x + v))
    simpa only [Set.preimage_univ, Function.comp_def, AffineMap.lineMap_apply_module',
      add_sub_cancel_left, add_comm] using h
  have hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt
      (fun s : ℝ ↦ f (x + s • v) - μ / 2 * ‖x + s • v‖ ^ 2)
      (inner ℝ (gradient f (x + t • v)) v - μ * inner ℝ (x + t • v) v) t := by
    intro t
    have hline : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ x + s • v) v t := by
      simpa only [one_smul] using (hasDerivAt_id' t).smul_const v |>.const_add x
    have hquad := hline.norm_sq.const_mul (μ / 2)
    have hquad' : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ μ / 2 * ‖x + s • v‖ ^ 2)
        (μ * inner ℝ (x + t • v) v) t := by
      convert! hquad using 1
      simp only [real_inner_comm v (x + t • v)]
      ring
    exact (hasDerivAt_line_objective hdiff x v t).sub hquad'
  have hmono : Monotone
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ inner ℝ (gradient f (x + t • v)) v - μ * inner ℝ (x + t • v) v) := by
    have h := hlineConvex.monotoneOn_deriv
      (fun t _ ↦ (hderiv t).differentiableAt)
    intro a b hab
    simpa only [(hderiv a).deriv, (hderiv b).deriv] using h (mem_univ a) (mem_univ b) hab
  have hlineZero : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ x + s • v) v 0 := by
    simpa only [one_smul] using (hasDerivAt_id' (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v |>.const_add x
  have hgradLine := (hgradient (x + (0 : ℝ) • v)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hlineZero
  have hinner := hgradLine.inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) v)
  have hlinear := (hlineZero.inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) v)).const_mul μ
  have hsecond := hinner.sub hlinear
  have hnonneg := hsecond.nonneg_of_monotone hmono
  simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero, inner_zero_right, zero_add,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, sub_nonneg] using hnonneg

    (hlower : ∀ z v, μ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤

      (iteration.point k) (iteration.point (k + 1) - iteration.point k))

    (hnot : ¬ Tendsto iteration.point atTop (𝓝 xstar)) :
    (∃ C > 0, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, 0 < freeCoefficient iteration k ∧
      freeCoefficient iteration k ≤ C * ‖step iteration (k - 1)‖ * ‖step iteration k‖) ∧

  have hprevious : N ≤ k - 1 := by omega
  have hindex : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
  have hraw := hN (k - 1) hprevious

    real_inner_comm] using hraw

    (hA : A.IsHermitian) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    inner ℝ (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A u) u ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 := by
  let T := Matrix.toEuclideanLin A
  have hs : T.IsSymmetric := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA
  have happly (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
      Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A v = T v := by
    exact congrArg (fun L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →ₗ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ↦ L v) (Matrix.coe_toEuclideanCLM_eq_toEuclideanLin A)
  let q := fun v : {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) // v ≠ 0} ↦
    inner ℝ (T v) v / ‖(v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ^ 2
  have hbounded : BddAbove (Set.range q) := by
    refine ⟨‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A‖, ?_⟩
    rintro z ⟨v, rfl⟩
    have hnorm := (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A).rayleighQuotient_le_norm v
    have hnorm' : |q v| ≤ ‖Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A‖ := by
      simpa only [q, ContinuousLinearMap.rayleighQuotient,
        ContinuousLinearMap.reApplyInnerSelf_apply, RCLike.re_to_real,
        happly] using hnorm
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans hnorm'
  have heigen : Module.End.HasEigenvalue T (⨆ v, q v) := by
    convert! hs.hasEigenvalue_iSup_of_finiteDimensional using 1
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs.exists_eigenvalues_eq finrank_euclideanSpace heigen
  have hune : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, norm_zero] at hu
    exact zero_ne_one hu
  have hunit : inner ℝ (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A u) u ≤ ⨆ v, q v := by
    have hbound := le_ciSup hbounded (⟨u, hune⟩ : {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) // v ≠ 0})
    simpa only [q, hu, one_pow, div_one, happly] using hbound
  have hmax : (⨆ v, q v) ≤ hA.eigenvalues₀ 0 := by
    rw [← hi, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀]
    exact hs.eigenvalues_antitone finrank_euclideanSpace (Fin.zero_le i)
  exact hunit.trans hmax

theorem source_smallestEigenvalue_tendsto_zero (iteration : DFP.SecantIteration 2)
    {μ c₁ c₂ : ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 iteration.objective) (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hlower : ∀ z v, μ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤
      inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (gradient iteration.objective) z v) v)
    (hStep : ∀ k, 0 < iteration.stepLength k)
    (hw : ∀ k, LineSearch.IsWeakWolfe c₁ c₂ iteration.objective
      (iteration.point k) (iteration.point (k + 1) - iteration.point k))
    (hdet : Tendsto (fun k ↦ (iteration.inverseHessian k).det) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun k ↦ (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef k).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 1)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hmax⟩ := source_maxEigenvalue_lower iteration hf hμ hlower hStep hw
  have hbound (k : ℕ) :
      (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 1 ≤
        M * (iteration.inverseHessian (k + 1)).det := by
    have hlowerMax := (hmax k).1.trans (hmax k).2
    have hscaled : 1 ≤ M * (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0 := by
      nlinarith [(div_le_iff₀ hM).mp hlowerMax]
    have hpositive := (orderedEigenvalue_pos (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)) 1).le
    have hproduct := orderedEigenvalues_product
      (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian
    calc
      (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 1 =
          1 * (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ (M * (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0) *
          (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscaled hpositive
      _ = M * ((iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 1 *
          (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 0) := by ring
      _ = M * (iteration.inverseHessian (k + 1)).det := by rw [hproduct]
  have hdetShift : Tendsto (fun k ↦ (iteration.inverseHessian (k + 1)).det) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    hdet.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun k ↦ M * (iteration.inverseHessian (k + 1)).det) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hdetShift.const_mul M
  have hminimum : Tendsto
      (fun k ↦ (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)).isHermitian.eigenvalues₀ 1)
      atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun k ↦ (orderedEigenvalue_pos (iteration.inverseHessianPosDef (k + 1)) 1).le)
      hbound hupper
  exact (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).mp hminimum

items.label: DFP.PlanarConvergence.SecantDegeneration.planarDegeneration
items.leanCode:
theorem planarDegeneration (iteration : DFP.SecantIteration 2) {μ c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 iteration.objective)
    (hstrong : StrongConvexOn Set.univ μ iteration.objective)
    (hμ : 0 < μ) (hStep : ∀ k, 0 < iteration.stepLength k)
    (hw : ∀ k, LineSearch.IsWeakWolfe c₁ c₂ iteration.objective
      (iteration.point k) (iteration.point (k + 1) - iteration.point k)) :
    ∃! xstar : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      (∀ z, iteration.objective xstar ≤ iteration.objective z) ∧
        (¬ Tendsto iteration.point atTop (𝓝 xstar) → DegenerationEstimates iteration) := by
  have hlower := hessianLowerBound_of_strongConvex hf hstrong
  obtain ⟨xstar, hmin, hunique⟩ := existsUniqueGlobalMinimizerOfHessian hf hμ hlower
  refine ⟨xstar, ⟨hmin, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro hnot
    obtain ⟨hproduct, hlimit⟩ := sourceFreeCoefficientDegeneration iteration hf hμ hlower
      hStep hw hmin hnot
    have hdet := determinant_tendsto_zero iteration hf hμ hlower hStep hlimit
    have hop := DFP.SecantIteration.orbitInverseHessianBoundedOfNonconvergence iteration
      hf hμ hlower hStep hw hmin hnot
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := hproduct
    have hbound' : ∃ C > 0, ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
        freeCoefficient iteration k ≤ C * ‖step iteration (k - 1)‖ * ‖step iteration k‖ :=
      ⟨C, hC, hbound.mono (fun k hk ↦ hk.2)⟩
    exact ⟨fun k _ ↦ freeCoefficient_pos iteration hf hμ hlower hStep k,
      hbound', hlimit, hop, hdet,
      source_smallestEigenvalue_tendsto_zero iteration hf hμ hlower hStep hw hdet⟩
  · intro z hz
    exact hunique z hz.1
items.statement:
lem:planar-degeneration (v21 Lemma7, GENERAL secant-search sequence).
A C² globally μ-strongly convex objective has a unique minimizer. Under nonconvergence,
an arbitrary nonstationary positive-definite search sequence satisfying fixed weak Wolfe
and the PREVIOUS SECANT equation has the source positive coefficient, adjacent-step
product bound and limit zero, a bounded full operator sequence, and smallest eigenvalue
tending to zero. No DFP update or Hessian Lipschitz hypothesis is imposed.

theorem feedbackCoefficient_local_bound (L K : ℝ) (hK : K ≠ 0) :
    ∃ B > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ A : ℝ, |A - K| < δ →
      |L * (K / A) ^ 2 - L| ≤ B * |A - K| := by
  have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun A : ℝ ↦ L * (K / A) ^ 2) K := by
    fun_prop
  have hbig : (fun A : ℝ ↦ L * (K / A) ^ 2 - L) =O[𝓝 K] (fun A ↦ A - K) := by
    simpa only [div_self hK, one_pow, mul_one] using hdiff.isBigO_sub
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbound⟩ := hbig.exists_pos
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδbound⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hbound.bound
  refine ⟨B, hB, δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  have hdist : dist A K < δ := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hA
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hδbound hdist

items.leanCode:
theorem feedbackDefect_error {t q L B Q : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htone : t ≤ 1)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hQ : q ≤ Q) (hsmall : Q * t ^ 3 ≤ 1)
    (herror : |q - L| ≤ B * t) :
    |(1 - Real.exp (-q * t ^ 3)) - L * t ^ 3| ≤ (Q ^ 2 + B) * t ^ 4 := by
  have hQt : 0 ≤ Q := hq.trans hQ
  have hpow : 0 ≤ t ^ 3 := pow_nonneg ht 3
  have hqu : 0 ≤ q * t ^ 3 := mul_nonneg hq hpow
  have hqupper : q * t ^ 3 ≤ 1 := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ hpow).trans hsmall
  have habs : |-q * t ^ 3| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [neg_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hqu]
    exact hqupper
  have hexp := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le habs
  have hlinear : |(q - L) * t ^ 3| ≤ B * t ^ 4 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hpow]
    calc
      |q - L| * t ^ 3 ≤ (B * t) * t ^ 3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right herror hpow
      _ = B * t ^ 4 := by ring
  have hsquare : (-q * t ^ 3) ^ 2 ≤ Q ^ 2 * t ^ 6 := by
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ hq hQ 2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (pow_nonneg ht 6)]
  have hexponents : (4 : ℕ) ≤ 6 := by norm_num
  have hpowers : t ^ 6 ≤ t ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one ht htone hexponents
  have hquad : |1 - Real.exp (-q * t ^ 3) - q * t ^ 3| ≤ Q ^ 2 * t ^ 4 := by
    have hsign : 1 - Real.exp (-q * t ^ 3) - q * t ^ 3 =
        -(Real.exp (-q * t ^ 3) - 1 - (-q * t ^ 3)) := by ring
    rw [hsign, abs_neg]
    exact hexp.trans (hsquare.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowers (sq_nonneg Q)))
  calc
    |(1 - Real.exp (-q * t ^ 3)) - L * t ^ 3| =
        |(1 - Real.exp (-q * t ^ 3) - q * t ^ 3) + (q - L) * t ^ 3| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |1 - Real.exp (-q * t ^ 3) - q * t ^ 3| + |(q - L) * t ^ 3| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (Q ^ 2 + B) * t ^ 4 := by linarith
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-corrections: Taylor's formula for the exact exponential
feedback preserves its cubic coefficient with a controlled fourth-order remainder.

theorem coefficientRatio_le (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    {κ A : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hbound : ∀ k, ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖ ≤ A * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 3)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖ / InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius p κ k ≤
      (A / κ) * p.scale (k / 2) := by
  have ht := ScaleTails.scale_pos p hstart (k / 2)
  have hρ : 0 < κ * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
  rw [InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius_apply]
  calc
    ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖ / (κ * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) ≤
        (A * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 3) / (κ * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hbound k) hρ.le
    _ = (A / κ) * p.scale (k / 2) := by
      field_simp

control gives a linear coefficient-to-radius bound for the exact prescribed supports.

    (hbound : ∀ k, ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖ ≤ A * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 3) :
    Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖ /
      InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius p κ k) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have htwo : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hscale := (ScaleTails.scale_tendsto_zero p).comp (Nat.tendsto_div_const_atTop htwo)

theorem coefficientHolder_le (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    {κ A : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hbound : ∀ k, ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖ ≤ A * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 3)

    ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖ *

  have hpower := Real.rpow_nonneg hκ.le (-3 / 2 : ℝ)

    ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖ *
        (κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) * (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 3)⁻¹) ≤

        (mul_nonneg hpower (inv_nonneg.mpr (pow_nonneg ht.le 3)))

theorem norm_polarCoefficient_odd (p : Parameters) (j : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 ≤ p.feedbackRate) (hr : 0 ≤ p.radius (2 * j + 1)) :

  have hsign : Real.exp (-(p.feedbackRate * (p.kStar / p.amplitude j) ^ 2) *
      p.scale j ^ 3) - 1 ≤ 0 := by linarith [hdefect.1]
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hsign]

theorem actualAmplitudeRadiusBounds :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ M > 0, ∃ K > 0, ∃ c > 0, ∃ B > 0,
        ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
          let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
          RadiusProducts.RadiusEstimates p (RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar) K c B ∧
            ∀ j, |p.amplitude j - p.kStar| ≤ M * p.scale j := by
  obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, htube⟩ := Continuation.actualTube
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hradii⟩ := RadiusProducts.polarRadiusProducts
  refine ⟨min η₀ η₁, lt_min hη₀ hη₁, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  have hnear₀ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₀) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))⟩
  have hnear₁ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₁) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_right _ _))⟩
  obtain ⟨hparameter, _, _, _, M, hM, J₀, hJ₀, htubeAll⟩ := htube νStar hnear₀
  obtain ⟨_, K, hK, c, hc, B, hB, J₁, hJ₁, hradiusAll⟩ := hradii νStar hnear₁
  refine ⟨hparameter, M, hM, K, hK, c, hc, B, hB,
    max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  refine ⟨hradiusAll j₀ ((le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀), ?_⟩
  intro j
  rw [amplitude_eq_normalized]
  exact (htubeAll j₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀) j).1

items.label: ActualObjective.coefficientEstimates_of_feedback
items.leanCode:
theorem coefficientEstimates_of_feedback {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ}
    {K c B S Q : ℝ} (hr : RadiusProducts.RadiusEstimates p D K c B)
    (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hL : 0 ≤ p.feedbackRate)
    (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hfeedback : ∀ j,
      |p.feedbackRate * (p.kStar / p.amplitude j) ^ 2 - p.feedbackRate| ≤ S * p.scale j ∧
        p.feedbackRate * (p.kStar / p.amplitude j) ^ 2 ≤ Q ∧ Q * p.scale j ^ 3 ≤ 1) :
    CoefficientEstimates p (Real.exp 1 * Q)
      (Real.exp 1 * (Q ^ 2 + S) + p.feedbackRate * (3 * (D 0 + D 1) + K)) := by
  have hodd : ∀ j,
      ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p (2 * j + 1)‖ ≤
          (Real.exp 1 * Q) * p.scale j ^ 3 ∧
        |‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p (2 * j + 1)‖ - p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3| ≤
          (Real.exp 1 * (Q ^ 2 + S) + p.feedbackRate * (3 * (D 0 + D 1) + K)) *
            p.scale j ^ 4 := by
    intro j
    let q := p.feedbackRate * (p.kStar / p.amplitude j) ^ 2
    have hq : 0 ≤ q := mul_nonneg hL (sq_nonneg _)
    have ht := ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j
    have htone := ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart j
    have hpow := pow_nonneg ht 3
    have hdefect := exp_neg_defect_bounds (mul_nonneg hq hpow)
    have hdefectUpper : 1 - Real.exp (-q * p.scale j ^ 3) ≤ Q * p.scale j ^ 3 := by
      rw [← neg_mul] at hdefect
      exact hdefect.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hfeedback j).2.1 hpow)
    have hrnonneg := (zero_lt_one.trans (hr.above_one (2 * j + 1))).le
    have hrUpper := hr.upper (2 * j + 1)
    have hnorm := norm_polarCoefficient_odd p j hL hrnonneg
    have herror := feedbackDefect_error ht htone hq (hfeedback j).2.1
      (hfeedback j).2.2 (hfeedback j).1
    have hquot : (2 * j + 1) / 2 = j := by omega
    have hRadError := (abs_le.mp (hr.expansion (2 * j + 1))).2
    rw [hquot] at hRadError
    have hexponents : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
    have hpowers : p.scale j ^ 2 ≤ p.scale j := by
      simpa only [pow_one] using pow_le_pow_of_le_one ht htone hexponents
    have hRad : p.radius (2 * j + 1) - 1 ≤ (3 * (D 0 + D 1) + K) * p.scale j := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowers hK
      linarith
    have hRadNonneg : 0 ≤ p.radius (2 * j + 1) - 1 := sub_nonneg.mpr (hr.above_one _).le
    constructor
    · rw [hnorm]
      calc
        (1 - Real.exp (-q * p.scale j ^ 3)) * p.radius (2 * j + 1) ≤
            (Q * p.scale j ^ 3) * Real.exp 1 :=
          mul_le_mul hdefectUpper hrUpper hrnonneg (mul_nonneg hQ hpow)
        _ = (Real.exp 1 * Q) * p.scale j ^ 3 := by ring
    · rw [hnorm]
      calc
        |(1 - Real.exp (-q * p.scale j ^ 3)) * p.radius (2 * j + 1) -
            p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3| =
            |((1 - Real.exp (-q * p.scale j ^ 3)) - p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) *
              p.radius (2 * j + 1) +
                (p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) * (p.radius (2 * j + 1) - 1)| := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ |((1 - Real.exp (-q * p.scale j ^ 3)) - p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) *
              p.radius (2 * j + 1)| +
            |(p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) * (p.radius (2 * j + 1) - 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ((Q ^ 2 + S) * p.scale j ^ 4) * Real.exp 1 +
            (p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) * ((3 * (D 0 + D 1) + K) * p.scale j) := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hrnonneg,
            abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hL hpow) hRadNonneg)]
          exact add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul herror hrUpper hrnonneg (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg Q) hS)
              (pow_nonneg ht 4)))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRad (mul_nonneg hL hpow))
        _ = (Real.exp 1 * (Q ^ 2 + S) +
            p.feedbackRate * (3 * (D 0 + D 1) + K)) * p.scale j ^ 4 := by ring
  constructor
  · intro k
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd' k with ⟨j, rfl | rfl⟩
    · rw [polarCoefficient_even, norm_zero]
      have ht := ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p (2 * j / 2)
      positivity
    · have hquot : (2 * j + 1) / 2 = j := by omega
      rw [hquot]
      exact (hodd j).1
  · intro j
    exact (hodd j).2

items.label: ActualObjective.actualCoefficientEstimates
items.leanCode:
theorem actualCoefficientEstimates :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ A > 0, ∃ E > 0, ∃ K > 0, ∃ c > 0, ∃ B > 0,
        ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
          let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
          RadiusProducts.RadiusEstimates p (RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar) K c B ∧
            CoefficientEstimates p A E ∧ 0 < p.feedbackRate := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hdata⟩ := actualAmplitudeRadiusBounds
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, M, hM, K, hK, c, hc, B, hB, J₀, hJ₀, hall⟩ := hdata νStar hnear
  let L := 4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)
  have ha := baseAngle_pos
  have hν : 0 < νStar := ha.trans hnear.1
  have hL : 0 < L := by
    dsimp only [L]
    positivity
  have hKstar : 0 < cycleK νStar := (TwoCycle.cycleFamily_mapsTo_positive hparameter).1
  obtain ⟨S, hS, δ, hδ, hlocal⟩ := feedbackCoefficient_local_bound L (cycleK νStar) hKstar.ne'
  let Q := L + S * M
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by positivity
  let R := 3 * (RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar 0 +
    RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar 1) + K
  have hD := RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficients_pos νStar hparameter
  have hD₀ := hD.1
  have hD₁ := hD.2
  have hR : 0 < R := by positivity
  have hE : 0 < Real.exp 1 * (Q ^ 2 + S * M) + L * R := by positivity
  have hcutoff : 0 < min (δ / (M + 1)) (1 / (Q + 1)) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨J₁, _, hscale⟩ := Continuation.existsStartThreshold _ hcutoff
  refine ⟨hparameter, Real.exp 1 * Q, mul_pos (Real.exp_pos 1) hQ,
    Real.exp 1 * (Q ^ 2 + S * M) + L * R, hE, K, hK, c, hc, B, hB,
      max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hj₀old : J₀ ≤ j₀ := (le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀
  have hj₀scale : J₁ ≤ j₀ := (le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀
  have hstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJ₀.trans_le hj₀old
  have hpL : p.feedbackRate = L := by
    rw [Parameters.feedbackRate_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  have hpK : p.kStar = cycleK νStar := by
    rw [Parameters.kStar_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  have hzero : p.scale 0 < min (δ / (M + 1)) (1 / (Q + 1)) := hscale νStar j₀ hj₀scale
  have hzeroδ := hzero.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hzeroQ := hzero.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hMone : 0 < M + 1 := by positivity
  have hQone : 0 < Q + 1 := by positivity
  have hfeedback : ∀ j,
      |p.feedbackRate * (p.kStar / p.amplitude j) ^ 2 - p.feedbackRate| ≤
          (S * M) * p.scale j ∧
        p.feedbackRate * (p.kStar / p.amplitude j) ^ 2 ≤ Q ∧ Q * p.scale j ^ 3 ≤ 1 := by
    intro j
    have ht := ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j
    have htone := ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart j
    have hscalej := ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hstart (Nat.zero_le j)
    have hamp := (hall j₀ hj₀old).2 j
    rw [hpK] at hamp
    have hampδ : |p.amplitude j - cycleK νStar| < δ := by
      nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ hMone).mp hzeroδ]
    have hqError : |L * (cycleK νStar / p.amplitude j) ^ 2 - L| ≤ S * M * p.scale j := by
      have hbound := (hlocal (p.amplitude j) hampδ).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hamp hS.le)
      simpa only [hpK, mul_assoc] using hbound
    have hqUpper : L * (cycleK νStar / p.amplitude j) ^ 2 ≤ Q := by
      have hsmall := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htone (mul_nonneg hS.le hM.le)
      have hbound := (abs_le.mp hqError).2
      dsimp only [Q]
      linarith
    have hexponents : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 3 := by norm_num
    have hpow : p.scale j ^ 3 ≤ p.scale j := by
      simpa only [pow_one] using pow_le_pow_of_le_one ht htone hexponents
    have hQsmall : Q * p.scale j ^ 3 ≤ 1 := by
      have hpower := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpow.trans hscalej) hQ.le
      nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ hQone).mp hzeroQ, ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p 0]
    rw [hpL, hpK]
    exact ⟨hqError, hqUpper, hQsmall⟩
  have hLp : 0 < p.feedbackRate := by
    rw [hpL]
    exact hL
  have hcoeff := coefficientEstimates_of_feedback (hall j₀ hj₀old).1 hstart hK.le
    hLp.le (mul_nonneg hS.le hM.le) hQ.le hfeedback
  rw [hpL] at hcoeff
  exact ⟨(hall j₀ hj₀old).1, hcoeff, hLp⟩

theorem CoefficientEstimates.norm_tendsto_zero {p : Parameters} {A E : ℝ}
    (h : CoefficientEstimates p A E) :
    Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have htwo : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hthree : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hscale := (ScaleTails.scale_tendsto_zero p).comp (Nat.tendsto_div_const_atTop htwo)
  have hlimit : Tendsto (fun k ↦ A * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 3) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, zero_pow hthree, mul_zero] using
      (hscale.pow 3).const_mul A
  exact squeeze_zero (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) h.norm_le hlimit

theorem gradient_norm_tendsto_one {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {K c B A E : ℝ}
    (hr : RadiusProducts.RadiusEstimates p D K c B) (ha : CoefficientEstimates p A E) :
    Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖p.gradient k‖) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hbound : ∀ k, ‖‖p.gradient k‖ - ‖p.point k‖‖ ≤
      ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p k‖ := by
    intro k

    exact abs_norm_sub_norm_le _ _

theorem CoefficientEstimates.odd_ratio_tendsto_one {p : Parameters} {A E : ℝ}
    (h : CoefficientEstimates p A E) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (hL : 0 < p.feedbackRate) :
    Tendsto (fun j ↦ ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p (2 * j + 1)‖ /
      (p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hbound : ∀ j, ‖‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p (2 * j + 1)‖ /
      (p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) - 1‖ ≤ (E / p.feedbackRate) * p.scale j := by
    intro j
    have ht := ScaleTails.scale_pos p hstart j
    have hden : 0 < p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3 := by positivity
    have hid : ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p (2 * j + 1)‖ /
        (p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) - 1 =
        (‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p (2 * j + 1)‖ -
          p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) / (p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) := by
      field_simp
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hid, abs_div, abs_of_pos hden]
    calc
      |‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p (2 * j + 1)‖ -
          p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3| / (p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) ≤
          (E * p.scale j ^ 4) / (p.feedbackRate * p.scale j ^ 3) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (h.odd_error j) hden.le
      _ = (E / p.feedbackRate) * p.scale j := by field_simp
  have hlimit : Tendsto (fun j ↦ (E / p.feedbackRate) * p.scale j) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using (ScaleTails.scale_tendsto_zero p).const_mul (E / p.feedbackRate)
  have hzero := squeeze_zero_norm hbound hlimit
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using hzero.add_const 1

theorem supportBalls_disjoint_of_separation (p : Parameters) {κ s : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hsmall : 2 * κ ≤ s)
    (hsep : ∀ k m, k ≠ m → s * max (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) (p.scale (m / 2) ^ 2) ≤
      ‖p.point m - p.point k‖) :
    Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint
      (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (p.point k) (InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius p κ k)) := by
  intro k _ m _ hkm
  apply Metric.ball_disjoint_ball
  rw [InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius_apply, InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius_apply,
    dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]
  have hmax : 0 ≤ max (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) (p.scale (m / 2) ^ 2) :=
    (sq_nonneg _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  calc
    κ * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 + κ * p.scale (m / 2) ^ 2 ≤
        κ * max (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) (p.scale (m / 2) ^ 2) +
          κ * max (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) (p.scale (m / 2) ^ 2) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) hκ)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) hκ)
    _ = (2 * κ) * max (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) (p.scale (m / 2) ^ 2) := by ring
    _ ≤ s * max (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) (p.scale (m / 2) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hmax
    _ ≤ ‖p.point m - p.point k‖ := hsep k m hkm

theorem hessian_eq_riesz_comp {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (f : F → ℝ) (x : F) :
    fderiv ℝ (gradient f) x =
      ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ F).symm : StrongDual ℝ F →L[ℝ] F) ∘L
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x := by
  have hfun : gradient f = (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ F).symm ∘ fderiv ℝ f := by
    rfl
  rw [hfun]
  exact LinearIsometryEquiv.comp_fderiv (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ F).symm

Fréchet derivative to the gradient Hessian without changing the source function.

theorem norm_hessian_sub_eq_secondFDeriv_sub {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (f : F → ℝ) (x y : F) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient f) x - fderiv ℝ (gradient f) y‖ =
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y‖ := by
  rw [hessian_eq_riesz_comp, hessian_eq_riesz_comp, ← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_sub]
  exact LinearIsometry.norm_toContinuousLinearMap_comp
    (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ F).symm.toLinearIsometry

theorem exists_positive_cutoff_bounds : ∃ Cχ > 0, CutoffBounds Cχ := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbounds⟩ :=
    InterpolationSum.exists_global_hessian_bounds (E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
  refine ⟨C + 1, add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hC zero_lt_one, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  intro c ρ a h B M hB hM hsize hholder
  obtain ⟨hsizeBound, hholderBound⟩ := hbounds c ρ a h B M hB hM hsize hholder
  constructor
  · intro x
    have hconstant : C ≤ C + 1 := by linarith
    exact (hsizeBound x).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hconstant hB)
  · intro x y
    have hconstant : 2 * C * M ≤ 2 * (C + 1) * M := by nlinarith
    exact (hholderBound x y).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hconstant (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))

theorem PreparedData.geometry {p : Parameters} {κ A E : ℝ} (h : PreparedData p κ A E)
    (hballs : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint
      (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (p.point k) (InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius p κ k))) :

items.label: ActualObjective.actualPreparedData
items.leanCode:
theorem actualPreparedData :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ A > 0, ∃ E > 0, ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        PreparedData (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) κ A E := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hdata⟩ := actualCoefficientEstimates
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, A, hA, E, hE, K, hK, c, _, B, _, J₀, hJ₀, hall⟩ := hdata νStar hnear
  refine ⟨A, hA, E, hE, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ
  let D := RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar
  have hD := RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficients_pos νStar hparameter
  have hDsum : 0 < D 0 + D 1 := add_pos hD.1 hD.2
  have hcutoff : 0 < 3 * (D 0 + D 1) / (K + 2 * κ + 1) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨J₁, _, hscale⟩ := Continuation.existsStartThreshold _ hcutoff
  refine ⟨max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hj₀old : J₀ ≤ j₀ := (le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀
  have hj₀scale : J₁ ≤ j₀ := (le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀
  obtain ⟨hr, ha, hL⟩ := hall j₀ hj₀old
  have hstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJ₀.trans_le hj₀old
  have hzero : p.scale 0 < 3 * (D 0 + D 1) / (K + 2 * κ + 1) :=
    hscale νStar j₀ hj₀scale
  have hden : 0 < K + 2 * κ + 1 := by positivity
  have hsmall : (K + 2 * κ) * p.scale 0 ≤ 3 * (D 0 + D 1) := by
    nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ hden).mp hzero, ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p 0]
  exact ⟨hstart, hκ, ha, hL,
    fun k ↦ norm_point p k (zero_lt_one.trans (hr.above_one k)).le,
    point_norm_tendsto_one hr, radialMargin_of_radius_error hr hstart hK.le hκ.le hsmall,
    coefficientRatio_tendsto_zero p hstart hκ ha.norm_le,
    coefficientRatio_le_start p hstart hκ hA.le ha.norm_le,
    coefficientHolder_le p hstart hκ ha.norm_le, gradient_norm_tendsto_one hr ha⟩

items.label: ActualObjective.objective_convexity_of_small_bound
items.leanCode:
theorem objective_convexity_of_small_bound {p : Parameters} {κ ε : ℝ}
    (hg : InterpolationSum.Geometry p.point (InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius p κ)
      (InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p))
    (hε : ε < 1)
    (hbound : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ)) x‖ ≤ ε) :
    HasHessianBounds (1 - ε) (1 + ε) (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) ∧
      StrongConvexOn Set.univ (1 - ε) (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) ∧
      ∀ x, ((1 - ε) / 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ x := by
  have hcont : ContDiff ℝ 2 (InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ) := by
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation_def]
    exact InterpolationSum.contDiff_perturbation hg
  have hfun : InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ =
      fun x ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖x - 0‖ ^ 2 + InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ x := by
    funext x
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarObjective_apply, sub_zero]
  have hpositive : 0 < 1 - ε := sub_pos.mpr hε
  have hHessian := HessianPerturbation.hasHessianBounds_halfNormSq_sub_add_of_secondFDeriv_norm_le
    (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ) ε
    hcont hbound
  have hconvex := HessianPerturbation.strongConvexOn_halfNormSq_add_of_secondFDeriv_norm_le
    (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ) ε
    hcont hε hbound
  rw [← hfun] at hHessian hconvex
  have hregular : ContDiff ℝ 2 (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) := by
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarObjective_def]
    exact InterpolationSum.contDiff_objective hg
  have hlower : ∀ x v, (1 - ε) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤
      inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (gradient (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ)) x v) v := by
    intro x v
    simpa only [hessian_def] using ((hHessian.at x).quadraticForm v).1
  have hzeroNorm : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ≤ 1 := by simp
  have hjet := perturbation_jets_on_disk hg hzeroNorm
  have hgradientZero : gradient (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hfun, HessianPerturbation.gradient_halfNormSq_sub_add]
    · simpa only [sub_self, zero_add] using hjet.2.1
    · exact (hcont.differentiable two_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  have hzero : InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ 0 = 0 := by
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarObjective_def]
    exact InterpolationSum.objective_zero hg
  refine ⟨hHessian, hconvex, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hgrowth := ContDiff.firstOrderOfHessianLowerBound _ (1 - ε)
    hregular hpositive hlower 0 x
  simpa only [hzero, hgradientZero, inner_zero_left, sub_zero, zero_add] using hgrowth
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-interpolation and eq:polar-objective: the source small
Hessian bound yields the uniform Loewner bounds, strong convexity and quadratic growth.
items.title: ActualObjective.objective_convexity_of_small_bound

theorem unique_minimizer_of_quadratic_growth {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    {f : F → ℝ} {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 < m) (hzero : f 0 = 0)
    (hgrowth : ∀ x, m * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ f x) (x : F) :
    (∀ y, f x ≤ f y) ↔ x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hmin
    have hupper := hmin 0
    rw [hzero] at hupper
    have hnorm : ‖x‖ = 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hnpos := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg x) (Ne.symm hn)
      have hpositive := mul_pos hm (sq_pos_of_pos hnpos)
      exact (not_lt_of_ge ((hgrowth x).trans hupper)) hpositive
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm
  · intro hx
    subst x
    intro y
    rw [hzero]
    exact (mul_nonneg hm.le (sq_nonneg _)).trans (hgrowth y)

items.label: ActualObjective.objectiveEstimatesOfPreparedData
items.leanCode:
theorem objectiveEstimatesOfPreparedData {p : Parameters} {κ A E ε Cχ : ℝ}
    (hp : PreparedData p κ A E) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hχ : CutoffBounds Cχ)
    (hballs : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint
      (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (p.point k) (InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius p κ k)))
    (hε : ε < 1) (hsmall : (Cχ * (A / κ)) * p.scale 0 ≤ ε) :
    ObjectiveEstimates p κ ε (Cχ * (A / κ)) (2 * Cχ * (A * κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ))) := by
  have hg := hp.geometry hballs
  have hB : 0 ≤ (A / κ) * p.scale 0 :=
    mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hA hp.support_pos.le) (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p 0)
  have hM : 0 ≤ A * κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) := mul_nonneg hA (Real.rpow_nonneg hp.support_pos.le _)
  obtain ⟨hsize, hholder⟩ := hχ.estimates p.point (InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius p κ)
    (InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p) hg ((A / κ) * p.scale 0)
      (A * κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ)) hB hM hp.ratio_bound hp.holder_bound
  have hsizeActual : ∀ x,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ)) x‖ ≤
        (Cχ * (A / κ)) * p.scale 0 := by
    intro x
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation_def]
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using hsize x
  have hholderActual : ∀ x y,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ)) x -
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ)) y‖ ≤
          (2 * Cχ * (A * κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ))) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation_def]
    exact hholder
  have hsmallActual : ∀ x,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ)) x‖ ≤ ε :=
    fun x ↦ (hsizeActual x).trans hsmall
  obtain ⟨hHessian, hconvex, hgrowth⟩ := objective_convexity_of_small_bound hg hε hsmallActual
  have hzero : InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ 0 = 0 := by
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarObjective_def]
    exact InterpolationSum.objective_zero hg
  have hregularPerturbation : ContDiff ℝ 2 (InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation p κ) := by
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarPerturbation_def]
    exact InterpolationSum.contDiff_perturbation hg
  have hregularObjective : ContDiff ℝ 2 (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) := by
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarObjective_def]
    exact InterpolationSum.contDiff_objective hg
  have hdisk : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖x‖ ≤ 1 →
      InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [InterpolationSum.polarObjective_def]
    exact InterpolationSum.objective_eq_quadratic_of_norm_le_one hg hx
  have hpositive : 0 < (1 - ε) / 2 := half_pos (sub_pos.mpr hε)
  exact ⟨hg, contDiff_polarBump p κ, tsupport_polarBump_subset_closedBall hg,
    polarPerturbation_eq_tsum hg, hregularPerturbation, hregularObjective,
    fun x hx ↦ perturbation_jets_on_disk hg hx.le, perturbation_jets_at_center hg,
    objective_endpoint hp hg, hdisk, hzero, hsizeActual,
    objective_hessian_bound hg hsizeActual,
    fun x ↦ (objective_hessian_bound hg hsizeActual x).trans hsmall,
    hholderActual, objective_hessian_holder hg hholderActual, hHessian, hconvex, hgrowth,
    unique_minimizer_of_quadratic_growth hpositive hzero hgrowth, hp.gradient_limit⟩

C² gluing theorem and cutoff bounds prove the objective conclusions from prepared

items.label: ActualObjective.actualInterpolationData
items.leanCode:
theorem actualInterpolationData :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ κ > 0, ∃ A > 0, ∃ E > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
        PreparedData p κ A E ∧ Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint
          (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (p.point k) (InterpolationSum.polarSupportRadius p κ k)) := by
  obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, hprepared⟩ := actualPreparedData
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hgeometry⟩ := PointGeometry.polarPointGeometry
  refine ⟨min η₀ η₁, lt_min hη₀ hη₁, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  have hnear₀ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₀) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))⟩
  have hnear₁ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₁) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_right _ _))⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA, E, hE, hprepareκ⟩ := hprepared νStar hnear₀
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, separation, hseparation, J₁, hJ₁, hpoints⟩ :=
    hgeometry νStar hnear₁
  let κ := separation / 4
  have hκ : 0 < κ := by positivity
  have hsmall : 2 * κ ≤ separation := by
    dsimp only [κ]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨J₀, hJ₀, hprepare⟩ := hprepareκ κ hκ
  refine ⟨κ, hκ, A, hA, E, hE, max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  have hprep := hprepare j₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  have hpoint := (hpoints j₀ ((le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)).2
  exact ⟨hprep, supportBalls_disjoint_of_separation _ hκ.le hsmall hpoint.separate⟩
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-support-radii and lem:polar-interpolation: actual source
separation fixes a positive support coefficient, and all remaining actual data estimates
hold uniformly after the final natural starting-index threshold.
items.title: ActualObjective.actualInterpolationData

items.label: ActualObjective.polarObjectiveEstimates
items.leanCode:
theorem polarObjectiveEstimates :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ κ > 0, ∃ C > 0, ∃ H > 0, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
        ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
          ObjectiveEstimates (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) κ ε C H := by
  obtain ⟨Cχ, hCχ, hχ⟩ := exists_positive_cutoff_bounds
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hactual⟩ := actualInterpolationData
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, A, hA, E, _, J₀, hJ₀, hdata⟩ := hactual νStar hnear
  let C := Cχ * (A / κ)
  let H := 2 * Cχ * (A * κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hC : 0 < C := mul_pos hCχ (div_pos hA hκ)
  have hH : 0 < H := by
    have hpower := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hκ (-3 / 2 : ℝ)
    positivity
  refine ⟨κ, hκ, C, hC, H, hH, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε hεone
  have hcutoff : 0 < ε / C := div_pos hε hC
  obtain ⟨J₁, _, hscale⟩ := Continuation.existsStartThreshold _ hcutoff
  refine ⟨max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  obtain ⟨hprepared, hballs⟩ := hdata j₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  have hzero : (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale 0 < ε / C :=
    hscale νStar j₀ ((le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  have hsmall : C * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale 0 ≤ ε := by
    nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ hC).mp hzero]
  exact objectiveEstimatesOfPreparedData hprepared hA.le hχ hballs hεone hsmall
items.statement:
lem:polar-interpolation and eq:polar-objective and eq:polar-endpoint-data:
the manuscript's exact actual correction sum is C² across the unit circle, has globally
half-Hölder Hessian, and realizes the original values, gradients and identity Hessians.
For the fixed support parameter chosen after νStar, every accuracy `0 < ε < 1` is attained
by one later natural threshold, uniformly over all larger starting indices. The resulting
objective is uniformly convex with unique origin minimizer and `f(0) = 0`.
items.title: ActualObjective.polarObjectiveEstimates

items.label: ActualObjective.polarHalfObjective
items.leanCode:
theorem polarHalfObjective :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ κ > 0, ∃ C > 0, ∃ H > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        ObjectiveEstimates (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) κ (1 / 2) C H := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hobjective⟩ := polarObjectiveEstimates
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, C, hC, H, hH, haccuracy⟩ := hobjective νStar hnear
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hhalfOne : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 := by norm_num
  exact ⟨κ, hκ, C, hC, H, hH, haccuracy (1 / 2) hhalf hhalfOne⟩
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-objective: the source accuracy ε = 1/2 gives the stated
uniformly convex actual objective, with all endpoint and Hölder conclusions.
items.title: ActualObjective.polarHalfObjective

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalize_apply
items.leanCode:
theorem normalize_apply (C : E) (G : ℝ) (x : E) :
    normalize C G x = G⁻¹ • (x - C) := by
  rfl
items.statement: Helper for sec:center-approach: the original affine normalization formula.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalize_apply

items.label: AffineInterpolation.denormalize_apply
items.leanCode:
theorem denormalize_apply (C : E) (G : ℝ) (z : E) :
    denormalize C G z = C + G • z := by
  rfl
items.statement: Helper for sec:center-approach: the original inverse affine formula.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.denormalize_apply

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalize_denormalize
items.leanCode:
theorem normalize_denormalize (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) (z : E) :
    normalize C G (denormalize C G z) = z := by
  simp only [normalize_apply, denormalize_apply, add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ hG, one_smul]
items.statement: Helper for sec:center-approach: normalizing the affine image recovers its coordinate.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalize_denormalize

items.label: AffineInterpolation.denormalize_normalize
items.leanCode:
theorem denormalize_normalize (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) (x : E) :
    denormalize C G (normalize C G x) = x := by
  simp only [denormalize_apply, normalize_apply, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hG, one_smul]
  abel
items.statement: Helper for sec:center-approach: the original physical point is recovered exactly.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.denormalize_normalize

items.label: AffineInterpolation.denormalize_sub
items.leanCode:
theorem denormalize_sub (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0) (z x : E) :
    denormalize C G z - x = G • (z - normalize C G x) := by
  rw [denormalize_apply, normalize_apply, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hG, one_smul]
  abel
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: differences from a physical center scale
by exactly G under the inverse coordinate map.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.denormalize_sub

items.label: AffineInterpolation.norm_normalize
items.leanCode:
theorem norm_normalize (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G) (x : E) :
    ‖normalize C G x‖ = ‖x - C‖ / G := by
  rw [normalize_apply, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hG.le)]
  ring
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: the normalized norm is the original radial
distance divided by the positive circle radius.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.norm_normalize

items.label: AffineInterpolation.norm_normalize_sub
items.leanCode:
theorem norm_normalize_sub (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G) (x y : E) :
    ‖normalize C G x - normalize C G y‖ = ‖x - y‖ / G := by
  have hsub : normalize C G x - normalize C G y = G⁻¹ • (x - y) := by
    rw [normalize_apply, normalize_apply, ← smul_sub]
    congr 1
    abel
  rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hG.le)]
  ring
items.statement: Helper for sec:center-approach: the normalized distance has its exact scalar factor.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.norm_normalize_sub

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalizedCenters_apply
items.leanCode:
theorem normalizedCenters_apply (C : E) (G : ℝ) (c : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) :
    normalizedCenters C G c k = normalize C G (c k) := by
  rfl
items.statement: Helper for sec:center-approach: evaluation of normalized centers.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalizedCenters_apply

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalizedRadii_apply
items.leanCode:
theorem normalizedRadii_apply (G : ℝ) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :

  rfl
items.statement: Helper for sec:center-approach: evaluation of normalized radii.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalizedRadii_apply

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalizedCoefficients_apply
items.leanCode:
theorem normalizedCoefficients_apply (G : ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) :
    normalizedCoefficients G a k = G⁻¹ • a k := by
  rfl
items.statement: Helper for sec:center-approach: evaluation of normalized coefficients.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalizedCoefficients_apply

items.label: AffineInterpolation.norm_normalizedCoefficients
items.leanCode:
theorem norm_normalizedCoefficients {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G) (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ = G⁻¹ * ‖a k‖ := by
  rw [normalizedCoefficients_apply, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hG.le)]
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: normalized coefficient norms have the
same positive inverse-radius factor as normalized support radii.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.norm_normalizedCoefficients

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalizedRatio_eq
items.leanCode:
theorem normalizedRatio_eq {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G)
    (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ / normalizedRadii G ρ k = ‖a k‖ / ρ k := by
  rw [norm_normalizedCoefficients hG, normalizedRadii_apply]
  calc
    _ = (G⁻¹ * G) * (‖a k‖ / ρ k) := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_div]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hG.ne', one_mul]
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: the coefficient-to-radius ratio is
unchanged by the exact circle normalization.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalizedRatio_eq

items.label: AffineInterpolation.mem_normalizedBall_iff
items.leanCode:
theorem mem_normalizedBall_iff (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G)
    (x z : E) (ρ : ℝ) :
    z ∈ Metric.ball (normalize C G x) (ρ / G) ↔
      denormalize C G z ∈ Metric.ball x ρ := by
  simp only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, denormalize_sub C hG.ne', norm_smul,
    Real.norm_of_nonneg hG.le]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using
    (lt_div_iff₀ hG : ‖z - normalize C G x‖ < ρ / G ↔
      ‖z - normalize C G x‖ * G < ρ)
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: normalized open balls are exactly the
inverse images of the ORIGINAL physical open balls.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.mem_normalizedBall_iff

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalizedBalls_disjoint
items.leanCode:
theorem normalizedBalls_disjoint (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G)
    (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hballs : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k))) :
    Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (normalizedCenters C G c k)
      (normalizedRadii G ρ k)) := by
  intro i hi j hj hij
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hzi hzj
  have hleft : denormalize C G z ∈ Metric.ball (c i) (ρ i) :=
    (mem_normalizedBall_iff C hG (c i) z (ρ i)).mp hzi
  have hright : denormalize C G z ∈ Metric.ball (c j) (ρ j) :=
    (mem_normalizedBall_iff C hG (c j) z (ρ j)).mp hzj
  exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hballs hi hj hij)) hleft hright
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: the manuscript's assumed disjoint OPEN
balls remain disjoint under exact circle normalization.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalizedBalls_disjoint

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalize_contDiff
items.leanCode:
theorem normalize_contDiff (C : E) (G : ℝ) {n : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ n (normalize C G) := by
  have hfun : normalize C G = fun x ↦ G⁻¹ • (x - C) := funext (normalize_apply C G)
  rw [hfun]
  exact (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).const_smul G⁻¹
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: the scalar affine map is smooth of every
finite order, including the fixed shifted-circle coordinate change.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalize_contDiff

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalize_hasFDerivAt
items.leanCode:
theorem normalize_hasFDerivAt (C : E) (G : ℝ) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (normalize C G) (G⁻¹ • (1 : E →L[ℝ] E)) x := by
  have h : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E ↦ G⁻¹ • (y - C)) (G⁻¹ • (1 : E →L[ℝ] E)) x :=
    ((hasFDerivAt_id x).sub_const C).const_smul (G⁻¹ : ℝ)
  simpa only [← normalize_apply] using h
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: the exact scalar derivative of the
normalized coordinate map.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalize_hasFDerivAt

items.label: AffineInterpolation.scaledPullback_apply
items.leanCode:
theorem scaledPullback_apply (C : E) (G : ℝ) (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    scaledPullback C G f x = G ^ 2 * f (normalize C G x) := by
  rfl
items.statement: Helper for sec:center-approach: evaluation of the exact scalar pullback.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.scaledPullback_apply

items.label: AffineInterpolation.scaledPullback_contDiff
items.leanCode:
theorem scaledPullback_contDiff (C : E) (G : ℝ) {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (scaledPullback C G f) := by
  have hfun : scaledPullback C G f = fun x ↦ G ^ 2 * f (normalize C G x) :=
    funext (scaledPullback_apply C G f)
  rw [hfun]
  exact contDiff_const.mul (hf.comp (normalize_contDiff C G))
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: the scalar pullback preserves C²
regularity once it has been PROVED for the normalized source sum.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.scaledPullback_contDiff

items.label: AffineInterpolation.fderiv_scaledPullback
items.leanCode:
theorem fderiv_scaledPullback (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0)
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (scaledPullback C G f) x = G • fderiv ℝ f (normalize C G x) := by
  have hraw := (((hf (normalize C G x)).hasFDerivAt).comp x
    (normalize_hasFDerivAt C G x)).const_smul (G ^ 2)
  have hfun : scaledPullback C G f = G ^ 2 • (f ∘ normalize C G) := by
    funext y
    rw [scaledPullback_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hfun, hraw.fderiv]
  have hfactor : G ^ 2 * G⁻¹ = G := by field_simp [hG]
  ext v
  simp only [smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, one_apply_eq_self,
    map_smul, smul_smul, hfactor]
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: one scalar factor cancels in the first
derivative of G² times the normalized function.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.fderiv_scaledPullback

items.label: AffineInterpolation.quadraticRadiusPower
items.leanCode:
theorem quadraticRadiusPower {t κ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    (κ * t ^ 2) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) = κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) * (t ^ 3)⁻¹ := by
  have hexponent : (2 : ℝ) * (-3 / 2) = -3 := by norm_num
  rw [Real.mul_rpow hκ.le (sq_nonneg t), ← Real.rpow_natCast_mul ht.le]
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  rw [hexponent, Real.rpow_neg ht.le, Real.rpow_ofNat]
items.statement:
Helper for cm-limiting-scales: quadratic support radii have precisely the
inverse three-halves power that cancels a cubic source coefficient.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.quadraticRadiusPower

items.label: AffineInterpolation.coefficientScaleBounds
items.leanCode:
theorem coefficientScaleBounds {t ρ s A κ : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hρ : κ * t ^ 2 ≤ ρ) (ha : s ≤ A * t ^ 3) :
    s / ρ ≤ (A / κ) * t ∧
      s / ρ ^ 2 ≤ (A / κ ^ 2) * t⁻¹ ∧
      s * ρ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ A * κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  have hlower : 0 < κ * t ^ 2 := mul_pos hκ (sq_pos_of_pos ht)
  have hpositive : 0 < ρ := hlower.trans_le hρ
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      s / ρ ≤ s / (κ * t ^ 2) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hs hlower hρ
      _ ≤ (A * t ^ 3) / (κ * t ^ 2) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ha hlower.le
      _ = _ := by field_simp [ht.ne', hκ.ne']
  · have hsquare : (κ * t ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hlower.le hρ 2
    calc
      s / ρ ^ 2 ≤ s / (κ * t ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hs (sq_pos_of_pos hlower) hsquare
      _ ≤ (A * t ^ 3) / (κ * t ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ha (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by field_simp [ht.ne', hκ.ne']
  · have hexponent : (-3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by norm_num
    have hpower := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hlower hρ hexponent
    have hproduct := mul_le_mul ha hpower (Real.rpow_nonneg hpositive.le _)
      (mul_nonneg hA (pow_nonneg ht.le 3))
    apply hproduct.trans_eq
    rw [quadraticRadiusPower ht hκ]
    field_simp [ht.ne']
items.statement:
Helper for cm-limiting-scales: cubic coefficients and a quadratic lower
radius bound give the linear, inverse-linear and uniform half-Hölder envelopes.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.coefficientScaleBounds

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalizedGeometry_of_scaleBounds
items.leanCode:
theorem normalizedGeometry_of_scaleBounds (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G)
    (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (t : ℕ → ℝ)
    (radialLower radialUpper κLow κHigh A tCap : ℝ)
    (hLower : 0 < radialLower) (hκLow : 0 < κLow) (hκHigh : 0 < κHigh)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hCap : 0 < tCap)
    (ht : ∀ k, 0 < t k) (ht0 : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) (htBound : ∀ k, t k ≤ tCap)
    (hradial : ∀ k, radialLower * t k ≤ ‖c k - C‖ - G ∧
      ‖c k - C‖ - G ≤ radialUpper * t k)
    (hradii : ∀ k, κLow * t k ^ 2 ≤ ρ k ∧ ρ k ≤ κHigh * t k ^ 2)
    (hcoefficients : ∀ k, ‖a k‖ ≤ A * t k ^ 3)
    (hsmall : 4 * κHigh * tCap < radialLower)
    (hballs : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k))) :
    InterpolationSum.Geometry (normalizedCenters C G c) (normalizedRadii G ρ)
      (normalizedCoefficients G a) := by
  have hρ : ∀ k, 0 < ρ k := by
    intro k
    exact (mul_pos hκLow (sq_pos_of_pos (ht k))).trans_le (hradii k).1
  have hgap : ∀ k, 0 ≤ ‖c k - C‖ - G := by
    intro k
    exact (mul_pos hLower (ht k)).le.trans (hradial k).1
  have hupperLimit : Tendsto (fun k ↦ radialUpper * t k) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using ht0.const_mul radialUpper
  have hgapLimit : Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖c k - C‖ - G) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero hgap (fun k ↦ (hradial k).2) hupperLimit
  have hnormLimit : Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖c k - C‖) atTop (𝓝 G) := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add] using hgapLimit.add_const G
  have hnormalizedLimit : Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖normalizedCenters C G c k‖) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simp only [normalizedCenters_apply, norm_normalize C hG]
    simpa only [div_self hG.ne'] using hnormLimit.div_const G
  have hratioBound : ∀ k,
      ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ / normalizedRadii G ρ k ≤ (A / κLow) * t k := by
    intro k
    rw [normalizedRatio_eq hG]
    exact (coefficientScaleBounds (ht k) hκLow (norm_nonneg _) hA
      (hradii k).1 (hcoefficients k)).1
  have hratioNonnegative : ∀ k, 0 ≤
      ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ / normalizedRadii G ρ k := by
    intro k
    rw [normalizedRatio_eq hG]
    exact div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (hρ k).le
  have hratioLimit : Tendsto
      (fun k ↦ ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ / normalizedRadii G ρ k) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hupper : Tendsto (fun k ↦ (A / κLow) * t k) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [mul_zero] using ht0.const_mul (A / κLow)
    exact squeeze_zero hratioNonnegative hratioBound hupper
  refine ⟨?_, normalizedBalls_disjoint C hG c ρ hballs, hnormalizedLimit, ?_, hratioLimit⟩
  · intro k
    rw [normalizedRadii_apply]
    exact div_pos (hρ k) hG
  · intro k
    have hcapProduct : 0 ≤ κHigh * tCap := mul_nonneg hκHigh.le hCap.le
    have hcoefficient : 2 * κHigh * t k ≤ radialLower := by
      have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (htBound k) (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hκHigh.le)
      nlinarith
    have hmargin : G + 2 * ρ k ≤ ‖c k - C‖ := by
      have hlinear := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoefficient (ht k).le
      nlinarith [(hradii k).2, (hradial k).1]
    rw [normalizedCenters_apply, norm_normalize C hG, normalizedRadii_apply]
    calc
      1 + 2 * (ρ k / G) = (G + 2 * ρ k) / G := by field_simp [hG.ne']
      _ ≤ ‖c k - C‖ / G := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hmargin hG.le
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach and cm-limiting-scales: raw linear radial
orders, quadratic radii, cubic coefficients and a small global cap imply every
PURE field of normalized Geometry. No analytic regularity is a premise.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalizedGeometry_of_scaleBounds

items.label: AffineInterpolation.bump_denormalize
items.leanCode:
theorem bump_denormalize (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0)
    (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ) (z : E) :
    InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k (denormalize C G z) = G ^ 2 *
      InterpolationSum.bump (normalizedCenters C G c) (normalizedRadii G ρ)
        (normalizedCoefficients G a) k z := by
  have hargument : ∀ v : E, (ρ k)⁻¹ • (G • v) = (ρ k / G)⁻¹ • v := by
    intro v
    rw [smul_smul, inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hfactor : G ^ 2 * G⁻¹ = G := by field_simp [hG]
  simp only [InterpolationSum.bump_apply, normalizedCenters_apply, normalizedRadii_apply,
    normalizedCoefficients_apply, denormalize_sub C hG, hargument,
    inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_left]
  calc
    _ = G * (ExplicitCutoff.chi ((ρ k / G)⁻¹ • (z - normalize C G (c k))) *
        inner ℝ (a k) (z - normalize C G (c k))) := by ring
    _ = (G ^ 2 * G⁻¹) *
        (ExplicitCutoff.chi ((ρ k / G)⁻¹ • (z - normalize C G (c k))) *
          inner ℝ (a k) (z - normalize C G (c k))) := by rw [hfactor]
    _ = _ := by ring
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: the SAME original χ correction transforms
by the exact factor G² under the shifted/scaled-circle coordinate map.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.bump_denormalize

items.label: AffineInterpolation.perturbation_denormalize
items.leanCode:
theorem perturbation_denormalize (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0)
    (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (z : E) :
    InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a (denormalize C G z) = G ^ 2 *
      InterpolationSum.perturbation (normalizedCenters C G c) (normalizedRadii G ρ)
        (normalizedCoefficients G a) z := by
  simp only [InterpolationSum.perturbation_apply, bump_denormalize C hG, ← mul_finsum]
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: exact affine normalization of the original
pointwise correction sum, with unchanged η/χ and unchanged physical bumps.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.perturbation_denormalize

items.label: AffineInterpolation.normalizedPerturbation_eq
items.leanCode:
theorem normalizedPerturbation_eq (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : G ≠ 0)
    (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (z : E) :
    (1 / G ^ 2) * InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a (denormalize C G z) =
      InterpolationSum.perturbation (normalizedCenters C G c) (normalizedRadii G ρ)
        (normalizedCoefficients G a) z := by
  rw [perturbation_denormalize C hG, one_div, ← mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hG), one_mul]
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach: the manuscript's normalization is precisely
G⁻² times the physical sum evaluated at C+Gz.
items.title: AffineInterpolation.normalizedPerturbation_eq

items.label: AffineInterpolation.bump_eq_correction

theorem hessian_finiteSum {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E → ℝ) :
    (∀ i ∈ s, ContDiff ℝ 2 (f i)) → ∀ x,
      hessian (fun y ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, f i y) x = ∑ i ∈ s, hessian (f i) x := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      intro _ x
      simpa only [Finset.sum_empty] using hessian_zero (E := E) x
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      intro hf x
      have hfi := hf i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)
      have hfs : ∀ j ∈ s, ContDiff ℝ 2 (f j) := by
        intro j hj
        exact hf j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
      have hfun : (fun y ↦ ∑ j ∈ insert i s, f j y) =
          f i + (fun y ↦ ∑ j ∈ s, f j y) := by
        funext y
        simp only [Finset.sum_insert hi, Pi.add_apply]
      rw [hfun, hessian_add hfi (ContDiff.sum hfs), ih hfs, Finset.sum_insert hi]

Helper for sec:center-approach: a finite family of C² original corrections
has exactly the finite sum of its Hessian operators.

    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, ContDiff ℝ 2 (f i))
    (hholder : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x y, ‖hessian (f i) x - hessian (f i) y‖ ≤
      H i * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (x y : E) :
    ‖hessian (fun z ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, f i z) x - hessian (fun z ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, f i z) y‖ ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, H i) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  rw [hessian_finiteSum s f hf, hessian_finiteSum s f hf, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖hessian (f i) x - hessian (f i) y‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, H i * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi ↦ hholder i hi x y)
    _ = _ := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm

theorem hessianBounds_of_normalizedGeometry (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G)
    {c : ℕ → E} {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℕ → E}
    (h : InterpolationSum.Geometry (normalizedCenters C G c) (normalizedRadii G ρ)
      (normalizedCoefficients G a)) {B M : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hsize : ∀ k, ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ / normalizedRadii G ρ k ≤ B)
    (hscaled : ∀ k, ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ *
      (normalizedRadii G ρ k) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ M) :
    ∃ D H : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ 0 < H ∧
      (∀ x, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) x‖ ≤ D * B) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) x -
        hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hbound⟩ := InterpolationSum.exists_global_hessian_bounds (E := E)
  have hb := hbound _ _ _ h B M hB hM hsize hscaled
  have hsmooth := InterpolationSum.contDiff_perturbation h
  have hconstant : 0 ≤ 2 * D * M * (G⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hD) hM)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hG.le) _)
  refine ⟨D, 2 * D * M * (G⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 1, hD,
    lt_add_of_le_of_pos hconstant zero_lt_one, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [perturbation_eq_scaledPullback C hG.ne', hessian_scaledPullback C hG.ne' hsmooth,
      norm_hessian_eq]
    exact hb.1 _
  · intro x y
    rw [perturbation_eq_scaledPullback C hG.ne', hessian_scaledPullback C hG.ne' hsmooth,
      hessian_scaledPullback C hG.ne' hsmooth, norm_hessianDifference_eq]
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 * D * M * ‖normalize C G x - normalize C G y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := hb.2 _ _
      _ = (2 * D * M * (G⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [norm_normalize_sub C hG, div_eq_mul_inv,
          Real.mul_rpow (norm_nonneg _) (inv_nonneg.mpr hG.le)]
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one)
        (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)

theorem normalizedScaledCoefficientBound {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G)
    (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (t : ℕ → ℝ) {κ A : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : ∀ k, 0 < t k)
    (hρ : ∀ k, κ * t k ^ 2 ≤ ρ k) (ha : ∀ k, ‖a k‖ ≤ A * t k ^ 3) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ * (normalizedRadii G ρ k) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
      (A / G) * (κ / G) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  have hlower : (κ / G) * t k ^ 2 ≤ normalizedRadii G ρ k := by
    rw [normalizedRadii_apply, div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hρ k) hG.le
  have hcoeff : ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ ≤ (A / G) * t k ^ 3 := by
    rw [norm_normalizedCoefficients hG]
    calc
      G⁻¹ * ‖a k‖ ≤ G⁻¹ * (A * t k ^ 3) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ha k) (inv_nonneg.mpr hG.le)
      _ = _ := by ring
  exact (coefficientScaleBounds (ht k) (div_pos hκ hG) (norm_nonneg _)
    (div_nonneg hA hG.le) hlower hcoeff).2.2
