theorem interpolateCircle_of_scaleBounds (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G)
    (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (t : ℕ → ℝ)
    (radialLower radialUpper κLow κHigh A tCap : ℝ)
    (hLower : 0 < radialLower) (hκLow : 0 < κLow) (hκHigh : 0 < κHigh)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hCap : 0 < tCap)
    (ht : ∀ k, 0 < t k) (ht0 : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) (htBound : ∀ k, t k ≤ tCap)
    (hradial : ∀ k, radialLower * t k ≤ ‖c k - C‖ - G ∧
      ‖c k - C‖ - G ≤ radialUpper * t k)
    (hradii : ∀ k, κLow * t k ^ 2 ≤ ρ k ∧ ρ k ≤ κHigh * t k ^ 2)
    (hcoefficients : ∀ k, ‖a k‖ ≤ A * t k ^ 3)
    (hsmall : 4 * κHigh * tCap < radialLower)
    (hballs : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k))) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) ∧
      (∀ x, ‖x - C‖ ≤ G → InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a x = 0 ∧
        gradient (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) x = 0 ∧
        hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) x = 0) ∧
      ∃ D H : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ 0 < H ∧
        (∀ x, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) x‖ ≤ D * tCap) ∧
        (∀ x y, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) x -
          hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
  have hgeometry := normalizedGeometry_of_scaleBounds C hG c ρ a t
    radialLower radialUpper κLow κHigh A tCap hLower hκLow hκHigh hA hCap
    ht ht0 htBound hradial hradii hcoefficients hsmall hballs
  have hB : 0 ≤ (A / κLow) * tCap := mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hA hκLow.le) hCap.le
  have hM : 0 ≤ (A / G) * (κLow / G) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hA hG.le) (Real.rpow_nonneg (div_nonneg hκLow.le hG.le) _)
  have hsize : ∀ k, ‖normalizedCoefficients G a k‖ / normalizedRadii G ρ k ≤
      (A / κLow) * tCap := by
    intro k
    rw [normalizedRatio_eq hG]
    exact (coefficientScaleBounds (ht k) hκLow (norm_nonneg _) hA
      (hradii k).1 (hcoefficients k)).1.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (htBound k) (div_nonneg hA hκLow.le))
  obtain ⟨D, H, hD, hH, hsizeSum, hholder⟩ := hessianBounds_of_normalizedGeometry C hG
    hgeometry hB hM hsize
    (normalizedScaledCoefficientBound hG ρ a t hκLow hA ht (fun k ↦ (hradii k).1) hcoefficients)
  refine ⟨perturbation_contDiff_of_normalizedGeometry C hG.ne' hgeometry,
    fun x hx ↦ perturbation_disk_jets C hG hgeometry hx,
    D * (A / κLow), H, mul_nonneg hD (div_nonneg hA hκLow.le), hH, ?_, hholder⟩
  intro x
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using hsizeSum x
items.statement:
Helper for sec:center-approach and cm-limiting-scales: raw source orders
and a fixed small cap give C², a vanishing two-jet on the closed disk, a full-sum
Hessian bound of order tCap, and a global half-Hölder Hessian.

theorem finiteCorrectionSum_holder (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E)
    (hρ : ∀ k, 0 < ρ k) (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ H : ℝ, 0 ≤ H ∧ ∀ x y,
      ‖hessian (finiteCorrectionSum c ρ a N) x - hessian (finiteCorrectionSum c ρ a N) y‖ ≤
        H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := InterpolationBounds.exists_norm_hessian_correction_sub_le (E := E)
  have hconstants : ∀ k, 0 ≤ K * ‖a k‖ * (ρ k) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    intro k
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK (norm_nonneg _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg (hρ k).le _)
  refine ⟨∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, K * ‖a k‖ * (ρ k) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ),
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ ↦ hconstants k), ?_⟩
  have hfun : finiteCorrectionSum c ρ a N =
      fun x ↦ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k x :=
    funext (finiteCorrectionSum_apply c ρ a N)
  rw [hfun]
  apply hessian_finiteSum_holder
  · intro k _
    exact (InterpolationSum.contDiff_bump c ρ a k).of_le
      (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  · intro k _ x y
    rw [norm_hessianDifference_eq, bump_eq_correction]
    exact hbound _ _ _ x y (hρ k)

whether its balls have a margin from the limiting circle.

theorem perturbation_regular_of_eventualBounds (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G)
    (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (t : ℕ → ℝ)
    (radialLower radialUpper κLow κHigh A : ℝ)
    (hLower : 0 < radialLower) (hUpper : 0 < radialUpper)
    (hκLow : 0 < κLow) (hκHigh : 0 < κHigh) (hA : 0 < A)
    (ht : ∀ k, 0 < t k) (ht0 : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) (hρ : ∀ k, 0 < ρ k)
    (hOrders : ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      radialLower * t k ≤ ‖c k - C‖ - G ∧
      ‖c k - C‖ - G ≤ radialUpper * t k ∧
      κLow * t k ^ 2 ≤ ρ k ∧ ρ k ≤ κHigh * t k ^ 2 ∧ ‖a k‖ ≤ A * t k ^ 3)
    (hballs : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k))) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) ∧
      ∃ H : ℝ, 0 < H ∧ ∀ x y,
        ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) x -
          hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  let tCap := min radialUpper (radialLower / (8 * κHigh))
  have hdenom : 0 < 8 * κHigh := by positivity
  have hCap : 0 < tCap := lt_min hUpper (div_pos hLower hdenom)
  have hsmall : 4 * κHigh * tCap < radialLower := by
    have hfactor : 0 ≤ 4 * κHigh := by positivity
    have hstrict : 4 * κHigh * (radialLower / (8 * κHigh)) < radialLower := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc]
      apply (div_lt_iff₀ hdenom).mpr
      nlinarith [mul_pos hLower hκHigh]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right _ _) hfactor).trans_lt hstrict
  have heventual : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, t k ≤ tCap ∧
      radialLower * t k ≤ ‖c k - C‖ - G ∧
      ‖c k - C‖ - G ≤ radialUpper * t k ∧
      κLow * t k ^ 2 ≤ ρ k ∧ ρ k ≤ κHigh * t k ^ 2 ∧ ‖a k‖ ≤ A * t k ^ 3 := by
    filter_upwards [hOrders, ht0.eventually_lt_const hCap] with k hk hcap
    exact ⟨hcap.le, hk⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp heventual
  have htail (k : ℕ) := hN (k + N) (Nat.le_add_left N k)
  have htailLimit := ht0.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat N)
  obtain ⟨hTailC2, _, D, Htail, _, hHtail, _, hTailHolder⟩ :=
    interpolateCircle_of_scaleBounds C hG
      (fun k ↦ c (k + N)) (fun k ↦ ρ (k + N)) (fun k ↦ a (k + N))
      (fun k ↦ t (k + N)) radialLower radialUpper κLow κHigh A tCap
      hLower hκLow hκHigh hA.le hCap (fun k ↦ ht (k + N)) htailLimit
      (fun k ↦ (htail k).1)
      (fun k ↦ ⟨(htail k).2.1, (htail k).2.2.1⟩)
      (fun k ↦ ⟨(htail k).2.2.2.1, (htail k).2.2.2.2.1⟩)
      (fun k ↦ (htail k).2.2.2.2.2) hsmall (tailBalls_disjoint c ρ hballs N)
  have hPrefixC2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (finiteCorrectionSum c ρ a N) :=
    (finiteCorrectionSum_contDiff c ρ a N).of_le
      (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl 2)
  obtain ⟨Hprefix, hHprefix, hPrefixHolder⟩ := finiteCorrectionSum_holder c ρ a hρ N
  rw [perturbation_split c ρ a hρ hballs N]
  refine ⟨hPrefixC2.add hTailC2, Hprefix + Htail, add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hHprefix hHtail, ?_⟩
  intro x y
  rw [hessian_add hPrefixC2 hTailC2, hessian_add hPrefixC2 hTailC2, add_sub_add_comm]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖hessian (finiteCorrectionSum c ρ a N) x - hessian (finiteCorrectionSum c ρ a N) y‖ +
        ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation (fun k ↦ c (k + N))
          (fun k ↦ ρ (k + N)) (fun k ↦ a (k + N))) x -
          hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation (fun k ↦ c (k + N))
            (fun k ↦ ρ (k + N)) (fun k ↦ a (k + N))) y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ Hprefix * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + Htail * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      add_le_add (hPrefixHolder x y) (hTailHolder x y)
    _ = _ := (add_mul _ _ _).symm

items.leanCode:
theorem interpolateCircle_of_eventualBounds (C : E) {G : ℝ} (hG : 0 < G)
    (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (t : ℕ → ℝ)
    (radialLower radialUpper κLow κHigh A : ℝ)
    (hLower : 0 < radialLower) (hUpper : 0 < radialUpper)
    (hκLow : 0 < κLow) (hκHigh : 0 < κHigh) (hA : 0 < A)
    (ht : ∀ k, 0 < t k) (ht0 : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) (hρ : ∀ k, 0 < ρ k)
    (hOrders : ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      radialLower * t k ≤ ‖c k - C‖ - G ∧
      ‖c k - C‖ - G ≤ radialUpper * t k ∧
      κLow * t k ^ 2 ≤ ρ k ∧ ρ k ≤ κHigh * t k ^ 2 ∧ ‖a k‖ ≤ A * t k ^ 3)
    (hballs : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint (fun k ↦ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k))) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ 2 (shiftedObjective C (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a)) ∧
      (∃ H : ℝ, 0 < H ∧
        (∀ x y, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) x -
          hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧
        (∀ x y, ‖hessian (shiftedObjective C (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a)) x -
          hessian (shiftedObjective C (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a)) y‖ ≤
            H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ k, InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a (c k) = 0 ∧
        gradient (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) (c k) = a k ∧
        hessian (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) (c k) = 0) ∧
      (∀ k, shiftedObjective C (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a) (c k) =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖c k - C‖ ^ 2 ∧
        gradient (shiftedObjective C (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a)) (c k) =
          c k - C + a k ∧
        hessian (shiftedObjective C (InterpolationSum.perturbation c ρ a)) (c k) = 1) := by
  obtain ⟨hsmooth, H, hH, hholder⟩ := perturbation_regular_of_eventualBounds C hG c ρ a t
    radialLower radialUpper κLow κHigh A hLower hUpper hκLow hκHigh hA ht ht0 hρ hOrders hballs
  have hjets := perturbation_center_jets c ρ a hρ hballs

    ⟨H, hH, hholder, shiftedObjective_holder C hsmooth hholder⟩, hjets, ?_⟩
  intro k
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [shiftedObjective_apply, (hjets k).1, add_zero]
  · rw [gradient_shiftedObjective C (hsmooth.differentiable two_ne_zero), (hjets k).2.1]
  · rw [hessian_shiftedObjective C hsmooth, (hjets k).2.2, add_zero]

items.leanCode:
theorem exists_bump_hessian_bounds :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (k : ℕ), 0 < ρ k →
      (∀ x, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) x‖ ≤ K * (‖a k‖ / ρ k)) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) x -
        hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) y‖ ≤
          K * (‖a k‖ / ρ k ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) x -
        hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) y‖ ≤
          K * (‖a k‖ * (ρ k) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ)) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨Ksize, hKsize, hsize⟩ := ExplicitCutoff.exists_norm_secondFDeriv_correction_le (E := E)
  obtain ⟨Klip, hKlip, hlip⟩ := InterpolationBounds.exists_norm_hessian_correction_sub_le_lipschitz
    (E := E)
  obtain ⟨Kholder, hKholder, hholder⟩ := InterpolationBounds.exists_norm_hessian_correction_sub_le
    (E := E)
  let K := max Ksize (max Klip Kholder)
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := hKsize.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hKsize' : Ksize ≤ K := le_max_left _ _
  have hKlip' : Klip ≤ K := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hKholder' : Kholder ≤ K := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
  intro c ρ a k hρ
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [norm_hessian_eq, bump_eq_correction]
    calc
      _ ≤ Ksize * ‖a k‖ / ρ k := hsize _ _ _ x hρ
      _ = Ksize * (‖a k‖ / ρ k) := mul_div_assoc _ _ _

      _ = (Klip * (‖a k‖ / ρ k ^ 2)) * ‖x - y‖ := by rw [mul_div_assoc]
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKlip' (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)))
        (norm_nonneg _)

    rw [norm_hessianDifference_eq, bump_eq_correction]
    calc
      _ ≤ Kholder * ‖a k‖ * (ρ k) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=

theorem bump_hessian_orders (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (t : ℕ → ℝ)
    {κ A : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : ∀ k, 0 < t k)
    (hρ : ∀ k, κ * t k ^ 2 ≤ ρ k) (ha : ∀ k, ‖a k‖ ≤ A * t k ^ 3) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ k,
      (∀ x, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) x‖ ≤ K * (A / κ) * t k) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) x -
        hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) y‖ ≤
          K * (A / κ ^ 2) * (t k)⁻¹ * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) x -
        hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) y‖ ≤
          K * (A * κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ)) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := exists_bump_hessian_bounds (E := E)
  refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
  intro k
  have hpositive : 0 < ρ k := (mul_pos hκ (sq_pos_of_pos (ht k))).trans_le (hρ k)
  have hscale := coefficientScaleBounds (ht k) hκ (norm_nonneg _) hA (hρ k) (ha k)
  have hb := hbound c ρ a k hpositive
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    have hscaled : K * (‖a k‖ / ρ k) ≤ K * (A / κ) * t k := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale.1 hK
    exact (hb.1 x).trans hscaled
  · intro x y
    calc
      _ ≤ K * (‖a k‖ / ρ k ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖ := hb.2.1 x y
      _ ≤ (K * ((A / κ ^ 2) * (t k)⁻¹)) * ‖x - y‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale.2.1 hK) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring
  · intro x y
    exact (hb.2.2 x y).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale.2.2 hK) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))

    (c : ℕ → E) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → E) (t : ℕ → ℝ)
    {κ A : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : ∀ k, 0 < t k)
    (hOrders : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, κ * t k ^ 2 ≤ ρ k ∧ ‖a k‖ ≤ A * t k ^ 3) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      (∀ x, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) x‖ ≤ K * (A / κ) * t k) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) x -
        hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) y‖ ≤
          K * (A / κ ^ 2) * (t k)⁻¹ * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) x -
        hessian (InterpolationSum.bump c ρ a k) y‖ ≤
          K * (A * κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ)) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧
      ‖a k‖ * (ρ k) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ A * κ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := exists_bump_hessian_bounds (E := E)
  refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hOrders] with k hk
  have hpositive : 0 < ρ k := (mul_pos hκ (sq_pos_of_pos (ht k))).trans_le hk.1
  have hscale := coefficientScaleBounds (ht k) hκ (norm_nonneg _) hA hk.1 hk.2
  have hb := hbound c ρ a k hpositive
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hscale.2.2⟩
  · intro x
    have hscaled : K * (‖a k‖ / ρ k) ≤ K * (A / κ) * t k := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale.1 hK
    exact (hb.1 x).trans hscaled
  · intro x y
    calc
      _ ≤ K * (‖a k‖ / ρ k ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖ := hb.2.1 x y
      _ ≤ (K * ((A / κ ^ 2) * (t k)⁻¹)) * ‖x - y‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale.2.1 hK) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring
  · intro x y
    exact (hb.2.2 x y).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale.2.2 hK) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))

items.label: AngularGeometry.unitRoot_bounds

theorem unitRoot_bounds {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htone : t ≤ 1) :
    1 ≤ Normalized.unitRoot t ∧ Normalized.unitRoot t ≤ 2 := by
  have hroot : 0 ≤ Normalized.unitRoot t := by
    rw [Normalized.unitRoot_def]
    exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hcube := unitRoot_cube ht
  have htCube : t ^ 3 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ ht htone
  have hthree : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
    norm_num
  constructor
  · apply (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ zero_le_one hroot hthree).mp
    norm_num only [one_pow]
    linarith [pow_nonneg ht 3]
  · apply (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ hroot (zero_le_two : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) hthree).mp
    norm_num
    linarith

Helper for lem:polar-geometry and eq:polar-angles: on scales in `[0,1]`

theorem angleFactor_bounds {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htone : t ≤ 1) :
    9 * baseAngle / 7 ≤ Normalized.angleFactor t ∧
      Normalized.angleFactor t ≤ 3 * baseAngle := by
  have hroot := unitRoot_bounds ht htone
  have hdenomLower : 3 ≤ Normalized.unitRoot t ^ 2 + Normalized.unitRoot t + 1 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Normalized.unitRoot t - 1)]
  have hdenomUpper : Normalized.unitRoot t ^ 2 + Normalized.unitRoot t + 1 ≤ 7 := by
    have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ (zero_le_one.trans hroot.1) hroot.2 2
    nlinarith
  have hdenomPos : 0 < Normalized.unitRoot t ^ 2 + Normalized.unitRoot t + 1 := by
    linarith
  have ha := baseAngle_pos
  have hnum : 0 ≤ 9 * baseAngle := by
    positivity
  have hthree : (0 : ℝ) < 3 := by
    norm_num
  rw [Normalized.angleFactor_def]
  constructor
  · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hdenomPos hdenomUpper
  · have hupper := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hnum hthree hdenomLower
    linarith

items.label: AngularGeometry.stageAngleFactor_bounds
items.leanCode:
theorem stageAngleFactor_bounds (i : Fin 2) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htone : t ≤ 1) :
    3 * baseAngle / 7 ≤ Normalized.stageAngleFactor i t ∧
      Normalized.stageAngleFactor i t ≤ 2 * baseAngle := by
  have ha := baseAngle_pos
  have hweight := stageWeight_bounds i
  have hfactor := angleFactor_bounds ht htone
  have hweightNonneg : 0 ≤ Normalized.stageWeight i := by
    linarith
  have hfactorNonneg : 0 ≤ Normalized.angleFactor t := by
    have hconstant : 0 < 9 * baseAngle / 7 := by
      positivity
    linarith
  have hlowerNonneg : 0 ≤ 9 * baseAngle / 7 := by
    positivity
  rw [Normalized.stageAngleFactor_def]
  constructor
  · calc
      3 * baseAngle / 7 = (1 / 3) * (9 * baseAngle / 7) := by ring
      _ ≤ Normalized.stageWeight i * (9 * baseAngle / 7) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hweight.1 hlowerNonneg
      _ ≤ Normalized.stageWeight i * Normalized.angleFactor t :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfactor.1 hweightNonneg
  · calc
      Normalized.stageWeight i * Normalized.angleFactor t ≤ (2 / 3) * Normalized.angleFactor t :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hweight.2 hfactorNonneg
      _ ≤ (2 / 3) * (3 * baseAngle) := by
        linarith [hfactor.2]
      _ = 2 * baseAngle := by ring

theorem angleIncrement_bounds (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (k : ℕ) :

      p.angleIncrement k ≤ (2 * baseAngle) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := by

items.label: AngularGeometry.firstCrossings_strictMono

theorem firstCrossings_strictMono {a b : ℕ → ℝ} {P : ℝ} {K : ℕ}
    (hmono : Monotone a) (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop) (hP : 0 < P)
    (hgap : ∀ n, b (n + 1) - b n = P)
    (hsmall : ∀ k, K ≤ k → a (k + 1) - a k < P)
    (hafter : ∀ n, a K < b n) :
    StrictMono (fun n ↦ firstCrossing a ha (b n)) := by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro n
  by_contra hnot
  have hle : firstCrossing a ha (b (n + 1)) ≤ firstCrossing a ha (b n) :=
    Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot
  rcases hle.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
  · have hbefore := firstCrossing_before a ha (b n) hlt
    have hcross := firstCrossing_spec a ha (b (n + 1))
    linarith [hgap n]
  · have hafterIndex := firstCrossing_after hmono ha (hafter n)
    have hpositive : 0 < firstCrossing a ha (b n) :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le K) hafterIndex
    have hpred : firstCrossing a ha (b n) - 1 < firstCrossing a ha (b n) := by
      omega
    have hbefore := firstCrossing_before a ha (b n) hpred
    have hcross := firstCrossing_spec a ha (b (n + 1))
    have hKpred : K ≤ firstCrossing a ha (b n) - 1 := by
      omega
    have hstep := hsmall (firstCrossing a ha (b n) - 1) hKpred
    have hsucc : firstCrossing a ha (b n) - 1 + 1 = firstCrossing a ha (b n) := by
      omega
    rw [hsucc] at hstep
    rw [heq] at hcross
    linarith [hgap n]

theorem firstCrossing_overshoot_tendsto {a b : ℕ → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop)
    (hstrict : StrictMono (fun n ↦ firstCrossing a ha (b n)))
    (hpositive : ∀ n, 0 < firstCrossing a ha (b n))
    (hstep : Tendsto (fun k ↦ a (k + 1) - a k) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ a (firstCrossing a ha (b n)) - b n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hpred : Tendsto (fun n ↦ firstCrossing a ha (b n) - 1) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_sub_atTop_nat 1).comp hstrict.tendsto_atTop
  have hnormalize (n : ℕ) : firstCrossing a ha (b n) - 1 + 1 = firstCrossing a ha (b n) :=
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (hpositive n)
  have hpredStep : Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ a (firstCrossing a ha (b n)) - a (firstCrossing a ha (b n) - 1))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, hnormalize] using hstep.comp hpred
  exact squeeze_zero
    (fun n ↦ (firstCrossing_overshoot_bounds a ha (b n) (hpositive n)).1)
    (fun n ↦ (firstCrossing_overshoot_bounds a ha (b n) (hpositive n)).2) hpredStep

items.label: AngularGeometry.exists_periodic_firstCrossings
items.leanCode:
theorem exists_periodic_firstCrossings {a : ℕ → ℝ} (hmono : StrictMono a)
    (ha : Tendsto a atTop atTop) (hstep : Tendsto (fun k ↦ a (k + 1) - a k) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (P : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (φ : ℝ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ,
      StrictMono (fun n ↦ firstCrossing a ha (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * P)) ∧
      (∀ n, a 0 < φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * P) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ a (firstCrossing a ha (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * P)) -
        (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * P)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hstep.eventually_lt_const hP)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((a K - φ) / P)
  have hlevel : a K < φ + (N : ℝ) * P := by
    have hscaled := (div_lt_iff₀ hP).mp hN
    linarith
  have hafter (n : ℕ) : a K < φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * P := by
    have hcast : (N : ℝ) ≤ ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right N n
    have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcast hP.le
    linarith
  have hgap (n : ℕ) : (φ + ((N + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * P) -
      (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * P) = P := by
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    ring
  have hstrict := firstCrossings_strictMono hmono.monotone ha hP hgap hK hafter
  have hpositive (n : ℕ) : 0 < firstCrossing a ha (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * P) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le K) (firstCrossing_after hmono.monotone ha (hafter n))
  refine ⟨N, hstrict, ?_, firstCrossing_overshoot_tendsto ha hstrict hpositive hstep⟩
  intro n
  exact (hmono.monotone (Nat.zero_le K)).trans_lt (hafter n)

items.label: AngularGeometry.exists_directional_firstCrossings
items.leanCode:
theorem exists_directional_firstCrossings (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (φ : ℝ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ j : ℕ → ℕ,
      StrictMono j ∧ Tendsto j atTop atTop ∧
      (∀ n, p.angle 0 < φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      (∀ n, φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) ≤ p.angle (j n)) ∧
      (∀ n k, k < j n → p.angle k < φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ p.angle (j n) - (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)))
        atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ polarUnit (p.angle (j n))) atTop (𝓝 (polarUnit φ)) := by
  have ha := angle_tendsto_atTop p hstart
  have hstep : Tendsto (fun k ↦ p.angle (k + 1) - p.angle k) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [← funext (Parameters.angleIncrement_def p)]
    exact angleIncrement_tendsto_zero p hstart
  have hperiod : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by
    positivity
  obtain ⟨N, hstrict, hlevel, herror⟩ := exists_periodic_firstCrossings
    (angle_strictMono p hstart) ha hstep (2 * Real.pi) hperiod φ
  let j : ℕ → ℕ := fun n ↦ firstCrossing p.angle ha (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))
  have hcross (n : ℕ) : φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) ≤ p.angle (j n) :=
    firstCrossing_spec p.angle ha _
  have hbefore (n k : ℕ) (hk : k < j n) :
      p.angle k < φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) :=
    firstCrossing_before p.angle ha _ hk
  have hangleLimit : Tendsto
      (fun n ↦ φ + (p.angle (j n) - (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi))))
      atTop (𝓝 φ) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.add herror
  have hnormalize (n : ℕ) : polarUnit (p.angle (j n)) =
      polarUnit (φ + (p.angle (j n) - (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)))) := by
    have hangle : p.angle (j n) =
        (φ + (p.angle (j n) - (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)))) +
          ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      ring
    calc
      polarUnit (p.angle (j n)) = polarUnit
          ((φ + (p.angle (j n) - (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)))) +
            ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) := congrArg polarUnit hangle
      _ = polarUnit (φ + (p.angle (j n) - (φ + ((N + n : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)))) :=
        polarUnit_add_natPeriod _ (N + n)
  have hpolar : Tendsto (fun n ↦ polarUnit (p.angle (j n))) atTop (𝓝 (polarUnit φ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, hnormalize] using
      (continuous_polarUnit.tendsto φ).comp hangleLimit
  exact ⟨N, j, hstrict, hstrict.tendsto_atTop, hlevel, hcross, hbefore, herror, hpolar⟩

theorem polar_chord_coordinates (r s θ φ : ℝ) :
    ‖r • polarUnit θ - s • polarUnit φ‖ ^ 2 =

  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]

    polarUnit_apply_zero, polarUnit_apply_one]

items.label: AngularGeometry.polar_chord_sq
items.leanCode:
theorem polar_chord_sq (r s θ φ : ℝ) :
    ‖r • polarUnit θ - s • polarUnit φ‖ ^ 2 =
      (r - s) ^ 2 + 4 * r * s * Real.sin ((θ - φ) / 2) ^ 2 := by
  have hhalf := Real.sin_sq_eq_half_sub ((θ - φ) / 2)
  have hdouble : 2 * ((θ - φ) / 2) = θ - φ := by
    ring
  rw [hdouble, Real.cos_sub] at hhalf
  rw [polar_chord_coordinates]
  have hθ := congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ r ^ 2 * z) (Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ)
  have hφ := congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ s ^ 2 * z) (Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq φ)
  have hhalfScaled := congrArg (fun z : ℝ ↦ 4 * r * s * z) hhalf
  nlinarith

    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcast (sq_nonneg _)).trans
      (nearWindow_mul_scale_sq_le p hstart k)
  have hspan : (2 * baseAngle) * (m - k : ℕ) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.pi := by
    have hcoefficient : 0 ≤ 2 * baseAngle := by
      positivity
    have hbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount hcoefficient
    rw [baseAngle_def] at hbound ⊢
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hspan⟩
  · nlinarith [hsumLower]
  · nlinarith [hsumUpper]

theorem existsStartThreshold (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ νStar : ℝ, ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
      (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale 0 < ε := by

  have hbound := hJ j₀ ((le_max_left J 1).trans hj₀)

items.label: Continuation.existsActualEstimateNeighborhood
items.leanCode:
theorem existsActualEstimateNeighborhood :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧
      ∃ rate > (1 / 3 : ℝ), ∃ r > 0, ∃ ρ > 0,
      ∃ Cfast > 0, ∃ Ccross > 0, ∃ Cslow > 0, ∃ D > 0, ∃ δ > 0,
        TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar (cycleK νStar) = 0 ∧
        (∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r),
          ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter A ∧
            A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧ 0 < A ∧
            -D ≤ deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A ∧
              deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A ≤ -rate) ∧
        ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r),
          ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, FastContraction.fixedNorm u ≤ ρ →
            ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ →
              FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError
                (Normalized.map (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar) t
                  (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u))) ≤
                    (3 / 4 : ℝ) * FastContraction.fixedNorm u + Cfast * t ^ 3 ∧
              |(Normalized.map (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar) t
                (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u)).1 -
                  (A + t ^ 3 * TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar A)| ≤
                    Ccross * t ^ 3 * FastContraction.fixedNorm u + Cslow * t ^ 4 := by
  obtain ⟨rSlow, hrSlow, rate, hrate, ηSlow, hηSlow, hslow⟩ := SlowCoupling.polarSlowBound
  obtain ⟨rFast, hrFast, hfast⟩ := FastRemainder.polarFastBound
  obtain ⟨ηFast, hηFast, hfastNear⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hfast
  refine ⟨min ηSlow ηFast, lt_min hηSlow hηFast, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hνStar
  have hνSlow : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + ηSlow) := by
    refine ⟨hνStar.1, ?_⟩
    exact hνStar.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left ηSlow ηFast))
  have hνFast : dist νStar baseAngle < ηFast := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hνStar.1)]
    linarith [hνStar.2, min_le_right ηSlow ηFast]
  obtain ⟨hparameter, s, hs, Ccross, hCcross, Cslow, hCslow, δSlow, hδSlow,
    heq, hslowBranch⟩ := hslow νStar hνSlow
  obtain ⟨_, Cfast, hCfast, δFast, hδFast, U, hU, hfastBranch⟩ := hfastNear hνFast
  obtain ⟨rU, hrU, hUball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU
  let r := min s (rU / 2)
  let ρ := min rSlow rFast / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hs (half_pos hrU)
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := half_pos (lt_min hrSlow hrFast)
  have hρSlow : ρ < rSlow :=
    (half_lt_self (lt_min hrSlow hrFast)).trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hρFast : ρ < rFast :=
    (half_lt_self (lt_min hrSlow hrFast)).trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hslowInterval : ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r),
      A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - s) (cycleK νStar + s) := by
    intro A hA
    have hrs : r ≤ s := min_le_left _ _
    constructor
    · linarith [hA.1]
    · linarith [hA.2]
  have hfastNeighborhood : ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r), A ∈ U := by
    intro A hA
    apply hUball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
    have hAr : |A - cycleK νStar| ≤ r := by
      apply abs_le.mpr
      constructor
      · linarith [hA.1]
      · linarith [hA.2]
    exact hAr.trans_lt ((min_le_right s (rU / 2)).trans_lt (half_lt_self hrU))
  have hregular : ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r),
      A ≠ 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter A := by
    intro A hA
    have hproperties := hslowBranch A (hslowInterval A hA)
    exact ⟨hproperties.2.2.1.ne', hproperties.1⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hlower⟩ := TubeBounds.restoringDrift_compact_deriv_lower νStar
    (Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r)) isCompact_Icc hregular
  refine ⟨hparameter, rate, hrate, r, hr, ρ, hρ, Cfast, hCfast,
    Ccross, hCcross, Cslow, hCslow, D, hD, min δSlow δFast,
    lt_min hδSlow hδFast, heq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro A hA
    have hproperties := hslowBranch A (hslowInterval A hA)
    exact ⟨hproperties.1, hproperties.2.1, hproperties.2.2.1,
      hlower A hA, hproperties.2.2.2.1⟩
  · intro A hA u hu t ht htδ
    have hfastEstimate := (hfastBranch A (hfastNeighborhood A hA)).2 u
      (hu.trans_lt hρFast) t ht (htδ.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
    have hslowEstimate := (hslowBranch A (hslowInterval A hA)).2.2.2.2 u
      (hu.trans_lt hρSlow) t ht (htδ.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
    exact ⟨hfastEstimate, hslowEstimate⟩
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the actual accepted slow and fast
estimates hold on one closed slow interval and one strictly interior fast
tolerance, with a finite two-sided drift derivative bound.
items.title: Continuation.existsActualEstimateNeighborhood

items.label: Continuation.actualTube
items.leanCode:
theorem actualTube :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter (cycleK νStar) ∧
      ∃ N > 0, ∃ M > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧
        ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ j : ℕ,
          |((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j).1 -
            (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).kStar| ≤ M * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ∧
          FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError
            ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j)) ≤
              N * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ^ 3 ∧
          ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j).1 ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
            0 < ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j).1 := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hestimates⟩ := existsActualEstimateNeighborhood
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hνStar
  obtain ⟨hparameter, rate, hrate, r, hr, ρ, hρ, Cfast, hCfast, Ccross, hCcross,
    Cslow, hCslow, D, hD, δ, hδ, heq, hbranch, hstep⟩ := hestimates νStar hνStar
  have hγnonnegative : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 := by norm_num
  have hγ : (3 / 4 : ℝ) < 1 := by norm_num
  have hdiff : ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A := by
    intro A hA
    have hregular := hbranch A hA
    exact (TwoCycle.restoringDrift_analyticAt νStar A
      hregular.2.2.1.ne' hregular.1).differentiableAt
  have hderiv : ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r),
      -D ≤ deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A ∧
        deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A ≤ -rate := by
    intro A hA
    exact ⟨(hbranch A hA).2.2.2.1, (hbranch A hA).2.2.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hNmargin, M, hM, hMmargin, εTube, hεTube, _, hTube⟩ :=
    TubeBounds.existsFixedNormTube_of_estimates (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar)
      (cycleK νStar) (3 / 4) Cfast Ccross Cslow rate D r ρ hγnonnegative hγ
      hCfast.le hCcross.le hCslow.le hrate hr hρ heq hdiff hderiv
  have hfastMargin : 0 < N - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * N - Cfast := by linarith
  have hslowMargin : 0 < (rate - 1 / 3) * M - Cslow := sub_pos.mpr hMmargin
  obtain ⟨εGeometry, hεGeometry, _, hgeometry⟩ :=
    TubeBounds.existsScaleThreshold N M Cfast Ccross D r ρ
      (N - (3 / 4 : ℝ) * N - Cfast) ((rate - 1 / 3) * M - Cslow)
      hr hρ hfastMargin hslowMargin
  let ε := min εTube (min εGeometry (δ / 2))
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min hεTube (lt_min hεGeometry (half_pos hδ))
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hstartBound⟩ := existsStartThreshold ε hε
  have hcenter : cycleK νStar ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r) := by
    constructor
    · linarith
    · linarith
  refine ⟨hparameter, (hbranch _ hcenter).1, N, hN, M, hM, J, hJ, ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  let u : ℕ → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun j ↦ FastContraction.fastError (p.normalizedEvenState j)
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun j ↦ (p.normalizedEvenState j).1 - cycleK νStar
  have hstart : 0 < j₀ := hJ.trans_le hj₀
  have hpstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using hstart
  have hsmall : p.scale 0 < ε := hstartBound νStar j₀ hj₀
  have hscales : ∀ j, p.scale j ≤ ε := by
    intro j
    exact ((ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hpstart) (Nat.zero_le j)).trans hsmall.le
  have hsmallTube : p.scale 0 ≤ εTube := hsmall.le.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hpν : p.cycleParameter ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_cycleParameter] using hparameter
  have hpk : p.kStar = cycleK νStar := by
    rw [Parameters.kStar_def]
    simp only [p, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  have hinitial := StageFeasibility.initial_errors_zero p hpstart hpν
  have huzero : u 0 = 0 := hinitial.2
  have hbzero : b 0 = 0 := by simpa only [b, hpk] using hinitial.1
  have hupdates : ∀ j, 0 < p.scale j → p.scale j ≤ εTube →
      FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) ≤ N * p.scale j ^ 3 → |b j| ≤ M * p.scale j →
      FastContraction.fixedNorm (u (j + 1)) ≤
        (3 / 4 : ℝ) * FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) + Cfast * p.scale j ^ 3 +
          Cfast * FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) ^ 2 ∧
      |b (j + 1) - TubeBounds.scalarStep (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar)
        (cycleK νStar) (p.scale j) (b j)| ≤
          Ccross * p.scale j ^ 3 * FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) +
            Cslow * p.scale j ^ 4 := by
    intro j ht _ hqin hbin
    have htGeometry : p.scale j ≤ εGeometry :=
      ((hscales j).trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have htδ : p.scale j < δ :=
      (((hscales j).trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans
        (min_le_right εGeometry (δ / 2))).trans_lt (half_lt_self hδ)
    have hregion := hgeometry (p.scale j) ht htGeometry
    have hslowRadius : |(p.normalizedEvenState j).1 - cycleK νStar| ≤ r :=
      hbin.trans hregion.1
    have hA : (p.normalizedEvenState j).1 ∈
        Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r) := by
      have habs := abs_le.mp hslowRadius
      constructor
      · linarith [habs.1]
      · linarith [habs.2]
    have hfastRadius : FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) ≤ ρ := hqin.trans hregion.2.1
    have hactual := hstep (p.normalizedEvenState j).1 hA (u j) hfastRadius
      (p.scale j) ht.le htδ
    dsimp only [u] at hactual
    rw [perturbedState_fastError] at hactual
    have hrec : p.normalizedEvenState (j + 1) =
        Normalized.map (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar)
          (p.scale j) (p.normalizedEvenState j) :=
      normalizedEvenState_of_succ j₀ νStar j hstart
    rw [← hrec] at hactual
    constructor
    · have hquadratic : 0 ≤ Cfast * FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) ^ 2 :=
        mul_nonneg hCfast.le (sq_nonneg _)
      exact hactual.1.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hquadratic)
    · have hslow := hactual.2
      rw [← SlowCoupling.slowStepError_eq (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) (cycleK νStar)
        (p.normalizedEvenState j).1 (p.normalizedEvenState (j + 1)).1 (p.scale j)] at hslow
      exact hslow
  have hall := hTube p hpstart hsmallTube u b huzero hbzero hupdates
  intro j
  obtain ⟨_, _, hfastBound, hslowBound, _, hslowRadius⟩ := hall j
  have hA : (p.normalizedEvenState j).1 ∈
      Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r) := by
    have habs := abs_le.mp hslowRadius
    dsimp only [b] at habs
    constructor
    · linarith [habs.1]
    · linarith [habs.2]
  refine ⟨?_, hfastBound, (hbranch _ hA).2.1, (hbranch _ hA).2.2.1⟩
  simpa only [b, p, Parameters.kStar_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter] using hslowBound

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the actual prescribed normalized

items.label: Continuation.continuousAt_perturbedState
items.leanCode:
theorem continuousAt_perturbedState (A : ℝ) (hA : A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet)
    (hν : ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter A) :
    ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) ↦ FastRemainder.perturbedState z.1 z.2)
      (A, 0) := by
  have hcurve : ContinuousAt
      (fun z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) ↦ TwoCycle.evenState z.1) (A, 0) :=
    (TwoCycle.evenState_analyticAt A hA hν).continuousAt.comp_of_eq continuousAt_fst rfl
  have hC := hcurve.snd.fst
  have hV := hcurve.snd.snd
  have hu0 : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) ↦ z.2 0) (A, 0) :=
    (continuous_apply 0).continuousAt.comp continuousAt_snd
  have hu1 : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) ↦ z.2 1) (A, 0) :=
    (continuous_apply 1).continuousAt.comp continuousAt_snd
  simp only [FastRemainder.perturbedState_apply, FastContraction.fastCoordinates_apply,
    Pi.add_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
  fun_prop

items.label: Continuation.statesNearCycle_of_uniformTube
items.leanCode:
theorem statesNearCycle_of_uniformTube (νStar : ℝ)
    (hparameter : νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet)
    (hν : ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter (cycleK νStar))
    (N M : ℝ) (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M) (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J)
    (htube : ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ j : ℕ,
      |((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j).1 -
        (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).kStar| ≤ M * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ∧
      FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError
        ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j)) ≤
          N * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ^ 3)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ J' : ℕ, J ≤ J' ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J', ∀ j : ℕ,
      (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j ∈
        Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK νStar)) R := by
  have hK : cycleK νStar ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet :=
    TwoCycle.cycleK_bijOn_parameterSet.mapsTo hparameter
  have hcurve := continuousAt_perturbedState (cycleK νStar) hK hν
  have hball : Metric.ball (TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK νStar)) R ∈
      𝓝 (FastRemainder.perturbedState (cycleK νStar) 0) := by
    rw [FastRemainder.perturbedState_zero]
    exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hR
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hnear⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hcurve.eventually hball)
  let B := ‖FastContraction.matrixOperator FastContraction.basisMatrix‖ + 1
  have hB : 0 < B := by
    dsimp only [B]
    positivity
  have hbase := ScaleTails.scale_tendsto_zero (Parameters.of 0 baseAngle)
  have hslowLimit : Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ M * (Parameters.of 0 baseAngle).scale n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hbase.const_mul M
  have hfastLimit : Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ B * N * (Parameters.of 0 baseAngle).scale n ^ 3) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (hbase.pow 3).const_mul (B * N)
  have heventually : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      M * (Parameters.of 0 baseAngle).scale n < a ∧
        B * N * (Parameters.of 0 baseAngle).scale n ^ 3 < a := by
    filter_upwards [hslowLimit.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds ha),
      hfastLimit.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds ha)] with n hslow hfast
    exact ⟨hslow, hfast⟩
  obtain ⟨J₀, hJ₀⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp heventually
  refine ⟨max J J₀, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀ j
  have hjTube : J ≤ j₀ := (le_max_left J J₀).trans hj₀
  have hjTail : J₀ ≤ j₀ := (le_max_right J J₀).trans hj₀
  have hstart : 0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).startIndex := by
    simpa only [Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJ.trans_le hjTube
  have hscale : (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ≤ (Parameters.of 0 baseAngle).scale j₀ := by
    have hmonotone := (ScaleTails.scale_antitone (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) hstart) (Nat.zero_le j)
    simpa only [Parameters.scale_def, Parameters.of_startIndex,
      Nat.zero_add, Nat.add_zero] using hmonotone
  have htail := hJ₀ j₀ hjTail
  have hbounds := htube j₀ hjTube j
  let x := (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j
  let u := FastContraction.fastError x
  have hslow : |x.1 - cycleK νStar| < a := by
    have hbound : |x.1 - cycleK νStar| ≤ M * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j := by
      simpa only [x, Parameters.kStar_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter] using hbounds.1
    exact (hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale hM.le)).trans_lt htail.1
  have hfast : ‖u‖ < a := by
    have hnorm : ‖u‖ ≤ B * FastContraction.fixedNorm u := by
      have hraw := FastContraction.norm_le_basisOperator_mul_fixedNorm u
      have hnonnegative := FastContraction.fixedNorm_nonneg u
      dsimp only [B]
      nlinarith
    have hpowers : (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ^ 3 ≤
        (Parameters.of 0 baseAngle).scale j₀ ^ 3 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg _ _) hscale 3
    calc
      ‖u‖ ≤ B * FastContraction.fixedNorm u := hnorm
      _ ≤ B * (N * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ^ 3) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbounds.2 hB.le
      _ ≤ B * (N * (Parameters.of 0 baseAngle).scale j₀ ^ 3) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowers hN.le) hB.le
      _ = B * N * (Parameters.of 0 baseAngle).scale j₀ ^ 3 := by ring
      _ < a := htail.2
  have hinput : dist (x.1, u) (cycleK νStar, (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) < a := by
    rw [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, dist_zero_right]
    exact max_lt hslow hfast
  have hstate := hnear hinput
  rw [perturbedState_fastError] at hstate
  exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr hstate.le

items.label: Continuation.existsPrescribedCycleFeasibility
items.leanCode:
theorem existsPrescribedCycleFeasibility (νStar : ℝ)
    (hparameter : νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet) :
    ∃ R > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ j₀ : ℕ, 0 < j₀ → ∀ j : ℕ,
      (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ≤ δ →
      (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j ∈
        Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK νStar)) R →
        ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).evenMatrix j).PosDef ∧
          0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).evenMatrix j 0 1 ∧
        ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).oddMatrix j).PosDef ∧
          0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).oddMatrix j 0 1 ∧
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).sigma (2 * j) ∧
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).sigma (2 * j + 1) ∧
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).radiusRatio (2 * j) ∧
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).radiusRatio (2 * j + 1) := by
  have hK : cycleK νStar ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet :=
    TwoCycle.cycleK_bijOn_parameterSet.mapsTo hparameter
  obtain ⟨R, hR, δ, hδ, _, _, hfeasible⟩ :=
    StageFeasibility.exists_uniform_rawCycleFeasibility
      (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar) (cycleK νStar) hK
  refine ⟨R, hR, δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hstart j htδ hx
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hpstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using hstart
  have ht := ScaleTails.scale_pos p hpstart j
  have hZ := Parameters.evenMatrix_isHermitian p j
  have hL : p.feedbackRate = 4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar) := by
    rw [Parameters.feedbackRate_def]
    simp only [p, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  have hKp : p.kStar = cycleK νStar := by
    rw [Parameters.kStar_def]
    simp only [p, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  have hcoordinates : Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) (p.evenMatrix j) ∈
      Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK νStar)) R := by
    rw [← StageFeasibility.normalizedEvenState_eq_coordinates]
    exact hx
  have hraw := hfeasible (p.scale j) ⟨ht, htδ⟩ (p.evenMatrix j) hZ hcoordinates
  rw [← hL, ← hKp] at hraw
  obtain ⟨hPE, hCE, hPO, hCO, _, _, hσE, hσO, hWE, hWO, _⟩ := hraw
  rw [StageFeasibility.rawFirstStage_prescribed p j (p.evenMatrix j) hpstart,
    ← Parameters.oddMatrix_def p j] at hPO hCO
  rw [← StageFeasibility.cycleSecant_zero_eq_sigmaOf p.feedbackRate p.kStar
    (p.scale j) (p.evenMatrix j) ht,
    ← StageFeasibility.normalizedEvenState_eq_coordinates p j,
    StageFeasibility.cycleSecant_even_prescribed p j hpstart] at hσE
  rw [← StageFeasibility.cycleSecant_one_eq_sigmaOf p.feedbackRate p.kStar
    (p.scale j) (p.evenMatrix j) hZ ht,
    ← StageFeasibility.normalizedEvenState_eq_coordinates p j,
    StageFeasibility.cycleSecant_odd_prescribed p j hpstart] at hσO
  rw [← StageFeasibility.cycleRadius_zero_eq_radiusRatioOf p.feedbackRate p.kStar
    (p.scale j) (p.evenMatrix j) ht,
    ← StageFeasibility.normalizedEvenState_eq_coordinates p j,
    StageFeasibility.cycleRadius_even_prescribed p j hpstart] at hWE
  rw [← StageFeasibility.cycleRadius_one_eq_radiusRatioOf p.feedbackRate p.kStar
    (p.scale j) (p.evenMatrix j) hZ ht,
    ← StageFeasibility.normalizedEvenState_eq_coordinates p j,
    StageFeasibility.cycleRadius_odd_prescribed p j hpstart] at hWO
  exact ⟨hPE, hCE, hPO, hCO, hσE, hσO, hWE, hWO⟩

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: one fixed neighborhood and scale

uniform lower bounds for their original secant and radius factors.

items.label: Continuation.polarContinuation
items.leanCode:
theorem polarContinuation :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ N > 0, ∃ M > 0,
        ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
          (∀ j : ℕ,
            |((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j).1 -
              (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).kStar| ≤ M * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ∧
            FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError
              ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j)) ≤
                N * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ^ 3 ∧
            ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j).1 ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
              0 < ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j).1) ∧
          ∀ k : ℕ,
            ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).matrix k).PosDef ∧
              0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).matrix k 0 1 ∧
              0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).sigma k ∧
              0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).radiusRatio k := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hTube⟩ := actualTube
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hνStar
  have hparameter := (hTube νStar hνStar).1
  obtain ⟨R, hR, δ, hδ, hfeasible⟩ := existsPrescribedCycleFeasibility νStar hparameter
  obtain ⟨_, hν, N, hN, M, hM, J, hJ, htube⟩ := hTube νStar hνStar
  have hscaledTube : ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ j : ℕ,
      |((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j).1 -
        (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).kStar| ≤ M * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ∧
      FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError
        ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j)) ≤
          N * (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ^ 3 := by
    intro j₀ hj₀ j
    exact ⟨(htube j₀ hj₀ j).1, (htube j₀ hj₀ j).2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨Jnear, hJnear, hnear⟩ := statesNearCycle_of_uniformTube νStar hparameter hν
    N M hN hM J hJ hscaledTube R hR
  obtain ⟨Jscale, _, hscaleCutoff⟩ := existsStartThreshold δ hδ
  have hJfinal : 0 < max Jnear Jscale := hJ.trans_le (hJnear.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  refine ⟨hparameter, N, hN, M, hM, max Jnear Jscale, hJfinal, ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  have hjNear : Jnear ≤ j₀ := (le_max_left Jnear Jscale).trans hj₀
  have hjScale : Jscale ≤ j₀ := (le_max_right Jnear Jscale).trans hj₀
  have hjTube : J ≤ j₀ := hJnear.trans hjNear
  have hstart : 0 < j₀ := hJ.trans_le hjTube
  have hpstart : 0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).startIndex := by
    simpa only [Parameters.of_startIndex] using hstart
  have hscaleAll : ∀ j, (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale j ≤ δ := by
    intro j
    exact ((ScaleTails.scale_antitone (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) hpstart)
      (Nat.zero_le j)).trans (hscaleCutoff νStar j₀ hjScale).le
  have hcyclic := fun j ↦ hfeasible j₀ hstart j (hscaleAll j) (hnear j₀ hjNear j)
  refine ⟨htube j₀ hjTube, ?_⟩
  intro k
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd' k with ⟨j, rfl | rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨hPE, hCE, _, _, hσE, _, hWE, _⟩ := hcyclic j
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hhalf.trans_le hσE, hhalf.trans_le hWE⟩
    · simpa only [Parameters.matrix_even] using hPE
    · simpa only [Parameters.matrix_even] using hCE
  · obtain ⟨_, _, hPO, hCO, _, hσO, _, hWO⟩ := hcyclic j
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hhalf.trans_le hσO, hhalf.trans_le hWO⟩
    · simpa only [Parameters.matrix_odd] using hPO
    · simpa only [Parameters.matrix_odd] using hCO
items.statement:
lem:polar-continuation: for every cycle parameter sufficiently close to
`baseAngle` from above, the original prescribed trajectory stays in its slow
and fast tube for every sufficiently large natural starting index. Every raw
matrix is positive definite with positive off-diagonal entry, secant scalar,
and radius factor. The widths and threshold precede every subsequent choice
of starting index.
items.title: Continuation.polarContinuation

items.label: Continuation.polarLimits
items.leanCode:
theorem polarLimits :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j).1)
          atTop (𝓝 (cycleK νStar)) ∧
        Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ FastContraction.fastError
          ((Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).normalizedEvenState j)
          atTop (𝓝 (TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK νStar))) := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hcontinuation⟩ := actualTube
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hνStar
  obtain ⟨hparameter, hν, N, hN, M, hM, J, hJ, hall⟩ := hcontinuation νStar hνStar
  refine ⟨J, hJ, ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hbounds := hall j₀ hj₀
  have hscale := ScaleTails.scale_tendsto_zero p
  have hslowLimit : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ M * p.scale j) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hscale.const_mul M
  have hslowBound : ∀ j : ℕ, ‖(p.normalizedEvenState j).1 - cycleK νStar‖ ≤ M * p.scale j := by
    intro j
    simpa only [p, Real.norm_eq_abs, Parameters.kStar_def,
      Parameters.of_cycleParameter] using (hbounds j).1
  have hslowZero := squeeze_zero_norm hslowBound hslowLimit
  let B := ‖FastContraction.matrixOperator FastContraction.basisMatrix‖ + 1
  have hB : 0 < B := by
    dsimp only [B]
    positivity
  have hfastLimit : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ (B * N) * p.scale j ^ 3) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (hscale.pow 3).const_mul (B * N)
  have hfastBound : ∀ j : ℕ, ‖FastContraction.fastError (p.normalizedEvenState j)‖ ≤
      (B * N) * p.scale j ^ 3 := by
    intro j
    let u := FastContraction.fastError (p.normalizedEvenState j)
    have hnorm : ‖u‖ ≤ B * FastContraction.fixedNorm u := by
      have hraw := FastContraction.norm_le_basisOperator_mul_fixedNorm u
      have hnonnegative := FastContraction.fixedNorm_nonneg u
      dsimp only [B]
      nlinarith
    calc
      ‖u‖ ≤ B * FastContraction.fixedNorm u := hnorm
      _ ≤ B * (N * p.scale j ^ 3) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbounds j).2.1 hB.le
      _ = (B * N) * p.scale j ^ 3 := by ring
  have hslow : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ (p.normalizedEvenState j).1)
      atTop (𝓝 (cycleK νStar)) := tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.mp hslowZero
  have hfast : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ ↦ FastContraction.fastError (p.normalizedEvenState j))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := squeeze_zero_norm hfastBound hfastLimit
  have hK : cycleK νStar ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet :=
    TwoCycle.cycleK_bijOn_parameterSet.mapsTo hparameter
  have hinput := hslow.prodMk_nhds hfast
  have hstate := (continuousAt_perturbedState (cycleK νStar) hK hν).tendsto.comp hinput
  refine ⟨hslow, hfast, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, FastRemainder.perturbedState_zero,
    perturbedState_fastError] using hstate
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: along every sufficiently late actual
source trajectory, the first diagonal coordinate tends to `KStar` and the
original fast-coordinate displacement tends to zero, so the full normalized
state tends to the source even cycle state.

theorem iteratedFDeriv_eta_eq_zero (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 0) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n eta t = 0 := by
  have hnegative : EqOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n eta) (fun _ ↦ 0) (Iio 0) := by
    intro s hs
    have hevent : eta =ᶠ[𝓝 s] (fun _ ↦ 0) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds hs] with u hu
      exact (eta_eq_zero_iff u).mpr hu.le
    simpa only [iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using
      (hevent.iteratedFDeriv ℝ n).self_of_nhds
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n eta) :=
    contDiff_eta.continuous_iteratedFDeriv
      (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl n)
  have hclosure : t ∈ closure (Iio (0 : ℝ)) := by
    rwa [closure_Iio]
  exact hnegative.closure hcontinuous continuous_const hclosure

  · have hright : 0 < ‖z‖ ^ 2 - (1 / 9 : ℝ) := by
      linarith [not_lt.mp hz]

theorem chi_eq_one {z : E} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1 / 3) : chi z = 1 := by
  have hsquare : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 9 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
  have hzero := (eta_eq_zero_iff (‖z‖ ^ 2 - 1 / 9)).mpr (sub_nonpos.mpr hsquare)
  have hpositive : 0 < 1 - ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
    linarith
  rw [chi_apply, hzero, add_zero]
  exact div_self ((eta_pos_iff _).mpr hpositive).ne'

ball of radius `1 / 3`.

theorem iteratedFDeriv_correction (n : ℕ) (c : E) (ρ : ℝ) (a z : E) (hρ : ρ ≠ 0) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (correction c ρ a) z =
      (ρ * (ρ⁻¹) ^ n) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (unitCorrection a) (ρ⁻¹ • (z - c)) := by
  have hunit : ContDiff ℝ n (unitCorrection a) :=
    (contDiff_unitCorrection a).of_le
      (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl n)
  have hscaled : ContDiff ℝ n (fun y : E ↦ unitCorrection a (ρ⁻¹ • (y - c))) :=
    hunit.comp ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).const_smul ρ⁻¹)
  have hrescale : correction c ρ a =
      fun y ↦ ρ • unitCorrection a (ρ⁻¹ • (y - c)) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using correction_eq_rescale c ρ a hρ
  rw [hrescale, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' hscaled.contDiffAt,
    iteratedFDeriv_comp_sub (𝕜 := ℝ)
      (f := fun y : E ↦ unitCorrection a (ρ⁻¹ • y)) n c z,
    iteratedFDeriv_comp_const_smul ρ⁻¹ hunit, smul_smul]

items.label: ExplicitCutoff.exists_norm_iteratedFDeriv_correction_le
items.leanCode:
theorem exists_norm_iteratedFDeriv_correction_le [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (c : E) (ρ : ℝ) (a z : E), 0 < ρ →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (correction c ρ a) z‖ ≤ C * ‖a‖ * ρ * (ρ⁻¹) ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := exists_norm_iteratedFDeriv_cutoffIdentity_le (E := E) n
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro c ρ a z hρ
  have hunit : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (unitCorrection a) (ρ⁻¹ • (z - c))‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * C :=
    (norm_iteratedFDeriv_unitCorrection_le n a _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound _) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hfactor : 0 < ρ * (ρ⁻¹) ^ n :=
    mul_pos hρ (pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr hρ) n)
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_correction n c ρ a z hρ.ne', norm_smul,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hfactor]
  calc
    (ρ * (ρ⁻¹) ^ n) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (unitCorrection a) (ρ⁻¹ • (z - c))‖ ≤
        (ρ * (ρ⁻¹) ^ n) * (‖a‖ * C) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hunit hfactor.le
    _ = C * ‖a‖ * ρ * (ρ⁻¹) ^ n := by
      ring
items.statement:

control all affine corrections, independently of their center, radius, and
coefficient. This gives the source scaling `‖D^n ψ‖ ≤ Cₙ ‖a‖ ρ^(1-n)`.

items.label: ExplicitCutoff.exists_norm_iteratedFDeriv_correction_le_zpow

    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (c : E) (ρ : ℝ) (a z : E), 0 < ρ →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (correction c ρ a) z‖ ≤ C * ‖a‖ * ρ ^ ((1 : ℤ) - n) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := exists_norm_iteratedFDeriv_correction_le (E := E) n
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩

  have hscale : ρ * (ρ⁻¹) ^ n = ρ ^ ((1 : ℤ) - n) := by
    rw [zpow_sub₀ hρ.ne', zpow_one, zpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]

    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (correction c ρ a) z‖ ≤ C * ‖a‖ * ρ * (ρ⁻¹) ^ n :=

theorem fderiv_correction_center (c : E) (ρ : ℝ) (a : E) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    fderiv ℝ (correction c ρ a) c = innerSL ℝ a := by
  rw [fderiv_correction c ρ a c hρ]
  simp only [sub_self, smul_zero, chi_zero, one_smul, inner_zero_right,
    mul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]
items.statement:
Helper for v21 Section 4.1: explicit cutoff: the affine correction has
exactly its prescribed first derivative at the center.

items.label: ExplicitCutoff.secondFDeriv_correction_center
items.leanCode:
theorem secondFDeriv_correction_center (c : E) (ρ : ℝ) (a : E) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (correction c ρ a)) c = 0 := by
  ext v u
  rw [secondFDeriv_correction_apply c ρ a c v u hρ]
  simp only [sub_self, smul_zero, fderiv_chi_zero, zero_apply, inner_zero_right,
    zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
items.statement:
Helper for v21 Section 4.1: explicit cutoff: the affine correction has
zero Hessian at its designated center.

items.label: ExplicitCutoff.exists_norm_secondFDeriv_correction_le
items.leanCode:
theorem exists_norm_secondFDeriv_correction_le [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (c : E) (ρ : ℝ) (a z : E), 0 < ρ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (correction c ρ a)) z‖ ≤ C * ‖a‖ / ρ := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := exists_norm_iteratedFDeriv_correction_le (E := E) 2
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro c ρ a z hρ
  calc
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (correction c ρ a)) z‖ =
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (correction c ρ a)) z‖ :=
      (norm_iteratedFDeriv_one (𝕜 := ℝ) (fderiv ℝ (correction c ρ a))).symm
    _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (correction c ρ a) z‖ := norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv
    _ ≤ C * ‖a‖ * ρ * (ρ⁻¹) ^ 2 := hbound c ρ a z hρ
    _ = C * ‖a‖ / ρ := by
      field_simp
items.statement:
Helper for v21 Section 4.1: explicit cutoff: the global Hessian bound of
each affine correction is `C ‖a‖ / ρ`, with `C` chosen before all correction
parameters.
items.title: ExplicitCutoff.exists_norm_secondFDeriv_correction_le

items.label: FastContraction.hasFDerivAt_leadingFast
items.leanCode:
theorem hasFDerivAt_leadingFast (c A : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hC : v 0 ≠ 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (leadingFast c A) (matrixOperator (stageDerivative c A v)) v := by
  have hCderiv := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : Fin 2) v
  have hVderiv := hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (1 : Fin 2) v
  have hinv := (hasFDerivAt_inv hC).comp v hCderiv
  have hquot := (hVderiv.mul hinv).sub_const c
  have hfirst := hquot.const_mul A
  have hsecond := ((hquot.pow 2).const_mul A).const_add 1
  rw [funext (leadingFast_apply c A)]
  apply hasFDerivAt_pi'.mpr
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · apply hfirst.congr_fderiv
    ext u
    simp [matrixOperator_apply, stageDerivative_def, Matrix.vecHead,
      Matrix.vecTail, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  · apply hsecond.congr_fderiv
    ext u
    simp [matrixOperator_apply, stageDerivative_def, Matrix.vecHead,
      Matrix.vecTail, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the leading stage has exactly the
displayed fast derivative whenever its off-diagonal input is nonzero.
items.title: FastContraction.hasFDerivAt_leadingFast

items.label: FastContraction.leadingCycle_def
items.leanCode:
theorem leadingCycle_def (A : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    leadingCycle A v = leadingFast baseAngle A (leadingFast (2 * baseAngle) A v) := by
  rfl
items.statement: Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the two-stage composition formula.

items.label: FastContraction.leadingCycle_fastCoordinates
items.leanCode:
theorem leadingCycle_fastCoordinates (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :
    leadingCycle x.1 (fastCoordinates x) =
      fastCoordinates
        (Normalized.leadingStage baseAngle (Normalized.leadingStage (2 * baseAngle) x)) := by
  have hfirst : (Normalized.leadingStage (2 * baseAngle) x).1 = x.1 := by
    rw [Normalized.leadingStage_apply]
  have hstage := leadingFast_fastCoordinates baseAngle
    (Normalized.leadingStage (2 * baseAngle) x)
  rw [hfirst] at hstage
  rw [leadingCycle_def, leadingFast_fastCoordinates, hstage]
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the fast two-stage map is the projection
of the actual two consecutive leading stages.
items.title: FastContraction.leadingCycle_fastCoordinates

items.label: FastContraction.map_zero
items.leanCode:
theorem map_zero (L κ : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :

  simp [Normalized.map_def, Normalized.rescale_apply, Normalized.twoStep_def,

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: at zero scale the exact normalized map

  rw [map_zero, leadingCycle_fastCoordinates]

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the fast coordinates of the exact

items.label: FastContraction.fastError_map_zero

theorem fastError_map_zero (L κ A : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) :

items.label: FastContraction.cycleDerivative_def
items.leanCode:
theorem cycleDerivative_def (A : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    cycleDerivative A v =
      stageDerivative baseAngle A (leadingFast (2 * baseAngle) A v) *
        stageDerivative (2 * baseAngle) A v := by
  rfl
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the defining ordered product of the
two-stage Jacobian.

items.label: FastContraction.hasFDerivAt_leadingCycle
items.leanCode:
theorem hasFDerivAt_leadingCycle (A : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hC : v 0 ≠ 0)
    (hCNext : leadingFast (2 * baseAngle) A v 0 ≠ 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (leadingCycle A) (matrixOperator (cycleDerivative A v)) v := by
  rw [cycleDerivative_def, matrixOperator_mul]
  exact (hasFDerivAt_leadingFast baseAngle A _ hCNext).comp v
    (hasFDerivAt_leadingFast (2 * baseAngle) A v hC)

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: differentiating the actual two-stage
leading map gives `cycleDerivative`.

items.label: FastContraction.hasFDerivAt_map_zero_fast
items.leanCode:
theorem hasFDerivAt_map_zero_fast (L κ A : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hC : v 0 ≠ 0)

    HasFDerivAt
      (fun w : Fin 2 → ℝ ↦ fastCoordinates (Normalized.map L κ 0 (A, w 0, w 1)))
      (matrixOperator (cycleDerivative A v)) v := by
  simpa only [fastCoordinates_map_zero, fastCoordinates_mk]
    using hasFDerivAt_leadingCycle A v hC hCNext

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: `cycleDerivative` is also the fast
linearization of the actual normalized map at zero scale.

items.label: FastContraction.stageDerivative_evenReference
items.leanCode:
theorem stageDerivative_evenReference :
    stageDerivative (2 * baseAngle) TwoCycle.kZero
      (fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference) =

items.label: FastContraction.leadingFast_evenState
items.leanCode:
theorem leadingFast_evenState (A : ℝ) (hA : A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet) :
    leadingFast (2 * baseAngle) A (fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A)) =
      fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.oddState A) := by
  have hfirst : (TwoCycle.evenState A).1 = A := by
    rw [TwoCycle.evenState_apply]
  have hstage := leadingFast_fastCoordinates (2 * baseAngle) (TwoCycle.evenState A)
  rw [hfirst, TwoCycle.evenToOdd A hA] at hstage
  exact hstage
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the leading fast stage carries each
even cycle state to the corresponding odd cycle state.

items.label: FastContraction.leadingCycle_evenState
items.leanCode:
theorem leadingCycle_evenState (A : ℝ) (hA : A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet) :
    leadingCycle A (fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A)) =
      fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) := by
  have hfirst : (TwoCycle.oddState A).1 = A := by
    rw [TwoCycle.oddState_apply]
  have hstage := leadingFast_fastCoordinates baseAngle (TwoCycle.oddState A)
  rw [hfirst, TwoCycle.oddToEven A hA] at hstage
  rw [leadingCycle_def, leadingFast_evenState A hA, hstage]
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the leading two-stage map fixes the
fast coordinates of the general nearby even cycle.
items.title: FastContraction.leadingCycle_evenState

items.label: FastContraction.cycleDerivative_evenReference
items.leanCode:
theorem cycleDerivative_evenReference :
    cycleDerivative TwoCycle.kZero (fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference) =
      !![3 / 2, -1 / (2 * baseAngle); 6 * baseAngle, -2] := by
  have hK : TwoCycle.kZero ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet :=
    mem_of_mem_nhds TwoCycle.normalizationSet_mem_nhds
  have hstage := leadingFast_evenState TwoCycle.kZero hK
  rw [TwoCycle.evenState_kZero, TwoCycle.oddState_kZero] at hstage
  rw [cycleDerivative_def, hstage, stageDerivative_evenReference,
    stageDerivative_oddReference]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i
  all_goals fin_cases j
  all_goals simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  all_goals field_simp [baseAngle_ne_zero]
  all_goals ring
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the full two-stage derivative at the
reference cycle is the displayed matrix `D_cyc`.

items.label: FastContraction.norm_mulVec_le_of_rowSum
items.leanCode:
theorem norm_mulVec_le_of_rowSum (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrow : ∀ i, |M i 0| + |M i 1| ≤ r) (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    ‖M *ᵥ u‖ ≤ r * ‖u‖ := by
  apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr (norm_nonneg u))).mpr
  intro i
  calc
    ‖(M *ᵥ u) i‖ = ‖M i 0 * u 0 + M i 1 * u 1‖ := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    _ ≤ ‖M i 0 * u 0‖ + ‖M i 1 * u 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = |M i 0| * ‖u 0‖ + |M i 1| * ‖u 1‖ := by
      simp only [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ |M i 0| * ‖u‖ + |M i 1| * ‖u‖ :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_le_pi_norm u 0) (abs_nonneg _))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_le_pi_norm u 1) (abs_nonneg _))
    _ = (|M i 0| + |M i 1|) * ‖u‖ := by ring

theorem eventually_fixedNorm_cycleDerivative_le :
    ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) in
        𝓝 (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference),
      z.2 0 ≠ 0 ∧ leadingFast (2 * baseAngle) z.1 z.2 0 ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ,
          fixedNorm (cycleDerivative z.1 z.2 *ᵥ u) ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u := by
  have hC := reference_nonsingular.1
  have hCNext := reference_nonsingular.2
  have hd := continuousAt_cycleDerivative TwoCycle.kZero _ hC hCNext
  have hconjugate : ContinuousAt
      (fun z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) ↦ inverseBasis * cycleDerivative z.1 z.2 * basisMatrix)
      (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference) :=
    (continuousAt_const.mul hd).mul continuousAt_const
  have hrows : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) in
        𝓝 (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference),
      ∀ i : Fin 2,
        |(inverseBasis * cycleDerivative z.1 z.2 * basisMatrix) i 0| +
          |(inverseBasis * cycleDerivative z.1 z.2 * basisMatrix) i 1| < (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
    intro i
    have hrow : ContinuousAt
        (fun z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) ↦
          |(inverseBasis * cycleDerivative z.1 z.2 * basisMatrix) i 0| +
            |(inverseBasis * cycleDerivative z.1 z.2 * basisMatrix) i 1|)
        (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference) := by
      fun_prop
    exact hrow.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (reference_conjugate_rowSum_lt i))
  have hcoordinate : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) ↦ z.2 0)
      (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference) := by
    fun_prop
  have hCevent : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) in
      𝓝 (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference), z.2 0 ≠ 0 :=
    hcoordinate.eventually_ne hC
  have hCNextEvent : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) in
      𝓝 (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference),
      leadingFast (2 * baseAngle) z.1 z.2 0 ≠ 0 := by
    have hstage := continuousAt_leadingFast (2 * baseAngle) TwoCycle.kZero _ hC
    exact (continuousAt_pi.mp hstage 0).eventually_ne hCNext
  filter_upwards [hCevent, hCNextEvent, hrows] with z hz hzNext hrow
  refine ⟨hz, hzNext, ?_⟩
  intro u
  rw [fixedNorm_def, inverseBasis_mulVec, fixedNorm_def]
  apply norm_mulVec_le_of_rowSum
  · norm_num
  · intro i
    exact (hrow i).le

items.label: FastContraction.exists_uniform_leadingCycle_contraction
items.leanCode:
theorem exists_uniform_leadingCycle_contraction :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ᶠ A : ℝ in 𝓝 TwoCycle.kZero,
      A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
        ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, fixedNorm u < r →
          fixedNorm (leadingCycle A (fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) + u) -
            fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A)) ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u := by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hcontract⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp eventually_fixedNorm_cycleDerivative_le
  have heven := continuousAt_evenState
  have hcurve : ContinuousAt
      (fun A : ℝ ↦ (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A))) TwoCycle.kZero := by
    simp only [fastCoordinates_apply]
    fun_prop
  have htendsto : Tendsto
      (fun A : ℝ ↦ (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A))) (𝓝 TwoCycle.kZero)
      (𝓝 (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference)) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, TwoCycle.evenState_kZero] using hcurve
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ A : ℝ in 𝓝 TwoCycle.kZero,
      dist (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A))
        (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference) < ε / 2 :=
    htendsto.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (half_pos hε))
  let B := ‖matrixOperator basisMatrix‖ + 1
  have hB : 0 < B := by
    dsimp only [B]
    positivity
  refine ⟨ε / (2 * B), div_pos hε (mul_pos zero_lt_two hB), ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [TwoCycle.normalizationSet_mem_nhds, hnear] with A hA hAnear
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  have hnormu : ‖u‖ < ε / 2 := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ ≤ ‖matrixOperator basisMatrix‖ * fixedNorm u :=
        norm_le_basisOperator_mul_fixedNorm u
      _ ≤ B * fixedNorm u := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (fixedNorm_nonneg u)
        dsimp only [B]
        linarith
      _ < B * (ε / (2 * B)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu hB
      _ = ε / 2 := by field_simp
  have hsegment : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      dist (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) + s • u)
        (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference) < ε := by
    intro s hs
    have hsmul : ‖s • u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg u) hs.2
    have hdist : dist
        (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) + s • u)
        (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A)) < ε / 2 := by
      rw [dist_prod_same_left, dist_eq_norm]
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using hsmul.trans_lt hnormu
    calc
      dist (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) + s • u)
          (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference) ≤
        dist (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) + s • u)
            (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A)) +
          dist (A, fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A))
            (TwoCycle.kZero, fastCoordinates TwoCycle.evenReference) := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add hdist hAnear
      _ = ε := by ring
  have hderiv : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt
        (fun s : ℝ ↦ inverseBasis *ᵥ
          leadingCycle A (fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) + s • u))
        (inverseBasis *ᵥ
          (cycleDerivative A (fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) + s • u) *ᵥ u)) s := by
    intro s hs
    have hstate := hcontract (hsegment s hs)
    have hline : HasDerivAt
        (fun s : ℝ ↦ fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) + s • u) u s := by
      simpa only [one_smul, id_eq] using
        ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const u).const_add (fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A))
    have hcycle := (hasFDerivAt_leadingCycle A _ hstate.1 hstate.2.1).comp_hasDerivAt s hline
    have houtput := (matrixOperator inverseBasis).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hcycle
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, matrixOperator_apply] using houtput
  have hbound : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖inverseBasis *ᵥ
          (cycleDerivative A (fastCoordinates (TwoCycle.evenState A) + s • u) *ᵥ u)‖ ≤
        (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u := by
    intro s hs
    exact (hcontract (hsegment s (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hs))).2.2 u
  have hmean := norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment_01'
    (fun s hs ↦ (hderiv s hs).hasDerivWithinAt) hbound
  simpa only [zero_smul, one_smul, add_zero, leadingCycle_evenState A hA,
    ← Matrix.mulVec_sub, fixedNorm_def] using hmean

theorem cycleStage_sub_leading_isBigO (L κ : ℝ) (i : Fin 2)
    (x₀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ Normalized.cycleStage L κ i t x₀ x -
      Normalized.leadingStage (Normalized.limitAngle i) x) =O[𝓝 0]
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
  have hfirst : iteratedDeriv 1 (fun t ↦ Normalized.cycleStage L κ i t x₀ x) 0 = 0 := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv,
      Normalized.cycleStage_firstIteratedFDeriv_eq_zero]
    rfl
  have hsecond : iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t ↦ Normalized.cycleStage L κ i t x₀ x) 0 = 0 := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv,
      Normalized.cycleStage_secondIteratedFDeriv_eq_zero]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hformula⟩ :=
    (Normalized.cycleStage_analyticAt_zero L κ i x₀ x).exists_eq_sum_add_pow_mul 3
  have hfactor (t : ℝ) :
      Normalized.cycleStage L κ i t x₀ x -
        Normalized.leadingStage (Normalized.limitAngle i) x = t ^ 3 • q t := by
    have hvalue : Normalized.cycleStage L κ i t x₀ x =
        Normalized.leadingStage (Normalized.limitAngle i) x + t ^ 3 • q t := by
      simpa [Finset.sum_range_succ, hfirst, hsecond, iteratedDeriv_zero,
        Normalized.cycleStage_zero] using hformula t
    rw [hvalue]
    abel
  have hbound := (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0)).smul
    (hq.continuousAt.isBigO_one ℝ)
  simpa only [hfactor, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hbound

theorem cycleStage_joint_analyticAt (L κ : ℝ) (i : Fin 2)
    (x₀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (hC : x.2.1 ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticAt ℝ
      (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ cycleStage L κ i z.1 x₀ z.2) (0, x) := by
  have hτ : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.1) (0, x) := analyticAt_fst
  have hX : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.2) (0, x) := analyticAt_snd
  have hfb : AnalyticAt ℝ
      (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ feedback L κ z.1 x₀) (0, x) := by
    simp only [feedback_def]
    fun_prop (disch := assumption)
  have hSlope : AnalyticAt ℝ
      (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ slope z.2) (0, x) := by
    have hCV : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.2.2) (0, x) :=
      analyticAt_snd.comp hX
    have hC' : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.2.2.1) (0, x) :=
      analyticAt_fst.comp hCV
    have hV : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.2.2.2) (0, x) :=
      analyticAt_snd.comp hCV
    simp only [slope_def]
    exact hV.div hC' hC
  fin_cases i
  · have hσ : stageSigma 0 0 x 1 (feedback L κ 0 x₀) ≠ 0 := by
      simp [feedback_def, stageSigma_def, stepV_def, stepW_def]
    simpa only [cycleStage_apply, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero] using
      stageAlong_analyticAt 0 hτ hX analyticAt_const hfb hSlope rfl hσ
  · have hσ : stageSigma 1 0 x (feedback L κ 0 x₀) 1 ≠ 0 := by
      simp [feedback_def, stageSigma_def, stepV_def, stepW_def]
    simpa only [cycleStage_apply, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_fin_one] using
      stageAlong_analyticAt 1 hτ hX hfb analyticAt_const hSlope rfl hσ

    (analyticAt_fst : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.1) (0, x)) rfl

  have hA : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.2.1) (0, x) :=

  have hCV : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.2.2) (0, x) :=

theorem analytic_comp_sub_isBigO {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} {a : E}
    {p q : ℝ → E} {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : AnalyticAt ℝ f a)
    (hp : Tendsto p (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a)) (hq : Tendsto q (𝓝 0) (𝓝 a))
    (hpq : (fun t ↦ p t - q t) =O[𝓝 0] g) :
    (fun t ↦ f (p t) - f (q t)) =O[𝓝 0] g := by
  have h := hf.hasStrictFDerivAt.isBigO_sub.comp_tendsto (hp.prodMk_nhds hq)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using h.trans hpq

Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): analytic maps
preserve a common asymptotic order between two germs with the same limit.

theorem analytic_sub_value_isBigO_cube {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] {f : ℝ → F} (hf : AnalyticAt ℝ f 0)
    (hfirst : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 f 0 = 0) (hsecond : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 = 0) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ f t - f 0) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
  have hderiv1 : iteratedDeriv 1 f 0 = 0 := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv, hfirst]
    rfl
  have hderiv2 : iteratedDeriv 2 f 0 = 0 := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv, hsecond]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hformula⟩ := hf.exists_eq_sum_add_pow_mul 3
  have hfactor (t : ℝ) : f t - f 0 = t ^ 3 • q t := by
    have hvalue : f t = f 0 + t ^ 3 • q t := by
      simpa [Finset.sum_range_succ, hderiv1, hderiv2, iteratedDeriv_zero]
        using hformula t
    rw [hvalue]
    abel
  have hbound := (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0)).smul
    (hq.continuousAt.isBigO_one ℝ)
  simpa only [hfactor, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hbound
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): an analytic
one-variable germ with zero first and second derivatives has cubic variation.
items.title: FastRemainder.analytic_sub_value_isBigO_cube

theorem twoStep_sub_zero_isBigO (L κ : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (hCNext : (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1 ≠ 0) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ twoStep L κ t x - twoStep L κ 0 x) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
  let y := cycleStage L κ 0 0 x x
  have hyC : y.2.1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [y, cycleStage_zero] using hCNext
  have hfirst3 : (fun t : ℝ ↦ cycleStage L κ 0 t x x - y) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
    simpa only [y, cycleStage_zero] using
      FastContraction.cycleStage_sub_leading_isBigO L κ 0 x x
  have hfirst : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ cycleStage L κ 0 t x x) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 y) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, y] using (cycleStage_analyticAt_zero L κ 0 x x).continuousAt
  have hp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t, cycleStage L κ 0 t x x))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0, y)) := tendsto_id.prodMk_nhds hfirst
  have hq : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t, y)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0, y)) :=
    tendsto_id.prodMk_nhds tendsto_const_nhds
  have hpq : (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t, cycleStage L κ 0 t x x) - (t, y)) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
    simpa only [Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_self] using
      (Asymptotics.isBigO_zero (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0)).prod_left hfirst3
  have hstate3 := analytic_comp_sub_isBigO
    (cycleStage_joint_analyticAt L κ 1 x y hyC) hp hq hpq
  have hsecond3 : (fun t : ℝ ↦ cycleStage L κ 1 t x y - cycleStage L κ 1 0 x y)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
    simpa only [cycleStage_zero] using
      FastContraction.cycleStage_sub_leading_isBigO L κ 1 x y
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, sub_add_sub_cancel, twoStep_def, y] using
    hstate3.add hsecond3
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): the original
two consecutive stages have no scale perturbation below cubic order.
items.title: FastRemainder.twoStep_sub_zero_isBigO

theorem rescale_sub_zero_isBigO (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ rescale t x - rescale 0 x) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
  have hρ3 := analytic_sub_value_isBigO_cube rescaleFactor_analyticAt
    rescaleFactor_firstIteratedFDeriv_eq_zero rescaleFactor_secondIteratedFDeriv_eq_zero
  have hρ : Tendsto rescaleFactor (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (rescaleFactor 0)) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt] using rescaleFactor_analyticAt.continuousAt
  have hf : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun r : ℝ ↦ (r ^ 2 * x.1, r * x.2.1, x.2.2))
      (rescaleFactor 0) := by
    fun_prop
  have h := (hf.differentiableAt.isBigO_sub.comp_tendsto hρ).trans hρ3
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, rescale_apply] using h
