theorem map_sub_zero_isBigO (L κ : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (hCNext : (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1 ≠ 0) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ Normalized.map L κ t x - Normalized.map L κ 0 x) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
  let y := twoStep L κ 0 x
  have htwo3 := twoStep_sub_zero_isBigO L κ x hCNext
  have htzero : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) 0 := by fun_prop
    simpa [ContinuousAt] using hc
  have htwo : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ twoStep L κ t x) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 y) :=
    tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff.mp (htwo3.trans_tendsto htzero)
  have hp : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t, twoStep L κ t x)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0, y)) :=
    tendsto_id.prodMk_nhds htwo
  have hq : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t, y)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (0, y)) :=
    tendsto_id.prodMk_nhds tendsto_const_nhds
  have hpq : (fun t : ℝ ↦ (t, twoStep L κ t x) - (t, y)) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
    simpa only [Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_self, y] using
      (Asymptotics.isBigO_zero (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0)).prod_left htwo3
  have hstate3 := analytic_comp_sub_isBigO (rescale_joint_analyticAt y) hp hq hpq
  have hrescale3 := rescale_sub_zero_isBigO y
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, sub_add_sub_cancel, Normalized.map_def, y] using
    hstate3.add hrescale3
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): the actual
composed and rescaled normalized map has pointwise cubic scale variation.

theorem map_twoJet_eq_constant (L κ : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (hA : 0 < x.1) (hC : 0 < x.2.1)
    (hCNext : 0 < (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1) :
    FiniteTaylorJet.ofFunction ℝ 2 (fun t ↦ Normalized.map L κ t x) 0 =
      FiniteTaylorJet.ofFunction ℝ 2 (fun _ : ℝ ↦ Normalized.map L κ 0 x) 0 := by
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun t ↦ Normalized.map L κ t x) 0 :=
    (map_scale_analyticAt L κ x hA hC hCNext).contDiffAt
  have herr : (fun t : ℝ ↦ Normalized.map L κ (0 + t) x -
      (fun _ : ℝ ↦ Normalized.map L κ 0 x) (0 + t)) =O[𝓝 0]
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ (2 + 1)) := by
    simpa only [zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd] using map_sub_zero_isBigO L κ x hCNext.ne'
  exact FiniteTaylorJet.ofFunction_eq_of_sub_isBigO_succ hf contDiffAt_const herr

scale jet of the actual two-stage rescaled map is its constant zero-scale jet.

theorem map_positiveIteratedFDeriv_eq_zero (L κ : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (hA : 0 < x.1) (hC : 0 < x.2.1)
    (hCNext : 0 < (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1)
    (n : Fin 3) (hn : (n : ℕ) ≠ 0) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n : ℕ) (fun t ↦ Normalized.map L κ t x) 0 = 0 := by
  have hderiv := (FiniteTaylorJet.ofFunction_eq_iff_iteratedDeriv_eq 2
    (fun t ↦ Normalized.map L κ t x) (fun _ : ℝ ↦ Normalized.map L κ 0 x) 0 0).mp
      (map_twoJet_eq_constant L κ x hA hC hCNext) n
  apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext_ring
  simpa only [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv, iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne hn,
    Pi.zero_apply, zero_apply] using hderiv

theorem uniformCubicSubBound {Θ F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    {f : Θ → ℝ → F} {J : Θ → FiniteTaylorJet ℝ ℝ F 3} {K : Set Θ}
    (hJ : FiniteTaylorJet.IsUniformOn f J 0 K)
    (hzero : ∀ θ ∈ K, (J θ).coeff 1 = 0 ∧ (J θ).coeff 2 = 0) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ θ ∈ K, ∀ t : ℝ, ‖t‖ < δ →
      ‖f θ t - f θ 0‖ ≤ C * ‖t ^ 3‖ := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, htop⟩ := hJ.boundedCoeff (3 : Fin 4)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hrem⟩ := FiniteTaylorJet.IsUniformRemainderOn.bound
    (hJ.remainder 1 zero_lt_one)
  refine ⟨B + 1, add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hB zero_lt_one, δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro θ hθ t ht
  have hconstant : (J θ).coeff (0 : Fin 4) (fun _ ↦ t) = f θ 0 := by
    have harg : (fun _ : Fin ((0 : Fin 4) : ℕ) ↦ t) = (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℝ)) := by
      simp only [Fin.val_zero]
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    calc
      (J θ).coeff (0 : Fin 4) (fun _ ↦ t) =
          (J θ).coeff (0 : Fin 4) (fun _ ↦ 0) :=
        congrArg ((J θ).coeff (0 : Fin 4)) harg
      _ = (J θ).constantCoeff := (FiniteTaylorJet.constantCoeff_eq_coeff_zero (J θ)).symm
      _ = f θ 0 := (hJ.value_eq_constantCoeff hθ).symm
  have heval : (J θ).eval t = f θ 0 + (J θ).coeff (3 : Fin 4) (fun _ : Fin 3 ↦ t) := by
    rw [FiniteTaylorJet.eval_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_four, (hzero θ hθ).1,
      (hzero θ hθ).2]
    simp only [zero_apply, add_zero, hconstant]
    rfl
  have htopBound : ‖(J θ).coeff (3 : Fin 4) (fun _ : Fin 3 ↦ t)‖ ≤ B * ‖t ^ 3‖ := by
    calc
      ‖(J θ).coeff (3 : Fin 4) (fun _ : Fin 3 ↦ t)‖ ≤
          ‖(J θ).coeff (3 : Fin 4)‖ * ∏ _i : Fin 3, ‖t‖ :=
        ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ B * ∏ _i : Fin 3, ‖t‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (htop θ hθ) (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg t)
      _ = B * ‖t ^ 3‖ := by simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin, norm_pow]
  have hremBound : ‖(J θ).remainder (f θ) 0 t‖ ≤ ‖t ^ 3‖ := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_natCast, one_mul, norm_pow] using hrem θ hθ t ht
  have hvalue : f θ t - f θ 0 =
      (J θ).remainder (f θ) 0 t + (J θ).coeff (3 : Fin 4) (fun _ : Fin 3 ↦ t) := by
    rw [FiniteTaylorJet.remainder_def, zero_add, heval]
    abel
  rw [hvalue]
  calc
    ‖(J θ).remainder (f θ) 0 t + (J θ).coeff (3 : Fin 4) (fun _ : Fin 3 ↦ t)‖ ≤
        ‖(J θ).remainder (f θ) 0 t‖ + ‖(J θ).coeff (3 : Fin 4) (fun _ : Fin 3 ↦ t)‖ :=
      norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖t ^ 3‖ + B * ‖t ^ 3‖ := add_le_add hremBound htopBound
    _ = (B + 1) * ‖t ^ 3‖ := by ring
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): a uniform cubic
scalar jet with zero linear and quadratic coefficients gives one common cubic
bound on variation from the base value.
items.title: FastRemainder.uniformCubicSubBound

theorem map_uniform_cubic_bound (L κ : ℝ) (K : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hA : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < x.1) (hC : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < x.2.1)
    (hCNext : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ t : ℝ, ‖t‖ < δ →
      ‖Normalized.map L κ t x - Normalized.map L κ 0 x‖ ≤ C * ‖t ^ 3‖ := by
  have huniform := map_uniformJets L κ 3 K hK hA hC hCNext
  apply uniformCubicSubBound huniform
  intro x hx
  have hfirst : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun t ↦ Normalized.map L κ t x) 0 = 0 :=
    map_positiveIteratedFDeriv_eq_zero L κ x (hA x hx) (hC x hx) (hCNext x hx) 1 one_ne_zero
  have hsecond : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun t ↦ Normalized.map L κ t x) 0 = 0 :=
    map_positiveIteratedFDeriv_eq_zero L κ x (hA x hx) (hC x hx) (hCNext x hx) 2 two_ne_zero
  constructor
  · simp only [FiniteTaylorJet.coeff_ofFunction]
    norm_num only [Fin.val_one, Nat.factorial_one, Nat.cast_one, inv_one, one_smul]
    exact hfirst
  · simp only [FiniteTaylorJet.coeff_ofFunction]
    exact smul_eq_zero_of_right _ hsecond

Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): on any fixed
compact positive state set, the exact normalized map has one cubic scale
constant and radius for all states in the set.

  have hK : TwoCycle.kZero ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet :=

items.label: FastRemainder.exists_regular_closedBall
items.leanCode:
theorem exists_regular_closedBall :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference r,
      0 < x.1 ∧ 0 < x.2.1 ∧ 0 < (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1 := by
  have hA : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ x.1) TwoCycle.evenReference :=
    continuous_fst.continuousAt
  have hC : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ x.2.1) TwoCycle.evenReference :=
    (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).continuousAt
  have hV : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ x.2.2) TwoCycle.evenReference :=
    (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd).continuousAt
  have hCne : TwoCycle.evenReference.2.1 ≠ 0 := reference_positive.2.1.ne'
  have hnext : ContinuousAt
      (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1)
      TwoCycle.evenReference := by
    simp only [leadingStage_apply]
    fun_prop (disch := assumption)
  have hregular : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ in 𝓝 TwoCycle.evenReference,
      0 < x.1 ∧ 0 < x.2.1 ∧ 0 < (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1 := by
    filter_upwards [hA.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds reference_positive.1),
      hC.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds reference_positive.2.1),
      hnext.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds reference_positive.2.2)] with x hxA hxC hxNext
    exact ⟨hxA, hxC, hxNext⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hregular
  refine ⟨r / 2, half_pos hr, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  exact hball ((Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hx).trans_lt (half_lt_self hr))

state ball lies in the positive regular domain of both leading stages.

  have hbound := (matrixOperator inverseBasis).le_opNorm u
  calc
    fixedNorm u ≤ ‖matrixOperator inverseBasis‖ * ‖u‖ := by
      simpa only [fixedNorm_def, matrixOperator_apply] using hbound

items.label: FastRemainder.fixedNorm_fastError_sub_le
items.leanCode:
theorem fixedNorm_fastError_sub_le {K : ℝ≥0} {s : Set ℝ}
    (hLip : LipschitzOnWith K TwoCycle.evenState s) (y z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (hy : y.1 ∈ s) (hz : z.1 ∈ s) :
    fixedNorm (fastError y - fastError z) ≤
      (‖matrixOperator inverseBasis‖ + 1) * (1 + (K : ℝ)) * ‖y - z‖ := by
  have hcurve := (lipschitzOnWith_iff_norm_sub_le.mp hLip) hy hz
  have hslow : ‖y.1 - z.1‖ ≤ ‖y - z‖ := norm_fst_le (y - z)
  have hcurveBound : ‖TwoCycle.evenState y.1 - TwoCycle.evenState z.1‖ ≤
      (K : ℝ) * ‖y - z‖ := hcurve.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hslow K.coe_nonneg)
  have hidentity : fastError y - fastError z =
      fastProjection (y - z) -
        fastProjection (TwoCycle.evenState y.1 - TwoCycle.evenState z.1) := by
    simp only [map_sub, fastProjection_apply, fastError_def]
    abel
  rw [hidentity]
  calc
    fixedNorm (fastProjection (y - z) -
        fastProjection (TwoCycle.evenState y.1 - TwoCycle.evenState z.1)) ≤
      (‖matrixOperator inverseBasis‖ + 1) *
        ‖fastProjection (y - z) -
          fastProjection (TwoCycle.evenState y.1 - TwoCycle.evenState z.1)‖ :=
      fixedNorm_le_inverseOperator _
    _ ≤ (‖matrixOperator inverseBasis‖ + 1) *
        (‖fastProjection (y - z)‖ +
          ‖fastProjection (TwoCycle.evenState y.1 - TwoCycle.evenState z.1)‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sub_le _ _)
        (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
    _ ≤ (‖matrixOperator inverseBasis‖ + 1) *
        (‖y - z‖ + ‖TwoCycle.evenState y.1 - TwoCycle.evenState z.1‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (add_le_add (norm_fastProjection_le _) (norm_fastProjection_le _))
        (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
    _ ≤ (‖matrixOperator inverseBasis‖ + 1) * (‖y - z‖ + (K : ℝ) * ‖y - z‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl hcurveBound)
        (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
    _ = (‖matrixOperator inverseBasis‖ + 1) * (1 + (K : ℝ)) * ‖y - z‖ := by ring

theorem eventually_input_and_output_near (L κ r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (s : Set ℝ) (hs : s ∈ 𝓝 TwoCycle.kZero) :
    ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) in 𝓝 (0, (TwoCycle.kZero, 0)),
      perturbedState z.2.1 z.2.2 ∈ Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference r ∧
        (Normalized.map L κ z.1 (perturbedState z.2.1 z.2.2)).1 ∈ s ∧ z.2.1 ∈ s := by
  have hstate : ContinuousAt
      (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ↦ perturbedState z.2.1 z.2.2)
      (0, (TwoCycle.kZero, 0)) :=
    continuousAt_perturbedState.comp_of_eq continuousAt_snd rfl
  have hinput : ContinuousAt
      (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ↦ (z.1, perturbedState z.2.1 z.2.2))
      (0, (TwoCycle.kZero, 0)) := continuousAt_fst.prodMk hstate
  have hinput0 : (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ↦
      (z.1, perturbedState z.2.1 z.2.2)) (0, (TwoCycle.kZero, 0)) =
        (0, TwoCycle.evenReference) := by
    simp only [perturbedState_zero, TwoCycle.evenState_kZero]
  have hmap := (map_analyticAt_zero L κ TwoCycle.evenReference
    reference_positive.1 reference_positive.2.1 reference_positive.2.2).continuousAt.comp_of_eq
      hinput hinput0
  have houtput : ContinuousAt
      (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ↦
        (Normalized.map L κ z.1 (perturbedState z.2.1 z.2.2)).1)
      (0, (TwoCycle.kZero, 0)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Function.uncurry_apply_pair] using
      continuousAt_fst.comp_of_eq hmap rfl
  have hsOutput : s ∈ 𝓝
      ((Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState TwoCycle.kZero 0)).1) := by
    rw [perturbedState_zero, TwoCycle.evenState_kZero, map_zero_evenReference,
      TwoCycle.evenReference_def]
    exact hs
  have hsInput : Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference r ∈
      𝓝 (perturbedState TwoCycle.kZero 0) := by
    simpa only [perturbedState_zero, TwoCycle.evenState_kZero] using
      Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds TwoCycle.evenReference hr
  have hA : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ↦ z.2.1)
      (0, (TwoCycle.kZero, 0)) := (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).continuousAt
  filter_upwards [hstate.eventually hsInput, houtput.eventually hsOutput,
    hA.eventually hs] with z hx hy hAin
  exact ⟨hx, hy, hAin⟩

items.label: FastRemainder.uniformFastBoundFixedNeighborhood
items.leanCode:
theorem uniformFastBoundFixedNeighborhood :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ d > 0, ∀ L κ : ℝ, ∃ C₀ > 0, ∃ δ > 0,
      ∀ A : ℝ, |A - TwoCycle.kZero| < d →
        A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
          ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, fixedNorm u < r → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ →
            fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u))) ≤
              (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u + C₀ * t ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hregular⟩ := exists_regular_closedBall
  obtain ⟨K, s, hs, hLip⟩ := evenState_locally_lipschitz
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hslowBall⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hs
  let D := (‖matrixOperator inverseBasis‖ + 1) * (1 + (K : ℝ))
  have hD : 0 < D := by
    dsimp only [D]
    positivity
  have hcompact : Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference R ∈
      𝓝 (perturbedState TwoCycle.kZero 0) := by
    simpa only [perturbedState_zero, TwoCycle.evenState_kZero] using
      Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds TwoCycle.evenReference hR
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hinput⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
    (continuousAt_perturbedState.eventually hcompact)
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hleading⟩ := exists_uniform_leadingCycle_contraction
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hzeroLeading⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hleading
  let B := ‖matrixOperator basisMatrix‖ + 1
  have hB : 0 < B := by
    dsimp only [B]
    positivity
  refine ⟨min r₀ (η / (2 * B)), lt_min hr₀ (div_pos hη (mul_pos zero_lt_two hB)),
    min b (min (η / 2) (a / 4)),
    lt_min hb (lt_min (half_pos hη) (div_pos ha zero_lt_four)), ?_⟩
  intro L κ
  obtain ⟨C, hC, δ₀, hδ₀, hmap⟩ := map_uniform_cubic_bound L κ
    (Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference R) (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    (fun x hx ↦ (hregular x hx).1) (fun x hx ↦ (hregular x hx).2.1)
    (fun x hx ↦ (hregular x hx).2.2)
  have hCOne : 0 < C + 1 := by linarith
  refine ⟨D * C, mul_pos hD hC, min δ₀ (min 1 (a / (4 * (C + 1)))),
    lt_min hδ₀ (lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos ha (mul_pos zero_lt_four hCOne))), ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  have hAb : dist A TwoCycle.kZero < b := by
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hA.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hAcontract := hzeroLeading hAb
  refine ⟨hAcontract.1, ?_⟩
  intro u hu t ht htsmall
  have hu₀ : fixedNorm u < r₀ := hu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have huη : fixedNorm u < η / (2 * B) := hu.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hnormu : ‖u‖ < η / 2 := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ ≤ ‖matrixOperator basisMatrix‖ * fixedNorm u :=
        norm_le_basisOperator_mul_fixedNorm u
      _ ≤ B * fixedNorm u := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (fixedNorm_nonneg u)
        dsimp only [B]
        linarith
      _ < B * (η / (2 * B)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left huη hB
      _ = η / 2 := by field_simp
  have hAη : |A - TwoCycle.kZero| < η / 2 :=
    (hA.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hAa : dist A TwoCycle.kZero < a / 4 := by
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using
      (hA.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hdist : dist (A, u) (TwoCycle.kZero, 0) < η := by
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    simp only [Real.dist_eq, dist_zero_right, max_lt_iff]
    exact ⟨hAη.trans (half_lt_self hη), hnormu.trans (half_lt_self hη)⟩
  have hinputMem := hinput hdist
  have htδ : ‖t‖ < δ₀ := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht]
    exact htsmall.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have htOne : t < 1 :=
    (htsmall.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have htScale : t < a / (4 * (C + 1)) :=
    (htsmall.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have htSquare : t ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ ht htOne.le
  have htCube : t ^ 3 ≤ t := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht (sub_nonneg.mpr htSquare)]
  have hsmallCubic : C * ‖t ^ 3‖ < a / 4 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg ht 3)]
    calc
      C * t ^ 3 ≤ C * t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htCube hC.le
      _ ≤ (C + 1) * t := by nlinarith
      _ < (C + 1) * (a / (4 * (C + 1))) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left htScale hCOne
      _ = a / 4 := by field_simp
  have hmapBound := hmap _ hinputMem t htδ
  have hzeroFirst : (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u)).1 = A := by
    rw [map_zero_fst, perturbedState_apply]
  have hslowError :
      ‖(Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)).1 - A‖ ≤
        ‖Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u) -
          Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u)‖ := by
    have hfst := norm_fst_le (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u) -
      Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u))
    simpa only [Prod.fst_sub, hzeroFirst] using hfst
  have houtputDist : dist (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)).1 TwoCycle.kZero < a := by
    have hstep : dist (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)).1 A < a / 4 := by
      simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hslowError.trans_lt (hmapBound.trans_lt hsmallCubic)
    calc
      dist (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)).1 TwoCycle.kZero ≤
          dist (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)).1 A + dist A TwoCycle.kZero :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < a / 4 + a / 4 := add_lt_add hstep hAa
      _ < a := by linarith
  have houtputMem : (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)).1 ∈ s :=
    hslowBall (Metric.mem_ball.mpr houtputDist)
  have hquarter : a / 4 < a := by linarith
  have hinputSlowMem : A ∈ s :=
    hslowBall (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hAa.trans hquarter))
  have hzeroSlow : (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u)).1 ∈ s := by
    rw [hzeroFirst]
    exact hinputSlowMem
  have htransport := fixedNorm_fastError_sub_le hLip
    (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u))
    (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u)) houtputMem hzeroSlow
  have hcubic : fixedNorm
      (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)) -
        fastError (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u))) ≤ (D * C) * t ^ 3 := by
    calc
      fixedNorm
          (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)) -
            fastError (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u))) ≤
        D * ‖Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u) -
          Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u)‖ := htransport
      _ ≤ D * (C * ‖t ^ 3‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmapBound hD.le
      _ = (D * C) * t ^ 3 := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg ht 3)]
        ring
  have hzero : fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u))) ≤
      (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u := by
    rw [perturbedState_apply, fastError_map_zero]
    exact hAcontract.2 u hu₀
  calc
    fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u))) =
        fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u)) +
          (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)) -
            fastError (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u)))) := by
      congr 1
      abel
    _ ≤ fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u))) +
        fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u)) -
          fastError (Normalized.map L κ 0 (perturbedState A u))) := fixedNorm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u + (D * C) * t ^ 3 := add_le_add hzero hcubic
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): one slow radius
and one fast radius work before the feedback parameters are fixed; only the
cubic constant and scale threshold then depend on `L` and `κ`.
items.title: FastRemainder.uniformFastBoundFixedNeighborhood

items.label: FastRemainder.uniformFastBound
items.leanCode:
theorem uniformFastBound (L κ : ℝ) :
    ∃ C₀ > 0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ A : ℝ in 𝓝 TwoCycle.kZero,
      A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
        ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, fixedNorm u < r → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ →
          fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u))) ≤
            (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u + C₀ * t ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, d, hd, hbound⟩ := uniformFastBoundFixedNeighborhood
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, δ, hδ, hfast⟩ := hbound L κ
  refine ⟨C₀, hC₀, r, hr, δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds TwoCycle.kZero hd] with A hA
  have hsmall : |A - TwoCycle.kZero| < d := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] using hA
  exact hfast A hsmall

lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound), fast estimate: the exact
positive-scale map contracts the original fast error, centered at the output
slow coordinate, up to one common cubic scale error. All constants and the
state neighborhood are fixed before `j₀` is selected.

theorem sourceFastBound (L κ : ℝ) :
    ∃ C₀ > 0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ A : ℝ in 𝓝 TwoCycle.kZero,
      A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
        ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, fixedNorm u < r → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ →
          fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u))) ≤
            (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u + C₀ * t ^ 3 + C₀ * fixedNorm u ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, r, hr, δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := uniformFastBound L κ
  refine ⟨C₀, hC₀, r, hr, δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hbound] with A hA
  refine ⟨hA.1, ?_⟩
  intro u hu t ht htδ

    (le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hC₀.le (sq_nonneg (fixedNorm u))))

theorem uniformFastBoundOnNeighborhood (L κ : ℝ) :
    ∃ γ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ C₀ > 0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ δ > 0,
      ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 TwoCycle.kZero, ∀ A ∈ U,
        A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
          ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, fixedNorm u < r → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ →
            fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u))) ≤
              γ * fixedNorm u + C₀ * t ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, r, hr, δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := uniformFastBound L κ
  have hγ : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by norm_num
  refine ⟨3 / 4, hγ, C₀, hC₀, r, hr, δ, hδ,
    {A : ℝ | A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
      ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, fixedNorm u < r → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ →
        fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u))) ≤
          (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u + C₀ * t ^ 3}, hbound, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  exact hA

Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): one explicit

theorem uniformFastBoundNearCycle :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ᶠ νStar : ℝ in 𝓝 baseAngle,
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∀ L κ : ℝ,
        ∃ C₀ > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 (cycleK νStar), ∀ A ∈ U,
          A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
            ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, fixedNorm u < r → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ →
              fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map L κ t (perturbedState A u))) ≤
                (3 / 4 : ℝ) * fixedNorm u + C₀ * t ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, d, hd, hbound⟩ := uniformFastBoundFixedNeighborhood
  have htendsto : Tendsto cycleK (𝓝 baseAngle) (𝓝 TwoCycle.kZero) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, TwoCycle.kZero_def] using
      TwoCycle.hasDerivAt_cycleK_baseAngle.continuousAt
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [TwoCycle.parameterSet_mem_nhds,
    htendsto.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds TwoCycle.kZero hd)] with νStar hν hcenter
  refine ⟨hν, ?_⟩
  intro L κ
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, δ, hδ, hfast⟩ := hbound L κ
  refine ⟨C₀, hC₀, δ, hδ, Metric.ball TwoCycle.kZero d,
    Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hcenter, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  have hsmall : |A - TwoCycle.kZero| < d := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] using hA
  exact hfast A hsmall

`ν*` near `baseAngle`, the common fast radius works on a neighborhood of the
actual center `K* = cycleK ν*`, for every fixed feedback choice.

theorem polarFastBound :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ᶠ νStar : ℝ in 𝓝 baseAngle,
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧
        ∃ C₀ > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 (cycleK νStar), ∀ A ∈ U,
          A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
            ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, fixedNorm u < r → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ →
              fixedNorm (fastError (Normalized.map (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar))
                (cycleK νStar) t (perturbedState A u))) ≤

  obtain ⟨r, hr, hbound⟩ := uniformFastBoundNearCycle
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hbound] with νStar hν
  exact ⟨hν.1, hν.2 (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar)⟩

theorem cubic_div_quadratic_rpow (t β : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    t ^ 3 / (t ^ 2) ^ (1 + β) = t ^ (1 - 2 * β) := by
  have hthree : t ^ 3 = t ^ (3 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_natCast t 3).symm
  have htwo : t ^ 2 = t ^ (2 : ℝ) := (Real.rpow_natCast t 2).symm
  have hexponent : (3 : ℝ) - 2 * (1 + β) = 1 - 2 * β := by ring
  rw [hthree, htwo, ← Real.rpow_mul ht.le, ← Real.rpow_sub ht, hexponent]

quadratic scale raised to `1+β` has the exact source exponent `1−2β`.

theorem cubic_div_scaled_quadratic_rpow (c U t β : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (ht : 0 < t) :
    c * t ^ 3 / (U * t ^ 2) ^ (1 + β) =
      (c / U ^ (1 + β)) * t ^ (1 - 2 * β) := by
  rw [Real.mul_rpow hU.le (sq_nonneg t)]
  calc
    c * t ^ 3 / (U ^ (1 + β) * (t ^ 2) ^ (1 + β)) =
        (c / U ^ (1 + β)) * (t ^ 3 / (t ^ 2) ^ (1 + β)) :=
      (div_mul_div_comm _ _ _ _).symm
    _ = (c / U ^ (1 + β)) * t ^ (1 - 2 * β) := by
      rw [cubic_div_quadratic_rpow t β ht]

ratio retains its source exponent after a fixed positive step coefficient.

theorem cubicQuadraticRatio_lower {a d t c U β : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hU : 0 < U) (hβ : 0 ≤ 1 + β)
    (hd : 0 < d) (ha : c * t ^ 3 ≤ a) (hstep : d ≤ U * t ^ 2) :
    (c / U ^ (1 + β)) * t ^ (1 - 2 * β) ≤ a / d ^ (1 + β) := by
  have haNonneg : 0 ≤ a := (mul_nonneg hc (pow_nonneg ht.le 3)).trans ha
  have hdenom := Real.rpow_le_rpow hd.le hstep hβ
  have hlargePositive := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (mul_pos hU (sq_pos_of_pos ht)) (1 + β)
  rw [← cubic_div_scaled_quadratic_rpow c U t β hU ht]
  calc
    c * t ^ 3 / (U * t ^ 2) ^ (1 + β) ≤ a / (U * t ^ 2) ^ (1 + β) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ha hlargePositive.le
    _ ≤ a / d ^ (1 + β) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left haNonneg (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd _) hdenom

and quadratic positive step upper bound give the precise source power lower bound.

theorem cubicQuadraticRatio_upper {a d t C lower β : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hlower : 0 < lower) (hβ : 0 ≤ 1 + β)
    (ha : a ≤ C * t ^ 3) (hstep : lower * t ^ 2 ≤ d) :
    a / d ^ (1 + β) ≤ (C / lower ^ (1 + β)) * t ^ (1 - 2 * β) := by
  have hd := (mul_pos hlower (sq_pos_of_pos ht)).trans_le hstep
  have hdenom := Real.rpow_le_rpow (mul_pos hlower (sq_pos_of_pos ht)).le hstep hβ
  rw [← cubic_div_scaled_quadratic_rpow C lower t β hlower ht]
  calc
    a / d ^ (1 + β) ≤ (C * t ^ 3) / d ^ (1 + β) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ha (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd _).le
    _ ≤ (C * t ^ 3) / (lower * t ^ 2) ^ (1 + β) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg hC (pow_nonneg ht.le 3))
        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (mul_pos hlower (sq_pos_of_pos ht)) _) hdenom

and quadratic step lower bound give the corresponding source power upper bound.

theorem oddCoefficient_cubic_bounds {p : Parameters} {A E : ℝ}
    (h : ActualObjective.CoefficientEstimates p A E) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hsmall : E * p.scale 0 ≤ p.feedbackRate / 2) (j : ℕ) :
    (p.feedbackRate / 2) * p.scale j ^ 3 ≤ ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p (2 * j + 1)‖ ∧
      ‖InterpolationSum.polarCoefficient p (2 * j + 1)‖ ≤
        (3 * p.feedbackRate / 2) * p.scale j ^ 3 := by
  have ht := ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j
  have hscale := ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hstart (Nat.zero_le j)
  have hsmallj := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscale hE).trans hsmall
  exact cubic_bounds_of_quartic_error ht hsmallj (h.odd_error j)

items.leanCode:
theorem not_holderHessianOn_of_evenCubicResidual {p : Parameters}
    {κ c lower upper separation β : ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ))
    (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (hc : 0 < c) (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 < upper)
    (hβ : 1 / 2 < β) (hpoints : PointGeometry.PointEstimates p lower upper separation)
    (hresidual : ∀ j, c * p.scale j ^ 3 ≤ ‖evenResidual p κ j‖)
    (S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (hS : Convex ℝ S) (hmem : ∀ k, p.point k ∈ S) :
    ¬ ∃ C ≥ 0, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
      ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) x -
        hessian (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ β := by
  have ht := ScaleTails.scale_pos p hstart
  have hstep := evenStep_bounds_of_pointEstimates hpoints
  have hpositive (j : ℕ) : 0 < ‖p.point (2 * j + 1) - p.point (2 * j)‖ := by
    simpa only [evenStep_def] using
      (mul_pos hlower (sq_pos_of_pos (ht j))).trans_le (hstep j).1
  have hdiverge := evenResidualRatio_tendsto_of_cubic_lower hstart hc hlower hupper hβ
    hpoints hresidual
  rw [funext (evenResidualRatio_def p κ β)] at hdiverge
  simp only [evenResidual_def, evenStep_def] at hdiverge
  have hβnonneg : 0 ≤ β := by linarith
  exact not_holderHessianOn_of_remainderRatio_tendsto hf hS
    (fun j ↦ hmem (2 * j)) (fun j ↦ hmem (2 * j + 1)) hpositive hβnonneg hdiverge
items.statement:
Helper for eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz and thm:main: a proved cubic
actual residual excludes a Hölder Hessian on every convex set containing the original points.
items.title: HolderSharpness.not_holderHessianOn_of_evenCubicResidual

items.label: HolderSharpness.sharpnessEstimatesOfActualData
items.leanCode:
theorem sharpnessEstimatesOfActualData {p : Parameters} {κ ε C H A E lower upper separation : ℝ}
    {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {K c B : ℝ}
    (hobjective : ActualObjective.ObjectiveEstimates p κ ε C H)
    (hcoefficients : ActualObjective.CoefficientEstimates p A E)
    (hradii : RadiusProducts.RadiusEstimates p D K c B)
    (hpoints : PointGeometry.PointEstimates p lower upper separation)
    (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (hfeedback : 0 < p.feedbackRate) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 < upper) (hε : ε < 1)
    (hsmall : E * p.scale 0 ≤ p.feedbackRate / 2) :
    SharpnessEstimates p κ (p.feedbackRate / 2) (3 * p.feedbackRate / 2) lower upper := by
  have hresidual := evenResidual_cubic_bounds hobjective hcoefficients hstart hE hsmall
  have hlow : 0 < p.feedbackRate / 2 := half_pos hfeedback
  have hhigh : 0 ≤ 3 * p.feedbackRate / 2 := by positivity
  have hlevel := convex_initialLevelSet_of_strongConvex (sub_pos.mpr hε).le hobjective.strongConvex
  have hmem := points_mem_initialLevelSet hobjective hradii
  have hnot : ∀ β ∈ Set.Ioc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), Convex ℝ S → (∀ k, p.point k ∈ S) →
        ¬ ∃ L ≥ 0, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
          ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) x -
            hessian (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖ ^ β := by
    intro β hβ S hS hcontains
    exact not_holderHessianOn_of_evenCubicResidual hobjective.objective_contDiff hstart hlow
      hlower hupper hβ.1 hpoints (fun j ↦ (hresidual j).1) S hS hcontains
  refine ⟨evenResidual_eq_oddCoefficient hobjective, hresidual,
    evenStep_bounds_of_pointEstimates hpoints, ?_, ?_, hlevel, hmem, hnot, ?_⟩
  · intro β hβ j
    have hexponent : 0 ≤ 1 + β := by linarith [hβ.1]
    exact evenResidualRatio_bounds_of_cubic_bounds hstart hlow.le hhigh hlower hupper
      hexponent hpoints hresidual j
  · intro β hβ
    exact evenResidualRatio_tendsto_of_cubic_lower hstart hlow hlower hupper hβ.1 hpoints
      (fun j ↦ (hresidual j).1)
  · intro β hβ
    exact hnot β hβ (initialLevelSet p κ) hlevel hmem
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main and eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz: actual objective,
coefficient, and geometry certificates yield the source sharpness contradiction.
items.title: HolderSharpness.sharpnessEstimatesOfActualData

items.label: HolderSharpness.polarHolderSharpness
items.leanCode:
theorem polarHolderSharpness :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ κ > 0, ∃ C > 0, ∃ H > 0, ∃ cResidual > 0, ∃ CResidual > 0,
        ∃ lower > 0, ∃ upper > 0, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
          ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
            ActualObjective.ObjectiveEstimates (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) κ ε C H ∧
              SharpnessEstimates (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) κ cResidual CResidual lower upper := by
  obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, hobjectives⟩ := ActualObjective.polarObjectiveEstimates
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hcoefficients⟩ := ActualObjective.actualCoefficientEstimates
  obtain ⟨η₂, hη₂, hgeometry⟩ := PointGeometry.polarPointGeometry
  refine ⟨min η₀ (min η₁ η₂), lt_min hη₀ (lt_min hη₁ hη₂), ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  have hnear₀ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₀) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))⟩
  have hnear₁ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₁) := by
    have hle := (min_le_right η₀ (min η₁ η₂)).trans (min_le_left η₁ η₂)
    exact ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl hle)⟩
  have hnear₂ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₂) := by
    have hle := (min_le_right η₀ (min η₁ η₂)).trans (min_le_right η₁ η₂)
    exact ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl hle)⟩
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, C, hC, H, hH, haccuracy⟩ := hobjectives νStar hnear₀
  obtain ⟨_, A, _, E, hE, K₁, _, c₁, _, B₁, _, J₁, hJ₁, hdata⟩ := hcoefficients νStar hnear₁
  obtain ⟨_, K₂, _, c₂, _, B₂, _, lower, hlower, upper, hupper, separation, _, J₂, _, hpoints⟩ :=
    hgeometry νStar hnear₂
  let L := 4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)
  have ha := AngularGeometry.baseAngle_pos
  have hν : 0 < νStar := ha.trans hnear.1
  have hL : 0 < L := by
    dsimp only [L]
    positivity
  have hcutoff : 0 < L / (2 * E) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨J₃, _, hscale⟩ := Continuation.existsStartThreshold _ hcutoff
  have hCResidual : 0 < 3 * L / 2 := by positivity
  refine ⟨κ, hκ, C, hC, H, hH, L / 2, half_pos hL, 3 * L / 2, hCResidual,
    lower, hlower, upper, hupper, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε hεone
  obtain ⟨J₀, hJ₀, hobjective⟩ := haccuracy ε hε hεone
  refine ⟨max J₀ (max J₁ (max J₂ J₃)), hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  have hj₀₀ := (le_max_left J₀ (max J₁ (max J₂ J₃))).trans hj₀
  have hj₀₁ := (le_max_left J₁ (max J₂ J₃)).trans
    ((le_max_right J₀ (max J₁ (max J₂ J₃))).trans hj₀)
  have hj₀₂ := (le_max_left J₂ J₃).trans
    ((le_max_right J₁ (max J₂ J₃)).trans
      ((le_max_right J₀ (max J₁ (max J₂ J₃))).trans hj₀))
  have hj₀₃ := (le_max_right J₂ J₃).trans
    ((le_max_right J₁ (max J₂ J₃)).trans
      ((le_max_right J₀ (max J₁ (max J₂ J₃))).trans hj₀))
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJ₁.trans_le hj₀₁
  have hfeedback : p.feedbackRate = L := feedbackRate_of j₀ νStar
  have hzero : p.scale 0 < L / (2 * E) := hscale νStar j₀ hj₀₃
  have hdenominator : 0 < 2 * E := by positivity
  have hsmall : E * p.scale 0 ≤ p.feedbackRate / 2 := by
    rw [hfeedback]
    nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ hdenominator).mp hzero]
  have hactualObjective := hobjective j₀ hj₀₀
  have hactualCoefficient := (hdata j₀ hj₀₁).2.1
  obtain ⟨hradius, hpoint⟩ := hpoints j₀ hj₀₂
  have hsharp := sharpnessEstimatesOfActualData hactualObjective hactualCoefficient hradius
    hpoint hstart (hdata j₀ hj₀₁).2.2 hE.le hlower hupper hεone hsmall
  rw [hfeedback] at hsharp
  exact ⟨hactualObjective, hsharp⟩
items.statement:
eq:counterexample-nonlipschitz and thm:main (sharp exponent): the exact source
objective has cubic even secant residuals and quadratic steps, so its residual ratio
has order `t^(1−2β)` and diverges for every `β∈(1/2,1]`. The Hessian is not β-Hölder
on its original convex initial level set. All support and quantitative constants are
chosen before the accuracy and every subsequent natural starting index.
items.title: HolderSharpness.polarHolderSharpness

theorem origin_unique_pullback {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : F → ℝ) (P : E ≃L[ℝ] F)
    (hzero : f 0 = 0) (hunique : ∀ x, (∀ y, f x ≤ f y) ↔ x = 0) :
    (f ∘ P) 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ x, (∀ y, (f ∘ P) x ≤ (f ∘ P) y) ↔ x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · simpa only [Function.comp_apply, map_zero] using hzero
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hmin
      have hsource : ∀ y, f (P x) ≤ f y := by
        intro y
        simpa only [Function.comp_apply, P.apply_symm_apply] using hmin (P.symm y)
      have hz := (hunique (P x)).mp hsource
      apply P.injective
      simpa only [map_zero] using hz
    · intro hx
      subst x
      intro y
      have hsource := (hunique 0).mpr rfl
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply, map_zero] using hsource (P y)
items.statement:

theorem canonicalPushforward_posDef {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : A.PosDef) (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ ≃⋆ₐ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)).symm
        (P.toContinuousLinearMap.pushforward
          ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ ≃⋆ₐ[ℝ]
            EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) A))).PosDef := by
  have hpositive : ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ ≃⋆ₐ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) A).IsPositive :=
    Matrix.isPositive_toEuclideanCLM_iff.mpr hA.posSemidef
  have hcongruent := hpositive.pushforward P.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hstrict : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), z ≠ 0 →
      0 < inner ℝ z (P.toContinuousLinearMap.pushforward
        ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ ≃⋆ₐ[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) A) z) := by
    intro z hz
    have hadjoint : P.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint z ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have h := congrArg P.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint hzero
      rw [P.adjoint_symm_apply_adjoint, map_zero] at h
      exact hz h
    have hcoordinates : WithLp.ofLp (P.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint z) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hadjoint
      exact (WithLp.ofLp_injective 2) hzero
    have hinner : 0 < inner ℝ (P.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint z)
        (((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ ≃⋆ₐ[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) A)
            (P.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint z)) := by
      simpa only [Matrix.inner_toEuclideanCLM, star_trivial] using
        hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hcoordinates
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.pushforward_apply,
      ← P.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
    exact hinner
  have hmatrix := WolfeCounterexample.canonicalMatrix_posDef_of_operatorStrictPositive
    hcongruent.isSelfAdjoint hstrict
  simpa only [WolfeCounterexample.canonicalMatrixSequence_apply] using hmatrix

preserves positive definiteness of the actual canonical matrix representation.

theorem pulledSteps_eq {n : ℕ} (it : DFP.InverseIteration (Fin n))
    (hstep : ∀ k, 0 < it.stepLength k)
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (k : ℕ) :
    DFP.steps it.stepLength (DFP.directions (pulledInverseHessians it P)
      (pulledGradients it P)) k =
        P.symm (DFP.steps it.stepLength (DFP.directions it.inverseHessian
          (DFP.gradients it.objective it.point)) k) := by
  have hnew := (pulledOrbit it hstep P).pointSucc k
  have hold := (it.isOrbit hstep).pointSucc k
  have hnewStep : DFP.steps it.stepLength (DFP.directions (pulledInverseHessians it P)
      (pulledGradients it P)) k = pulledPoints it P (k + 1) - pulledPoints it P k := by
    rw [hnew]
    abel
  calc
    DFP.steps it.stepLength (DFP.directions (pulledInverseHessians it P)
        (pulledGradients it P)) k = pulledPoints it P (k + 1) - pulledPoints it P k := hnewStep
    _ = P.symm (it.point (k + 1) - it.point k) := by
      rw [pulledPoints_apply, pulledPoints_apply, map_sub]
    _ = P.symm (DFP.steps it.stepLength (DFP.directions it.inverseHessian
        (DFP.gradients it.objective it.point)) k) := by
      rw [hold]
      congr 1
      abel

theorem existsPulledIteration {n : ℕ} (it : DFP.InverseIteration (Fin n))
    (hstep : ∀ k, 0 < it.stepLength k)
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ∃ target : DFP.InverseIteration (Fin n), PullbackData it target P := by
  have hOrbit := pulledOrbit it hstep P
  have hPos := pulledInverseHessians_posDef it P
  have hDen := pulledDenominator_ne it hstep P
  let target := hOrbit.toInverseIteration hPos hDen
  have hf : target.objective = pulledObjective it P :=
    hOrbit.toInverseIteration_objective hPos hDen
  have hα : target.stepLength = it.stepLength := hOrbit.toInverseIteration_stepLength hPos hDen
  have hx : target.point = pulledPoints it P := hOrbit.toInverseIteration_point_eq hPos hDen
  have hH : target.inverseHessian = pulledInverseHessians it P :=
    hOrbit.toInverseIteration_inverseHessian_eq hPos hDen
  have hg : DFP.gradients target.objective target.point = pulledGradients it P := by
    rw [hf, hx]
    exact hOrbit.gradients_eq
  exact ⟨target, hf, hα, hx, hH, hg⟩

items.label: IdentityInitialization.positiveRoot_bounds
items.leanCode:
theorem positiveRoot_bounds {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧
      a • (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ≤
        hA.sqrtEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback 1 ∧
      hA.sqrtEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback 1 ≤
        b • (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ∧
      a • (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ≤
        hA.sqrtEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pushforward 1 := by
  let Aop := (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ ≃⋆ₐ[ℝ]
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) A
  have hpositive : Aop.IsPositive := Matrix.isPositive_toEuclideanCLM_iff.mpr hA.posSemidef
  have hunit : IsUnit Aop := by
    exact (isUnit_map_iff (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ ≃⋆ₐ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) A).mpr hA.isUnit
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hlower⟩ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.exists_loewner_lowerBound_of_isPositive_isUnit hpositive hunit
  have hupper : Aop ≤ ‖Aop‖ • (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_le_norm_smul_one hpositive
  have hdiff : (‖Aop‖ + 1) • (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) - ‖Aop‖ • 1 = 1 := by module
  have hnormLe : ‖Aop‖ • (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ≤ (‖Aop‖ + 1) • 1 := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.le_def, hdiff]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_one
  have hpull : hA.sqrtEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback 1 = Aop := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.pullback_one_eq_pushforward_one _ hA.sqrtEquiv_isSelfAdjoint,
      ← hA.sqrtEquiv_pushforward_one]
  have hpush : hA.sqrtEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pushforward 1 = Aop :=
    hA.sqrtEquiv_pushforward_one.symm
  have hb : 0 < ‖Aop‖ + 1 := by positivity
  refine ⟨a, ‖Aop‖ + 1, ha, hb, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hpull]
    exact hlower
  · rw [hpull]
    exact hupper.trans hnormLe
  · rw [hpush]
    exact hlower

Helper for cor:identity-initialization: the literal positive self-adjoint
matrix square root has fixed positive lower and upper distortion constants.

items.leanCode:
theorem pulledGradient_liminf {n : ℕ} {c₁ c₂ q : ℝ}
    (c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin n) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂)
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hlower : q • (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ≤
      P.toContinuousLinearMap.pushforward 1) :
    0 < liminf (fun k ↦ ‖pulledGradients c.iteration P k‖) atTop ∧
      ∃ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, δ ≤ ‖pulledGradients c.iteration P k‖ := by
  have hSourceLower : ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      c.gradientLimit / 2 ≤ ‖DFP.gradients c.iteration.objective c.iteration.point k‖ := by
    have hlt : c.gradientLimit / 2 < c.gradientLimit := by linarith [c.gradientLimitPos]
    exact ((tendsto_order.1 c.gradientNormTendsto).1 _ hlt).mono (fun _ h ↦ h.le)
  have hSourceUpper : ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      ‖DFP.gradients c.iteration.objective c.iteration.point k‖ ≤ 2 * c.gradientLimit := by
    have hlt : c.gradientLimit < 2 * c.gradientLimit := by linarith [c.gradientLimitPos]
    exact ((tendsto_order.1 c.gradientNormTendsto).2 _ hlt).mono (fun _ h ↦ h.le)
  let δ := Real.sqrt q * (c.gradientLimit / 2)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq) (half_pos c.gradientLimitPos)
  have hLower : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, δ ≤ ‖pulledGradients c.iteration P k‖ := by
    filter_upwards [hSourceLower] with k hk
    rw [pulledGradients_apply]
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk (Real.sqrt_nonneg q)).trans
      (P.toContinuousLinearMap.norm_adjoint_lower_bound hq.le hlower _)
  have hUpper : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ‖pulledGradients c.iteration P k‖ ≤
      ‖P.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint‖ * (2 * c.gradientLimit) := by
    filter_upwards [hSourceUpper] with k hk
    rw [pulledGradients_apply]
    exact (P.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.le_opNorm _).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk (norm_nonneg _))
  exact ⟨DFP.positive_liminf_of_eventually_lower_upper hδ hLower hUpper, δ, hδ, hLower⟩

Helper for cor:identity-initialization: a positive source gradient limit
and positive adjoint distortion give an explicit positive transformed tail and liminf.

items.label: IdentityInitialization.existsNormalizedCertificate
items.leanCode:
theorem existsNormalizedCertificate {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin n) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂) :
    ∃ (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
      (m M : ℝ) (d : WolfeCounterexample.MatrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeCertificate n m M c₁ c₂),
      P = (c.iteration.inverseHessianPosDef 0).sqrtEquiv ∧
        PullbackData c.iteration d.iteration P := by
  let P := (c.iteration.inverseHessianPosDef 0).sqrtEquiv
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hlower, hupper, hgradient⟩ :=
    positiveRoot_bounds _ (c.iteration.inverseHessianPosDef 0)
  obtain ⟨it, hdata⟩ := existsPulledIteration c.iteration c.stepLengthPos P
  have hhalfPos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hm : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * a := mul_pos hhalfPos ha
  have hab : a ≤ b := WolfeCounterexample.scalar_le_of_identity_loewner_bounds hn
    (hlower.trans hupper)
  have hmM : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * a ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * b := by nlinarith
  have hC2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 it.objective := by
    rw [hdata.objective, pulledObjective_def]
    exact c.objectiveContDiff.comp P.contDiff
  have hstep : ∀ k, 0 < it.stepLength k := by
    rw [hdata.stepLength]
    exact c.stepLengthPos
  have hGradientDiff : Differentiable ℝ (gradient c.iteration.objective) :=
    (c.objectiveContDiff.gradient_succ (n := 1)).differentiable_one
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hthree : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hBounds : HasHessianBounds ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * a) ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * b) it.objective := by
    rw [hdata.objective, pulledObjective_def]
    exact c.hessianBounds.comp_continuousLinearEquiv P hGradientDiff hhalf hthree hlower hupper
  have hInitial : it.inverseHessian 0 = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
    rw [hdata.inverseHessian]
    exact pulledInverseHessians_zero c.iteration
  have hGradient := pulledGradient_liminf c P ha hgradient
  have hLiminf : 0 < liminf (fun k ↦ ‖DFP.gradients it.objective it.point k‖) atTop := by
    rw [hdata.gradients]
    exact hGradient.1
  have hTail : ∃ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, δ ≤ ‖DFP.gradients it.objective it.point k‖ := by
    rw [hdata.gradients]
    exact hGradient.2
  let d : WolfeCounterexample.MatrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeCertificate n
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * a) ((3 / 2 : ℝ) * b) c₁ c₂ := {
    iteration := it
    c₁_pos := (c.strongWolfe 0).c₁_pos
    c₁_lt_c₂ := (c.strongWolfe 0).c₁_lt_c₂
    c₂_lt_one := (c.strongWolfe 0).c₂_lt_one
    hessianLowerPos := hm
    hessianLowerLeUpper := hmM
    objectiveContDiff := hC2
    stepLengthPos := hstep
    hessianBounds := hBounds
    strongWolfe := hdata.strongWolfe c.strongWolfe
    initialInverseHessian_eq_one := hInitial
    gradientNormLiminfPos := hLiminf
    gradientNormEventuallyPositive := hTail
  }
  have hP : P = (c.iteration.inverseHessianPosDef 0).sqrtEquiv := rfl
  exact ⟨P, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * a, (3 / 2 : ℝ) * b, d, hP, hdata⟩

theorem normalizePlanarWithProperties {c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin 2) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂)
    (hzero : c.iteration.objective 0 = 0)
    (hunique : ∀ x, (∀ y, c.iteration.objective x ≤ c.iteration.objective y) ↔ x = 0)
    (hholder : ∃ C ≥ 0, ∀ x y,
      ‖hessian c.iteration.objective x - hessian c.iteration.objective y‖ ≤
        C * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (hcircle : ∀ x, MapClusterPt x atTop c.iteration.point ↔ ‖x‖ = 1) :
    ∃ (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
      (m M : ℝ) (d : WolfeCounterexample.MatrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeCertificate 2 m M c₁ c₂),
      P = (c.iteration.inverseHessianPosDef 0).sqrtEquiv ∧ PullbackData c.iteration d.iteration P ∧
        EllipseObjectiveProperties d.iteration P.symm.toLinearMap := by
  have htwo : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 2 := le_rfl
  obtain ⟨P, m, M, d, hP, hdata⟩ := existsNormalizedCertificate htwo c
  have hObjective : d.iteration.objective = c.iteration.objective ∘ P :=
    hdata.objective.trans (pulledObjective_def c.iteration P)
  have horigin := origin_unique_pullback c.iteration.objective P hzero hunique
  have hInjective : Function.Injective P.symm.toLinearMap := P.symm.injective
  have hcluster : {z | MapClusterPt z atTop d.iteration.point} =
      P.symm.toLinearMap '' Metric.sphere 0 1 := by
    rw [hdata.point, pulledPoints_def]
    exact clusterSet_ellipse P c.iteration.point hcircle
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hHolder⟩ := hholder
  let B := ‖P.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ^ 2 * C * ‖P.toContinuousLinearMap‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by positivity
  have hPositive : 0 < B + 1 := by linarith
  have hHalf : ∀ x y, ‖hessian d.iteration.objective x - hessian d.iteration.objective y‖ ≤
      (B + 1) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    intro x y
    rw [hObjective]
    have h := halfHolder_pullback c.iteration.objective c.objectiveContDiff P C hC hHolder x y
    have hLe : B ≤ B + 1 := by linarith
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLe (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))
  have hZero : d.iteration.objective 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hObjective]
    exact horigin.1
  have hUnique : ∀ x, (∀ y, d.iteration.objective x ≤ d.iteration.objective y) ↔ x = 0 := by
    rw [hObjective]
    exact horigin.2
  have hHalfPackage : ∃ C > 0, ∀ x y,
      ‖hessian d.iteration.objective x - hessian d.iteration.objective y‖ ≤
        C * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := ⟨B + 1, hPositive, hHalf⟩
  have hProperties : EllipseObjectiveProperties d.iteration P.symm.toLinearMap :=
    ⟨hInjective, ellipse_range_finrank _ hInjective, hcluster, hHalfPackage, hZero, hUnique⟩
  exact ⟨P, m, M, d, hP, hdata, hProperties⟩

    (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁lim : c₁ < 2 / 3) (hc₂lim : 2 / 3 ≤ c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :

theorem isometric_matrix_one {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ ≃⋆ₐ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)).symm
        (Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.pushforward 1) =
          (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
  have hmap : Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.symm.toContinuousLinearMap =
      (Q.symm : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by rfl
  have hidentity : Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.pushforward 1 =
      (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    rw [hmap, ContinuousLinearMap.pushforward_one, Q.symm.adjoint_eq_symm]
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro z
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, one_apply_eq_self,
      LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_symm, LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_coe''] using
      Q.symm_apply_apply z
  rw [hidentity, map_one]

items.label: IdentityInitialization.extendNormalizedPlanar
items.leanCode:
theorem extendNormalizedPlanar (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) {m M c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (d : WolfeCounterexample.MatrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeCertificate 2 m M c₁ c₂)
    (i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hproperties : EllipseObjectiveProperties d.iteration i) :
    ∃ result : WolfeCounterexample.MatrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeCertificate n
        (min m 1) (max M 1) c₁ c₂,
      DimensionExtensionData n hn d.iteration result.iteration ∧
        EllipseObjectiveProperties result.iteration
          ((OrthogonalExtension.planeEmbedding n hn).toLinearMap.comp i) := by
  let Q := OrthogonalExtension.coordinateEquiv n hn
  let itSum := d.iteration.orthogonalSum (κ := Fin (n - 2)) d.stepLengthPos
  have hStepSum : ∀ k, 0 < itSum.stepLength k := by
    simpa only [itSum, DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_stepLength] using d.stepLengthPos
  let it := itSum.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv hStepSum Q
  have hObjective : it.objective =
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := Fin (n - 2))
        d.iteration.objective ∘ Q := by
    simp only [it, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_objective, itSum,
      DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_objective, DFP.OrthogonalSum.objective_eq]
  have hPoint (k : ℕ) : it.point k =
      OrthogonalExtension.planeEmbedding n hn (d.iteration.point k) := by
    simp only [it, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_point, itSum,
      DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_point, OrthogonalExtension.embed_eq_leftEmbedding,
      OrthogonalExtension.planeEmbedding_apply, Q]
  have hAlpha : it.stepLength = d.iteration.stepLength := by
    simp only [it, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_stepLength, itSum,
      DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_stepLength]
  have hMatrix (k : ℕ) : it.inverseHessian k =
      OrthogonalExtension.extendedMatrix n hn (d.iteration.inverseHessian k) := by
    simp only [it, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_inverseHessian, itSum,
      DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_inverseHessian, OrthogonalExtension.extendedMatrix_def, Q]
  have hm : 0 < min m 1 := lt_min d.hessianLowerPos zero_lt_one
  have hmM : min m 1 ≤ max M 1 := (min_le_left _ _).trans
    (d.hessianLowerLeUpper.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  have hC2Sum : ContDiff ℝ 2 itSum.objective := by
    dsimp only [itSum]
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_objective, DFP.OrthogonalSum.objective_eq]
    exact EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.contDiff_objective d.objectiveContDiff
  have hC2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 it.objective := by
    dsimp only [it]
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_objective]
    exact hC2Sum.comp Q.contDiff
  have hStep : ∀ k, 0 < it.stepLength k := by
    rw [hAlpha]
    exact d.stepLengthPos
  have hWide : HasHessianBounds (min m 1) (max M 1) d.iteration.objective :=
    PlanarCounterexample.hessianBounds_mono d.objectiveContDiff d.hessianBounds
      (min_le_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hBoundsSum : HasHessianBounds (min m 1) (max M 1) itSum.objective := by
    dsimp only [itSum]
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_objective, DFP.OrthogonalSum.objective_eq]
    exact EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.hasHessianBounds_objective
      d.objectiveContDiff hWide (min_le_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hGradientDiffSum : Differentiable ℝ (gradient itSum.objective) :=
    (hC2Sum.gradient_succ (n := 1)).differentiable_one
  have hMnonneg : 0 ≤ max M 1 := zero_le_one.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hBounds : HasHessianBounds (min m 1) (max M 1) it.objective := by
    dsimp only [it]
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_objective]
    exact hBoundsSum.comp_linearIsometryEquiv Q hGradientDiffSum hm.le hMnonneg
  have hStrongSum (k : ℕ) : LineSearch.IsStrongWolfe c₁ c₂ itSum.objective
      (itSum.point k) (itSum.point (k + 1) - itSum.point k) := by
    have h := (LineSearch.IsStrongWolfe.orthogonalSum_iff (κ := Fin (n - 2))).mpr
      (d.strongWolfe k)
    simpa only [itSum, DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_objective,
      DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_point, DFP.OrthogonalSum.objective_eq,
      OrthogonalExtension.embed_eq_leftEmbedding, OrthogonalExtension.leftEmbedding_apply,
      map_sub] using h
  have hStrong (k : ℕ) : LineSearch.IsStrongWolfe c₁ c₂ it.objective
      (it.point k) (it.point (k + 1) - it.point k) := by
    have h := (hStrongSum k).comp_linearIsometryEquiv Q
    simpa only [it, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_objective,
      DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_point, map_sub] using h
  have hInitial : it.inverseHessian 0 = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) := by
    dsimp only [it]
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_inverseHessian]
    dsimp only [itSum]
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_inverseHessian, d.initialInverseHessian_eq_one,
      orthogonal_matrix_one, map_one]
    exact isometric_matrix_one Q
  have hNorm (k : ℕ) : ‖DFP.gradients it.objective it.point k‖ =
      ‖DFP.gradients d.iteration.objective d.iteration.point k‖ := by
    simp only [it, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_gradients,
      Q.symm.norm_map, itSum, DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_gradients,
      DFP.OrthogonalSum.norm_embed]
  have hLiminf : 0 < liminf (fun k ↦ ‖DFP.gradients it.objective it.point k‖) atTop := by
    simpa only [hNorm] using d.gradientNormLiminfPos
  have hTail : ∃ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, δ ≤ ‖DFP.gradients it.objective it.point k‖ := by
    simpa only [hNorm] using d.gradientNormEventuallyPositive
  have hPointFun : it.point = OrthogonalExtension.planeEmbedding n hn ∘ d.iteration.point := by
    funext k
    exact hPoint k
  have hCluster : {z | MapClusterPt z atTop it.point} =
      ((OrthogonalExtension.planeEmbedding n hn).toLinearMap.comp i) '' Metric.sphere 0 1 := by
    rw [hPointFun, OrthogonalExtension.clusterSet_isometric_embedding,
      hproperties.cluster, Set.image_image]
    rfl
  have hInjective : Function.Injective
      ((OrthogonalExtension.planeEmbedding n hn).toLinearMap.comp i) :=
    (OrthogonalExtension.planeEmbedding n hn).injective.comp hproperties.injective
  have hOriginSum := OrthogonalExtension.objective_orthogonal_unique_origin
    (κ := Fin (n - 2)) hproperties.origin hproperties.unique_minimizer
  have hOrigin := OrthogonalExtension.objective_isometric_unique_origin Q
    hOriginSum.1 hOriginSum.2
  have hZero : it.objective 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hObjective]
    exact hOrigin.1
  have hUnique : ∀ x, (∀ y, it.objective x ≤ it.objective y) ↔ x = 0 := by
    rw [hObjective]
    exact hOrigin.2
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hHolder⟩ := hproperties.half_holder
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hHolderSum : ∀ x y,
      ‖hessian (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := Fin (n - 2))
        d.iteration.objective) x -
        hessian (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := Fin (n - 2))
          d.iteration.objective) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.hessianHolder_objective
      d.objectiveContDiff hC.le hhalf hHolder
  have hHolderFinal : ∀ x y, ‖hessian it.objective x - hessian it.objective y‖ ≤
      C * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hObjective]
    exact OrthogonalExtension.hessian_holder_isometric
      (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.contDiff_objective d.objectiveContDiff) Q hHolderSum
  have hHolderPackage : ∃ C > 0, ∀ x y,
      ‖hessian it.objective x - hessian it.objective y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    ⟨C, hC, hHolderFinal⟩
  have hProperties : EllipseObjectiveProperties it
      ((OrthogonalExtension.planeEmbedding n hn).toLinearMap.comp i) :=
    ⟨hInjective, ellipse_range_finrank _ hInjective, hCluster, hHolderPackage, hZero, hUnique⟩
  let result : WolfeCounterexample.MatrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeCertificate n
      (min m 1) (max M 1) c₁ c₂ := {
    iteration := it
    c₁_pos := d.c₁_pos
    c₁_lt_c₂ := d.c₁_lt_c₂
    c₂_lt_one := d.c₂_lt_one
    hessianLowerPos := hm
    hessianLowerLeUpper := hmM
    objectiveContDiff := hC2
    stepLengthPos := hStep
    hessianBounds := hBounds
    strongWolfe := hStrong
    initialInverseHessian_eq_one := hInitial
    gradientNormLiminfPos := hLiminf
    gradientNormEventuallyPositive := hTail
  }
  have hIt : result.iteration = it := rfl
  refine ⟨result, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hIt]
    exact ⟨hObjective, hPoint, hAlpha, hMatrix⟩
  · rw [hIt]
    exact hProperties

    ∃ νStar > baseAngle, ∃ κ > 0, ∃ j₀ : ℕ, 0 < j₀ ∧
      ∃ source : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin 2) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂,
        PlanarCounterexample.SourceIdentity (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) κ source ∧
        ∃ (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
          (m M : ℝ)
          (planar : WolfeCounterexample.MatrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeCertificate 2 m M c₁ c₂),
          P = (source.iteration.inverseHessianPosDef 0).sqrtEquiv ∧

            ∃ result : WolfeCounterexample.MatrixIdentityLiminfStrongWolfeCertificate n

theorem norm_secondFDeriv_sub_le_of_thirdFDeriv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f : E → ℝ} {B : ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 3 f)
    (hbound : ∀ z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f z‖ ≤ B) (x y : E) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y‖ ≤ B * ‖x - y‖ := by
  have horderFirst : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 3 := by
    norm_num
  have horderSecond : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 2 := by
    norm_num
  have hfirst : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fderiv ℝ f) := hf.fderiv_right horderFirst
  have hsecond : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)) :=
    hfirst.fderiv_right horderSecond
  have hboundOrdinary : ∀ z, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)) z‖ ≤ B := by
    intro z
    calc
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)) z‖ =
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)) z‖ :=
        (norm_iteratedFDeriv_one (𝕜 := ℝ) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f))).symm
      _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fderiv ℝ f) z‖ := norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv
      _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f z‖ := norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv
      _ ≤ B := hbound z
  exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
    (s := Set.univ) (f := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f))
    (fun z _ ↦ hsecond.differentiable_one z) (fun z _ ↦ hboundOrdinary z)
    convex_univ (Set.mem_univ y) (Set.mem_univ x)

theorem min_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    min A B ≤ Real.sqrt A * Real.sqrt B := by
  have hmin : 0 ≤ min A B := le_min hA hB
  have hproduct := mul_le_mul (min_le_left A B) (min_le_right A B) hmin hA
  have hsquare : min A B ^ 2 ≤ A * B := by
    simpa only [pow_two] using hproduct
  exact (Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hsquare).trans_eq (Real.sqrt_mul hA B)

theorem rpow_neg_three_halves_eq_inv_mul_sqrt_inv {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ρ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) = ρ⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (ρ⁻¹) := by
  have hexponent : (-3 / 2 : ℝ) = -1 + -(1 / 2) := by
    norm_num
  rw [hexponent, Real.rpow_add hρ, Real.rpow_neg_one,
    Real.rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]

items.label: InterpolationBounds.min_inverse_scales_le_halfPower
items.leanCode:
theorem min_inverse_scales_le_halfPower {ρ d : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    min (ρ⁻¹) ((ρ⁻¹) ^ 2 * d) ≤ ρ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) * d ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  have hinverse : 0 ≤ ρ⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hρ).le
  have hscaled : 0 ≤ (ρ⁻¹) ^ 2 * d := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hd
  calc
    min (ρ⁻¹) ((ρ⁻¹) ^ 2 * d) ≤
        Real.sqrt (ρ⁻¹) * Real.sqrt ((ρ⁻¹) ^ 2 * d) :=
      min_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt hinverse hscaled
    _ = Real.sqrt (ρ⁻¹) * (ρ⁻¹ * Real.sqrt d) := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq hinverse]
    _ = (ρ⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (ρ⁻¹)) * Real.sqrt d := by
      ring
    _ = ρ ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) * d ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by

items.leanCode:
theorem norm_finsum_sub_le_two_mul_modulus
    {ι X G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] (f : ι → X → G)
    (hdisjoint : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint (fun i ↦ Function.support (f i)))
    (modulus : X → X → ℝ) (hmodulus : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ modulus x y)
    (hlocal : ∀ i x y, ‖f i x - f i y‖ ≤ modulus x y) (x y : X) :
    ‖(∑ᶠ i, f i x) - ∑ᶠ i, f i y‖ ≤ 2 * modulus x y := by
  classical
  have hsubsingleton (z : X) : (Function.support (fun i ↦ f i z)).Subsingleton := by
    intro i hi j hj
    exact hdisjoint.elim_set (Set.mem_univ i) (Set.mem_univ j) z hi hj
  have hcard (z : X) : (hsubsingleton z).finite.toFinset.card ≤ 1 := by
    apply Finset.card_le_one.mpr
    intro i hi j hj
    exact hsubsingleton z ((hsubsingleton z).finite.mem_toFinset.mp hi)
      ((hsubsingleton z).finite.mem_toFinset.mp hj)
  let I := (hsubsingleton x).finite.toFinset ∪ (hsubsingleton y).finite.toFinset
  have hcardI : I.card ≤ 2 := by
    calc
      I.card ≤ (hsubsingleton x).finite.toFinset.card +
          (hsubsingleton y).finite.toFinset.card := Finset.card_union_le _ _
      _ ≤ 1 + 1 := Nat.add_le_add (hcard x) (hcard y)
      _ = 2 := rfl
  have hx : Function.support (fun i ↦ f i x) ⊆ I := by
    intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_union_left _ ((hsubsingleton x).finite.mem_toFinset.mpr hi)
  have hy : Function.support (fun i ↦ f i y) ⊆ I := by
    intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_union_right _ ((hsubsingleton y).finite.mem_toFinset.mpr hi)
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hx, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hy,
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  calc
    ‖∑ i ∈ I, (f i x - f i y)‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, ‖f i x - f i y‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ I, modulus x y := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ ↦ hlocal i x y)
    _ = (I.card : ℝ) * modulus x y := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ 2 * modulus x y :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hcardI) (hmodulus x y)
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-interpolation: for a family with pairwise disjoint
function supports, at most two indices contribute to a difference of pointwise
finsums. A common modulus for each summand therefore gives twice that modulus
for the finsum.

theorem iteratedFDeriv_correction_eq_zero_of_radius_le_norm_sub
    (n : ℕ) (c : E) (ρ : ℝ) (a z : E) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hz : ρ ≤ ‖z - c‖) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a) z = 0 := by
  have hzero : EqOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a))
      (fun _ ↦ 0) (Metric.closedBall c ρ)ᶜ := by
    intro y hy
    have hnot : y ∉ tsupport (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a) := by
      intro hsupport
      exact hy (ExplicitCutoff.tsupport_correction_subset_closedBall c ρ a hρ hsupport)
    exact iteratedFDeriv_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a) n hnot
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) :=
    (ExplicitCutoff.contDiff_correction c ρ a).continuous_iteratedFDeriv
      (ENat.natCast_le_of_coe_top_le_withTop le_rfl n)
  have hclosure : z ∈ closure (Metric.closedBall c ρ)ᶜ := by
    rw [closure_compl, interior_closedBall c hρ.ne']
    simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, not_lt] using hz
  exact hzero.closure hcontinuous continuous_const hclosure

theorem exists_norm_hessian_correction_sub_le_min :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (c : E) (ρ : ℝ) (a x y : E), 0 < ρ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) x -
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) y‖ ≤
        C * ‖a‖ * min (ρ⁻¹) ((ρ⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖) := by
  obtain ⟨Csize, hCsize, hsize⟩ :=
    ExplicitCutoff.exists_norm_secondFDeriv_correction_le (E := E)
  obtain ⟨Clip, hClip, hlip⟩ := exists_norm_hessian_correction_sub_le_lipschitz (E := E)
  have hC : 0 ≤ max (2 * Csize) Clip := hClip.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨max (2 * Csize) Clip, hC, ?_⟩
  intro c ρ a x y hρ
  rw [mul_min_of_nonneg _ _ (mul_nonneg hC (norm_nonneg a))]
  apply le_min
  · calc
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) x -
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) y‖ ≤
          ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) x‖ +
            ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) y‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ Csize * ‖a‖ / ρ + Csize * ‖a‖ / ρ :=
        add_le_add (hsize c ρ a x hρ) (hsize c ρ a y hρ)
      _ = (2 * Csize) * ‖a‖ * ρ⁻¹ := by
        ring
      _ ≤ max (2 * Csize) Clip * ‖a‖ * ρ⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
          (inv_pos.mpr hρ).le
  · calc
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) x -
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) y‖ ≤
          (Clip * ‖a‖ / ρ ^ 2) * ‖x - y‖ := hlip c ρ a x y hρ
      _ = Clip * ‖a‖ * ((ρ⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖) := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
        ring
      _ ≤ max (2 * Csize) Clip * ‖a‖ * ((ρ⁻¹) ^ 2 * ‖x - y‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
          (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))

      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction c ρ a)) x -

theorem exists_norm_finsum_hessian_correction_sub_le {ι : Type*} :
    ∃ Cχ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cχ ∧ ∀ (c : ι → E) (ρ : ι → ℝ) (a : ι → E) (M : ℝ),
      0 ≤ M → (∀ i, 0 < ρ i) →
      Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint (fun i ↦ Metric.ball (c i) (ρ i)) →
      (∀ i, ‖a i‖ * (ρ i) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ M) → ∀ x y : E,
      ‖(∑ᶠ i, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))) x) -
        ∑ᶠ i, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))) y‖ ≤
        2 * Cχ * M * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨Cχ, hCχ, hlocal⟩ := exists_norm_hessian_correction_sub_le (E := E)
  refine ⟨Cχ, hCχ, ?_⟩
  intro c ρ a M hM hρ hballs hscaled x y
  have hdisjoint : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint
      (fun i ↦ Function.support
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))))) :=
    hballs.mono (fun i ↦ support_hessian_correction_subset_ball (c i) (ρ i) (a i) (hρ i))
  have hmodulus (u v : E) : 0 ≤ Cχ * M * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCχ hM) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
  have hlocalUniform (i : ι) (u v : E) :
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))) u -
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))) v‖ ≤
        Cχ * M * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    calc
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))) u -
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))) v‖ ≤
          Cχ * ‖a i‖ * (ρ i) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        hlocal (c i) (ρ i) (a i) u v (hρ i)
      _ = Cχ * (‖a i‖ * (ρ i) ^ (-3 / 2 : ℝ)) * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        ring
      _ ≤ Cχ * M * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hscaled i) hCχ)
          (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
  have hsum := norm_finsum_sub_le_two_mul_modulus
    (fun i ↦ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))))
    hdisjoint (fun u v ↦ Cχ * M * ‖u - v‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) hmodulus hlocalUniform x y
  calc
    ‖(∑ᶠ i, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))) x) -
        ∑ᶠ i, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (ExplicitCutoff.correction (c i) (ρ i) (a i))) y‖ ≤
        2 * (Cχ * M * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := hsum
    _ = 2 * Cχ * M * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      ring

open support balls and a uniform scaled coefficient bound, the pointwise
finsum of exact correction Hessians has a uniform half-Hölder bound. This is
an estimate for the Hessian field; it does not assert a derivative identity
for an infinite objective sum.

theorem fderiv_finsum_of_locallyFinite
    {D G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup D] [NormedSpace ℝ D]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
    (f : ℕ → D → G) (hsmooth : ∀ k, Differentiable ℝ (f k)) (x : D)
    (hlocal : ∃ s ∈ 𝓝 x, {k | (tsupport (f k) ∩ s).Nonempty}.Finite) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ ∑ᶠ k, f k y) x = ∑ᶠ k, fderiv ℝ (f k) x := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hfinite⟩ := hlocal
  let I := hfinite.toFinset
  have hxs : x ∈ s := mem_of_mem_nhds hs
  have hnormal : (fun y ↦ ∑ᶠ k, f k y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y ↦ ∑ k ∈ I, f k y) := by
    filter_upwards [hs] with y hy
    apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
    intro k hk
    exact hfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨y, subset_tsupport (f k) hk, hy⟩
  have hderivativeSupport : Function.support (fun k ↦ fderiv ℝ (f k) x) ⊆ I := by
    intro k hk
    have hsupport : x ∈ tsupport (f k) := support_fderiv_subset ℝ hk
    exact hfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, hsupport, hxs⟩
  have hderivative := hnormal.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun k _ ↦ hsmooth k x)] at hderivative
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hderivativeSupport]
  exact hderivative
items.statement:

finite family of smooth functions has derivative equal to the pointwise
finsum of its derivatives, without any disjointness of closed supports.

theorem exists_prefix_radius_lower (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (hρ : ∀ k, 0 < ρ k) (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ k < K, δ ≤ ρ k := by
  induction K with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    omega
  | succ K hK =>
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hlower⟩ := hK
    refine ⟨min δ (ρ K), lt_min hδ (hρ K), ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    by_cases hlt : k < K
    · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (hlower k hlt)
    · have heq : k = K := by
        omega
      rw [heq]
      exact min_le_right _ _

    {c : ℕ → E} {ρ : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℕ → E} (h : Geometry c ρ a)
    (f : ℕ → E → G) (C : ℝ) (q : ℕ)
    (hsupport : ∀ k, tsupport (f k) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (c k) (ρ k))
    (hopen : ∀ k, Function.support (f k) ⊆ Metric.ball (c k) (ρ k))
    (hbound : ∀ k x, x ∈ tsupport (f k) →
      ‖f k x‖ / Metric.infDist x unitSphere ^ q ≤ C * (‖a k‖ / ρ k)) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ ‖∑ᶠ k, f k x‖ / Metric.infDist x unitSphere ^ q)
      boundaryFilter (𝓝 0) := by
  have hweight : Tendsto (fun k ↦ C * (‖a k‖ / ρ k)) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero] using h.ratio_decay.const_mul C
  apply Metric.tendsto_nhds.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hweight.eventually_lt_const hε)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hprefix⟩ := exists_prefix_radius_lower ρ h.radius_pos K
  filter_upwards [boundaryFilter_infDist_tendsto.eventually_lt_const hδ] with x hx
  have hquotient : 0 ≤ ‖∑ᶠ k, f k x‖ / Metric.infDist x unitSphere ^ q :=
    div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg Metric.infDist_nonneg q)
  rw [dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hquotient]
  by_cases hactive : ∃ k, f k x ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hactive
    rw [finsum_eq_active f _ h.disjoint_open hopen k hk]
    have htsupport : x ∈ tsupport (f k) := subset_tsupport (f k) hk
    have hradius := h.radius_le_infDist k (hsupport k htsupport)
    have htail : K ≤ k := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hfinite := hprefix k (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnot)
      linarith
    exact (hbound k x htsupport).trans_lt (hK k htail)
  · have hzero (k : ℕ) : f k x = 0 := by
      by_contra hk
      exact hactive ⟨k, hk⟩
    simpa only [hzero, finsum_zero, norm_zero, zero_div] using hε

    (hdecay : Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖p.gradient k - p.point k‖ / (κ * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2))
      atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (polarPerturbation p κ) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 2 (polarObjective p κ) ∧

theorem stageMatrix_def (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (ζ ζNext : ℝ) :
    stageMatrix i t x ζ ζNext =
      let X := RealSymmetric2.matrix x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2
      let v := stepV x
      let w := stepW i t x ζ ζNext
      let σ := stageSigma i t x ζ ζNext
      let P := rotation i t
      P *
        ((1 - σ⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec w v) * X *
          (1 - σ⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec v w) + σ⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec w w) *
        P.transpose := by
  -- Unfold only the named components of the normalized stage.
  rfl

  -- First expose the stage's named base matrix, vectors, scalar, and rotation.
  rw [stageMatrix_def]
  dsimp
  let X := RealSymmetric2.matrix x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2
  let v := stepV x
  let w := stepW i t x ζ ζNext
  let σ := stageSigma i t x ζ ζNext
  let P := rotation i t

    dfpBracket_isHermitian X v w σ
      (RealSymmetric2.matrix_isHermitian x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
  have hStage := Matrix.isHermitian_mul_mul_conjTranspose P hBracket
  -- The real conjugate transpose is ordinary transpose, matching the definition.
  change (P * dfpBracket X v w σ * P.transpose).IsHermitian
  simpa [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] using hStage

theorem nextScale_scale (p : DFP.Polar.Parameters) (j : ℕ)
    (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) :
    nextScale (p.scale j) = p.scale (j + 1) := by
  -- The prescribed scale is positive, so the positive-branch continuation formula applies.
  have hN : 0 < ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.add_pos_left hstart j
  have ht : 0 < p.scale j := by
    rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.scale_def]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN _
  have hpow :
      (((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ (3 : ℕ) =
        ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hN.le]
    norm_num [Real.rpow_neg_one]
  have hcast :
      ((p.startIndex + (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add]
    ring
  have hNplus_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hNplus_pos :
      0 < ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
  rw [DFP.Polar.Normalized.nextScale_eq_rpow (p.scale j) ht]
  simp only [DFP.Polar.Parameters.scale_def]
  rw [hcast]
  rw [hpow]
  have hratio :
      1 + ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ =
        (((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) /
          ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    field_simp [hN.ne']
  rw [hratio, Real.div_rpow (x := ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)
    (y := ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ)) hNplus_nonneg hN.le
    (-(1 : ℝ) / 3)]
  field_simp [Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN _, Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hNplus_pos _]
items.statement: The analytic next-scale map advances the prescribed cubic scale sequence.
items.title: Normalized.nextScale_scale
