theorem stageAngle_scale (p : DFP.Polar.Parameters) (i : Fin 2) (j : ℕ)
    (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) :
    stageAngle i (p.scale j) = p.angleIncrement (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) := by
  -- First identify the unweighted analytic increment with consecutive even angles.
  have hN : 0 < ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.add_pos_left hstart j
  have ht : 0 < p.scale j := by
    rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.scale_def]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN _
  have hpow : (p.scale j) ^ (3 : ℕ) =
      ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.scale_def, ← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hN.le]
    norm_num [Real.rpow_neg_one]
  have hcast :
      ((p.startIndex + (j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) =
        ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add]
    ring
  have hratio :
      1 + ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ =
        (((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) /
          ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    field_simp [hN.ne']
  have hNplus_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hunweighted :
      (9 * DFP.Polar.baseAngle / p.scale j) *
          ((1 + (p.scale j) ^ (3 : ℕ)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) - 1) =
        p.evenAngle (j + 1) - p.evenAngle j := by
    rw [hpow, DFP.Polar.Parameters.scale_def, hratio]
    rw [Real.div_rpow (x := ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)
      (y := ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ)) hNplus_nonneg hN.le
      ((1 : ℝ) / 3)]
    have hneg : (-(1 : ℝ) / 3) = -((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by ring
    rw [hneg, Real.rpow_neg hN.le]
    have hroot :
        ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) ≠ 0 :=
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN _).ne'
    field_simp [hN.ne', hroot]
    rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.evenAngle_def,
      DFP.Polar.Parameters.evenAngle_def, hcast,
      DFP.Polar.baseAngle_def]
    ring
  -- The two finite phases simply weight this common increment by 2/3 and 1/3.
  rw [stageAngle_eq_rpow i (p.scale j) ht, hunweighted]
  fin_cases i
  · change stageWeight (0 : Fin 2) *
        (p.evenAngle (j + 1) - p.evenAngle j) =
      p.angleIncrement (2 * j + 0)
    rw [stageWeight_zero, DFP.Polar.Parameters.angleIncrement_def]
    have hzero : 2 * j + 0 = 2 * j := by omega
    rw [hzero]
    rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.angle_odd, DFP.Polar.Parameters.angle_even,
      DFP.Polar.Parameters.oddAngle_def]
    ring
  · change stageWeight (1 : Fin 2) *
        (p.evenAngle (j + 1) - p.evenAngle j) =
      p.angleIncrement (2 * j + 1)
    rw [stageWeight_one, DFP.Polar.Parameters.angleIncrement_def]
    have hnext : 2 * j + 1 + 1 = 2 * (j + 1) := by omega
    rw [hnext]
    rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.angle_even, DFP.Polar.Parameters.angle_odd,
      DFP.Polar.Parameters.oddAngle_def]
    ring
items.statement: The two analytic stage angles are the prescribed even and odd angular increments.

lemma twoStepCoordinates (p : Parameters) (j : ℕ)
    (Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hZ : Z.IsHermitian)
    (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) :
    Normalized.twoStep p.feedbackRate p.kStar (p.scale j)
        (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z) =
      Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) (p.nextEvenMatrix j Z) := by
  -- The normalized feedback at the boundary is exactly the prescribed odd multiplier.
  have hfeedback :
      Normalized.feedback p.feedbackRate p.kStar (p.scale j)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z) = p.oddMultiplierOf j Z := by
    rw [Normalized.feedback_def, DFP.Polar.Parameters.oddMultiplierOf_def,
      DFP.Polar.Parameters.amplitudeOf_def, Normalized.coordinates_apply]
  have ht : 0 < p.scale j := by
    have hN : 0 < ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.add_pos_left hstart j
    rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.scale_def]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN _
  have hangle0 :
      Normalized.stageAngle 0 (p.scale j) =
        p.oddAngle j - p.evenAngle j := by
    rw [Normalized.stageAngle_scale p 0 j hstart,
      DFP.Polar.Parameters.angleIncrement_def]
    have hzero : 2 * j + ((0 : Fin 2) : ℕ) = 2 * j := by norm_num
    rw [hzero, DFP.Polar.Parameters.angle_odd,
      DFP.Polar.Parameters.angle_even]
  have hangle1 :
      Normalized.stageAngle 1 (p.scale j) =
        p.evenAngle (j + 1) - p.oddAngle j := by
    rw [Normalized.stageAngle_scale p 1 j hstart,
      DFP.Polar.Parameters.angleIncrement_def]
    have hnext : 2 * j + ((1 : Fin 2) : ℕ) + 1 = 2 * (j + 1) := by
      norm_num
      omega
    rw [hnext, DFP.Polar.Parameters.angle_even]
    have hone : ((1 : Fin 2) : ℕ) = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [hone, DFP.Polar.Parameters.angle_odd]
  have hZodd :
      (DFP.Polar.matrixStep Z (p.oddAngle j - p.evenAngle j) 1
        (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z)).IsHermitian := by
    exact DFP.Polar.matrixStep_isHermitian _ _ _ _ hZ
  have hcycle0 :
      Normalized.cycleStage p.feedbackRate p.kStar 0 (p.scale j)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z) =
        Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j)
          (DFP.Polar.matrixStep Z (p.oddAngle j - p.evenAngle j) 1
            (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z)) := by
    rw [Normalized.cycleStage_apply, hfeedback]
    simpa [hangle0] using
      (Normalized.stageCoordinates 0 (p.scale j) Z 1
        (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z) hZ ht)
  have hcycle1 :
      Normalized.cycleStage p.feedbackRate p.kStar 1 (p.scale j)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j)
            (DFP.Polar.matrixStep Z (p.oddAngle j - p.evenAngle j) 1
              (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z))) =
        Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j)
          (DFP.Polar.matrixStep
            (DFP.Polar.matrixStep Z (p.oddAngle j - p.evenAngle j) 1
              (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z))
            (p.evenAngle (j + 1) - p.oddAngle j)
            (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z) 1) := by
    rw [Normalized.cycleStage_apply, hfeedback]
    simpa [hangle1] using
      (Normalized.stageCoordinates 1 (p.scale j)
        (DFP.Polar.matrixStep Z (p.oddAngle j - p.evenAngle j) 1
          (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z))
        (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z) 1 hZodd ht)
  calc
    Normalized.twoStep p.feedbackRate p.kStar (p.scale j)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z) =
        Normalized.cycleStage p.feedbackRate p.kStar 1 (p.scale j)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z)
          (Normalized.cycleStage p.feedbackRate p.kStar 0 (p.scale j)
            (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z)
            (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z)) := by
      rw [Normalized.twoStep_def]
    _ = Normalized.cycleStage p.feedbackRate p.kStar 1 (p.scale j)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) Z)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j)
            (DFP.Polar.matrixStep Z (p.oddAngle j - p.evenAngle j) 1
              (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z))) := by rw [hcycle0]
    _ = Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j)
          (DFP.Polar.matrixStep
            (DFP.Polar.matrixStep Z (p.oddAngle j - p.evenAngle j) 1
              (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z))
            (p.evenAngle (j + 1) - p.oddAngle j)
            (p.oddMultiplierOf j Z) 1) := hcycle1
    _ = Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) (p.nextEvenMatrix j Z) := by
      rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.nextEvenMatrix_def]
items.statement: Two normalized stages reproduce the prescribed two-stage polar matrix recurrence.
items.title: Parameters.twoStepCoordinates

theorem normalizedEvenState_succ (p : Parameters) (j : ℕ)
    (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) :
    p.normalizedEvenState (j + 1) =
      Normalized.map p.feedbackRate p.kStar (p.scale j) (p.normalizedEvenState j) := by
  -- The successor boundary is obtained by the raw two-stage recurrence first.
  have ht : 0 < p.scale j := by
    have hN : 0 < ((p.startIndex + j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.add_pos_left hstart j
    rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.scale_def]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hN _
  have hscale := Normalized.nextScale_scale p j hstart
  have htwo := twoStepCoordinates p j (p.evenMatrix j)
    (DFP.Polar.Parameters.evenMatrix_isHermitian p j) hstart
  have hrescale := Normalized.rescaleCoordinates (p.scale j)
    (p.nextEvenMatrix j (p.evenMatrix j)) ht
  calc
    p.normalizedEvenState (j + 1) =
        Normalized.coordinates (p.scale (j + 1)) (p.evenMatrix (j + 1)) := by
      rfl
    _ = Normalized.coordinates (Normalized.nextScale (p.scale j))
          (p.nextEvenMatrix j (p.evenMatrix j)) := by
      rw [DFP.Polar.Parameters.evenMatrix_succ, hscale]
    _ = Normalized.rescale (p.scale j)
          (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j)
            (p.nextEvenMatrix j (p.evenMatrix j))) := by
      exact hrescale.symm
    _ = Normalized.rescale (p.scale j)
          (Normalized.twoStep p.feedbackRate p.kStar (p.scale j)
            (Normalized.coordinates (p.scale j) (p.evenMatrix j))) := by
      rw [htwo]
    _ = Normalized.map p.feedbackRate p.kStar (p.scale j)
          (p.normalizedEvenState j) := by
      rw [Normalized.map_def]
      rfl
items.statement: The prescribed normalized even states follow the canonical normalized map.
items.title: Parameters.normalizedEvenState_succ

theorem denominators_apply (L κ t : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :
    denominators L κ t x =
      let ζOdd := feedback L κ t x
      let x₁ := cycleStage L κ 0 t x x
      ![unitRoot t, unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1,
        sinFactor 0 t, sinFactor 1 t, x.1, x.2.1,
        stageSigma 0 t x 1 ζOdd, x₁.2.1,
        stageSigma 1 t x₁ ζOdd 1] := by
  -- The denominator family is defined by exactly this displayed vector.
  rfl

items.label: Normalized.denominators_uniformOn
items.leanCode:
theorem denominators_uniformOn (L κ : ℝ) (𝒦 : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦)
    (hA : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, 0 < x.1)
    (hC : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, 0 < x.2.1)
    (hC₁ : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, 0 < (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ d > 0, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-ε) ε,
      ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, ∀ i : Fin 9, d ≤ |denominators L κ t x i| := by
  -- Take one positive minimum on the fixed compact state/index fiber.
  have hcompact : IsCompact (𝒦 ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin 9))) := h𝒦.prod isCompact_univ
  have hcontinuous : ContinuousOn
      (fun xi : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × Fin 9 ↦ |denominators L κ 0 xi.1 xi.2|)
      (𝒦 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    intro xi hxi
    have hD := (denominators_analyticAt_zero L κ xi.1
      (hA xi.1 hxi.1) (hC xi.1 hxi.1) (hC₁ xi.1 hxi.1)).continuousAt
    have hbase : ContinuousAt
        (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ denominators L κ 0 x) xi.1 :=
      hD.comp (continuousAt_const.prodMk continuousAt_id)
    have heval : ContinuousAt
        (fun z : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × Fin 9 ↦ denominators L κ 0 z.1 z.2) xi := by
      apply continuousAt_prod_of_discrete_right.mpr
      exact (continuousAt_apply xi.2 _).comp hbase
    exact heval.abs.continuousWithinAt
  have hpositive : ∀ xi ∈ (𝒦 ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin 9))),
      0 < |denominators L κ 0 xi.1 xi.2| := by
    intro xi hxi
    exact abs_pos.mpr (denominators_pos_zero L κ xi.1
      (hA xi.1 hxi.1) (hC xi.1 hxi.1) (hC₁ xi.1 hxi.1) xi.2).ne'
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbound⟩ := hcompact.exists_forall_le' hcontinuous hpositive
  -- Joint continuity preserves half this minimum on one common scale radius.
  have hnear : ∀ xi ∈ (𝒦 ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin 9))),
      ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × Fin 9) in 𝓝 (0, xi),
        b / 2 ≤ |denominators L κ z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2| := by
    intro xi hxi
    have hD := (denominators_analyticAt_zero L κ xi.1
      (hA xi.1 hxi.1) (hC xi.1 hxi.1) (hC₁ xi.1 hxi.1)).continuousAt
    have hinput : ContinuousAt
        (fun z : ℝ × ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × Fin 9) ↦ (z.1, z.2.1)) (0, xi) :=
      continuousAt_fst.prodMk (continuousAt_snd.fst)
    have hindex : ContinuousAt
        (fun z : ℝ × ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × Fin 9) ↦ z.2.2) (0, xi) :=
      continuousAt_snd.snd
    have hfull : ContinuousAt
        (fun z : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) × Fin 9 ↦
          |denominators L κ z.1.1 z.1.2 z.2|) ((0, xi.1), xi.2) := by
      apply continuousAt_prod_of_discrete_right.mpr
      exact ((continuousAt_apply xi.2 _).comp hD).abs
    have heval : ContinuousAt
        (fun z : ℝ × ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × Fin 9) ↦
          |denominators L κ z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2|) (0, xi) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
        (ContinuousAt.comp
          (g := fun z : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) × Fin 9 ↦
            |denominators L κ z.1.1 z.1.2 z.2|)
          (f := fun z : ℝ × ((ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × Fin 9) ↦
            ((z.1, z.2.1), z.2.2)) hfull (hinput.prodMk hindex))
    have hgap : b / 2 < |denominators L κ 0 xi.1 xi.2| :=
      (half_lt_self hb).trans_le (hbound xi hxi)
    exact (heval.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hgap)).mono fun _ hz ↦ hz.le
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδbound⟩ := FiniteTaylorJet.compactFiberNormRadius (X := ℝ)
    (P := fun t xi ↦ b / 2 ≤ |denominators L κ t xi.1 xi.2|) hcompact hnear
  refine ⟨δ / 2, half_pos hδ, b / 2, half_pos hb, ?_⟩
  intro t ht x hx i
  have htNorm : ‖t‖ ≤ δ / 2 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    exact ht
  exact hδbound (x, i) ⟨hx, Set.mem_univ i⟩ t
    (htNorm.trans_lt (half_lt_self hδ))

On a compact positive-state set, all normalized denominators have one positive
lower bound for uniformly small scale.
items.title: Normalized.denominators_uniformOn

theorem map_analyticAt_zero (L κ : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (hA : 0 < x.1) (hC : 0 < x.2.1)
    (hC₁ : 0 < (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1) :
    AnalyticAt ℝ (Function.uncurry (map L κ)) (0, x) := by
  -- First stage, evaluated at its exact limiting state.
  have hτ : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ y.1) (0, x) := analyticAt_fst
  have hX : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ y.2) (0, x) := analyticAt_snd
  have hfb := feedbackAlong_analyticAt L κ hτ hX hA.ne'
  have hSlope := slopeAlong_analyticAt hX hC.ne'
  have hX₁ := cycleStageAlong_analyticAt L κ 0 hτ hX hfb hSlope rfl
  have hC₁₀ : (cycleStage L κ 0 0 x x).2.1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [cycleStage_zero]
    exact hC₁.ne'
  have hSlope₁ := slopeAlong_analyticAt hX₁ hC₁₀
  have hX₂ := cycleStageAlong_analyticAt L κ 1 hτ hX₁ hfb hSlope₁ rfl
  have hrescale := rescaleAlong_analyticAt hτ hX₂ rfl
  -- Compose the two stages before the source's final change of scale.
  change AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ map L κ y.1 y.2) (0, x)
  simp only [map_def, twoStep_def]
  exact hrescale
items.statement: The normalized two-stage map is jointly analytic at zero scale and a positive state.
items.title: Normalized.map_analyticAt_zero

items.label: Normalized.map_uniformJets
items.leanCode:
theorem map_uniformJets (L κ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (𝒦 : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦)
    (hA : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, 0 < x.1)
    (hC : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, 0 < x.2.1)
    (hC₁ : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, 0 < (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1) :
    FiniteTaylorJet.IsUniformOn
      (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ fun t : ℝ ↦ map L κ t x)
      (fun x ↦ FiniteTaylorJet.ofFunction ℝ m (fun t ↦ map L κ t x) 0)
      0 𝒦 := by
  -- Compact-fiber Taylor uniformity applies after swapping parameter and scale coordinates.
  refine FiniteTaylorJet.isUniformOn_of_contDiffAt m
    (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ fun t : ℝ ↦ map L κ t x) 0 𝒦 h𝒦 ?_
  intro x hx
  have hm := map_analyticAt_zero L κ x (hA x hx) (hC x hx) (hC₁ x hx)
  have hswap : AnalyticAt ℝ
      (fun y : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ ↦ (y.2, y.1)) (x, 0) := by
    exact (analyticAt_snd : AnalyticAt ℝ
      (fun y : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ ↦ y.2) (x, 0)).prod
      (analyticAt_fst : AnalyticAt ℝ
        (fun y : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ ↦ y.1) (x, 0))
  have hswap0 : (fun y : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ ↦ (y.2, y.1)) (x, 0) = (0, x) := rfl
  have hcomp := hm.comp_of_eq hswap hswap0
  have htarget : AnalyticAt ℝ
      (Function.uncurry (fun x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ fun t : ℝ ↦ map L κ t x)) (x, 0) := by
    change AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y : (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ ↦ map L κ y.2 y.1) (x, 0)
    exact hcomp
  exact htarget.contDiffAt

theorem nextScale_eq_rpow (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    nextScale t = t * (1 + t ^ 3) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
  have hbase : 0 < 1 + t ^ 3 := by
    nlinarith [pow_pos ht 3]
  have hroot : unitRoot t = (1 + t ^ 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
    rw [unitRoot_def, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hbase]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hexponent : (-(1 : ℝ) / 3) = -((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
    ring
  -- Convert the inverse exp-log root to the negative real power.
  rw [nextScale_def, hroot, hexponent, Real.rpow_neg hbase.le]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
items.statement: At positive scale, `nextScale` agrees with the real-power cubic scale formula.

items.leanCode:
theorem stageAngle_eq_rpow (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    stageAngle i t =
      stageWeight i *
        ((9 * DFP.Polar.baseAngle / t) *
          ((1 + t ^ 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) - 1)) := by
  have hbase : 0 < 1 + t ^ 3 := by
    nlinarith [pow_pos ht 3]
  have hroot : unitRoot t = (1 + t ^ 3) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
    rw [unitRoot_def, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hbase]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hdenom : unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have hroot_pos : 0 < unitRoot t := Real.exp_pos _
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (unitRoot t)]
  -- Replace the real power by the named root, then use exact cubic cancellation.
  rw [stageAngle_def, stageAngleFactor_def, angleFactor_def, ← hroot,
    unitRoot_sub_one_eq_cube_div t hbase]
  field_simp [ht.ne', hdenom]
items.statement: At positive scale, a stage angle agrees with its weighted real-power increment.
items.title: Normalized.stageAngle_eq_rpow

items.leanCode:
theorem nextScale_analyticAt :
    AnalyticAt ℝ nextScale 0 := by
  have hroot_ne : unitRoot 0 ≠ 0 := by
    norm_num [unitRoot]
  -- Divide the analytic identity map by the nonzero analytic root.
  unfold nextScale
  exact analyticAt_id.div unitRoot_analyticAt hroot_ne

items.label: Normalized.stageAngle_analyticAt

theorem stageAngle_analyticAt (i : Fin 2) :
    AnalyticAt ℝ (stageAngle i) 0 := by

  unfold stageAngle
  exact (analyticAt_id.pow 2).mul (stageAngleFactor_analyticAt i)

items.label: Normalized.sinFactor_eq_sin_div
items.leanCode:
theorem sinFactor_eq_sin_div (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    sinFactor i t = Real.sin (stageAngle i t) / t ^ 2 := by
  have hfactor : stageAngleFactor i t ≠ 0 := (stageAngleFactor_pos i t).ne'
  have hstage : stageAngle i t ≠ 0 := by
    rw [stageAngle_def]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 ht.ne') hfactor
  -- Expand `sinc` away from zero and cancel the explicit quadratic stage factor.
  rw [sinFactor_def, Real.sinc_of_ne_zero hstage, stageAngle_def]
  field_simp [ht.ne', hfactor]
items.statement: Away from zero, `sinFactor` recovers `sin (stageAngle i t) / t ^ 2`.
items.title: Normalized.sinFactor_eq_sin_div

items.label: Normalized.cotFactor_eq_mul_cot
items.leanCode:
theorem cotFactor_eq_mul_cot (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    cotFactor i t = t ^ 2 * Real.cot (stageAngle i t) := by
  -- Inverting the regularized sine quotient requires only `t ≠ 0`.
  rw [cotFactor_def, sinFactor_eq_sin_div i t ht, Real.cot_eq_cos_div_sin]
  calc
    Real.cos (stageAngle i t) / (Real.sin (stageAngle i t) / t ^ 2) =
        Real.cos (stageAngle i t) * (Real.sin (stageAngle i t) / t ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    _ = Real.cos (stageAngle i t) * (t ^ 2 / Real.sin (stageAngle i t)) := by
      rw [inv_div]
    _ = t ^ 2 * (Real.cos (stageAngle i t) / Real.sin (stageAngle i t)) := by
      ring
items.statement: Away from zero, `cotFactor` recovers `t ^ 2 * cot (stageAngle i t)`.
items.title: Normalized.cotFactor_eq_mul_cot

    rescaleFactor t = (nextScale t / t) ^ 2 := by
  have hroot : unitRoot t ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
  -- Cancel the positive scale in `nextScale t / t` before squaring.
  rw [rescaleFactor_def, nextScale_def]
  field_simp [ht.ne', hroot]

theorem sinFactor_analyticAt (i : Fin 2) :
    AnalyticAt ℝ (sinFactor i) 0 := by
  have hstage_zero : stageAngle i 0 = 0 := by
    simp [stageAngle]
  have hsinc : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.sinc (stageAngle i t)) 0 := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      analyticAt_sinc_zero.comp_of_eq (stageAngle_analyticAt i) hstage_zero
  -- Multiply the analytic angle coefficient by the analytic sinc extension.

items.label: Normalized.nextScale_expansion
items.leanCode:
theorem nextScale_expansion :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ nextScale t - (t - (1 / 3 : ℝ) * t ^ 4)) =O[𝓝 0]
      fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7 := by
  let qNext : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    (unitRoot t ^ 2 + 2 * unitRoot t + 3) /
      (3 * unitRoot t * (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) ^ 2)
  have hnum :
      AnalyticAt ℝ (fun t : ℝ ↦ unitRoot t ^ 2 + 2 * unitRoot t + 3) 0 :=
    (unitRoot_analyticAt.pow 2).add (analyticAt_const.mul unitRoot_analyticAt) |>.add
      analyticAt_const
  have hdenom : AnalyticAt ℝ
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ 3 * unitRoot t * (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) ^ 2) 0 :=
    (analyticAt_const.mul unitRoot_analyticAt).mul
      (unitRootDenominator_analyticAt.pow 2)
  have hdenom_ne :
      3 * unitRoot 0 * (unitRoot 0 ^ 2 + unitRoot 0 + 1) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    norm_num [unitRoot]
  have hq_analytic : AnalyticAt ℝ qNext 0 := by
    dsimp only [qNext]
    exact hnum.div hdenom hdenom_ne
  have hq_order : qNext =O[𝓝 0] (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) :=
    hq_analytic.continuousAt.isBigO_one ℝ
  have hmodel : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7 * qNext t) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7) := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7) (𝓝 0)).mul hq_order
  have hbase_eventually : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, 0 < 1 + t ^ 3 := by
    have hcontinuous : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ 1 + t ^ 3) 0 := by
      fun_prop
    exact hcontinuous.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  have hfactor : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7 * qNext t) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ nextScale t - (t - (1 / 3 : ℝ) * t ^ 4)) := by
    filter_upwards [hbase_eventually] with t ht
    exact (nextScale_sub_quartic_eq t ht).symm
  -- The analytic cofactor is bounded, so exact factorization gives the order-seven bound.
  exact hmodel.congr' hfactor Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl
items.statement: The next-scale map has remainder of order seven after its quartic expansion.
items.title: Normalized.nextScale_expansion

items.label: Normalized.stageAngle_expansion
items.leanCode:
theorem stageAngle_expansion (i : Fin 2) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ stageAngle i t - limitAngle i * t ^ 2) =O[𝓝 0]
      fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 5 := by
  let qAngle : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    -3 * DFP.Polar.baseAngle * stageWeight i * (unitRoot t + 2) /
      (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) ^ 2
  have hnum : AnalyticAt ℝ
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ -3 * DFP.Polar.baseAngle * stageWeight i * (unitRoot t + 2)) 0 :=
    analyticAt_const.mul (unitRoot_analyticAt.add analyticAt_const)
  have hdenom :
      AnalyticAt ℝ (fun t : ℝ ↦ (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) ^ 2) 0 :=
    unitRootDenominator_analyticAt.pow 2
  have hdenom_ne : (unitRoot 0 ^ 2 + unitRoot 0 + 1) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    norm_num [unitRoot]
  have hq_analytic : AnalyticAt ℝ qAngle 0 := by
    dsimp only [qAngle]
    exact hnum.div hdenom hdenom_ne
  have hq_order : qAngle =O[𝓝 0] (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) :=
    hq_analytic.continuousAt.isBigO_one ℝ
  have hmodel : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 5 * qAngle t) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 5) := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 5) (𝓝 0)).mul hq_order
  have hbase_eventually : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, 0 < 1 + t ^ 3 := by
    have hcontinuous : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ 1 + t ^ 3) 0 := by
      fun_prop
    exact hcontinuous.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  have hfactor : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 5 * qAngle t) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ stageAngle i t - limitAngle i * t ^ 2) := by
    filter_upwards [hbase_eventually] with t ht
    exact (stageAngle_sub_quadratic_eq i t ht).symm
  -- The analytic cofactor is bounded, so exact factorization gives the order-five bound.
  exact hmodel.congr' hfactor Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl
items.statement: Each stage angle has an order-five remainder after its quadratic term.
items.title: Normalized.stageAngle_expansion

theorem isometric_pullback_apply
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (Q : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (A : F →L[ℝ] F) (x : E) :
    Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback A x = Q.symm (A (Q x)) := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.pullback_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Q.adjoint_eq_symm]
  rfl
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: the source adjoint congruence under a linear isometry
equivalence acts by inverse isometry, operator, and forward isometry.
items.title: OrthogonalExtension.isometric_pullback_apply

items.label: OrthogonalExtension.isometric_pullback_norm
items.leanCode:
theorem isometric_pullback_norm
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (Q : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (A : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    ‖Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback A‖ = ‖A‖ := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg A)
    intro x
    rw [isometric_pullback_apply, Q.symm.norm_map]
    simpa only [Q.norm_map] using A.le_opNorm (Q x)
  · apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _)
    intro y
    have hconjugate : A y = Q
        (Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback A (Q.symm y)) := by
      rw [isometric_pullback_apply, Q.apply_symm_apply, Q.apply_symm_apply]
    calc
      ‖A y‖ = ‖Q (Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback A (Q.symm y))‖ :=
        congrArg norm hconjugate
      _ = ‖Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback A (Q.symm y)‖ := Q.norm_map _
      _ ≤ ‖Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback A‖ * ‖Q.symm y‖ :=
        (Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback A).le_opNorm _
      _ = ‖Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback A‖ * ‖y‖ := by
        rw [Q.symm.norm_map]
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: isometric adjoint congruence preserves the operator norm,
including zero-dimensional complementary coordinate blocks.
items.title: OrthogonalExtension.isometric_pullback_norm

theorem hessian_isometric_comp
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : F → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (Q : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (x : E) :
    hessian (f ∘ Q) x = Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.pullback
      (hessian f (Q x)) := by
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (gradient f) :=
    (hf.gradient_succ (n := 1)).differentiable_one
  simpa only [LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv] using
    Q.toContinuousLinearEquiv.comp_right_hessian f x (hdiff _)

Helper for thm:main: the Hessian of an isometric reindexing is the original
operator's adjoint congruence, with the function coercions normalized.

    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

theorem hessian_isometric_sub_identity_norm
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]

    ← ContinuousLinearMap.pullback_sub, isometric_pullback_norm]

theorem hessian_orthogonal_sub_identity_norm_le {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (ι ⊕ κ)) :
    ‖hessian (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f) p - 1‖ ≤
      ‖hessian f (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left p) - 1‖ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg _)
  intro w
  have hnorm :
      ‖(hessian (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f) p - 1) w‖ =
        ‖(hessian f (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left p) - 1)
          (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left w)‖ := by
    have hsquare := EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.norm_sq_eq_left_add_right
      ((hessian (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f) p - 1) w)
    simp only [sub_apply,
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.hessian_objective_apply hf, map_sub,
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left_sumEquivProd_symm,
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.right_sumEquivProd_symm,
      one_apply_eq_self, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow two_ne_zero, add_zero] at hsquare
    simpa only [sub_apply, one_apply_eq_self,
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.hessian_objective_apply hf] using
      (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp hsquare
  rw [hnorm]
  exact ((hessian f (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left p) - 1).le_opNorm _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.norm_left_le w)
      (norm_nonneg _))
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: adjoining the identity quadratic block does not increase
the operator norm of the Hessian's deviation from identity.

theorem hessian_holder_isometric
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : F → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (Q : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) {C β : ℝ}

    ‖hessian (f ∘ Q) x - hessian (f ∘ Q) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ β := by

items.leanCode:
theorem no_holder_initial_orthogonalSum {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (β : ℝ)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ C ≥ 0, ∀ x ∈ {x | f x ≤ f x₀}, ∀ y ∈ {x | f x ≤ f x₀},
      ‖hessian f x - hessian f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ β) :
    ¬ ∃ C ≥ 0,
      ∀ X ∈ {X | EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f X ≤
        EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f (leftEmbedding (κ := κ) x₀)},
      ∀ Y ∈ {X | EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f X ≤
        EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f (leftEmbedding (κ := κ) x₀)},
      ‖hessian (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f) X -
        hessian (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f) Y‖ ≤
          C * ‖X - Y‖ ^ β := by
  rintro ⟨C, hC, hholder⟩
  apply hno
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  have hx' : EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f (leftEmbedding x) ≤
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f (leftEmbedding (κ := κ) x₀) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, leftEmbedding_apply,
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective_inl] using hx
  have hy' : EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f (leftEmbedding y) ≤
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f (leftEmbedding (κ := κ) x₀) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, leftEmbedding_apply,
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective_inl] using hy
  have hbound := hholder (leftEmbedding x) hx' (leftEmbedding y) hy'
  have hrestriction := EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.norm_hessian_sub_le_objective
    (κ := κ) hf x y
  rw [← leftEmbedding_apply, ← leftEmbedding_apply] at hrestriction
  have hnorm : ‖leftEmbedding (κ := κ) x - leftEmbedding y‖ = ‖x - y‖ := by
    rw [← map_sub, (leftEmbedding (κ := κ)).norm_map]
  exact hrestriction.trans (hnorm ▸ hbound)

complementary block transfers an initial-level Hölder bound back to the base objective.

theorem no_holder_initial_isometric
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : F → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (Q : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (x₀ : F) (β : ℝ)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ C ≥ 0, ∀ x ∈ {x | f x ≤ f x₀}, ∀ y ∈ {x | f x ≤ f x₀},
      ‖hessian f x - hessian f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ β) :
    ¬ ∃ C ≥ 0, ∀ x ∈ {x | (f ∘ Q) x ≤ (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm x₀)},
      ∀ y ∈ {x | (f ∘ Q) x ≤ (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm x₀)},
        ‖hessian (f ∘ Q) x - hessian (f ∘ Q) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ β := by
  rintro ⟨C, hC, hholder⟩
  apply hno
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  have hx' : (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm x) ≤ (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm x₀) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Function.comp_apply, Q.apply_symm_apply] using hx
  have hy' : (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm y) ≤ (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm x₀) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Function.comp_apply, Q.apply_symm_apply] using hy
  have hbound := hholder (Q.symm x) hx' (Q.symm y) hy'
  simpa only [hessian_isometric_sub_norm hf Q, Q.apply_symm_apply, ← map_sub,
    Q.symm.norm_map] using hbound

failure of every initial-level Hessian Hölder bound by restriction through the inverse map.

theorem cluster_isometric_embedding
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (i : E →ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (u : ℕ → E) (z : F) :
    MapClusterPt z atTop (i ∘ u) ↔ ∃ x, MapClusterPt x atTop u ∧ i x = z := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨j, hstrict, hj⟩ := hz.tendsto_subseq
    have hclosed := i.isometry.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    have hmem : z ∈ Set.range i := hclosed.mem_of_tendsto hj
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n ↦ ⟨u (j n), rfl⟩))
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hmem
    have hbase : Tendsto (u ∘ j) atTop (𝓝 x) := by
      apply i.isometry.tendsto_nhds_iff.mpr
      simpa only [Function.comp_assoc] using hj
    exact ⟨x, MapClusterPt.of_comp hstrict.tendsto_atTop hbase.mapClusterPt, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hx.continuousAt_comp i.continuous.continuousAt

Helper for thm:main: an isometric embedding of a complete space transports
the existing cluster set exactly to its image.

items.leanCode:
theorem objective_orthogonal_unique_origin {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hzero : f 0 = 0)
    (hunique : ∀ x, (∀ y, f x ≤ f y) ↔ x = 0) :
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ p, (∀ q, EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f p ≤
        EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f q) ↔ p = 0 := by
  have hmin : ∀ y, 0 ≤ f y := by
    have h := (hunique 0).mpr rfl
    simpa only [hzero] using h
  have hzero' : EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f 0 = 0 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective_apply, map_zero, map_zero,
      hzero, norm_zero]
    norm_num
  refine ⟨hzero', ?_⟩
  intro p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hle := hp 0
    rw [hzero', EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective_apply] at hle
    have hright : EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.right p = 0 := by
      apply norm_eq_zero.mp
      nlinarith [hmin (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left p),
        norm_nonneg (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.right p)]
    have hleft : EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left p = 0 := by
      apply (hunique _).mp
      intro y
      have hbase : f (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left p) ≤ 0 := by
        rw [hright, norm_zero] at hle
        linarith
      exact hbase.trans (hmin y)
    have hsquare := EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.norm_sq_eq_left_add_right p
    rw [hleft, hright, norm_zero] at hsquare
    simp only [norm_zero, zero_pow two_ne_zero, zero_add] at hsquare
    apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg p]
  · rintro rfl q
    rw [hzero', EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective_apply]
    exact add_nonneg (hmin _) (div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) zero_le_two)
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: adjoining the identity quadratic block preserves the
origin normalization and unique global origin minimizer.

theorem certificateWithIteration {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {m M c₁ c₂ g : ℝ}
    (c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample ι m M c₁ c₂) (it : DFP.InverseIteration ι)
    (hobjective : it.objective = c.iteration.objective) (hpoint : it.point = c.iteration.point)
    (hstep : ∀ k, 0 < it.stepLength k) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hlimit : Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖DFP.gradients it.objective it.point k‖) atTop (𝓝 g)) :
    ∃ d : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample ι m M c₁ c₂,
      d.iteration = it ∧ d.gradientLimit = g := by
  have hcontDiff : ContDiff ℝ 2 it.objective := by
    rw [hobjective]
    exact c.objectiveContDiff
  have hbounds : HasHessianBounds m M it.objective := by
    rw [hobjective]
    exact c.hessianBounds
  have hweak : ∀ k, LineSearch.IsWeakWolfe c₁ c₂ it.objective
      (it.point k) (it.point (k + 1) - it.point k) := by
    rw [hobjective, hpoint]
    exact c.weakWolfe
  have hstrong : ∀ k, LineSearch.IsStrongWolfe c₁ c₂ it.objective
      (it.point k) (it.point (k + 1) - it.point k) := by
    rw [hobjective, hpoint]
    exact c.strongWolfe
  let d : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample ι m M c₁ c₂ := {
    toWolfeCounterexample := {
      iteration := it
      gradientLimit := g
      objectiveContDiff := hcontDiff
      stepLengthPos := hstep
      hessianBounds := hbounds
      weakWolfe := hweak
      gradientLimitPos := hg
      gradientNormTendsto := hlimit
    }
    strongWolfe := hstrong
  }
  exact ⟨d, rfl, rfl⟩
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: a reviewed supplied certificate can be placed on any
specified canonical iteration with the same objective and points and a supplied limit.
items.title: OrthogonalExtension.certificateWithIteration

theorem orthogonalSumWithIteration {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    {m M c₁ c₂ : ℝ} (c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample ι m M c₁ c₂)
    (hm : m ≤ 1) (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    ∃ d : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (ι ⊕ κ) m M c₁ c₂,
      d.iteration = c.iteration.orthogonalSum (κ := κ) c.stepLengthPos ∧
        d.gradientLimit = c.gradientLimit := by
  obtain ⟨d₀, hobjective, hpoint⟩ := c.orthogonalSumWithObjective (κ := κ) hm hM
  let it := c.iteration.orthogonalSum (κ := κ) c.stepLengthPos
  have hobjective' : it.objective = d₀.iteration.objective := by
    rw [hobjective]
    exact DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_objective c.iteration c.stepLengthPos
  have hpoint' : it.point = d₀.iteration.point := by
    funext k
    rw [hpoint]
    exact DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_point c.iteration c.stepLengthPos k
  have hstep : ∀ k, 0 < it.stepLength k := by
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_stepLength]
    exact c.stepLengthPos
  have hlimit : Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖DFP.gradients it.objective it.point k‖)
      atTop (𝓝 c.gradientLimit) := by
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_gradients]
    simpa only [DFP.OrthogonalSum.norm_embed] using c.gradientNormTendsto
  exact certificateWithIteration d₀ it hobjective' hpoint' hstep c.gradientLimitPos hlimit
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: the reviewed extension certificate has the exact
canonical identity-block iteration, including all original step lengths and matrices.
items.title: OrthogonalExtension.orthogonalSumWithIteration

theorem pullbackWithIteration {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] {m M c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample ι m M c₁ c₂)
    (Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    ∃ d : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample κ m M c₁ c₂,
      d.iteration = c.iteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv c.stepLengthPos Q ∧
        d.gradientLimit = c.gradientLimit := by
  obtain ⟨d₀, hobjective, hpoint⟩ := c.pullbackWithObjective Q hm hM
  let it := c.iteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv c.stepLengthPos Q
  have hobjective' : it.objective = d₀.iteration.objective := by
    rw [hobjective]
    exact DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_objective
      c.iteration c.stepLengthPos Q
  have hpoint' : it.point = d₀.iteration.point := by
    funext k
    rw [hpoint]
    exact DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_point
      c.iteration c.stepLengthPos Q k
  have hstep : ∀ k, 0 < it.stepLength k := by
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_stepLength]
    exact c.stepLengthPos
  have hlimit : Tendsto (fun k ↦ ‖DFP.gradients it.objective it.point k‖)
      atTop (𝓝 c.gradientLimit) := by
    rw [DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_gradients]
    simpa only [Q.symm.norm_map] using c.gradientNormTendsto
  exact certificateWithIteration d₀ it hobjective' hpoint' hstep c.gradientLimitPos hlimit

Helper for thm:main: the reviewed isometric certificate can be chosen on
the exact canonical pullback iteration with unchanged step lengths.

theorem hessianBounds_isometric
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : F → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (Q : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) {m M : ℝ}
    (h : HasHessianBounds m M f) : HasHessianBounds m M (f ∘ Q) := by
  apply HasHessianBounds.of_forall
  intro x
  apply HasHessianBoundsAt.of_quadraticForm
  · exact hessian_isSelfAdjoint (hf.comp Q.contDiff).contDiffAt
  · intro v
    have hquadratic := (h.at (Q x)).quadraticForm (Q v)
    have hinner : inner ℝ (Q.symm (hessian f (Q x) (Q v))) v =
        inner ℝ (hessian f (Q x) (Q v)) (Q v) := by
      simpa only [Q.symm_apply_apply] using
        Q.symm.inner_map_map (hessian f (Q x) (Q v)) (Q v)
    rw [hessian_isometric_comp hf Q, isometric_pullback_apply, hinner]
    simpa only [Q.norm_map] using hquadratic

theorem norm_gradientRemainder_orthogonalSum {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖gradient (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f) (leftEmbedding y) -
        gradient (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective f) (leftEmbedding x) -
        hessian (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective f) (leftEmbedding x)
          (leftEmbedding y - leftEmbedding x)‖ =
      ‖gradient f y - gradient f x - hessian f x (y - x)‖ := by
  have hdiff := hf.differentiable two_ne_zero
  rw [leftEmbedding_apply, leftEmbedding_apply]
  have hsquare := EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.norm_sq_eq_left_add_right
    (gradient (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f)
        (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.inl y) -
      gradient (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f)
        (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.inl x) -
      hessian (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) f)
        (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.inl x)
        (EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.inl y - EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.inl x))
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.gradient_objective_inl (hdiff x),
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.gradient_objective_inl (hdiff y),
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.hessian_objective_apply hf, map_sub,
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left_inl,
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.right_inl,
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left_sumEquivProd_symm,
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.right_sumEquivProd_symm,
    sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow two_ne_zero, add_zero] at hsquare
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  simpa only [EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.gradient_objective_inl (hdiff x),
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.gradient_objective_inl (hdiff y),
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.hessian_objective_apply hf, map_sub,
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.left_inl,
    EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.right_inl, sub_self] using hsquare

theorem norm_gradientRemainder_isometric
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : F → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (Q : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (x y : F) :
    ‖gradient (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm y) - gradient (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm x) -
        hessian (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm x) (Q.symm y - Q.symm x)‖ =
      ‖gradient f y - gradient f x - hessian f x (y - x)‖ := by

        hessian (f ∘ Q) (Q.symm x) (Q.symm y - Q.symm x) =
      Q.symm (gradient f y - gradient f x - hessian f x (y - x)) := by
    simp only [gradient_isometric_comp, hessian_isometric_comp hf Q,
      isometric_pullback_apply, map_sub, Q.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [hnormalize, Q.symm.norm_map]

theorem objective_isometric_unique_origin
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : F → ℝ} (Q : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) (hzero : f 0 = 0)
    (hunique : ∀ x, (∀ y, f x ≤ f y) ↔ x = 0) :
    (f ∘ Q) 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ x, (∀ y, (f ∘ Q) x ≤ (f ∘ Q) y) ↔ x = 0 := by
  have hzero' : (f ∘ Q) 0 = 0 := by simpa only [Function.comp_apply, map_zero] using hzero

    have hxzero := (hunique (Q x)).mp hbase

    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, map_zero] using (hunique 0).mpr rfl (Q y)

items.leanCode:
theorem CounterexampleProperties.orthogonalSum {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq κ] {ε c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    {c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample ι (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂}
    {d : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (ι ⊕ κ) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂}
    {i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}
    (h : CounterexampleProperties ε c i) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hd : d.iteration = c.iteration.orthogonalSum (κ := κ) c.stepLengthPos)
    (hlimit : d.gradientLimit = c.gradientLimit) :
    CounterexampleProperties ε d ((leftEmbedding (κ := κ)).comp i) := by
  have hobjective : d.iteration.objective =
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := κ) c.iteration.objective := by
    rw [hd, DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_objective, DFP.OrthogonalSum.objective_eq]
  have hpoint : d.iteration.point = leftEmbedding (κ := κ) ∘ c.iteration.point := by
    funext k
    rw [hd, DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_point, embed_eq_leftEmbedding]
    rfl
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hlower : 1 - ε ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hupper : 1 ≤ 1 + ε := by linarith
  have horigin := objective_orthogonal_unique_origin (κ := κ) h.origin h.unique_minimizer
  constructor
  · exact hlimit.trans h.gradientLimit
  · intro x
    rw [hobjective]
    exact (hessian_orthogonal_sub_identity_norm_le c.objectiveContDiff x).trans
      (h.near_identity _)
  · rw [hobjective]
    exact EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.hasHessianBounds_objective
      c.objectiveContDiff h.accuracy_bounds hlower hupper
  · obtain ⟨H, hH, hholder⟩ := h.half_holder
    refine ⟨H, hH, ?_⟩
    rw [hobjective]
    exact EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.hessianHolder_objective
      c.objectiveContDiff hH hhalf hholder
  · rw [hobjective]
    exact horigin.1
  · rw [hobjective]
    exact horigin.2
  · rw [hpoint, clusterSet_isometric_embedding, h.cluster, Set.image_image]
    rfl
  · intro β hβ
    have hno := h.no_holder_initial β hβ
    rw [initialLevelSet_def] at hno
    rw [initialLevelSet_def, hobjective, hpoint, Function.comp_apply]
    exact no_holder_initial_orthogonalSum (κ := κ) c.objectiveContDiff
      (c.iteration.point 0) β hno
  · intro β hβ
    rw [hd, secantResidualRatio_orthogonalSum _ _ c.objectiveContDiff]
    exact h.residual_diverges β hβ
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: the exact source direct sum transports all analytic,
cluster, and initial-level sharpness properties of the supplied certificate.

theorem CounterexampleProperties.pullback {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] {ε c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    {c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample ι (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂}
    {d : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample κ (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂}
    {i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}
    (h : CounterexampleProperties ε c i)
    (Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ κ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (hd : d.iteration = c.iteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv c.stepLengthPos Q)
    (hlimit : d.gradientLimit = c.gradientLimit) :
    CounterexampleProperties ε d (Q.symm.toLinearIsometry.comp i) := by
  have hobjective : d.iteration.objective = c.iteration.objective ∘ Q := by
    rw [hd, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_objective]
  have hpoint : d.iteration.point = Q.symm ∘ c.iteration.point := by
    funext k
    rw [hd, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_point]
    rfl
  have horigin := objective_isometric_unique_origin Q h.origin h.unique_minimizer
  constructor
  · exact hlimit.trans h.gradientLimit
  · intro x
    rw [hobjective, hessian_isometric_sub_identity_norm c.objectiveContDiff Q]
    exact h.near_identity _
  · rw [hobjective]
    exact hessianBounds_isometric c.objectiveContDiff Q h.accuracy_bounds
  · obtain ⟨H, hH, hholder⟩ := h.half_holder
    refine ⟨H, hH, ?_⟩
    rw [hobjective]
    exact hessian_holder_isometric c.objectiveContDiff Q hholder
  · rw [hobjective]
    exact horigin.1
  · rw [hobjective]
    exact horigin.2
  · have hcluster := clusterSet_isometric_embedding Q.symm.toLinearIsometry c.iteration.point
    simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearIsometry] at hcluster
    rw [hpoint, hcluster, h.cluster, Set.image_image]
    rfl
  · intro β hβ
    have hno := h.no_holder_initial β hβ
    rw [initialLevelSet_def] at hno
    rw [initialLevelSet_def, hobjective, hpoint, Function.comp_apply]
    exact no_holder_initial_isometric c.objectiveContDiff Q (c.iteration.point 0) β hno
  · intro β hβ
    rw [hd, secantResidualRatio_isometric _ _ c.objectiveContDiff Q]
    exact h.residual_diverges β hβ

theorem hessianBounds_mono
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) {m M a b : ℝ} (h : HasHessianBounds m M f)
    (ha : a ≤ m) (hb : M ≤ b) : HasHessianBounds a b f := by
  apply HasHessianBounds.of_forall
  intro x
  apply HasHessianBoundsAt.of_quadraticForm (hessian_isSelfAdjoint hf.contDiffAt)
  intro v
  have hbase := (h.at x).quadraticForm v
  exact ⟨(mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha (sq_nonneg ‖v‖)).trans hbase.1,
    hbase.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (sq_nonneg ‖v‖))⟩
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: widening the requested global spectral interval
preserves Hessian bounds without any sign restriction on its endpoints.

theorem CounterexampleProperties.mono {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {δ ε c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    {w : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample ι (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂}
    {i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι}
    (h : CounterexampleProperties δ w i) (hδε : δ ≤ ε) : CounterexampleProperties ε w i := by
  have hnear (x) : ‖hessian w.iteration.objective x - 1‖ ≤ ε :=
    (h.near_identity x).trans hδε
  have hlower : 1 - ε ≤ 1 - δ := by linarith
  have hupper : 1 + δ ≤ 1 + ε := by linarith
  have hbounds := hessianBounds_mono w.objectiveContDiff h.accuracy_bounds hlower hupper
  exact ⟨h.gradientLimit, hnear, hbounds, h.half_holder, h.origin, h.unique_minimizer,
    h.cluster, h.no_holder_initial, h.residual_diverges⟩

theorem extendPlanarCertificate (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) {ε c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin 2) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂)
    (h : CounterexampleProperties ε c LinearIsometry.id)
    (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    ∃ w : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin n) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂,
      FinExtensionIdentity n hn c w ∧ CounterexampleProperties ε w (planeEmbedding n hn) := by
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hlower : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by norm_num
  have hupper : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hthree : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hlimit⟩ := orthogonalSumWithIteration (κ := Fin (n - 2)) c hlower hupper
  have hdProperties := h.orthogonalSum hε hd hlimit
  let Q := coordinateEquiv n hn
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwlimit⟩ := pullbackWithIteration d Q hhalf hthree
  have hwProperties := hdProperties.pullback Q hw hwlimit
  have hproperties : CounterexampleProperties ε w (planeEmbedding n hn) := by
    rw [planeEmbedding_def]
    simpa only [Q, LinearIsometry.comp_id] using hwProperties
  have hobjective : w.iteration.objective =
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective (κ := Fin (n - 2)) c.iteration.objective ∘
        coordinateEquiv n hn := by
    rw [hw, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_objective, hd,
      DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_objective, DFP.OrthogonalSum.objective_eq]
  have hpoint (k : ℕ) : w.iteration.point k = planeEmbedding n hn (c.iteration.point k) := by
    rw [hw, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_point, hd,
      DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_point, embed_eq_leftEmbedding, planeEmbedding_apply]
  have hstep : w.iteration.stepLength = c.iteration.stepLength := by
    rw [hw, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_stepLength, hd,
      DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_stepLength]
  have hmatrix (k : ℕ) :
      w.iteration.inverseHessian k = extendedMatrix n hn (c.iteration.inverseHessian k) := by
    rw [hw, DFP.InverseIteration.pullback_linearIsometryEquiv_inverseHessian, hd,
      DFP.InverseIteration.orthogonalSum_inverseHessian, extendedMatrix_def]
  have hplane (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
      w.iteration.objective (planeEmbedding n hn x) = c.iteration.objective x := by
    rw [hobjective, Function.comp_apply, planeEmbedding_apply,
      (coordinateEquiv n hn).apply_symm_apply, leftEmbedding_apply,
      EuclideanSpace.OrthogonalSum.Gradient.objective_inl]
  exact ⟨w, ⟨hobjective, hpoint, hstep, hmatrix, hplane⟩, hproperties⟩
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: all dimensions `n≥2` admit the exact source orthogonal
extension of any supplied planar certificate with all its source properties preserved.
items.title: OrthogonalExtension.extendPlanarCertificate

theorem polarCounterexampleFamily (c₁ c₂ : ℝ)
    (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁lim : c₁ < 2 / 3) (hc₂lim : 2 / 3 ≤ c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1) :
    ∃ νStar > baseAngle, ∃ κ > 0, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        ∃ c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin 2) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂,
          PlanarCounterexample.SourceIdentity (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) κ c ∧
            CounterexampleProperties ε c LinearIsometry.id ∧
            ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ hn : 2 ≤ n,
              ∃ w : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin n) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂,
                FinExtensionIdentity n hn c w ∧
                  CounterexampleProperties ε w (planeEmbedding n hn) := by
  obtain ⟨νStar, hνStar, κ, hκ, haccuracy⟩ :=
    PlanarCounterexample.planarCounterexampleFamily c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁lim hc₂lim hc₂
  refine ⟨νStar, hνStar, κ, hκ, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  let δ := min ε (1 / 2)
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hhalfOne : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 := by norm_num
  have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hε hhalf
  have hδone : δ < 1 := (min_le_right ε (1 / 2)).trans_lt hhalfOne
  have hδε : δ ≤ ε := min_le_left _ _
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hfamily⟩ := haccuracy δ hδ hδone
  refine ⟨J, hJ, ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  obtain ⟨c, hsource, hproperties⟩ := hfamily j₀ hj₀
  have hbase := (counterexampleProperties_of_planar hproperties).mono hδε
  refine ⟨c, hsource, hbase, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  exact extendPlanarCertificate n hn c hbase hε.le

Helper for thm:main: one actual new polar family extends into every dimension
at least two, with its source parameter and support chosen before every accuracy and
with one starting threshold before every later fresh initialization and dimension.

items.label: OrthogonalExtension.polarCounterexample
items.leanCode:
theorem polarCounterexample (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (c₁ c₂ ε : ℝ)
    (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁lim : c₁ < 2 / 3) (hc₂lim : 2 / 3 ≤ c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1)
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ w : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin n) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂,
      CounterexampleProperties ε w (planeEmbedding n hn) ∧
        ∃ νStar > baseAngle, ∃ κ > 0, ∃ j₀ : ℕ, 0 < j₀ ∧
          ∃ c : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin 2) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂,
            PlanarCounterexample.SourceIdentity (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) κ c ∧
              FinExtensionIdentity n hn c w := by
  obtain ⟨νStar, hνStar, κ, hκ, haccuracy⟩ :=
    polarCounterexampleFamily c₁ c₂ hc₁ hc₁lim hc₂lim hc₂
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hfamily⟩ := haccuracy ε hε
  obtain ⟨c, hsource, _, hdimensions⟩ := hfamily J le_rfl
  obtain ⟨w, hextension, hproperties⟩ := hdimensions n hn
  exact ⟨w, hproperties, νStar, hνStar, κ, hκ, J, hJ, c, hsource, hextension⟩

constructed polar counterexample extends to every `Fin n`, `n≥2`, by exactly the
source orthogonal objective and identity-block inverse DFP matrices, with unchanged
step lengths. It retains gradient-norm limit one, the fixed global Hessian bounds,
arbitrary requested near-identity accuracy, global half-Hölder Hessian, unique origin
minimum and normalization, the exact embedded unit circle cluster set, and failure of

items.label: PhysicalRealization.rotation_orthogonal

theorem rotation_orthogonal (θ : ℝ) :
    rotationMatrix θ ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin 2) ℝ := by
  rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff, rotationMatrix_def]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i

theorem conjugate_mul {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (R A B : Matrix n n ℝ) (hR : R ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup n ℝ) :
    (R * A * R.transpose) * (R * B * R.transpose) = R * (A * B) * R.transpose := by
  have hRTR := (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff' _ _).mp hR
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc R.transpose R, hRTR, Matrix.one_mul]

cancels the intermediate orthogonal frame.

items.label: PhysicalRealization.conjugate_posDef
items.leanCode:
theorem conjugate_posDef {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (R Z : Matrix n n ℝ) (hR : R ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup n ℝ) (hZ : Z.PosDef) :
    (R * Z * R.transpose).PosDef := by
  have hRRT := (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff _ _).mp hR
  have hinjective : Function.Injective R.transpose.mulVec := by
    intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg R.mulVec hxy
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hRRT, Matrix.one_mulVec] using h
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial, Matrix.transpose_transpose] using
    hZ.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hinjective
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-physical-step: rotating a positive definite matrix
preserves positive definiteness.
items.title: PhysicalRealization.conjugate_posDef

items.label: PhysicalRealization.physicalInverseHessian_step
items.leanCode:
theorem physicalInverseHessian_step (Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (θ δ r rNext ζ ζNext : ℝ) (hr : rNext * radiusRatioOf Z δ = r)
    (hZ : Z.PosDef) (hrNext : 0 < rNext) (hsin : 0 < Real.sin δ)
    (hσ : 0 < sigmaOf Z δ ζ ζNext) :
    rotationMatrix (θ + δ) * (matrixStep Z δ ζ ζNext)⁻¹ *
        (rotationMatrix (θ + δ)).transpose =
      Matrix.inverseDFPUpdate
        (rotationMatrix θ * Z⁻¹ * (rotationMatrix θ).transpose)
        (WithLp.ofLp (rNext • polarUnit (θ + δ) - r • polarUnit θ))
        (WithLp.ofLp (ζNext • (rNext • polarUnit (θ + δ)) - ζ • (r • polarUnit θ))) := by
  have hunit : IsUnit Z.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hZ.det_pos)
  have hHZ :
      (rotationMatrix θ * Z⁻¹ * (rotationMatrix θ).transpose) *
        (rotationMatrix θ * Z * (rotationMatrix θ).transpose) = 1 := by
    rw [conjugate_mul _ _ _ (rotation_orthogonal θ), Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul Z hunit,
      Matrix.mul_one]
    exact (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff _ _).mp (rotation_orthogonal θ)
  have hcurvature := secant_pairing_pos Z θ δ r rNext ζ ζNext hr hrNext hsin hσ
  have hH := conjugate_posDef _ _ (rotation_orthogonal θ) hZ.inv
  have hq := hH.inverseDFPUpdate_denominator_pos hcurvature
  rw [← conjugate_inv _ _ (rotation_orthogonal (θ + δ)),
    physicalHessian_step Z θ δ r rNext ζ ζNext hr (ne_of_gt hrNext) (ne_of_gt hsin)]
  exact factoredHessianStep_inv _ _ _ _ hHZ (ne_of_gt hq) (ne_of_gt hcurvature)
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-physical-step: inverting the actual rotated raw stage
produces the inverse DFP update for the physical chord and secant.

theorem angleIncrement_lt_pi (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (k : ℕ) :
    p.angleIncrement k < Real.pi := by
  have hnonneg := ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p (k / 2)
  have hone := ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart (k / 2)
  have hsq : p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith

  have hcoefficient := AngularGeometry.baseAngle_pos
  have hbound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (mul_nonneg (zero_le_two) hcoefficient.le)
  rw [baseAngle_def] at hupper hbound
  nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]

less than `π` for every positive initial index.

theorem uniformRealization_of_radiusRecurrence :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        (∀ k, 0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).radius k) →
        (∀ k, (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).radius (k + 1) =
          (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).radius k / (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).radiusRatio k) →
        ∀ k, RealizesStep (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) k := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hcontinuation⟩ := Continuation.polarContinuation
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hνStar
  obtain ⟨_, N, _, M, _, J, hJ, htrajectory⟩ := hcontinuation νStar hνStar
  refine ⟨J, hJ, ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀ hrPos hrSucc k
  have hstart : 0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).startIndex := by
    simpa only [Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJ.trans_le hj₀
  obtain ⟨hZ, hC, hσ, hW⟩ := (htrajectory j₀ hj₀).2 k
  exact realizesStep_of_radiusRecurrence _ k hstart hZ hC hσ hW (hrPos (k + 1)) (hrSucc k)
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-physical-step: Continuation supplies all matrix and
angle hypotheses uniformly before the choice of starting index; only the
separate original-radius interface remains in this integration adapter.
items.title: PhysicalRealization.uniformRealization_of_radiusRecurrence

theorem prescribed_hessian_step (p : Parameters) (k : ℕ) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hr : p.radius (k + 1) = p.radius k / p.radiusRatio k)
    (hW : p.radiusRatio k ≠ 0) (hrNext : p.radius (k + 1) ≠ 0) :
    rotationMatrix (p.angle (k + 1)) * p.matrix (k + 1) *
        (rotationMatrix (p.angle (k + 1))).transpose =
      factoredHessianStep
        (rotationMatrix (p.angle k) * p.matrix k * (rotationMatrix (p.angle k)).transpose)

    (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (hrCurrent : 0 < p.radius k)
    (hrNext : 0 < p.radius (k + 1))
    (hr : p.radius (k + 1) = p.radius k / p.radiusRatio k) :
    (rotationMatrix (p.angle k)).transpose *ᵥ chord p k =
        (p.radius (k + 1) * Real.sin (p.angleIncrement k)) • p.stepV k ∧
      (rotationMatrix (p.angle k)).transpose *ᵥ secant p k =
        (p.radius (k + 1) * Real.sin (p.angleIncrement k)) • p.stepW k ∧
      chord p k ⬝ᵥ secant p k =
        (p.radius (k + 1) * Real.sin (p.angleIncrement k)) ^ 2 * p.sigma k := by
  have hW := radiusRatio_pos_of_radiusRecurrence p k hrCurrent hrNext hr
  exact ⟨prescribed_chord_in_frame p k hr (ne_of_gt hW),
    prescribed_secant_in_frame p k hstart hr (ne_of_gt hW),
    prescribed_secant_pairing p k hstart hr (ne_of_gt hW)⟩

items.label: PhysicalRealization.polarPhysicalRealization
items.leanCode:
theorem polarPhysicalRealization :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
        ∀ k, RealizesStep p k ∧
          (rotationMatrix (p.angle k)).transpose *ᵥ chord p k =
            (p.radius (k + 1) * Real.sin (p.angleIncrement k)) • p.stepV k ∧
          (rotationMatrix (p.angle k)).transpose *ᵥ secant p k =
            (p.radius (k + 1) * Real.sin (p.angleIncrement k)) • p.stepW k ∧
          chord p k ⬝ᵥ secant p k =
            (p.radius (k + 1) * Real.sin (p.angleIncrement k)) ^ 2 * p.sigma k := by
  obtain ⟨ηs, hηs, hsteps⟩ := uniformRealization_of_radiusRecurrence
  obtain ⟨ηr, hηr, hradii⟩ := RadiusProducts.polarRadiusProducts
  refine ⟨min ηs ηr, lt_min hηs hηr, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  have hnearSteps : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + ηs) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left ηs ηr))⟩
  have hnearRadii : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + ηr) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_right ηs ηr))⟩
  obtain ⟨Js, hJs, hstep⟩ := hsteps νStar hnearSteps
  obtain ⟨_, K, _, c, _, B, _, Jr, hJr, hradius⟩ := hradii νStar hnearRadii
  refine ⟨max Js Jr, hJs.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  dsimp only
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hjSteps : Js ≤ j₀ := (le_max_left Js Jr).trans hj₀
  have hjRadii : Jr ≤ j₀ := (le_max_right Js Jr).trans hj₀
  have hstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJs.trans_le hjSteps
  have hR := hradius j₀ hjRadii
  have hrPos : ∀ k, 0 < p.radius k := fun k ↦ zero_lt_one.trans (hR.above_one k)
  have hrealizes := hstep j₀ hjSteps hrPos hR.recurrence
  intro k
  exact ⟨hrealizes k, physicalIdentities_of_radiusRecurrence p k hstart
    (hrPos k) (hrPos (k + 1)) (hR.recurrence k)⟩
items.statement:
eq:polar-physical-step and physical DFP realization: for the original
prescribed point, gradient, radius, and inverse-Hessian sequences, every step
is a positive inverse-DFP search step and satisfies both exact source frame
identities and the exact physical curvature formula. The parameter interval
and natural threshold precede every subsequent initialized starting index.
items.title: PhysicalRealization.polarPhysicalRealization

theorem strongWolfe_of_endpoint_inequalities {p : Parameters} {κ δ C H c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    (h : ActualObjective.ObjectiveEstimates p κ δ C H)
    (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (horder : c₁ < c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1)
    (harmijo : ∀ k, InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ (p.point (k + 1)) ≤
      InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ (p.point k) +
        c₁ * inner ℝ (p.gradient k) (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k))
    (hcurvature : ∀ k, |inner ℝ (p.gradient (k + 1)) (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k)| ≤
      c₂ * |inner ℝ (p.gradient k) (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k)|) (k : ℕ) :
    LineSearch.IsStrongWolfe c₁ c₂ (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ)
      (p.point k) (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k) := by
  have hnext : HasGradientAt (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) (p.gradient (k + 1))
      (p.point k + (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k)) := by
    rw [point_add_chord]
    exact objective_hasGradientAt h (k + 1)
  have harmijoNext : InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ
      (p.point k + (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k)) ≤
      InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ (p.point k) +
        c₁ * inner ℝ (p.gradient k) (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k) := by
    rw [point_add_chord]
    exact harmijo k
  exact LineSearch.IsStrongWolfe.ofHasGradientAt hc₁ horder hc₂
    (objective_hasGradientAt h k) hnext harmijoNext (hcurvature k)
items.statement:
Helper for thm:main: the exact model endpoint inequalities and original
interpolated gradients give the canonical standard strong Wolfe predicate.

theorem hessianBounds_mono {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
    [CompleteSpace F] {f : F → ℝ} {m M m' M' : ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)

    HasHessianBounds m' M' f := by

  intro x

  intro v

    hquad.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM (sq_nonneg _))⟩

items.leanCode:
theorem properties_of_source {p : Parameters} {κ δ ε C H c₁ c₂ : ℝ}
    {w : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin 2) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂}
    (h : ActualObjective.ObjectiveEstimates p κ δ C H)
    (hcluster : ∀ x, MapClusterPt x atTop p.point ↔ ‖x‖ = 1)
    (hsource : SourceIdentity p κ w) (hlimit : w.gradientLimit = 1)
    (hδε : δ ≤ ε) (hH : 0 ≤ H)
    (hnoHolder : ∀ β ∈ Set.Ioc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1,
      ¬ ∃ L ≥ 0,
        ∀ x ∈ {x | InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ x ≤
          InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ (p.point 0)},
        ∀ y ∈ {x | InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ x ≤
          InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ (p.point 0)},
        ‖hessian (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) x -
          hessian (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖ ^ β)
    (hdiverge : ∀ β ∈ Set.Ioc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1,
      Tendsto (fun j ↦
        ‖p.gradient (2 * j + 1) - p.gradient (2 * j) -
            hessian (InterpolationSum.polarObjective p κ) (p.point (2 * j))
              (p.point (2 * j + 1) - p.point (2 * j))‖ /
          ‖p.point (2 * j + 1) - p.point (2 * j)‖ ^ (1 + β)) atTop atTop) :
    CounterexampleProperties ε w := by
  constructor
  · exact hlimit
  · intro x
    rw [hsource.objective, hessian_def]
    exact (h.near_identity x).trans hδε
  · rw [hsource.objective]
    have hlower : 1 - ε ≤ 1 - δ := by linarith
    have hupper : 1 + δ ≤ 1 + ε := by linarith
    exact hessianBounds_mono h.objective_contDiff h.hessian_bounds hlower hupper
  · refine ⟨H, hH, ?_⟩
    intro x y
    rw [hsource.objective, hessian_def, hessian_def]
    exact h.hessian_holder x y
  · rw [hsource.objective]
    exact h.origin
  · rw [hsource.objective]
    exact h.unique_minimizer
  · rw [hsource.point]
    exact hcluster
  · rw [initialLevelSet_def, hsource.objective, hsource.point]
    exact hnoHolder
  · intro β hβ
    rw [funext (hsource.secantResidualRatio β)]
    exact hdiverge β hβ

explicit intermediate obligations, to be discharged by the actual source proof.

theorem physicalGeometryNeighborhood :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ lower > 0, ∃ upper > 0, ∃ separation > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
        (∀ k, PhysicalRealization.RealizesStep p k) ∧
          PointGeometry.PointEstimates p lower upper separation ∧ (∀ k, 0 < p.radius k) := by
  obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, hphysical⟩ := PhysicalRealization.polarPhysicalRealization
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hgeometry⟩ := PointGeometry.polarPointGeometry
  refine ⟨min η₀ η₁, lt_min hη₀ hη₁, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  have hnear₀ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₀) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))⟩
  have hnear₁ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₁) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_right _ _))⟩
  obtain ⟨J₀, hJ₀, hsteps⟩ := hphysical νStar hnear₀
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, lower, hlower, upper, hupper, separation, hseparation,
    J₁, _, hpoints⟩ := hgeometry νStar hnear₁
  refine ⟨lower, hlower, upper, hupper, separation, hseparation,
    max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  have hstep := hsteps j₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  obtain ⟨hradii, hpoint⟩ := hpoints j₀ ((le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  exact ⟨fun k ↦ (hstep k).1, hpoint, fun k ↦ zero_lt_one.trans (hradii.above_one k)⟩

theorem counterexampleFamilyOfUniformEndpoints (c₁ c₂ : ℝ)
    (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (horder : c₁ < c₂) (hc₂ : c₂ < 1)
    (hselect : ∀ η > 0, ∃ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ k : ℕ,
        let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
        (p.radius (k + 1) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ p.radius k ^ 2 / 2 +
          c₁ * inner ℝ (p.gradient k) (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k)) ∧
        |inner ℝ (p.gradient (k + 1)) (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k)| ≤
          c₂ * |inner ℝ (p.gradient k) (p.point (k + 1) - p.point k)|) :
    ∃ νStar > baseAngle, ∃ κ > 0, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
      ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        ∃ w : DFP.StrongWolfeCounterexample (Fin 2) (1 / 2) (3 / 2) c₁ c₂,
          SourceIdentity (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) κ w ∧ CounterexampleProperties ε w := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hdata⟩ := sourceDataNeighborhood
  obtain ⟨νStar, hνStar, Jw, hJw, hmodel⟩ := hselect η hη
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, C, _, H, hH, haccuracy⟩ := hdata νStar hνStar
  refine ⟨νStar, hνStar.1, κ, hκ, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε _
  let δ := min ε (1 / 2)
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hhalfOne : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 := by norm_num
  have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hε hhalf
  have hδhalf : δ ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hδε : δ ≤ ε := min_le_left _ _
  have hδone : δ < 1 := hδhalf.trans_lt hhalfOne
  obtain ⟨Js, hJs, hsource⟩ := haccuracy δ hδ hδone
  refine ⟨max Js Jw, hJs.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  have hactual := hsource j₀ ((le_max_left Js Jw).trans hj₀)
  have hstep := hmodel j₀ ((le_max_right Js Jw).trans hj₀)

  have hhalfPi : (θ - φ) / 2 ≤ Real.pi / 2 := by linarith
  have hsinLower := Real.mul_le_sin hhalf hhalfPi
  have hsinNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sin ((θ - φ) / 2) := by
    have hPi : (θ - φ) / 2 ≤ Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
    exact Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hhalf hPi
  have hrs : 1 ≤ r * s := one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le hr hs
  have hfour : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by norm_num
  have hterm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrs
    (mul_nonneg hfour (sq_nonneg (Real.sin ((θ - φ) / 2))))

    rw [polar_chord_sq]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - s)]

    _ ≤ 2 * Real.sin ((θ - φ) / 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsinLower zero_le_two

theorem ordered_point_separation (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hsmall : p.scale 0 ≤ 1 / 4) (habove : ∀ k, 1 ≤ p.radius k)
    (hanti : Antitone p.radius) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hdrop : ∀ k, c * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 ≤ p.radius k - p.radius (k + 1))
    (k m : ℕ) (hkm : k < m) :
    min nearSeparationConstant (c / 128) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 ≤
      ‖p.point m - p.point k‖ := by
  by_cases hnear : m - k ≤ nearWindow p k
  · have hbound := near_point_separation p hstart habove k m hkm hnear
    have hcount : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m - k : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hkm)
    have hcoefficient : 0 ≤ nearSeparationConstant * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 :=
      mul_nonneg nearSeparationConstant_pos.le (sq_nonneg _)
    have hcountBound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount hcoefficient
    have hmin := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (min_le_left nearSeparationConstant (c / 128)) (sq_nonneg (p.scale (k / 2)))
    calc
      min nearSeparationConstant (c / 128) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 ≤
          nearSeparationConstant * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := hmin
      _ ≤ nearSeparationConstant * (m - k : ℕ) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [hcountBound]
      _ ≤ ‖p.point m - p.point k‖ := hbound
  · have hwindow : k + nearWindow p k ≤ m := by omega
    have hfar := far_point_separation p hstart hsmall habove hanti c hc hdrop k m hwindow
    have hmin := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (min_le_right nearSeparationConstant (c / 128)) (sq_nonneg (p.scale (k / 2)))
    exact hmin.trans hfar

radial sum give one ordered-pair separation bound without any final-angle restriction.

theorem point_separation (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hsmall : p.scale 0 ≤ 1 / 4) (habove : ∀ k, 1 ≤ p.radius k)
    (hanti : Antitone p.radius) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hdrop : ∀ k, c * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 ≤ p.radius k - p.radius (k + 1))
    (k m : ℕ) (hne : k ≠ m) :
    min nearSeparationConstant (c / 128) *
        max (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) (p.scale (m / 2) ^ 2) ≤ ‖p.point m - p.point k‖ := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hkm | hmk
  · have hcycle : k / 2 ≤ m / 2 := Nat.div_le_div_right hkm.le
    have hscale := ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hstart hcycle
    have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p _) hscale 2
    rw [max_eq_left hsquare]
    exact ordered_point_separation p hstart hsmall habove hanti c hc hdrop k m hkm
  · have hcycle : m / 2 ≤ k / 2 := Nat.div_le_div_right hmk.le
    have hscale := ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hstart hcycle
    have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p _) hscale 2
    rw [max_eq_right hsquare, norm_sub_rev]
    exact ordered_point_separation p hstart hsmall habove hanti c hc hdrop m k hmk

source maximum of squared scales for every pair of distinct actual points.

theorem point_step_lower (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hsmall : p.scale 0 ≤ 1 / 4) (habove : ∀ k, 1 ≤ p.radius k) (k : ℕ) :
    nearSeparationConstant * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 ≤ ‖p.point (k + 1) - p.point k‖ := by
  have hpositive := nearWindow_pos p hstart hsmall k
  have hwindow : k + 1 - k ≤ nearWindow p k := by omega
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] using

items.label: PointGeometry.point_step_upper
items.leanCode:
theorem point_step_upper {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {K c B : ℝ}
    (h : RadiusEstimates p D K c B) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖p.point (k + 1) - p.point k‖ ≤
      (B + Real.exp 1 * (2 * baseAngle)) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := by
  have hr : 0 ≤ p.radius k := zero_le_one.trans (h.above_one k).le
  have hradial : |p.radius (k + 1) - p.radius k| ≤ B * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (h.strictAnti.antitone (Nat.le_succ k)))]
    linarith [(h.drop k).2]
  have hangle : |p.angle (k + 1) - p.angle k| ≤ (2 * baseAngle) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr ((angle_strictMono p hstart) (Nat.lt_succ_self k)))]
    rw [← Parameters.angleIncrement_def]
    exact (angleIncrement_bounds p hstart k).2
  have hbound := polarChord_upper (p.radius (k + 1)) (p.radius k)
    (p.angle (k + 1)) (p.angle k) hr
  rw [← Parameters.point_def, ← Parameters.point_def] at hbound
  have hangleNonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * baseAngle) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := by
    have ha := baseAngle_pos
    positivity
  have ht := ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p (k / 2)
  have htone := ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart (k / 2)
  have hsquare := pow_le_one₀ ht htone (n := 2)
  have hfourth : p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 ≤ p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (p.scale (k / 2))) (sub_nonneg.mpr hsquare)]
  calc
    ‖p.point (k + 1) - p.point k‖ ≤
        |p.radius (k + 1) - p.radius k| + p.radius k * |p.angle (k + 1) - p.angle k| := hbound
    _ ≤ B * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 + p.radius k * ((2 * baseAngle) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) :=
      add_le_add hradial (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hangle hr)
    _ ≤ B * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 + Real.exp 1 * ((2 * baseAngle) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) :=
      add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h.upper k) hangleNonneg)
    _ ≤ B * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 + Real.exp 1 * ((2 * baseAngle) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfourth hB) le_rfl
    _ = (B + Real.exp 1 * (2 * baseAngle)) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := by ring
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-orders: the original quartic radius drop and quadratic
angle increment bound give the actual quadratic upper bound for one-step distance.
items.title: PointGeometry.point_step_upper

theorem pointEstimatesOfRadiusEstimates {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {K c B : ℝ}
    (h : RadiusEstimates p D K c B) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hsmall : p.scale 0 ≤ 1 / 4) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    PointEstimates p nearSeparationConstant (B + Real.exp 1 * (2 * baseAngle))
      (min nearSeparationConstant (c / 128)) := by
  have habove (k : ℕ) : 1 ≤ p.radius k := (h.above_one k).le
  have hradius (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ p.radius k := zero_le_one.trans (habove k)
  refine ⟨?_, point_chord_sq p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k
    exact point_norm p k (hradius k)
  · intro k
    exact ⟨point_step_lower p hstart hsmall habove k, point_step_upper h hstart hB k⟩
  · exact point_cluster_iff p hstart hradius h.tendsto_one
  · exact point_separation p hstart hsmall habove h.strictAnti.antitone c hc
      (fun k ↦ (h.drop k).1)

Helper for lem:polar-geometry: the source near/far and first-crossing arguments
turn the proved original radius estimates into actual point geometry.

items.label: PointGeometry.polarPointGeometry
