theorem polarPointGeometry :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ K > 0, ∃ c > 0, ∃ B > 0,
        ∃ lower > 0, ∃ upper > 0, ∃ separation > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧
          ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
            RadiusEstimates (Parameters.of j₀ νStar)
                (RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar) K c B ∧
              PointEstimates (Parameters.of j₀ νStar) lower upper separation := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hactual⟩ := polarRadiusProducts
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, K, hK, c, hc, B, hB, J₀, hJ₀, hradius⟩ := hactual νStar hnear
  have hquarter : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨J₁, _, hscale⟩ := Continuation.existsStartThreshold (1 / 4) hquarter
  have ha := baseAngle_pos
  have hupper : 0 < B + Real.exp 1 * (2 * baseAngle) := by positivity
  have hdenominator : (0 : ℝ) < 128 := by norm_num
  have hseparation : 0 < min nearSeparationConstant (c / 128) := by
    exact lt_min nearSeparationConstant_pos (div_pos hc hdenominator)
  refine ⟨hparameter, K, hK, c, hc, B, hB, nearSeparationConstant, nearSeparationConstant_pos,
    B + Real.exp 1 * (2 * baseAngle), hupper, min nearSeparationConstant (c / 128),
    hseparation, max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  have hj₀old := (le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀
  have hstart : 0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).startIndex := by
    simpa only [Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJ₀.trans_le hj₀old
  have hsmall : (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).scale 0 ≤ 1 / 4 :=
    (hscale νStar j₀ ((le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)).le
  have h := hradius j₀ hj₀old
  exact ⟨h, pointEstimatesOfRadiusEstimates h hstart hsmall hc.le hB.le⟩
items.statement:
lem:polar-geometry and eq:polar-orders and eq:polar-separation: the original
actual points have the source radial expansion, quartic radial decrements, quadratic
step norms, exact unit-circle cluster set, and uniform all-pairs separation.
All positive constants precede every subsequently larger natural starting index.

theorem point_cubic_distance (p : Parameters) (hanti : Antitone p.radius) (N : ℕ)
    (hstart : p.startIndex ≤ N ^ 3) :
    ‖p.point (2 * (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex)) -
        p.point (2 * ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex))‖ =
      p.evenRadius (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) - p.evenRadius ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex) := by
  have hcubes : N ^ 3 ≤ (N + 1) ^ 3 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ N) 3
  have hnext : p.startIndex ≤ (N + 1) ^ 3 := hstart.trans hcubes
  have hindices : 2 * (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) ≤ 2 * ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hcubes p.startIndex)
  have hradial : 0 ≤ p.evenRadius (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) -
      p.evenRadius ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex) := by
    simpa only [Parameters.radius_even] using sub_nonneg.mpr (hanti hindices)
  simp only [Parameters.point_def, Parameters.angle_even, Parameters.radius_even,
    polarUnit_evenAngle_cubic p N hstart, polarUnit_evenAngle_cubic p (N + 1) hnext]
  rw [← sub_smul, norm_smul, polarUnit_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one, abs_of_nonneg hradial]
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-geometry: at the original consecutive cubic endpoints,
the polar directions agree exactly, so Euclidean distance equals radial decrease.
items.title: PointGeometry.point_cubic_distance

items.label: PointGeometry.polarPointFullTurn

theorem polarPointFullTurn :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ K > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → j₀ ≤ N ^ 3 →
        let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
        |‖p.point (2 * (N ^ 3 - j₀)) - p.point (2 * ((N + 1) ^ 3 - j₀))‖ -
            3 * (RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar 0 +
              RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar 1) / ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1))| ≤
          K * (N : ℝ) ^ (-3 : ℤ) := by
  obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, hradii⟩ := polarRadiusProducts
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hturn⟩ := polarRadiusFullTurn
  refine ⟨min η₀ η₁, lt_min hη₀ hη₁, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  have hnear₀ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₀) := by
    exact ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))⟩
  have hnear₁ : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η₁) := by
    exact ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_right _ _))⟩
  obtain ⟨_, K₀, _, c, _, B, _, J₀, hJ₀, hradius⟩ := hradii νStar hnear₀
  obtain ⟨K, hK, J₁, _, hbound⟩ := hturn νStar hnear₁
  refine ⟨K, hK, max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀ N hN hstart
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hanti : Antitone p.radius :=
    (hradius j₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)).strictAnti.antitone
  have hstart' : p.startIndex ≤ N ^ 3 := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using hstart
  have hdistance : ‖p.point (2 * (N ^ 3 - j₀)) - p.point (2 * ((N + 1) ^ 3 - j₀))‖ =
      p.evenRadius (N ^ 3 - j₀) - p.evenRadius ((N + 1) ^ 3 - j₀) := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using point_cubic_distance p hanti N hstart'
  dsimp only
  rw [hdistance]
  exact hbound j₀ ((le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀) N hN hstart

Helper for lem:polar-geometry: the source complete-turn radial asymptotic is
also an actual Euclidean distance estimate at the original cubic endpoints,
uniformly before all subsequently larger starting indices.

theorem sin_remainder_factor :
    ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, AnalyticAt ℝ q 0 ∧ ∀ u : ℝ, Real.sin u - u = u ^ 3 * q u := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hformula⟩ :=

theorem cos_stageAngle_expansion (i : Fin 2) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.cos (stageAngle i t) - 1 + (limitAngle i) ^ 2 / 2 * t ^ 4)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hfactor⟩ := cos_remainder_factor
  have hcos8 : (fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.cos (stageAngle i t) - 1 + stageAngle i t ^ 2 / 2)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 8) := by
    simpa only [hfactor, Nat.reduceMul] using anglePowerFactor_isBigO i 4 q hq
  have hmain := (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 2) (𝓝 0)).const_mul_left
    (limitAngle i)
  have hplus := (stageAngle_isBigO_sq i).add hmain
  have hproduct := (stageAngle_expansion i).mul hplus
  have hidentity (t : ℝ) :
      (stageAngle i t - limitAngle i * t ^ 2) * (stageAngle i t + limitAngle i * t ^ 2) =
        stageAngle i t ^ 2 - limitAngle i ^ 2 * t ^ 4 := by ring
  have hsquare7 : (fun t : ℝ ↦ stageAngle i t ^ 2 - limitAngle i ^ 2 * t ^ 4) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7) := by
    simpa only [hidentity, ← pow_add, Nat.reduceAdd] using hproduct
  have horder : (7 : ℕ) < 8 := by norm_num
  have hsmall : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 8) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7) :=
    (Asymptotics.isLittleO_pow_pow horder).isBigO
  have hmodel := (hcos8.trans hsmall).sub (hsquare7.const_mul_left (1 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hcombine (t : ℝ) :
      (Real.cos (stageAngle i t) - 1 + stageAngle i t ^ 2 / 2) -
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (stageAngle i t ^ 2 - limitAngle i ^ 2 * t ^ 4) =
        Real.cos (stageAngle i t) - 1 + limitAngle i ^ 2 / 2 * t ^ 4 := by ring
  simpa only [hcombine] using hmodel

Helper for eq:polar-W-expansion: the cosine of the original stage angle
has fourth-order leading defect and a seventh-order remainder.

theorem radiusAtSlope_expansion (i : Fin 2) (Q : ℝ) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ radiusAtSlope i t Q - 1 -
      (limitAngle i * Q - limitAngle i ^ 2 / 2) * t ^ 4) =O[𝓝 0]
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7) := by
  have hcoef : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 2 * Q) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [mul_comm Q] using
      (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 2) (𝓝 0)).const_mul_left Q
  have hproduct := hcoef.mul (sin_stageAngle_expansion i)
  have hproduct7 : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 2 * Q *
      (Real.sin (stageAngle i t) - limitAngle i * t ^ 2)) =O[𝓝 0]
        (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7) := by
    simpa only [← pow_add, Nat.reduceAdd] using hproduct
  have hidentity (t : ℝ) :
      (Real.cos (stageAngle i t) - 1 + limitAngle i ^ 2 / 2 * t ^ 4) +
          t ^ 2 * Q * (Real.sin (stageAngle i t) - limitAngle i * t ^ 2) =
        radiusAtSlope i t Q - 1 - (limitAngle i * Q - limitAngle i ^ 2 / 2) * t ^ 4 := by
    rw [radiusAtSlope_def]
    ring
  simpa only [hidentity] using (cos_stageAngle_expansion i).add hproduct7

slope has fourth-order coefficient `cQ-c²/2` and seventh-order remainder.

items.label: RadiusExpansions.radiusEstimateOfSlopeBound
items.leanCode:
theorem radiusEstimateOfSlopeBound (i : Fin 2) (Q B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ → ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      |slope x - Q| ≤ B * t →
        |normalizedRadiusFactor i t x - 1 -
          (limitAngle i * Q - limitAngle i ^ 2 / 2) * t ^ 4| ≤ C * t ^ 5 := by
  have horder : (5 : ℕ) < 7 := by norm_num
  have hsmall : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 7) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 5) :=
    (Asymptotics.isLittleO_pow_pow horder).isBigO
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hfixed⟩ := ((radiusAtSlope_expansion i Q).trans hsmall).exists_pos
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hsin⟩ := (sin_stageAngle_isBigO_sq i).exists_pos
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hfixed.bound.and hsin.bound)
  refine ⟨A + B * S, add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hA (mul_nonneg hB hS.le), δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro t ht htδ x hx
  have hdist : dist t 0 < δ := by
    simpa only [dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht] using htδ
  rcases hbound hdist with ⟨hmodel, hsinBound⟩
  have hmodelAbs : |radiusAtSlope i t Q - 1 -
      (limitAngle i * Q - limitAngle i ^ 2 / 2) * t ^ 4| ≤ A * t ^ 5 := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg ht 5)] using hmodel
  have hsinAbs : |Real.sin (stageAngle i t)| ≤ S * t ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg ht 2)] using hsinBound
  have hbase : |t ^ 2 * (slope x - Q)| ≤ B * t ^ 3 := by
    calc
      |t ^ 2 * (slope x - Q)| = t ^ 2 * |slope x - Q| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg t)]
      _ ≤ t ^ 2 * (B * t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (sq_nonneg t)
      _ = B * t ^ 3 := by ring
  have hvariable : |t ^ 2 * (slope x - Q) * Real.sin (stageAngle i t)| ≤
      (B * S) * t ^ 5 := by
    calc
      |t ^ 2 * (slope x - Q) * Real.sin (stageAngle i t)| =
          |t ^ 2 * (slope x - Q)| * |Real.sin (stageAngle i t)| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ (B * t ^ 3) * (S * t ^ 2) := mul_le_mul hbase hsinAbs
        (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hB (pow_nonneg ht 3))
      _ = (B * S) * t ^ 5 := by ring
  rw [normalizedRadiusFactor_error_identity]
  calc
    |(radiusAtSlope i t Q - 1 - (limitAngle i * Q - limitAngle i ^ 2 / 2) * t ^ 4) +
        t ^ 2 * (slope x - Q) * Real.sin (stageAngle i t)| ≤
      |radiusAtSlope i t Q - 1 - (limitAngle i * Q - limitAngle i ^ 2 / 2) * t ^ 4| +
        |t ^ 2 * (slope x - Q) * Real.sin (stageAngle i t)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ A * t ^ 5 + (B * S) * t ^ 5 := add_le_add hmodelAbs hvariable
    _ = (A + B * S) * t ^ 5 := by ring
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-W-expansion: the exact trigonometric radius formula
turns a linear normalized slope error into one common fifth-order radius error.
items.title: RadiusExpansions.radiusEstimateOfSlopeBound

theorem slopeAlong_analyticAt {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {X : E → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ} {z : E} (hX : AnalyticAt ℝ X z) (hC : (X z).2.1 ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ slope (X y)) z := by

  have hC' : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ (X y).2.1) z := analyticAt_fst.comp hCV
  have hV : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ (X y).2.2) z := analyticAt_snd.comp hCV
  simp only [slope_def]
  exact hV.div hC' hC

theorem stageAlong_analyticAt {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (i : Fin 2) {τ : E → ℝ} {X : E → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ} {ζ η : E → ℝ} {z : E}
    (hτ : AnalyticAt ℝ τ z) (hX : AnalyticAt ℝ X z)
    (hζ : AnalyticAt ℝ ζ z) (hη : AnalyticAt ℝ η z)
    (hSlope : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ slope (X y)) z) (hτ0 : τ z = 0)
    (hσ : stageSigma i (τ z) (X z) (ζ z) (η z) ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ stage i (τ y) (X y) (ζ y) (η y)) z := by
  have hA : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ (X y).1) z := analyticAt_fst.comp hX
  have hCV : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ (X y).2) z := analyticAt_snd.comp hX
  have hC : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ (X y).2.1) z := analyticAt_fst.comp hCV
  have hV : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ (X y).2.2) z := analyticAt_snd.comp hCV
  have hAngle := (stageAngle_analyticAt i).comp_of_eq hτ hτ0
  have hSin := (sinFactor_analyticAt i).comp_of_eq hτ hτ0
  have hCot := (cotFactor_analyticAt i).comp_of_eq hτ hτ0
  have hv0 : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ stepV (X y) 0) z := by
    simp only [stepV_def, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
    exact hSlope.neg
  have hv1 : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ stepV (X y) 1) z := by
    simp only [stepV_def, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
    exact analyticAt_const
  have hw : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ stepW i (τ y) (X y) (ζ y) (η y)) z := by
    apply analyticAt_pi_iff.mpr
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · simp only [stepW_def, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      fun_prop
    · simpa only [stepW_def, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val_fin_one] using hη
  have hR : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun y ↦ fun r c : Fin 2 ↦ rotation i (τ y) r c) z := by
    apply analyticAt_pi_iff.mpr
    intro r
    apply analyticAt_pi_iff.mpr
    intro c
    fin_cases r
    all_goals fin_cases c
    all_goals simp only [rotation_def, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one,
      Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
    all_goals fun_prop
  have hw0 := analyticAt_pi_iff.mp hw 0
  have hw1 := analyticAt_pi_iff.mp hw 1
  have hR0 := analyticAt_pi_iff.mp hR 0
  have hR1 := analyticAt_pi_iff.mp hR 1
  have hR00 := analyticAt_pi_iff.mp hR0 0
  have hR01 := analyticAt_pi_iff.mp hR0 1
  have hR10 := analyticAt_pi_iff.mp hR1 0
  have hR11 := analyticAt_pi_iff.mp hR1 1
  have hSecant : AnalyticAt ℝ
      (fun y ↦ stageSigma i (τ y) (X y) (ζ y) (η y)) z := by
    simp only [stageSigma_scalar]
    fun_prop
  have hInv := hSecant.inv hσ
  simp only [stage_apply, stageMatrix_def, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.add_apply,
    Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.of_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    RealSymmetric2.matrix_eq, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
  fun_prop

theorem cycleSlopeEstimateOfStateBound (L κ ν B : ℝ)
    (hν : ν ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ → ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      ‖x - TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)‖ ≤ B * t →
        ∀ i : Fin 2, |cycleSlope L κ i t x - referenceSlope ν i| ≤ C * t := by
  have hK := TwoCycle.cycleK_bijOn_parameterSet.mapsTo hν
  have hE := (regularState_def _).mp (regularState_evenState (cycleK ν) hK)
  have hO := (regularState_def _).mp (regularState_oddState (cycleK ν) hK)
  have hCNext : (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) (TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν))).2.1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [limitAngle_zero, TwoCycle.evenToOdd _ hK]
    exact hO.2.1.ne'
  let f : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)) → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun z i ↦ cycleSlope L κ i z.1 z.2
  have hf : AnalyticAt ℝ f (0, TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)) := by
    apply analyticAt_pi_iff.mpr
    intro i
    exact cycleSlope_joint_analyticAt L κ i _ hE.1.ne' hE.2.1.ne' hCNext
  obtain ⟨K, s, hs, hLip⟩ := hf.hasStrictFDerivAt.exists_lipschitzOnWith
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hs
  have hbase : (0, TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)) ∈ s := mem_of_mem_nhds hs
  have hBOne : 0 < B + 1 := by linarith
  have hKOne : 0 < (K : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  refine ⟨((K : ℝ) + 1) * (B + 1), mul_pos hKOne hBOne,
    ε / (B + 1), div_pos hε hBOne, ?_⟩
  intro t ht htδ x hx i
  have hdistBound : dist (t, x) (0, TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)) ≤ (B + 1) * t := by
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    apply max_le
    · rw [dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hB ht]
    · rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have hBt : B * t ≤ (B + 1) * t := by nlinarith
      exact hx.trans hBt
  have hsmall : (B + 1) * t < ε := by
    nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ hBOne).mp htδ]
  have hin : (t, x) ∈ s := hball (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hdistBound.trans_lt hsmall))
  have hfull := (lipschitzOnWith_iff_norm_sub_le.mp hLip) hin hbase
  have hnormBound : ‖(t, x) - (0, TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν))‖ ≤ (B + 1) * t := by
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hdistBound
  have htotal : ‖f (t, x) - f (0, TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν))‖ ≤
      (((K : ℝ) + 1) * (B + 1)) * t := by
    calc
      ‖f (t, x) - f (0, TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν))‖ ≤
          (K : ℝ) * ‖(t, x) - (0, TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν))‖ := hfull
      _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * ((B + 1) * t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnormBound K.coe_nonneg
      _ ≤ (((K : ℝ) + 1) * (B + 1)) * t := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hBOne.le ht]
  have hcoordinate := (norm_le_pi_norm
    (f (t, x) - f (0, TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν))) i).trans htotal
  simpa only [f, Pi.sub_apply, cycleSlope_at_zero L κ ν hν, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hcoordinate

items.label: RadiusExpansions.localSlopeAndRadiusBounds
items.leanCode:
theorem localSlopeAndRadiusBounds (L κ ν B : ℝ)
    (hν : ν ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ → ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      ‖x - TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)‖ ≤ B * t →
        (∀ i : Fin 2, |cycleSlope L κ i t x - referenceSlope ν i| ≤ C * t) ∧
          ∀ i : Fin 2,
            |normalizedRadiusFactor i t (cycleInput L κ i t x) - 1 -
              radiusCoefficient ν i * t ^ 4| ≤ C * t ^ 5 := by
  obtain ⟨Cq, hCq, δq, hδq, hslope⟩ := cycleSlopeEstimateOfStateBound L κ ν B hν hB
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, δ₀, hδ₀, hW₀⟩ := radiusEstimateOfSlopeBound 0 (referenceSlope ν 0) Cq hCq.le
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁, δ₁, hδ₁, hW₁⟩ := radiusEstimateOfSlopeBound 1 (referenceSlope ν 1) Cq hCq.le
  have hC : 0 < Cq + C₀ + C₁ := by linarith
  refine ⟨Cq + C₀ + C₁, hC, min δq (min δ₀ δ₁), lt_min hδq (lt_min hδ₀ hδ₁), ?_⟩
  intro t ht htδ x hx
  have htq : t < δq := htδ.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have ht₀ : t < δ₀ := (htδ.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have ht₁ : t < δ₁ := (htδ.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)).trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hq := hslope t ht htq x hx
  constructor
  · intro i
    have hCqLe : Cq ≤ Cq + C₀ + C₁ := by linarith
    exact (hq i).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCqLe ht)
  · intro i
    have hq₀ : |slope (cycleInput L κ 0 t x) - referenceSlope ν 0| ≤ Cq * t := by
      simpa only [cycleSlope_def] using hq 0
    have hq₁ : |slope (cycleInput L κ 1 t x) - referenceSlope ν 1| ≤ Cq * t := by
      simpa only [cycleSlope_def] using hq 1
    have hbound₀ := hW₀ t ht ht₀ (cycleInput L κ 0 t x) hq₀
    have hbound₁ := hW₁ t ht ht₁ (cycleInput L κ 1 t x) hq₁
    have hC₀Le : C₀ ≤ Cq + C₀ + C₁ := by linarith
    have hC₁Le : C₁ ≤ Cq + C₀ + C₁ := by linarith
    have hresult₀ := hbound₀.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC₀Le (pow_nonneg ht 5))
    have hresult₁ := hbound₁.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC₁Le (pow_nonneg ht 5))
    fin_cases i
    · simpa only [radiusCoefficient_def, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue] using hresult₀
    · simpa only [radiusCoefficient_def, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue] using hresult₁

theorem norm_state_sub_evenState_le (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖x - TwoCycle.evenState x.1‖ ≤
      (‖FastContraction.matrixOperator FastContraction.basisMatrix‖ + 1) *
        FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError x) := by
  have hreconstruct : FastRemainder.perturbedState x.1 (FastContraction.fastError x) = x := by
    rw [FastRemainder.perturbedState_apply, FastContraction.fastError_def]
    simp only [FastContraction.fastCoordinates_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · apply Prod.ext
      · dsimp only
        ring
      · dsimp only
        ring
  have h := SlowCoupling.norm_perturbedState_sub_evenState_le x.1 (FastContraction.fastError x)
  rwa [hreconstruct] at h

items.label: RadiusExpansions.stateBoundOfTube
items.leanCode:
theorem stateBoundOfTube (ν M N : ℝ) (hν : ν ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet)
    (hbranch : ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter (cycleK ν))
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hN : 0 ≤ N) :
    ∃ B > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ → ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      |x.1 - cycleK ν| ≤ M * t →
        FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError x) ≤ N * t ^ 3 →
          ‖x - TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)‖ ≤ B * t := by
  have hK := TwoCycle.cycleK_bijOn_parameterSet.mapsTo hν
  have hcurve := TwoCycle.evenState_analyticAt (cycleK ν) hK hbranch
  obtain ⟨K, s, hs, hLip⟩ := hcurve.hasStrictFDerivAt.exists_lipschitzOnWith
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hs
  have hbase : cycleK ν ∈ s := mem_of_mem_nhds hs
  let P := ‖FastContraction.matrixOperator FastContraction.basisMatrix‖ + 1
  have hP : 0 < P := by
    dsimp only [P]
    positivity
  have hMOne : 0 < M + 1 := by linarith
  have hB : 0 < P * N + (K : ℝ) * M + 1 := by
    positivity
  refine ⟨P * N + (K : ℝ) * M + 1, hB,
    min 1 (ρ / (M + 1)), lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hρ hMOne), ?_⟩
  intro t ht htδ x hslow hfast
  have htOne : t ≤ 1 := (htδ.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)).le
  have htSquare : t ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ ht htOne
  have htCube : t ^ 3 ≤ t := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht (sub_nonneg.mpr htSquare)]
  have hsmall : (M + 1) * t < ρ := by
    have htρ : t < ρ / (M + 1) := htδ.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
    nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ hMOne).mp htρ]
  have hAin : x.1 ∈ s := by
    apply hball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
    have hMt : M * t ≤ (M + 1) * t := by nlinarith
    exact hslow.trans_lt (hMt.trans_lt hsmall)
  have hcurveBound := (lipschitzOnWith_iff_norm_sub_le.mp hLip) hAin hbase
  have hslowNorm : ‖x.1 - cycleK ν‖ ≤ M * t := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hslow
  have hcurveLinear : ‖TwoCycle.evenState x.1 - TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)‖ ≤
      ((K : ℝ) * M) * t := by
    calc
      ‖TwoCycle.evenState x.1 - TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)‖ ≤
          (K : ℝ) * ‖x.1 - cycleK ν‖ := hcurveBound
      _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * (M * t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hslowNorm K.coe_nonneg
      _ = ((K : ℝ) * M) * t := by ring
  have hfastLinear : ‖x - TwoCycle.evenState x.1‖ ≤ (P * N) * t := by
    calc
      ‖x - TwoCycle.evenState x.1‖ ≤
          P * FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError x) :=
        norm_state_sub_evenState_le x
      _ ≤ P * (N * t ^ 3) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfast hP.le
      _ ≤ P * (N * t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htCube hN) hP.le
      _ = (P * N) * t := by ring
  calc
    ‖x - TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)‖ =
        ‖(x - TwoCycle.evenState x.1) +
          (TwoCycle.evenState x.1 - TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν))‖ := by
      rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
    _ ≤ ‖x - TwoCycle.evenState x.1‖ +
        ‖TwoCycle.evenState x.1 - TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK ν)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (P * N) * t + ((K : ℝ) * M) * t := add_le_add hfastLinear hcurveLinear
    _ ≤ (P * N + (K : ℝ) * M + 1) * t := by nlinarith

theorem localSlopeAndRadiusBoundsOfTube (L κ ν M N : ℝ)
    (hν : ν ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet)
    (hbranch : ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter (cycleK ν))
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hN : 0 ≤ N) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ → ∀ x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
      |x.1 - cycleK ν| ≤ M * t →
        FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError x) ≤ N * t ^ 3 →
          (∀ i : Fin 2, |cycleSlope L κ i t x - referenceSlope ν i| ≤ C * t) ∧
            ∀ i : Fin 2,
              |normalizedRadiusFactor i t (cycleInput L κ i t x) - 1 -
                radiusCoefficient ν i * t ^ 4| ≤ C * t ^ 5 := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, δb, hδb, hstate⟩ := stateBoundOfTube ν M N hν hbranch hM hN
  obtain ⟨C, hC, δc, hδc, hlocal⟩ := localSlopeAndRadiusBounds L κ ν B hν hB.le
  refine ⟨C, hC, min δb δc, lt_min hδb hδc, ?_⟩
  intro t ht htδ x hslow hfast
  have hstateBound := hstate t ht (htδ.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) x hslow hfast
  exact hlocal t ht (htδ.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) x hstateBound

theorem omegaErrorOfCycleSlopeBound (p : Parameters) (j : ℕ) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (i : Fin 2) (Q C : ℝ)
    (hq : |cycleSlope p.feedbackRate p.kStar i (p.scale j) (p.normalizedEvenState j) - Q| ≤
      C * p.scale j) :
    |p.omega (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - Q * p.scale j ^ 2| ≤ C * p.scale j ^ 3 := by
  rw [omega_prescribed p j hstart i]
  have hidentity : p.scale j ^ 2 *
      cycleSlope p.feedbackRate p.kStar i (p.scale j) (p.normalizedEvenState j) -
        Q * p.scale j ^ 2 = p.scale j ^ 2 *
          (cycleSlope p.feedbackRate p.kStar i (p.scale j) (p.normalizedEvenState j) - Q) := by
    ring
  rw [hidentity, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (p.scale j))]
  calc
    p.scale j ^ 2 *
        |cycleSlope p.feedbackRate p.kStar i (p.scale j) (p.normalizedEvenState j) - Q| ≤
      p.scale j ^ 2 * (C * p.scale j) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = C * p.scale j ^ 3 := by ring

items.label: RadiusExpansions.actualSlopeAndRadiusEstimates
items.leanCode:
theorem actualSlopeAndRadiusEstimates :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ C > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧
        ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin 2,
          let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
          |cycleSlope p.feedbackRate p.kStar i (p.scale j) (p.normalizedEvenState j) -
              referenceSlope νStar i| ≤ C * p.scale j ∧
            |p.omega (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - referenceSlope νStar i * p.scale j ^ 2| ≤
              C * p.scale j ^ 3 ∧
              |p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1 - radiusCoefficient νStar i * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤
                C * p.scale j ^ 5 := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hTube⟩ := Continuation.actualTube
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, hbranch, N, hN, M, hM, J₀, hJ₀, htube⟩ := hTube νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨C, hC, δ, hδ, hlocal⟩ := localSlopeAndRadiusBoundsOfTube
    (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar) νStar M N hparameter hbranch hM.le hN.le
  obtain ⟨J₁, _, hscale⟩ := Continuation.existsStartThreshold δ hδ
  refine ⟨hparameter, C, hC, max J₀ J₁, lt_of_lt_of_le hJ₀ (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀ j i
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using
      lt_of_lt_of_le hJ₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  have ht : 0 < p.scale j := ScaleTails.scale_pos p hstart j
  have hzeroScale : p.scale 0 < δ :=
    hscale νStar j₀ ((le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  have hsmall : p.scale j < δ :=
    (ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hstart (Nat.zero_le j)).trans_lt hzeroScale
  have hactualTube := htube j₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀) j
  have hfeedback : p.feedbackRate = 4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar) := by
    simp only [p, Parameters.feedbackRate_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  have hkStar : p.kStar = cycleK νStar := by
    simp only [p, Parameters.kStar_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  have hslow : |(p.normalizedEvenState j).1 - cycleK νStar| ≤ M * p.scale j := by
    have h : |(p.normalizedEvenState j).1 - p.kStar| ≤ M * p.scale j := hactualTube.1
    rwa [hkStar] at h
  have hfast : FastContraction.fixedNorm (FastContraction.fastError (p.normalizedEvenState j)) ≤
      N * p.scale j ^ 3 := hactualTube.2.1
  have hresult := hlocal (p.scale j) ht.le hsmall (p.normalizedEvenState j) hslow hfast
  rw [← hfeedback, ← hkStar] at hresult
  have homega := omegaErrorOfCycleSlopeBound p j hstart i (referenceSlope νStar i) C (hresult.1 i)
  have hradius := hresult.2 i
  rw [radiusFactor_prescribed p j hstart i] at hradius
  exact ⟨hresult.1 i, homega, hradius⟩

items.leanCode:
theorem polarRadiusExpansions :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ C > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧
        ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ k : ℕ,
          let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
          |p.omega k - referenceSlope νStar (phaseIndex k) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2| ≤
              C * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 3 ∧
            |p.radiusRatio k - 1 - radiusCoefficient νStar (phaseIndex k) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4| ≤
              C * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 5 := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hbound⟩ := actualSlopeAndRadiusEstimates
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, C, hC, J, hJ, hactual⟩ := hbound νStar hnear
  refine ⟨hparameter, C, hC, J, hJ, ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀ k
  have h := hactual j₀ hj₀ (k / 2) (phaseIndex k)
  rw [phaseIndex_identity] at h
  exact h.2
items.statement:
eq:polar-slope-estimates and eq:polar-W-expansion: the original actual
physical slope and radius-factor sequences have the source expansions at
every iteration, uniformly for all subsequently larger natural starting indices.
items.title: RadiusExpansions.polarRadiusExpansions

items.label: RadiusExpansions.radiusGrowthOfErrorBound
items.leanCode:
theorem radiusGrowthOfErrorBound (W D C t : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hsmall : C * t ≤ D / 2)
    (herror : |W - 1 - D * t ^ 4| ≤ C * t ^ 5) :
    (D / 2) * t ^ 4 ≤ W - 1 ∧ W - 1 ≤ (3 * D / 2) * t ^ 4 ∧ 1 < W := by
  have hpower : C * t ^ 5 ≤ (D / 2) * t ^ 4 := by
    calc
      C * t ^ 5 = (C * t) * t ^ 4 := by ring
      _ ≤ (D / 2) * t ^ 4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall (pow_nonneg ht.le 4)
  have hbounds := abs_le.mp herror
  have hlower : (D / 2) * t ^ 4 ≤ W - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hupper : W - 1 ≤ (3 * D / 2) * t ^ 4 := by nlinarith
  have hpositive : 0 < (D / 2) * t ^ 4 := mul_pos (half_pos hD) (pow_pos ht 4)
  have hW : 1 < W := by linarith
  exact ⟨hlower, hupper, hW⟩
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-W-expansion: a proved fifth-order remainder with
positive source coefficient gives quantitative fourth-order growth and `W>1`.
items.title: RadiusExpansions.radiusGrowthOfErrorBound

items.label: RadiusExpansions.polarRadiusGrowth
items.leanCode:
theorem polarRadiusGrowth :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧
        ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ k : ℕ,
          let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
          (radiusCoefficient νStar (phaseIndex k) / 2) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 ≤
              p.radiusRatio k - 1 ∧
            p.radiusRatio k - 1 ≤ (3 * radiusCoefficient νStar (phaseIndex k) / 2) *
                p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 ∧
              1 < p.radiusRatio k := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hbound⟩ := polarRadiusExpansions
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, C, hC, J₀, hJ₀, hactual⟩ := hbound νStar hnear
  have hD := radiusCoefficients_pos νStar hparameter
  let d := min (radiusCoefficient νStar 0) (radiusCoefficient νStar 1)
  have hd : 0 < d := lt_min hD.1 hD.2
  have hdle : ∀ i : Fin 2, d ≤ radiusCoefficient νStar i := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa only [d, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue] using
        min_le_left (radiusCoefficient νStar 0) (radiusCoefficient νStar 1)
    · simpa only [d, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue] using
        min_le_right (radiusCoefficient νStar 0) (radiusCoefficient νStar 1)
  have hcutoff : 0 < d / (2 * C) := div_pos hd (mul_pos zero_lt_two hC)
  obtain ⟨J₁, _, hscale⟩ := Continuation.existsStartThreshold (d / (2 * C)) hcutoff
  refine ⟨hparameter, max J₀ J₁, lt_of_lt_of_le hJ₀ (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀ k
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using
      lt_of_lt_of_le hJ₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  have ht : 0 < p.scale (k / 2) := ScaleTails.scale_pos p hstart _
  have hzeroScale : p.scale 0 < d / (2 * C) :=
    hscale νStar j₀ ((le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  have hsmall : p.scale (k / 2) < d / (2 * C) :=
    (ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hstart (Nat.zero_le (k / 2))).trans_lt hzeroScale
  have htwoC : 0 < 2 * C := mul_pos zero_lt_two hC
  have hCt : C * p.scale (k / 2) ≤ radiusCoefficient νStar (phaseIndex k) / 2 := by
    nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ htwoC).mp hsmall, hdle (phaseIndex k)]
  have herror := (hactual j₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀) k).2
  exact radiusGrowthOfErrorBound (p.radiusRatio k) (radiusCoefficient νStar (phaseIndex k)) C
    (p.scale (k / 2)) (radiusCoefficient_pos νStar hparameter (phaseIndex k)) ht hCt herror
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-W-expansion: after one common increase of the
natural starting-index threshold, every actual source radius factor exceeds
one and its defect has the source positive fourth-order size.
items.title: RadiusExpansions.polarRadiusGrowth

items.label: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_def
items.leanCode:
theorem tailProduct_def (w : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    tailProduct w j = ∏' n : ℕ, w (j + n) := by
  rfl
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: the defining tail-product formula.
items.title: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_def

items.label: RadiusProducts.logTail_def
items.leanCode:
theorem logTail_def (w : ℕ → ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    logTail w j = ∑' n : ℕ, Real.log (w (j + n)) := by
  rfl
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: the defining logarithmic-tail formula.
items.title: RadiusProducts.logTail_def

items.label: RadiusProducts.summableLogTail
items.leanCode:
theorem summableLogTail {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hlog : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n)))
    (j : ℕ) : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w (j + n))) := by
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using (summable_nat_add_iff j).2 hlog
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: summability of logarithms persists in every tail.
items.title: RadiusProducts.summableLogTail

items.label: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_eq_exp
items.leanCode:
theorem tailProduct_eq_exp {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ n, 0 < w n)
    (hlog : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n))) (j : ℕ) :
    tailProduct w j = Real.exp (logTail w j) := by
  rw [tailProduct_def, logTail_def]
  exact (Real.rexp_tsum_eq_tprod (fun n ↦ hw (j + n)) (summableLogTail hlog j)).symm
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-radii: summable logarithms give the original positive product,
with its exact exponential representation.
items.title: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_eq_exp

items.label: RadiusProducts.multipliableTail
items.leanCode:
theorem multipliableTail {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ n, 0 < w n)
    (hlog : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n))) (j : ℕ) :
    Multipliable (fun n ↦ w (j + n)) := by
  exact Real.multipliable_of_summable_log (fun n ↦ hw (j + n)) (summableLogTail hlog j)
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: every positive tail with summable logarithms is multipliable.
items.title: RadiusProducts.multipliableTail

items.label: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_pos
items.leanCode:
theorem tailProduct_pos {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ n, 0 < w n)
    (hlog : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n))) (j : ℕ) :
    0 < tailProduct w j := by
  rw [tailProduct_eq_exp hw hlog]
  exact Real.exp_pos _
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: a positive logarithmic tail gives a positive radius.
items.title: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_pos

items.label: RadiusProducts.logTail_shift
items.leanCode:
theorem logTail_shift {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hlog : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n)))
    (j : ℕ) : logTail w j = Real.log (w j) + logTail w (j + 1) := by
  rw [logTail_def, logTail_def, (summableLogTail hlog j).tsum_eq_zero_add]
  simp only [Nat.add_zero, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: removing the first term shifts the logarithmic tail exactly.
items.title: RadiusProducts.logTail_shift

items.label: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_shift
items.leanCode:
theorem tailProduct_shift {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ n, 0 < w n)
    (hlog : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n))) (j : ℕ) :
    tailProduct w j = w j * tailProduct w (j + 1) := by
  rw [tailProduct_eq_exp hw hlog, logTail_shift hlog, Real.exp_add,
    Real.exp_log (hw j), tailProduct_eq_exp hw hlog]
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-radii: the exact shifted tail-product recurrence follows
by exponentiating the shifted sum of logarithms.
items.title: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_shift

items.label: RadiusProducts.logTail_tendsto_zero
items.leanCode:
theorem logTail_tendsto_zero (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    Tendsto (logTail w) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  rw [funext (logTail_def w)]
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using
    tendsto_sum_nat_add (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n))
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: the logarithmic tails tend to zero.
items.title: RadiusProducts.logTail_tendsto_zero

items.label: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_tendsto_one
items.leanCode:
theorem tailProduct_tendsto_one {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ n, 0 < w n)
    (hlog : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n))) :
    Tendsto (tailProduct w) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
  have hlimit := Real.continuous_exp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (logTail_tendsto_zero w)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.exp_zero, ← tailProduct_eq_exp hw hlog] using hlimit
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: positive tail products tend to one through their logarithms.
items.title: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_tendsto_one

items.label: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_gt_one
items.leanCode:
theorem tailProduct_gt_one {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ n, 1 < w n)
    (hlog : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n))) (j : ℕ) :
    1 < tailProduct w j := by
  have hpositive : ∀ n, 0 < w n := fun n ↦ zero_lt_one.trans (hw n)
  have htail : 0 < logTail w j := by
    rw [logTail_def]
    apply (summableLogTail hlog j).tsum_pos
    · intro n
      exact (Real.log_pos (hw (j + n))).le
    · exact Real.log_pos (hw (j + 0))
  rw [tailProduct_eq_exp hpositive hlog, ← Real.exp_zero]
  exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr htail
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: factors strictly above one give radii strictly above one.
items.title: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_gt_one

items.label: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_strictAnti
items.leanCode:
theorem tailProduct_strictAnti {w : ℕ → ℝ} (hw : ∀ n, 1 < w n)
    (hlog : Summable (fun n ↦ Real.log (w n))) : StrictAnti (tailProduct w) := by
  have hpositive : ∀ n, 0 < w n := fun n ↦ zero_lt_one.trans (hw n)
  apply strictAnti_nat_of_succ_lt
  intro j
  rw [tailProduct_shift hpositive hlog j]
  exact lt_mul_of_one_lt_left (tailProduct_pos hpositive hlog (j + 1)) (hw j)
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-radii: factors strictly above one make the tail products
strictly decrease.
items.title: RadiusProducts.tailProduct_strictAnti

items.label: RadiusProducts.abs_log_sub_linear_le_sq
items.leanCode:
theorem abs_log_sub_linear_le_sq {w : ℝ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) :
    |Real.log w - (w - 1)| ≤ (w - 1) ^ 2 := by
  have hpos : 0 < w := zero_lt_one.trans_le hw
  have hcub : 0 ≤ (w - 1) ^ 3 := pow_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hw) 3
  have hquot : (w - 1) - (w - 1) ^ 2 ≤ (w - 1) / w := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hpos).2
    nlinarith
  have hid : (w - 1) / w = 1 - w⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  have hlower := hquot.trans (hid ▸ Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos hpos)
  have hupper := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos hpos
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hupper)]
  linarith
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-radii: the logarithm differs from its linear term by at most
the squared displacement, for every factor at least one.
items.title: RadiusProducts.abs_log_sub_linear_le_sq

items.label: RadiusProducts.cycleFactor_def
items.leanCode:
theorem cycleFactor_def (p : Parameters) (j : ℕ) :
    cycleFactor p j = p.radiusRatio (2 * j) * p.radiusRatio (2 * j + 1) := by
  rfl
items.statement: Helper for eq:polar-radii: the paired factor retains both original phases.
items.title: RadiusProducts.cycleFactor_def

items.label: RadiusProducts.evenRadius_eq_tailProduct
items.leanCode:
theorem evenRadius_eq_tailProduct (p : Parameters) (j : ℕ) :
    p.evenRadius j = tailProduct (cycleFactor p) j := by
  rw [Parameters.evenRadius_def, tailProduct_def]
  simp only [cycleFactor_def]
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-radii: the existing even radius is exactly the paired-factor
tail product.
items.title: RadiusProducts.evenRadius_eq_tailProduct

items.label: RadiusProducts.factor_sub_one_bounds
items.leanCode:
theorem factor_sub_one_bounds {w t D C : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htone : t ≤ 1)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hsmall : C * t ≤ D / 2)
    (herror : |w - 1 - D * t ^ 4| ≤ C * t ^ 5) :
    D / 2 * t ^ 4 ≤ w - 1 ∧ w - 1 ≤ (D + C) * t ^ 4 := by
  have hexponents : (4 : ℕ) ≤ 5 := by norm_num
  have hpowers : t ^ 5 ≤ t ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one ht htone hexponents
  have hsmallPower := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall (pow_nonneg ht 4)
  have herrorPower := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowers hC
  have habs := abs_le.mp herror
  constructor
  · nlinarith
  · linarith
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-radii: a fifth-order remainder gives uniform fourth-order
upper and lower bounds after the scale is sufficiently small.
items.title: RadiusProducts.factor_sub_one_bounds

items.label: RadiusProducts.logFactor_error
items.leanCode:
theorem logFactor_error {w t D C : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htone : t ≤ 1)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hw : 1 ≤ w)
    (herror : |w - 1 - D * t ^ 4| ≤ C * t ^ 5) :
    |Real.log w - D * t ^ 4| ≤ (C + (D + C) ^ 2) * t ^ 5 := by
  have hexponents : (4 : ℕ) ≤ 5 := by norm_num
  have hpowers : t ^ 5 ≤ t ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one ht htone hexponents
  have hupper : w - 1 ≤ (D + C) * t ^ 4 := by
    have habs := (abs_le.mp herror).2
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowers hC
    linarith
  have hsquare : (w - 1) ^ 2 ≤ ((D + C) * t ^ 4) ^ 2 := by
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr hw) hupper 2
  have heighthExponent : (5 : ℕ) ≤ 8 := by norm_num
  have heighth : t ^ 8 ≤ t ^ 5 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one ht htone heighthExponent
  have hquadratic : (w - 1) ^ 2 ≤ (D + C) ^ 2 * t ^ 5 := by
    calc
      (w - 1) ^ 2 ≤ ((D + C) * t ^ 4) ^ 2 := hsquare
      _ = (D + C) ^ 2 * t ^ 8 := by ring
      _ ≤ (D + C) ^ 2 * t ^ 5 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left heighth (sq_nonneg _)
  calc
    |Real.log w - D * t ^ 4| =
        |(Real.log w - (w - 1)) + (w - 1 - D * t ^ 4)| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |Real.log w - (w - 1)| + |w - 1 - D * t ^ 4| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (w - 1) ^ 2 + C * t ^ 5 := add_le_add (abs_log_sub_linear_le_sq hw) herror
    _ ≤ (C + (D + C) ^ 2) * t ^ 5 := by linarith
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-radii: the exact logarithm of a factor has the same quartic
coefficient, with an explicit uniform fifth-order remainder.
items.title: RadiusProducts.logFactor_error

items.label: RadiusProducts.summableLog_of_error
items.leanCode:
theorem summableLog_of_error (p : Parameters) {w : ℕ → ℝ} {D C : ℝ}
    (herror : ∀ j, |Real.log (w j) - D * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤ C * p.scale j ^ 5) :
    Summable (fun j ↦ Real.log (w j)) := by
  have herr : Summable (fun j ↦ Real.log (w j) - D * p.scale j ^ 4) := by
    apply ((ScaleTails.summable_scale_five p).mul_left C).of_norm_bounded
    intro j
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using herror j
  have hsum := herr.add ((ScaleTails.summable_scale_four p).mul_left D)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hsum
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-radii: a quartic logarithmic expansion along the actual
prescribed scale proves summability of the logarithms.
items.title: RadiusProducts.summableLog_of_error

items.label: RadiusProducts.logTail_quartic_error
items.leanCode:
theorem logTail_quartic_error (p : Parameters) {w : ℕ → ℝ} {D C : ℝ}
    (herror : ∀ j, |Real.log (w j) - D * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤ C * p.scale j ^ 5)
    (j : ℕ) :
    |logTail w j - D * ScaleTails.powerTail p 4 j| ≤
      C * ScaleTails.powerTail p 5 j := by
  have hfour : Summable (fun n ↦ p.scale (j + n) ^ 4) := by
    simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using
      (summable_nat_add_iff j).2 (ScaleTails.summable_scale_four p)
  have hfive : Summable (fun n ↦ p.scale (j + n) ^ 5) := by
    simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using
      (summable_nat_add_iff j).2 (ScaleTails.summable_scale_five p)
  have hid : logTail w j - D * ScaleTails.powerTail p 4 j =
      ∑' n : ℕ, (Real.log (w (j + n)) - D * p.scale (j + n) ^ 4) := by
    rw [logTail_def, ScaleTails.powerTail_def,
      (summableLogTail (summableLog_of_error p herror) j).tsum_sub (hfour.mul_left D),
      tsum_mul_left]
  rw [hid]
  have hnorm : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖Real.log (w (j + n)) - D * p.scale (j + n) ^ 4‖ ≤
      C * p.scale (j + n) ^ 5 := by
    intro n
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using herror (j + n)
  have hsum := tsum_of_norm_bounded (hfive.mul_left C).hasSum
    hnorm
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, tsum_mul_left, ← ScaleTails.powerTail_def] using hsum
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-radii: summing the logarithmic remainder gives exactly a
constant times the prescribed quintic scale tail.
items.title: RadiusProducts.logTail_quartic_error

items.label: RadiusProducts.logTail_linear_error
items.leanCode:
theorem logTail_linear_error (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    {w : ℕ → ℝ} {D C : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (herror : ∀ j, |Real.log (w j) - D * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤ C * p.scale j ^ 5)
    (j : ℕ) :
    |logTail w j - 3 * D * p.scale j| ≤ (D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale j ^ 2 := by
  have hfour := ScaleTails.quarticTail_error p hstart j
  have hfive := ScaleTails.quinticTail_le p hstart j
  have hexponents : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by norm_num
  have hpowers : p.scale j ^ 4 ≤ p.scale j ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_of_le_one (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j)
      (ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart j) hexponents
  have hmain : |D * (ScaleTails.powerTail p 4 j - 3 * p.scale j)| ≤
      D * p.scale j ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hD, abs_of_nonneg hfour.1]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfour.2.trans hpowers) hD
  calc
    |logTail w j - 3 * D * p.scale j| =
        |(logTail w j - D * ScaleTails.powerTail p 4 j) +
          D * (ScaleTails.powerTail p 4 j - 3 * p.scale j)| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |logTail w j - D * ScaleTails.powerTail p 4 j| +
        |D * (ScaleTails.powerTail p 4 j - 3 * p.scale j)| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ C * ScaleTails.powerTail p 5 j + D * p.scale j ^ 2 :=
      add_le_add (logTail_quartic_error p herror j) hmain
    _ ≤ (D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale j ^ 2 := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfive hC
      nlinarith
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-geometry: the source integral comparisons turn the quartic
logarithmic expansion into a uniform linear tail expansion.
items.title: RadiusProducts.logTail_linear_error

items.label: RadiusProducts.abs_logTail_le_scale
items.leanCode:
theorem abs_logTail_le_scale (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    {w : ℕ → ℝ} {D C : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (herror : ∀ j, |Real.log (w j) - D * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤ C * p.scale j ^ 5)
    (j : ℕ) : |logTail w j| ≤ (4 * D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale j := by
  have hbound := logTail_linear_error p hstart hD hC herror j
  have ht := ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j
  have hexponents : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  have hpowers : p.scale j ^ 2 ≤ p.scale j := by
    simpa only [pow_one] using pow_le_pow_of_le_one ht
      (ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart j) hexponents
  have hconstant : 0 ≤ D + (5 / 2) * C := by positivity
  have hmain : 0 ≤ 3 * D * p.scale j := by positivity
  calc
    |logTail w j| = |(logTail w j - 3 * D * p.scale j) + 3 * D * p.scale j| := by
      rw [sub_add_cancel]
    _ ≤ |logTail w j - 3 * D * p.scale j| + |3 * D * p.scale j| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale j ^ 2 + 3 * D * p.scale j := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hmain]
      exact add_le_add hbound le_rfl
    _ ≤ (4 * D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale j := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowers hconstant
      linarith
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-geometry: a uniform bound for the logarithmic radius in terms
of the actual prescribed scale.
items.title: RadiusProducts.abs_logTail_le_scale

items.label: RadiusProducts.abs_logTail_le_one
items.leanCode:
theorem abs_logTail_le_one (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    {w : ℕ → ℝ} {D C : ℝ} (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (herror : ∀ j, |Real.log (w j) - D * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤ C * p.scale j ^ 5)
    (hsmall : (4 * D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale 0 ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) :
    |logTail w j| ≤ 1 := by
  have hconstant : 0 ≤ 4 * D + (5 / 2) * C := by positivity
  calc
    |logTail w j| ≤ (4 * D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale j :=
      abs_logTail_le_scale p hstart hD hC herror j
    _ ≤ (4 * D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale 0 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hstart (Nat.zero_le j)) hconstant
    _ ≤ 1 := hsmall

Helper for lem:polar-geometry: a single smallness condition at the starting scale

theorem tailProduct_linear_error (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    {w : ℕ → ℝ} {D C : ℝ} (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (herror : ∀ j, |Real.log (w j) - D * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤ C * p.scale j ^ 5)
    (hsmall : (4 * D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale 0 ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) :
    |tailProduct w j - 1 - 3 * D * p.scale j| ≤
      ((4 * D + (5 / 2) * C) ^ 2 + D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale j ^ 2 := by
  have hbound := abs_logTail_le_scale p hstart hD hC herror j
  have hexp := Real.abs_exp_sub_one_sub_id_le
    (abs_logTail_le_one p hstart hD hC herror hsmall j)
  have hsquare := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg (logTail w j)) hbound 2
  have hsquare' : logTail w j ^ 2 ≤
      (4 * D + (5 / 2) * C) ^ 2 * p.scale j ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [sq_abs, mul_pow] using hsquare
  rw [tailProduct_eq_exp hw (summableLog_of_error p herror)]
  calc
    |Real.exp (logTail w j) - 1 - 3 * D * p.scale j| =
        |(Real.exp (logTail w j) - 1 - logTail w j) +
          (logTail w j - 3 * D * p.scale j)| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |Real.exp (logTail w j) - 1 - logTail w j| +
        |logTail w j - 3 * D * p.scale j| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ logTail w j ^ 2 + (D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale j ^ 2 :=
      add_le_add hexp (logTail_linear_error p hstart hD hC herror j)
    _ ≤ ((4 * D + (5 / 2) * C) ^ 2 + D + (5 / 2) * C) * p.scale j ^ 2 := by
      linarith

Helper for lem:polar-geometry: exponentiating the source logarithmic expansion
gives the radius expansion, with a constant independent of the starting index.

    {w : ℕ → ℝ} {D C : ℝ} (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hC : 0 ≤ C)

    {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {C : ℝ} (hD : ∀ i, 0 < D i) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (herror : ∀ j (i : Fin 2),
      |p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1 - D i * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤ C * p.scale j ^ 5)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, C * p.scale 0 ≤ D i / 2) : FactorBounds p D C := by

      (ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart j) hC hsmallj (herror j i)
  exact ⟨hD, hC, herror, fun j i ↦ (hbounds j i).1, fun j i ↦ (hbounds j i).2⟩

    1 < cycleFactor p j := by

    simpa only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero] using h.factor_gt_one hstart j 0
  have hO : 1 < p.radiusRatio (2 * j + 1) := h.factor_gt_one hstart j 1

items.leanCode:
theorem FactorBounds.cycleLog_error {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (h : FactorBounds p D C) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex) (j : ℕ) :
    |Real.log (cycleFactor p j) - (D 0 + D 1) * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤
      cycleLogConstant D C * p.scale j ^ 5 := by
  have hE : 1 < p.radiusRatio (2 * j) := by
    simpa only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero] using h.factor_gt_one hstart j 0
  have hO : 1 < p.radiusRatio (2 * j + 1) := h.factor_gt_one hstart j 1
  have herrorE : |p.radiusRatio (2 * j) - 1 - D 0 * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤
      C * p.scale j ^ 5 := by
    simpa only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero] using h.expansion j 0
  have hlogE := logFactor_error (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j)
    (ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart j) h.error_nonneg hE.le herrorE
  have hlogO := logFactor_error (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j)
    (ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart j) h.error_nonneg hO.le (h.expansion j 1)
  rw [cycleFactor_def, Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hE))
    (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hO)), cycleLogConstant_def]
  calc
    |Real.log (p.radiusRatio (2 * j)) + Real.log (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + 1)) -
        (D 0 + D 1) * p.scale j ^ 4| =
        |(Real.log (p.radiusRatio (2 * j)) - D 0 * p.scale j ^ 4) +
          (Real.log (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + 1)) - D 1 * p.scale j ^ 4)| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |Real.log (p.radiusRatio (2 * j)) - D 0 * p.scale j ^ 4| +
        |Real.log (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + 1)) - D 1 * p.scale j ^ 4| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (2 * C + (D 0 + C) ^ 2 + (D 1 + C) ^ 2) * p.scale j ^ 5 := by
      linarith

Helper for eq:polar-radii: the source paired factors have quartic logarithmic
coefficient `D₀ + D₁` and a uniform fifth-order remainder.

theorem FactorBounds.radius_phase_drop_bounds {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (h : FactorBounds p D C) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hsmall : radiusLogScaleConstant D C * p.scale 0 ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) (i : Fin 2) :
    D i / 2 * p.scale j ^ 4 ≤
        p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) ∧
      p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) ≤
        Real.exp 1 * (D i + C) * p.scale j ^ 4 := by
  have hdefect : 0 ≤ p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1 :=
    sub_nonneg.mpr (h.factor_gt_one hstart j i).le
  have hrLower : 1 ≤ p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) :=
    (h.radius_gt_one hstart _).le
  have hrUpper := h.radius_le_exp_one hstart hsmall (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1)
  rw [h.radius_drop_eq hstart]
  constructor
  · calc
      D i / 2 * p.scale j ^ 4 ≤ p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1 := h.lower j i
      _ ≤ p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) *
          (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1) := le_mul_of_one_le_left hdefect hrLower
  · calc
      p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) * (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1) ≤
          Real.exp 1 * (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrUpper hdefect
      _ ≤ Real.exp 1 * ((D i + C) * p.scale j ^ 4) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h.upper j i) (Real.exp_pos 1).le
      _ = Real.exp 1 * (D i + C) * p.scale j ^ 4 := by ring

size in either original phase, uniformly in the starting index.

items.leanCode:
theorem FactorBounds.radius_error {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (h : FactorBounds p D C) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hsmall : radiusLogScaleConstant D C * p.scale 0 ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    |p.radius k - 1 - 3 * (D 0 + D 1) * p.scale (k / 2)| ≤
      radiusExpansionConstant D C * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 := by
  have hD := h.coefficient_pos 0
  have hC := h.error_nonneg
  have hextra : 0 ≤ Real.exp 1 * (D 0 + C) := by positivity
  have htwo : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by norm_num
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd' k with ⟨j, rfl | rfl⟩
  · simp only [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ zero_lt_two, Parameters.radius_even]
    have hbound := h.evenRadius_error hstart hsmall j
    rw [radiusExpansionConstant_def]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hextra (sq_nonneg (p.scale j))]
  · have hquot : (2 * j + 1) / 2 = j := by omega
    rw [hquot, Parameters.radius_odd]
    have hbound := h.evenRadius_error hstart hsmall j
    have hdiff := h.evenRadius_sub_oddRadius_bounds hstart hsmall j
    have hpowers : p.scale j ^ 4 ≤ p.scale j ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j)
        (ScaleTails.scale_le_one p hstart j) htwo
    calc
      |p.oddRadius j - 1 - 3 * (D 0 + D 1) * p.scale j| =
          |(p.evenRadius j - 1 - 3 * (D 0 + D 1) * p.scale j) -
            (p.evenRadius j - p.oddRadius j)| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |p.evenRadius j - 1 - 3 * (D 0 + D 1) * p.scale j| +
          |p.evenRadius j - p.oddRadius j| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ (radiusLogScaleConstant D C ^ 2 + D 0 + D 1 +
          (5 / 2) * cycleLogConstant D C) * p.scale j ^ 2 +
            Real.exp 1 * (D 0 + C) * p.scale j ^ 4 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hdiff.1]
        exact add_le_add hbound hdiff.2
      _ ≤ radiusExpansionConstant D C * p.scale j ^ 2 := by
        rw [radiusExpansionConstant_def]
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowers hextra
        nlinarith

coefficient and one common uniform second-order error constant.

theorem FactorBounds.radius_drop_bounds {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (h : FactorBounds p D C) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hsmall : radiusLogScaleConstant D C * p.scale 0 ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    (min (D 0) (D 1) / 2) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 ≤ p.radius k - p.radius (k + 1) ∧
      p.radius k - p.radius (k + 1) ≤
        (Real.exp 1 * (max (D 0) (D 1) + C)) * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 := by
  have hphase : k % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt k zero_lt_two
  let i : Fin 2 := ⟨k % 2, hphase⟩

    dsimp only [i]
    omega
  have hstage := h.radius_phase_drop_bounds hstart hsmall (k / 2) i
  rw [hindex] at hstage
  have hcoeff := phaseCoefficient_bounds D i
  have hpower := pow_nonneg (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p (k / 2)) 4

  · exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hcoeff.1 zero_le_two) hpower).trans hstage.1
  · exact hstage.2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hcoeff.2 le_rfl) (Real.exp_pos 1).le) hpower)

theorem FactorBounds.radius_phase_drop_error {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (h : FactorBounds p D C) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hsmall : radiusLogScaleConstant D C * p.scale 0 ≤ 1) (j : ℕ) (i : Fin 2) :
    |p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) -
        D i * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤
      (C + 2 * radiusLogScaleConstant D C * (D i + C)) * p.scale j ^ 5 := by
  have hindex : 2 * j ≤ 2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1 := by omega
  have hnext : p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) ≤ p.evenRadius j := by
    simpa only [Parameters.radius_even] using (h.radius_strictAnti hstart).antitone hindex
  have hnextSmall : p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) - 1 ≤
      2 * radiusLogScaleConstant D C * p.scale j :=
    (sub_le_sub_right hnext 1).trans (h.evenRadius_sub_one_le hstart hsmall j)
  have hnextNonneg : 0 ≤ p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) - 1 :=
    sub_nonneg.mpr (h.radius_gt_one hstart _).le
  have hdefect : 0 ≤ p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1 :=
    sub_nonneg.mpr (h.factor_gt_one hstart j i).le
  have hC := h.error_nonneg
  have ht := ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j
  have hprod := mul_le_mul hnextSmall (h.upper j i) hdefect
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two (radiusLogScaleConstant_pos h.coefficient_pos hC).le) ht)
  rw [h.radius_drop_eq hstart]
  calc
    |p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) * (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1) -
        D i * p.scale j ^ 4| =
        |(p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) - 1) *
          (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1) +
            (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1 - D i * p.scale j ^ 4)| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |(p.radius (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) - 1) *
          (p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1)| +
        |p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1 - D i * p.scale j ^ 4| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (2 * radiusLogScaleConstant D C * p.scale j) *
        ((D i + C) * p.scale j ^ 4) + C * p.scale j ^ 5 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hnextNonneg hdefect)]
      exact add_le_add hprod (h.expansion j i)
    _ = (C + 2 * radiusLogScaleConstant D C * (D i + C)) * p.scale j ^ 5 := by ring

theorem sum_decrement_error {r u v : ℕ → ℝ} {D C : ℝ}
    (herror : ∀ j, |r j - r (j + 1) - D * u j| ≤ C * v j)
    {A B : ℕ} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    |r A - r B - D * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico A B, u j| ≤
      C * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico A B, v j := by
  have htel : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico A B, (r j - r (j + 1))) = r A - r B := by
    have h := Finset.sum_Ico_sub r hAB
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at h ⊢
    linarith
  calc
    |r A - r B - D * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico A B, u j| =
        |∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico A B, (r j - r (j + 1) - D * u j)| := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, htel]
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico A B, |r j - r (j + 1) - D * u j| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico A B, C * v j :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ herror j)
    _ = C * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico A B, v j := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm

Helper for lem:polar-geometry: summing a controlled decrement over a finite interval
gives the endpoint difference with the summed error.

theorem actualFactorBounds :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ C > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧
        ∀ j₀ ≥ J, let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
          FactorBounds p (RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar) C ∧
            radiusLogScaleConstant (RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar) C * p.scale 0 ≤
              1 := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hactual⟩ := RadiusExpansions.actualSlopeAndRadiusEstimates
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, C, hC, J₀, hJ₀, hphase⟩ := hactual νStar hnear
  let D := RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar
  have hD : ∀ i, 0 < D i := RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient_pos νStar hparameter
  let d := min (D 0) (D 1)
  have hd : 0 < d := lt_min (hD 0) (hD 1)
  have hdle : ∀ i : Fin 2, d ≤ D i := fun i ↦ (phaseCoefficient_bounds D i).1
  let H := radiusLogScaleConstant D C
  have hH : 0 < H := radiusLogScaleConstant_pos hD hC.le
  have hcutoff : 0 < min (d / (2 * C)) (1 / H) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨J₁, _, hscale⟩ := Continuation.existsStartThreshold _ hcutoff
  refine ⟨hparameter, C, hC, max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hj₀old : J₀ ≤ j₀ := (le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀
  have hj₀scale : J₁ ≤ j₀ := (le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀
  have hstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJ₀.trans_le hj₀old
  have hzero : p.scale 0 < min (d / (2 * C)) (1 / H) := hscale νStar j₀ hj₀scale
  have hzeroC : p.scale 0 < d / (2 * C) := hzero.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hzeroH : p.scale 0 < 1 / H := hzero.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have htwoC : 0 < 2 * C := by positivity
  have hsmallC : ∀ i, C * p.scale 0 ≤ D i / 2 := by
    intro i
    nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ htwoC).mp hzeroC, hdle i]
  have hsmallH : H * p.scale 0 ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ hH).mp hzeroH]
  have herror : ∀ j (i : Fin 2),
      |p.radiusRatio (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1 - D i * p.scale j ^ 4| ≤
        C * p.scale j ^ 5 := by
    intro j i
    exact (hphase j₀ hj₀old j i).2.2
  exact ⟨factorBounds_of_expansion p hstart hD hC.le herror hsmallC, hsmallH⟩

Helper for eq:polar-radii: the accepted actual W expansion discharges the scalar
phase interface uniformly for every larger starting index. The two smallness thresholds
are chosen only after the source coefficients and common W error constant.

items.leanCode:
theorem polarRadiusProducts :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ K > 0, ∃ c > 0, ∃ B > 0,
        ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
          RadiusEstimates (Parameters.of j₀ νStar)

theorem quinticFullTurn_le (p : Parameters) (hpositive : 0 < p.startIndex) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hstart : p.startIndex ≤ N ^ 3) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex),
      p.scale j ^ 5) ≤ 4 * (N : ℝ) ^ (-3 : ℤ) := by
  have hNreal : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hNge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hq : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := (inv_pos.mpr hNreal).le
  have hqone : (N : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hNge
  have hexponents : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by norm_num
  have hqfour : ((N : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 4 ≤ ((N : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq hqone hexponents
  have hden : (N : ℝ) * N ≤ (N : ℝ) * (N + 1) := by nlinarith
  have hprincipal : 3 / ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1)) ≤ 3 * ((N : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      3 / ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1)) ≤ 3 / ((N : ℝ) * N) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left zero_le_three (mul_pos hNreal hNreal) hden
      _ = 3 * ((N : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, pow_two]
  have hquartic := (abs_le.mp (ScaleTails.quarticFullTurn_abs_error p N hN hstart)).2
  simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_ofNat, ← inv_pow] at hquartic
  have hfour : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex)
      ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex), p.scale j ^ 4) ≤ 4 * ((N : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    linarith
  have hpointwise : ∀ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex)
      ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex), p.scale j ^ 5 ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * p.scale j ^ 4 := by
    intro j hj
    have hscale : p.scale j ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← scale_cubic p N hstart]
      exact ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hpositive (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj).1
    calc
      p.scale j ^ 5 = p.scale j * p.scale j ^ 4 := by ring
      _ ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * p.scale j ^ 4 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscale (pow_nonneg (ScaleTails.scale_nonneg p j) 4)
  calc
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex),
        p.scale j ^ 5) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex),
          (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * p.scale j ^ 4 := Finset.sum_le_sum hpointwise
    _ = (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex)
        ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex), p.scale j ^ 4 := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ)⁻¹ * (4 * ((N : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfour hq
    _ = 4 * (N : ℝ) ^ (-3 : ℤ) := by
      simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_ofNat, ← inv_pow]
      ring

theorem FactorBounds.fullTurn_error {p : Parameters} {D : Fin 2 → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (h : FactorBounds p D C) (hpositive : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hsmall : radiusLogScaleConstant D C * p.scale 0 ≤ 1)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hstart : p.startIndex ≤ N ^ 3) :
    |p.evenRadius (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) -
        p.evenRadius ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex) -
          3 * (D 0 + D 1) / ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1))| ≤
      (D 0 + D 1 + 4 * cycleDropConstant D C) * (N : ℝ) ^ (-3 : ℤ) := by
  have hAB : N ^ 3 - p.startIndex ≤ (N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex :=
    Nat.sub_le_sub_right (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_succ N) 3) p.startIndex
  have hsegment := sum_decrement_error (h.evenRadius_drop_error hpositive hsmall) hAB
  have hscalar := ScaleTails.quarticFullTurn_abs_error p N hN hstart
  have hDsum : 0 ≤ D 0 + D 1 := add_nonneg (h.coefficient_pos 0).le (h.coefficient_pos 1).le
  have hdropC := cycleDropConstant_nonneg h.coefficient_pos h.error_nonneg
  have hquintic := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (quinticFullTurn_le p hpositive N hN hstart) hdropC
  have hNge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hexponents : (3 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by norm_num
  have hpowers : (N : ℝ) ^ (-4 : ℤ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ (-3 : ℤ) := by
    simp only [zpow_neg]
    exact inv_pow_le_inv_pow_of_le hNge hexponents
  have hscalarMul : |(D 0 + D 1) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex)
      ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex), p.scale j ^ 4) -
        3 / ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1)))| ≤ (D 0 + D 1) * (N : ℝ) ^ (-4 : ℤ) := by
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hDsum]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hscalar hDsum
  calc
    |p.evenRadius (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) -
        p.evenRadius ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex) -
          3 * (D 0 + D 1) / ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1))| =
        |(p.evenRadius (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) -
          p.evenRadius ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex) - (D 0 + D 1) *
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex),
              p.scale j ^ 4) + (D 0 + D 1) *
                ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex)
                  ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex), p.scale j ^ 4) -
                    3 / ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1)))| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |p.evenRadius (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) -
          p.evenRadius ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex) - (D 0 + D 1) *
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex) ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex),
              p.scale j ^ 4| +
        |(D 0 + D 1) * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex)
          ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex), p.scale j ^ 4) -
            3 / ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1)))| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ cycleDropConstant D C * (∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (N ^ 3 - p.startIndex)
          ((N + 1) ^ 3 - p.startIndex), p.scale j ^ 5) +
        (D 0 + D 1) * (N : ℝ) ^ (-4 : ℤ) := add_le_add hsegment hscalarMul
    _ ≤ (D 0 + D 1 + 4 * cycleDropConstant D C) * (N : ℝ) ^ (-3 : ℤ) := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpowers hDsum
      nlinarith

theorem polarRadiusFullTurn :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ K > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → j₀ ≤ N ^ 3 →
        let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
        |p.evenRadius (N ^ 3 - j₀) - p.evenRadius ((N + 1) ^ 3 - j₀) -
            3 * (RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar 0 +
              RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar 1) / ((N : ℝ) * (N + 1))| ≤
          K * (N : ℝ) ^ (-3 : ℤ) := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hbounds⟩ := actualFactorBounds
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, C, hC, J, hJ, hactual⟩ := hbounds νStar hnear
  let D := RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient νStar
  have hD : ∀ i, 0 < D i := RadiusExpansions.radiusCoefficient_pos νStar hparameter
  have hdrop := cycleDropConstant_nonneg hD hC.le
  have hK : 0 < D 0 + D 1 + 4 * cycleDropConstant D C := by
    have hE := hD 0
    have hO := hD 1
    positivity
  refine ⟨D 0 + D 1 + 4 * cycleDropConstant D C, hK, J, hJ, ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀ N hN hstart
  have hpositive : 0 < (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).startIndex := by
    simpa only [Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJ.trans_le hj₀
  have hstart' : (Parameters.of j₀ νStar).startIndex ≤ N ^ 3 := by
    simpa only [Parameters.of_startIndex] using hstart
  simpa only [Parameters.of_startIndex] using
    (hactual j₀ hj₀).1.fullTurn_error hpositive (hactual j₀ hj₀).2 N hN hstart'

    ∀ᶠ p : ℝ × ℝ in 𝓝 (baseAngle, kZero),

      (baseAngle, kZero) := by

      inverseParameter_deriv_continuousAt_kZero continuousAt_snd

  have hK : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ cycleK p.1) (baseAngle, kZero) :=

      (inverseParameter_contDiffAt_kZero.differentiableAt hnonzeroOrder) hkpos.ne',
      hasDerivAt_restoringDrift_kZero.deriv]

theorem exists_uniformRestoringNeighborhood :
    ∃ rate > (1 / 3 : ℝ), ∃ δ > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + δ),
      νStar ∈ parameterSet ∧ ∃ r > 0,
        ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r),
          ContDiffAt ℝ ω inverseParameter A ∧ A ∈ normalizationSet ∧
            0 < A ∧ deriv (restoringDrift νStar) A ≤ -rate := by
  obtain ⟨U, V, hUopen, hUa, hVopen, hVk, hUV⟩ :=
    mem_nhds_prod_iff'.mp restoringDrift_deriv_eventually
  have hKV : ∀ᶠ ν in 𝓝 baseAngle, cycleK ν ∈ V := by
    have hV : V ∈ 𝓝 (cycleK baseAngle) := by
      rw [← kZero_def]
      exact hVopen.mem_nhds hVk
    exact cycleK_analyticAt_baseAngle.continuousAt.eventually hV
  have hparameters : U ∩ parameterSet ∩ cycleK ⁻¹' V ∈ 𝓝 baseAngle :=
    inter_mem (inter_mem (hUopen.mem_nhds hUa) parameterSet_mem_nhds) hKV
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hparameters
  refine ⟨1, ?_, δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  · norm_num
  · intro νStar hνStar
    have hnear : νStar ∈ Metric.ball baseAngle δ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hνStar.1)]
      linarith [hνStar.2]
    have hν := hball hnear
    refine ⟨hν.1.2, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hVopen.mem_nhds hν.2)
    refine ⟨ε / 2, half_pos hε, ?_⟩
    intro A hA
    have hAV : A ∈ V := by
      apply hεball
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
      constructor
      · linarith [hA.1]
      · linarith [hA.2]
    exact hUV (a := (νStar, A)) ⟨hν.1.1, hAV⟩

theorem feedback_cubic_remainder (L κ : ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ feedback L κ t x₀ - (1 - L * (κ / x₀.1) ^ 2 * t ^ 3))
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 6) := by
  have hcubic : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ -L * (κ / x₀.1) ^ 2 * t ^ 3)
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ -L * (κ / x₀.1) ^ 2 * t ^ 3) 0 := by
      fun_prop
    simpa using hc.tendsto
  have hexp := (Real.exp_sub_sum_range_isBigO_pow 2).comp_tendsto hcubic
  have hpower := ((Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0)).const_mul_left
    (-L * (κ / x₀.1) ^ 2)).pow 2
  have horder : (fun t : ℝ ↦ (-L * (κ / x₀.1) ^ 2 * t ^ 3) ^ 2)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 6) := by
    simpa only [← pow_mul, Nat.reduceMul] using hpower
  have hsum (t : ℝ) :
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 2, (-L * (κ / x₀.1) ^ 2 * t ^ 3) ^ j / Nat.factorial j =
        1 - L * (κ / x₀.1) ^ 2 * t ^ 3 := by
    norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    ring
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, hsum, feedback_def] using hexp.trans horder

Helper for eq:polar-slow-drift: the actual cubic feedback has an order-six
error after its constant and cubic terms.

theorem stepW_first_cubic (i : Fin 2) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (ζ η : ℝ → ℝ) (h : ℝ) (hζ : ContinuousAt ζ 0)
    (hchange : (fun t : ℝ ↦ η t - ζ t - h * t ^ 3)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4)) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ stepW i t x (ζ t) (η t) 0 - (h / limitAngle i) * t ^ 3)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) := by
  have hcot : (fun t : ℝ ↦ cotFactor i t - 1 / limitAngle i)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t) := by
    simpa only [cotFactor_at_zero, sub_zero] using
      (cotFactor_analyticAt i).differentiableAt.isBigO_sub
  have hcotBound := (cotFactor_analyticAt i).continuousAt.isBigO_one ℝ
  have hfirst : (fun t : ℝ ↦ (η t - ζ t - h * t ^ 3) * cotFactor i t)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using hchange.mul hcotBound
  have hsecond : (fun t : ℝ ↦ h * (t ^ 3 * (cotFactor i t - 1 / limitAngle i)))
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) := by
    have hpowers (t : ℝ) : t ^ 3 * t = t ^ 4 := by ring
    exact (((Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0)).mul
      hcot).const_mul_left h).congr_right hpowers
  have hthird : (fun t : ℝ ↦ slope x * (ζ t * t ^ 4))
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      ((hζ.isBigO_one ℝ).mul
        (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) (𝓝 0))).const_mul_left (slope x)
  have heq (t : ℝ) :
      (η t - ζ t - h * t ^ 3) * cotFactor i t +
          h * (t ^ 3 * (cotFactor i t - 1 / limitAngle i)) -
          slope x * (ζ t * t ^ 4) =
        stepW i t x (ζ t) (η t) 0 - (h / limitAngle i) * t ^ 3 := by
    rw [stepW_def]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
    ring
  simpa only [heq] using (hfirst.add hsecond).sub hthird

theorem unitRoot_cube (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < 1 + t ^ 3) :
    unitRoot t ^ 3 = 1 + t ^ 3 := by
  rw [unitRoot_def, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
  calc
    Real.exp (3 * (Real.log (1 + t ^ 3) / 3)) =
        Real.exp (Real.log (1 + t ^ 3)) := by
      congr 1
      ring

theorem rescale_firstDiagonalFactor_sub_cubic (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < 1 + t ^ 3) :
    rescaleFactor t ^ 2 - (1 - (4 / 3 : ℝ) * t ^ 3) =
      t ^ 6 *
        ((4 * unitRoot t ^ 5 + 8 * unitRoot t ^ 4 + 12 * unitRoot t ^ 3 +
          9 * unitRoot t ^ 2 + 6 * unitRoot t + 3) /
          (3 * unitRoot t ^ 4 * (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) ^ 2)) := by
  have hrootPositive : 0 < unitRoot t := by
    rw [unitRoot_def]
    exact Real.exp_pos _
  have hdenom : unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1 ≠ 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (unitRoot t)]
  have hcubic : t ^ 3 = (unitRoot t - 1) *
      (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) := by
    calc
      t ^ 3 = unitRoot t ^ 3 - 1 := by
        rw [unitRoot_cube t ht]
        ring
      _ = (unitRoot t - 1) * (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) := by ring
  have hsix : t ^ 6 = (t ^ 3) ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [rescaleFactor_def, hsix, hcubic]
  field_simp [hrootPositive.ne', hdenom]
  ring

items.label: Normalized.rescale_firstDiagonalFactor_cubic

theorem rescale_firstDiagonalFactor_cubic :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ rescaleFactor t ^ 2 - (1 - (4 / 3 : ℝ) * t ^ 3))
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 6) := by
  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦
    (4 * unitRoot t ^ 5 + 8 * unitRoot t ^ 4 + 12 * unitRoot t ^ 3 +
      9 * unitRoot t ^ 2 + 6 * unitRoot t + 3) /
      (3 * unitRoot t ^ 4 * (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) ^ 2)
  have hroot := unitRoot_analyticAt_zero.continuousAt
  have hq : ContinuousAt q 0 := by
    dsimp only [q]
    fun_prop (disch := norm_num [unitRoot_def])
  have hbound := (Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 6) (𝓝 0)).mul
    (hq.isBigO_one ℝ)
  have hpositive : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0, 0 < 1 + t ^ 3 := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ 1 + t ^ 3) 0 := by fun_prop
    have hzero : 0 < (1 : ℝ) + 0 ^ 3 := by norm_num
    exact hc.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hzero)
  have hfactor : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 6 * q t) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ rescaleFactor t ^ 2 - (1 - (4 / 3 : ℝ) * t ^ 3)) := by
    filter_upwards [hpositive] with t ht
    exact (rescale_firstDiagonalFactor_sub_cubic t ht).symm
  have hbound' : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 6 * q t) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 6) := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using hbound
  exact hbound'.congr' hfactor Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl

theorem preRotation_first_cubic_along (X : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (hX : AnalyticAt ℝ X 0) (hC : (X 0).2.1 ≠ 0)
    (w : ℝ → Fin 2 → ℝ) (σ : ℝ → ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (hσ : AnalyticAt ℝ σ 0) (hσone : σ 0 = 1)
    (hw : (fun t : ℝ ↦ w t 0 - b * t ^ 3) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4)) :
    (fun t : ℝ ↦ preRotation (X t) (w t) (σ t) 0 0 -
      ((X t).1 + 2 * b * ((X 0).1 * slope (X 0) - (X 0).2.1) * t ^ 3))
        =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) := by
  let D : ℝ → ℝ := fun t ↦ (X t).1 * slope (X t) - (X t).2.1
  have hA : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun t ↦ (X t).1) 0 :=
    AnalyticAt.comp analyticAt_fst hX
  have hCV : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun t ↦ (X t).2) 0 :=
    AnalyticAt.comp analyticAt_snd hX
  have hCpath : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun t ↦ (X t).2.1) 0 :=
    AnalyticAt.comp analyticAt_fst hCV
  have hQ := slope_along_analyticAt X hX hC
  have hD : AnalyticAt ℝ D 0 := by
    dsimp only [D]
    fun_prop
  have hσne : σ 0 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hσone]
    exact one_ne_zero
  have hinv : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun t ↦ (σ t)⁻¹) 0 := hσ.fun_inv hσne
  have hinvDefect : (fun t : ℝ ↦ (σ t)⁻¹ - 1)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t) := by
    simpa only [hσone, inv_one, sub_zero] using hinv.differentiableAt.isBigO_sub
  have hfirst : (fun t : ℝ ↦ (w t 0 - b * t ^ 3) * (σ t)⁻¹)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using hw.mul (hinv.continuousAt.isBigO_one ℝ)
  have hpowers (t : ℝ) : t ^ 3 * t = t ^ 4 := by ring
  have hsecond : (fun t : ℝ ↦ b * (t ^ 3 * ((σ t)⁻¹ - 1)))
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) :=
    (((Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0)).mul
      hinvDefect).const_mul_left b).congr_right hpowers
  have hquotient : (fun t : ℝ ↦ w t 0 / σ t - b * t ^ 3)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) := by
    apply (hfirst.add hsecond).congr_left
    intro t
    ring
  have hlinear : (fun t : ℝ ↦ 2 * D t * (w t 0 / σ t - b * t ^ 3))
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      ((hD.continuousAt.isBigO_one ℝ).const_mul_left 2).mul hquotient
  have hDdefect : (fun t : ℝ ↦ D t - D 0) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hD.differentiableAt.isBigO_sub
  have hvariation : (fun t : ℝ ↦ 2 * b * (t ^ 3 * (D t - D 0)))
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) :=
    (((Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0)).mul
      hDdefect).const_mul_left (2 * b)).congr_right hpowers
  have hwthree : (fun t : ℝ ↦ w t 0) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) := by
    have hfourThree : (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) :=
      (Asymptotics.isLittleO_pow_pow (Nat.lt_succ_self 3)).isBigO
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using (hw.trans hfourThree).add
      ((Asymptotics.isBigO_refl (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3) (𝓝 0)).const_mul_left b)
  have hcofactor : ContinuousAt
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ (σ t + slope (X t) * D t) / σ t ^ 2) 0 := by
    have hσcontinuous := hσ.continuousAt
    have hQcontinuous := hQ.continuousAt
    have hDcontinuous := hD.continuousAt
    have hnonzero := pow_ne_zero 2 hσne
    fun_prop (disch := assumption)
  have hsquare : (fun t : ℝ ↦
      (σ t + slope (X t) * D t) / σ t ^ 2 * w t 0 ^ 2)
      =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 4) := by
    have hlt : (4 : ℕ) < 6 := by norm_num
    have hpower : (fun t : ℝ ↦ w t 0 ^ 2) =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 6) := by
      simpa only [← pow_mul, Nat.reduceMul] using hwthree.pow 2

        (σ t + slope (X t) * D t) / σ t ^ 2 * w t 0 ^ 2)
        =O[𝓝 0] (fun t : ℝ ↦ t ^ 6) := by
      simpa only [one_mul] using (hcofactor.isBigO_one ℝ).mul hpower
    exact hsix.trans (Asymptotics.isLittleO_pow_pow hlt).isBigO
  have heq :
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ 2 * D t * (w t 0 / σ t - b * t ^ 3) +
        2 * b * (t ^ 3 * (D t - D 0)) +
        (σ t + slope (X t) * D t) / σ t ^ 2 * w t 0 ^ 2)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
      (fun t : ℝ ↦ preRotation (X t) (w t) (σ t) 0 0 -
        ((X t).1 + 2 * b * ((X 0).1 * slope (X 0) - (X 0).2.1) * t ^ 3)) := by
    filter_upwards [hσ.continuousAt.eventually_ne hσne,
      hCpath.continuousAt.eventually_ne hC] with t htσ htC
    rw [preRotation_firstDiagonal (X t) (w t) (σ t) htC htσ]
    dsimp only [D]
    ring
  exact ((hlinear.add hvariation).add hsquare).congr' heq Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl
