items.label: SequenceAsymptotics.freeCoefficient_stepProduct_bounds
items.leanCode:
theorem freeCoefficient_stepProduct_bounds (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hK : 0 < p.kStar) {lower upper : ℝ} (hlower : 0 < lower) (hupper : 0 < upper)
    (hsteps : ∀ k, lower * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2 ≤ ‖step p k‖ ∧
      ‖step p k‖ ≤ upper * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 2)
    (hfree : freeCoefficient p ~[atTop] (fun k ↦ p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 / p.kStar)) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      (1 / (8 * upper ^ 2 * p.kStar)) * (‖step p (k - 1)‖ * ‖step p k‖) ≤ freeCoefficient p k ∧
      freeCoefficient p k ≤ (2 / (lower ^ 2 * p.kStar)) *
        (‖step p (k - 1)‖ * ‖step p k‖) := by
  have hpositive (k : ℕ) : 0 < p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 / p.kStar :=
    div_pos (pow_pos (ScaleTails.scale_pos p hstart _) 4) hK
  have hbounds := eventual_factor_bounds_of_equivalent hpositive hfree
  have ha : 0 ≤ 1 / (8 * upper ^ 2 * p.kStar) := by positivity
  have hb : 0 ≤ 2 / (lower ^ 2 * p.kStar) := by positivity
  filter_upwards [hbounds, eventually_ge_atTop 1] with k hk hkOne
  have hproduct := stepProduct_bounds p hstart hlower hupper hsteps k hkOne
  constructor
  · calc
      (1 / (8 * upper ^ 2 * p.kStar)) * (‖step p (k - 1)‖ * ‖step p k‖) ≤
          (1 / (8 * upper ^ 2 * p.kStar)) * (4 * upper ^ 2 * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hproduct.2 ha
      _ = (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 / p.kStar) / 2 := by
        field_simp [hK.ne', hupper.ne']
        ring
      _ ≤ freeCoefficient p k := hk.1
  · calc
      freeCoefficient p k ≤ 2 * (p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4 / p.kStar) := hk.2
      _ = (2 / (lower ^ 2 * p.kStar)) * (lower ^ 2 * p.scale (k / 2) ^ 4) := by
        field_simp [hK.ne', hlower.ne']
      _ ≤ (2 / (lower ^ 2 * p.kStar)) * (‖step p (k - 1)‖ * ‖step p k‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hproduct.1 hb

items.label: SequenceAsymptotics.polarFreeCoefficientStepOrder
items.leanCode:
theorem polarFreeCoefficientStepOrder :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      ∃ a > 0, ∃ b > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ j₀ ≥ J,
        let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
        ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
          a * (‖step p (k - 1)‖ * ‖step p k‖) ≤ freeCoefficient p k ∧
          freeCoefficient p k ≤ b * (‖step p (k - 1)‖ * ‖step p k‖) := by
  obtain ⟨ηx, hηx, hscalars⟩ := polarScalarAsymptotics
  obtain ⟨ηs, hηs, hsteps⟩ := polarStepLengthDivergence
  refine ⟨min ηx ηs, lt_min hηx hηs, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  have hnearX : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + ηx) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left _ _))⟩
  have hnearS : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + ηs) :=
    ⟨hnear.1, hnear.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_right _ _))⟩
  obtain ⟨hparameter, Jx, hJx, hscalarAll⟩ := hscalars νStar hnearX
  obtain ⟨lower, hlower, upper, hupper, Js, _, hstepAll⟩ := hsteps νStar hnearS
  have hK : 0 < cycleK νStar := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_Ioi] using (TwoCycle.cycleFamily_mapsTo_positive hparameter).1
  have ha : 0 < 1 / (8 * upper ^ 2 * cycleK νStar) := by positivity
  have hb : 0 < 2 / (lower ^ 2 * cycleK νStar) := by positivity
  refine ⟨1 / (8 * upper ^ 2 * cycleK νStar), ha, 2 / (lower ^ 2 * cycleK νStar), hb,
    max Jx Js, hJx.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀
  dsimp only
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hjX : Jx ≤ j₀ := (le_max_left _ _).trans hj₀
  have hjS : Js ≤ j₀ := (le_max_right _ _).trans hj₀
  have hstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using hJx.trans_le hjX
  have hpK : p.kStar = cycleK νStar := by
    rw [Parameters.kStar_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  have hKp : 0 < p.kStar := by
    rw [hpK]
    exact hK
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hfree, _, _, _, _⟩ := hscalarAll j₀ hjX
  have h := freeCoefficient_stepProduct_bounds p hstart hKp hlower hupper
    (hstepAll j₀ hjS).1 hfree
  simpa only [hpK] using h

Helper for sec:known-results and the source degeneration order after
lem:planar-degeneration: on the actual original polar family, `λ_k` has the

theorem compactFourthDerivativeBound (f : ℝ × E → ℝ) (𝒦 : Set E)
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦) (hf : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, ContDiffAt ℝ 4 f (0, x)) :
    ∃ B > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, ∀ t : ℝ, ‖t‖ < δ →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 4 f (t, x) ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 4 f (t, x)‖ ≤ B := by
  have hbase : ContinuousOn (fun x ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ 4 f (0, x)) 𝒦 := by
    intro x hx
    have hcontinuous := (hf x hx).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv le_rfl
    have hinput : ContinuousAt (fun y : E ↦ ((0 : ℝ), y)) x :=
      continuousAt_const.prodMk continuousAt_id
    exact (hcontinuous.comp_of_eq hinput rfl).continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := h𝒦.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hbase
  have hB : 0 < |B₀| + 1 := by positivity
  have hfinite : (4 : ℕ∞ω) ≠ ∞ := by simp
  have hlocal : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, ∀ᶠ p : ℝ × E in 𝓝 (0, x),
      ContDiffAt ℝ 4 f p ∧ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 4 f p‖ ≤ |B₀| + 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have hbound : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 4 f (0, x)‖ < |B₀| + 1 := by
      linarith [hB₀ x hx, le_abs_self B₀]
    have hnorm := ((hf x hx).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv le_rfl).norm
    filter_upwards [(hf x hx).eventually hfinite,
      hnorm.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hbound)] with p hp hpnorm
    exact ⟨hp, hpnorm.le⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := FiniteTaylorJet.compactFiberNormRadius (X := ℝ)
    (P := fun t x ↦ ContDiffAt ℝ 4 f (t, x) ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 4 f (t, x)‖ ≤ |B₀| + 1) h𝒦 hlocal
  exact ⟨|B₀| + 1, hB, δ, hδ, hbound⟩

theorem norm_stateIteratedDerivative_le (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ × E → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : E)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hbound : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) f (t, x)‖ ≤ B) :
    ‖(fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f) (t, x)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E)‖ ≤ B := by

  intro v
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply]
  calc
    ‖(fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f) (t, x)) (0, v)‖ ≤
        ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f) (t, x)‖ * ‖((0, v) : ℝ × E)‖ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _

      rw [norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv, Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero,
        max_eq_right (norm_nonneg v)]

theorem thirdJointDerivative_state_lipschitz (f : ℝ × E → ℝ) (𝒦 : Set E)
    (h𝒦 : Convex ℝ 𝒦) (t B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, ContDiffAt ℝ 4 f (t, x))
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 4 f (t, x)‖ ≤ B)
    (x y : E) (hx : x ∈ 𝒦) (hy : y ∈ 𝒦) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f (t, y) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f (t, x)‖ ≤ B * ‖y - x‖ := by
  have hd : ∀ z ∈ 𝒦,
      HasFDerivWithinAt (fun w ↦ iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f (t, w))
        ((fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f) (t, z)).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E)) 𝒦 z := by
    intro z hz
    exact (stateIteratedDerivative_hasFDerivAt 3 f t z (hf z hz)).hasFDerivWithinAt
  have hnorm : ∀ z ∈ 𝒦,
      ‖(fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 f) (t, z)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E)‖ ≤ B := by
    intro z hz
    exact norm_stateIteratedDerivative_le 3 f t z B hB (hbound z hz)
  exact h𝒦.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le hd hnorm hx hy

theorem norm_iteratedDeriv_scaleDifference_le (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ × E → ℝ)
    (t s B : ℝ) (x y : E)
    (hx : ContDiffAt ℝ n f (s * t, x)) (hy : ContDiffAt ℝ n f (s * t, y))
    (hbound : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s * t, y) -
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s * t, x)‖ ≤ B) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv n (fun v : ℝ ↦ f (v * t, y) - f (v * t, x)) s‖ ≤ B * ‖t‖ ^ n := by
  have hinputx : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun v : ℝ ↦ (v * t, x)) s := by fun_prop
  have hinputy : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun v : ℝ ↦ (v * t, y)) s := by fun_prop
  have hpathx : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun v : ℝ ↦ f (v * t, x)) s := hx.comp s hinputx
  have hpathy : ContDiffAt ℝ n (fun v : ℝ ↦ f (v * t, y)) s := hy.comp s hinputy
  have hx' : ContDiffAt ℝ n f (((0 : ℝ), x) + s • ((t, 0) : ℝ × E)) := by
    simpa only [Prod.smul_mk, smul_zero, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk,
      zero_add, add_zero] using hx
  have hy' : ContDiffAt ℝ n f (((0 : ℝ), y) + s • ((t, 0) : ℝ × E)) := by
    simpa only [Prod.smul_mk, smul_zero, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk,
      zero_add, add_zero] using hy
  have hdx := FiniteTaylorJet.iteratedDeriv_comp_add_smul
    (x := ((0 : ℝ), x)) (h := ((t, 0) : ℝ × E)) (t := s) hx'
  have hdy := FiniteTaylorJet.iteratedDeriv_comp_add_smul
    (x := ((0 : ℝ), y)) (h := ((t, 0) : ℝ × E)) (t := s) hy'
  simp only [Prod.smul_mk, smul_zero, smul_eq_mul, Prod.mk_add_mk,
    zero_add, add_zero] at hdx hdy
  rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub hpathy hpathx, hdy, hdx, ← sub_apply]
  calc
    ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s * t, y) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s * t, x))
        (fun _ ↦ (t, 0))‖ ≤
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s * t, y) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f (s * t, x)‖ *
        ∏ _ : Fin n, ‖((t, 0) : ℝ × E)‖ := ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
    _ ≤ B * ∏ _ : Fin n, ‖((t, 0) : ℝ × E)‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ norm_nonneg _)
    _ = B * ‖t‖ ^ n := by
      simp only [Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero, max_eq_left (norm_nonneg t),
        Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin]

items.leanCode:
theorem uniformCubicStateDifference (f : ℝ × E → ℝ) (𝒦 : Set E)
    (hcompact : IsCompact 𝒦) (hconvex : Convex ℝ 𝒦)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, ContDiffAt ℝ 4 f (0, x))
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, ∀ n : Fin 3, (n : ℕ) ≠ 0 →
      iteratedDeriv (n : ℕ) (fun t : ℝ ↦ f (t, x)) 0 = 0) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ 𝒦, ∀ y ∈ 𝒦, ∀ t : ℝ, ‖t‖ < δ →
      ‖(f (t, y) - f (0, y)) - (f (t, x) - f (0, x))‖ ≤
        C * ‖t‖ ^ 3 * ‖y - x‖ := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := compactFourthDerivativeBound f 𝒦 hcompact hf
  refine ⟨B, hB, δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy t ht
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s ↦ f (s * t, y) - f (s * t, x)
  have hdegree : (3 : ℕ∞ω) ≤ 4 := by norm_num
  have hscale : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖s * t‖ < δ := by
    intro s hs
    have hsNorm : ‖s‖ = s := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
    rw [norm_mul, hsNorm]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg t) hs.2).trans_lt ht
  have hpath : ∀ z ∈ 𝒦, ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 3 (fun v : ℝ ↦ f (v * t, z)) s := by
    intro z hz s hs
    have hreg := ((hbound z hz (s * t) (hscale s hs)).1).of_le hdegree
    have hinput : ContDiffAt ℝ 3 (fun v : ℝ ↦ (v * t, z)) s := by fun_prop
    exact hreg.comp s hinput
  have hg : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ 3 g s := by
    intro s hs
    exact (hpath y hy s hs).sub (hpath x hx s hs)
  have hzeroInterval : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
  have hslice : ∀ z ∈ 𝒦, ContDiffAt ℝ 3 (fun v : ℝ ↦ f (v, z)) 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hinput : ContDiffAt ℝ 3 (fun v : ℝ ↦ (v, z)) 0 := by fun_prop
    exact ((hf z hz).of_le hdegree).comp 0 hinput
  have hzeroG : ∀ n : Fin 3, (n : ℕ) ≠ 0 → iteratedDeriv (n : ℕ) g 0 = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    have hnNat : (n : ℕ) ≤ 3 := by omega
    have hnDegree : ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ 3 := by exact_mod_cast hnNat
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_fun_sub ((hpath y hy 0 hzeroInterval).of_le hnDegree)
      ((hpath x hx 0 hzeroInterval).of_le hnDegree)]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_rescale_zero (n : ℕ) (fun v ↦ f (v, y)) t
      ((hslice y hy).of_le hnDegree),
      iteratedDeriv_rescale_zero (n : ℕ) (fun v ↦ f (v, x)) t
      ((hslice x hx).of_le hnDegree), hzero y hy n hn, hzero x hx n hn]
    ring
  have hthird : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedDeriv 3 g s‖ ≤ B * ‖y - x‖ * ‖t‖ ^ 3 := by
    intro s hs
    have hreg : ∀ z ∈ 𝒦, ContDiffAt ℝ 4 f (s * t, z) := by
      intro z hz
      exact (hbound z hz (s * t) (hscale s hs)).1
    have htop : ∀ z ∈ 𝒦, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 4 f (s * t, z)‖ ≤ B := by
      intro z hz
      exact (hbound z hz (s * t) (hscale s hs)).2
    have hvariation := thirdJointDerivative_state_lipschitz f 𝒦 hconvex
      (s * t) B hB.le hreg htop x y hx hy
    exact norm_iteratedDeriv_scaleDifference_le 3 f t s (B * ‖y - x‖) x y
      ((hreg x hx).of_le hdegree) ((hreg y hy).of_le hdegree) hvariation
  have hgOn : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro s hs
    exact (hg s hs).contDiffWithinAt
  have hthirdWithin : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖iteratedDerivWithin 3 g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) s‖ ≤
        B * ‖y - x‖ * ‖t‖ ^ 3 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv (uniqueDiffOn_Icc zero_lt_one) (hg s hs) hs]
    exact hthird s hs
  have htaylor := taylor_mean_remainder_bound (f := g) (n := 2)
    (a := 0) (b := 1) (x := 1) zero_le_one hgOn
    (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one) hthirdWithin
  have hTaylorValue : taylorWithinEval g 2 (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) 0 1 = g 0 := by
    rw [taylor_within_apply]
    have hterms : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range 3, k ≠ 0 →
        iteratedDerivWithin k g (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) 0 = 0 := by
      intro k hk hkzero
      have hklt : k < 3 := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      have hkDegree : (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ 3 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt hklt
      rw [iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv (uniqueDiffOn_Icc zero_lt_one)
        ((hg 0 hzeroInterval).of_le hkDegree) hzeroInterval]
      exact hzeroG ⟨k, hklt⟩ hkzero
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
    · simp only [pow_zero, sub_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, inv_one,
        one_mul, one_smul, iteratedDerivWithin_zero]
    · intro k hk hkzero
      rw [hterms k hk hkzero]
      exact smul_zero _
    · intro hnot
      have hmem : (0 : ℕ) ∈ Finset.range 3 := by norm_num
      exact (hnot hmem).elim
  rw [hTaylorValue] at htaylor
  have hnonnegative : 0 ≤ B * ‖y - x‖ * ‖t‖ ^ 3 := by positivity
  have hTaylorBound : ‖g 1 - g 0‖ ≤ B * ‖t‖ ^ 3 * ‖y - x‖ := by
    norm_num only [sub_zero, one_pow, mul_one, Nat.factorial_succ,
      Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.reduceMul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at htaylor
    nlinarith
  have hidentity :
      g 1 - g 0 = (f (t, y) - f (0, y)) - (f (t, x) - f (0, x)) := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [one_mul, zero_mul]
    ring
  rwa [hidentity] at hTaylorBound

theorem norm_perturbedState_sub_evenState_le (A : ℝ) (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    ‖FastRemainder.perturbedState A u - TwoCycle.evenState A‖ ≤
      (‖FastContraction.matrixOperator FastContraction.basisMatrix‖ + 1) *

    simp only [Prod.norm_mk, norm_zero]

  rw [perturbedState_sub_evenState]

items.label: SlowCoupling.existsFixedSourceNeighborhood
items.leanCode:
theorem existsFixedSourceNeighborhood :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ d > 0, ∃ R > 0,
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference R,
        0 < x.1 ∧ 0 < x.2.1 ∧
          0 < (Normalized.leadingStage (Normalized.limitAngle 0) x).2.1) ∧
      ∀ A : ℝ, |A - TwoCycle.kZero| < d →
        A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
        TwoCycle.evenState A ∈ Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference R ∧
        ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, FastContraction.fixedNorm u < r →
          FastRemainder.perturbedState A u ∈ Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference R := by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hregular⟩ := FastRemainder.exists_regular_closedBall
  have hcompact : Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference R ∈
      𝓝 (FastRemainder.perturbedState TwoCycle.kZero 0) := by
    rw [FastRemainder.perturbedState_zero, TwoCycle.evenState_kZero]
    exact Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds _ hR
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hinput⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
    (FastRemainder.continuousAt_perturbedState.eventually hcompact)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hnormalization⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp TwoCycle.normalizationSet_mem_nhds
  let B := ‖FastContraction.matrixOperator FastContraction.basisMatrix‖ + 1
  have hB : 0 < B := by
    dsimp only [B]
    positivity
  have hr : 0 < η / (2 * B) := div_pos hη (mul_pos zero_lt_two hB)
  refine ⟨η / (2 * B), hr, min (η / 2) a, lt_min (half_pos hη) ha, R, hR, hregular, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  have hslow : |A - TwoCycle.kZero| < η :=
    (hA.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)).trans (half_lt_self hη)
  have hnormal : A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet := by
    apply hnormalization
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
    exact hA.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hperturbed : ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, FastContraction.fixedNorm u < η / (2 * B) →
      FastRemainder.perturbedState A u ∈ Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference R := by
    intro u hu
    have hfast : ‖u‖ < η := by
      calc
        ‖u‖ ≤ B * FastContraction.fixedNorm u :=
          norm_le_positiveBasisBound u
        _ < B * (η / (2 * B)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu hB
        _ = η / 2 := by field_simp [hB.ne']
        _ < η := half_lt_self hη
    have hnear : dist (A, u) (TwoCycle.kZero, (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) < η := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, dist_zero_right]
      exact max_lt hslow hfast
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (hinput hnear)
  have hzero : FastContraction.fixedNorm (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) = 0 :=
    (FastContraction.fixedNorm_eq_zero 0).mpr rfl
  have heven := hperturbed 0
  rw [hzero] at heven
  refine ⟨hnormal, ?_, hperturbed⟩
  simpa only [FastRemainder.perturbedState_zero] using heven hr
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): one regular
compact state ball and source slow/fast radii can be fixed before the feedback
parameters `L` and `κ`.
items.title: SlowCoupling.existsFixedSourceNeighborhood

items.label: SlowCoupling.uniformSlowCouplingFixedNeighborhood
items.leanCode:
theorem uniformSlowCouplingFixedNeighborhood :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ d > 0, ∀ L κ : ℝ, ∃ Ccross > 0, ∃ δ > 0,
      ∀ A : ℝ, |A - TwoCycle.kZero| < d →
        A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧
        ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, FastContraction.fixedNorm u < r →
          ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ →
            |(Normalized.map L κ t (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u)).1 -
              (Normalized.map L κ t (TwoCycle.evenState A)).1| ≤
                Ccross * |t| ^ 3 * FastContraction.fixedNorm u := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, d, hd, R, hR, hregular, hsource⟩ := existsFixedSourceNeighborhood
  let B := ‖FastContraction.matrixOperator FastContraction.basisMatrix‖ + 1
  have hB : 0 < B := by
    dsimp only [B]
    positivity
  refine ⟨r, hr, d, hd, ?_⟩
  intro L κ
  obtain ⟨C, hC, δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := map_slowIncrement_uniformCubicStateDifference L κ
    (Metric.closedBall TwoCycle.evenReference R) (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    (convex_closedBall _ _)
    (fun x hx ↦ (hregular x hx).1) (fun x hx ↦ (hregular x hx).2.1)
    (fun x hx ↦ (hregular x hx).2.2)
  refine ⟨C * B, mul_pos hC hB, δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  have hstates := hsource A hA
  refine ⟨hstates.1, ?_⟩
  intro u hu t ht
  have hraw := hbound (TwoCycle.evenState A) hstates.2.1
    (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u) (hstates.2.2 u hu) t ht
  have hidentity :
      ((Normalized.map L κ t (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u)).1 -
        (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u).1) -
      ((Normalized.map L κ t (TwoCycle.evenState A)).1 - (TwoCycle.evenState A).1) =
      (Normalized.map L κ t (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u)).1 -
        (Normalized.map L κ t (TwoCycle.evenState A)).1 := by
    rw [perturbedState_fst, TwoCycle.evenState_firstDiagonal]
    ring
  rw [hidentity] at hraw
  calc
    |(Normalized.map L κ t (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u)).1 -
        (Normalized.map L κ t (TwoCycle.evenState A)).1| ≤
      C * |t| ^ 3 * ‖FastRemainder.perturbedState A u - TwoCycle.evenState A‖ := hraw
    _ ≤ C * |t| ^ 3 * (B * FastContraction.fixedNorm u) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_perturbedState_sub_evenState_le A u)
        (mul_nonneg hC.le (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg t) 3))
    _ = (C * B) * |t| ^ 3 * FastContraction.fixedNorm u := by ring
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation (eq:polar-fast-bound): select fixed
source slow and fast radii before arbitrary feedback parameters. The actual
slow map then satisfies the required uniform cubic off-curve estimate.
items.title: SlowCoupling.uniformSlowCouplingFixedNeighborhood

items.label: SlowCoupling.polarSlowBound
items.leanCode:
theorem polarSlowBound :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ rate > (1 / 3 : ℝ), ∃ η > 0,
      ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
        νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧
        ∃ s > 0, ∃ Ccross > 0, ∃ Cslow > 0, ∃ ε > 0,
          TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar (cycleK νStar) = 0 ∧
          ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - s) (cycleK νStar + s),
            ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter A ∧
              A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet ∧ 0 < A ∧
              deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A ≤ -rate ∧
              ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, FastContraction.fixedNorm u < r →
                ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < ε →
                  |(Normalized.map (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar) t
                    (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u)).1 -
                      (A + t ^ 3 * TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar A)| ≤
                        Ccross * t ^ 3 * FastContraction.fixedNorm u + Cslow * t ^ 4 := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, d, hd, hcoupling⟩ := uniformSlowCouplingFixedNeighborhood
  obtain ⟨rate, hrate, δG, hδG, hrestoring⟩ := TwoCycle.restoringSlowDrift
  have htendsto : Tendsto cycleK (𝓝 baseAngle) (𝓝 TwoCycle.kZero) := by
    simpa only [ContinuousAt, TwoCycle.kZero_def] using
      TwoCycle.hasDerivAt_cycleK_baseAngle.continuousAt
  have hcenterEventually : ∀ᶠ ν : ℝ in 𝓝 baseAngle,
      |cycleK ν - TwoCycle.kZero| < d / 2 := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] using
      htendsto.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds TwoCycle.kZero (half_pos hd))
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hcenter⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hcenterEventually
  refine ⟨r, hr, rate, hrate, min η δG, lt_min hη hδG, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hνStar
  have hνSource : νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + δG) := by
    refine ⟨hνStar.1, ?_⟩
    exact hνStar.2.trans_le (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_right η δG))
  have hνNear : dist νStar baseAngle < η := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hνStar.1)]
    have hupper := hνStar.2
    linarith [min_le_left η δG]
  have hKnear : |cycleK νStar - TwoCycle.kZero| < d / 2 := hcenter hνNear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, rG, hrG, Cslow, hCslow, δSlow, hδSlow, heq, hbranch⟩ :=
    hrestoring νStar hνSource
  obtain ⟨Ccross, hCcross, δCross, hδCross, hcross⟩ :=
    hcoupling (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar)
  let s := min rG (d / 4)
  have hs : 0 < s := lt_min hrG (div_pos hd zero_lt_four)
  refine ⟨hparameter, s, hs, Ccross, hCcross, Cslow, hCslow,
    min δCross δSlow, lt_min hδCross hδSlow, heq, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  have hsG : s ≤ rG := min_le_left _ _
  have hsD : s ≤ d / 4 := min_le_right _ _
  have hAG : A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - rG) (cycleK νStar + rG) := by
    constructor
    · linarith [hA.1]
    · linarith [hA.2]
  have hAcenter : |A - cycleK νStar| ≤ s := by
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor
    · linarith [hA.1]
    · linarith [hA.2]
  have hAnear : |A - TwoCycle.kZero| < d := by
    have htriangle := abs_sub_le A (cycleK νStar) TwoCycle.kZero
    linarith
  have hproperties := hbranch A hAG
  refine ⟨hproperties.1, hproperties.2.1, hproperties.2.2.1,
    hproperties.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro u hu t ht htε
  have htCross : |t| < δCross := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
    exact htε.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have htSlow : |t| < δSlow := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
    exact htε.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hcrossBound := (hcross A hAnear).2 u hu t htCross
  have hslowBound := hproperties.2.2.2.2 t htSlow
  rw [abs_of_nonneg ht] at hcrossBound hslowBound
  have htriangle := abs_sub_le
    (Normalized.map (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar) t
      (FastRemainder.perturbedState A u)).1
    (Normalized.map (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar) t
      (TwoCycle.evenState A)).1
    (A + t ^ 3 * TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar A)
  exact htriangle.trans (add_le_add hcrossBound hslowBound)
items.statement:
eq:polar-fast-bound (lem:polar-continuation): the actual normalized map
has slow error bounded by `Ccross * t ^ 3 * fixedNorm u + Cslow * t ^ 4`
on a fixed neighborhood of the source cycle normalization. The fast radius
and parameter neighborhood precede the feedback selection, and all constants
precede the initial cycle index.

  rw [stateMatrix_def, RealSymmetric2.matrix_eq, Matrix.det_fin_two]

items.label: StageFeasibility.stateMatrix_posDef

theorem stateMatrix_posDef (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (hA : 0 < x.1)
    (hdet : 0 < x.1 * x.2.2 - x.2.1 ^ 2) : (stateMatrix x).PosDef := by
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
  · exact RealSymmetric2.matrix_isHermitian _ _ _
  · intro u hu
    have hform : star u ⬝ᵥ (stateMatrix x *ᵥ u) =
        x.1 * (u 0 + x.2.1 / x.1 * u 1) ^ 2 +
          (x.1 * x.2.2 - x.2.1 ^ 2) / x.1 * (u 1) ^ 2 := by
      simp only [stateMatrix_def, RealSymmetric2.matrix_eq, Matrix.mulVec,
        dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
        Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
      field_simp [hA.ne']
      ring
    rw [hform]
    by_cases hu1 : u 1 = 0
    · have hu0 : u 0 ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        apply hu
        ext i
        fin_cases i
        · exact hzero
        · exact hu1
      simpa [hu1] using mul_pos hA (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hu0)
    · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (mul_nonneg hA.le (sq_nonneg _))
        (mul_pos (div_pos hdet hA) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero hu1))

    (hτ : ContinuousAt τ z) (hX : ContinuousAt X z)
    (hζ : ContinuousAt ζ z) (hη : ContinuousAt η z) (hτ0 : τ z = 0)
    (hC : (X z).2.1 ≠ 0) (hσ : stageSigma i (τ z) (X z) (ζ z) (η z) ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt (fun y ↦ stageMatrix i (τ y) (X y) (ζ y) (η y)) z := by
  have hSlope := slopeAlong_continuousAt hX hC
  have hAngle := (stageAngle_analyticAt i).continuousAt.comp_of_eq hτ hτ0
  have hSin := (sinFactor_analyticAt i).continuousAt.comp_of_eq hτ hτ0
  have hCot := (cotFactor_analyticAt i).continuousAt.comp_of_eq hτ hτ0
  have hv : ContinuousAt (fun y ↦ stepV (X y)) z := by
    apply continuousAt_pi.mpr
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · simp only [stepV_def, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      exact hSlope.neg
    · simp only [stepV_def, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
      exact continuousAt_const
  have hw : ContinuousAt (fun y ↦ stepW i (τ y) (X y) (ζ y) (η y)) z := by
    apply continuousAt_pi.mpr
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · simp only [stepW_def, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      fun_prop
    · simpa only [stepW_def, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val_fin_one] using hη
  have hR : ContinuousAt (fun y ↦ rotation i (τ y)) z := by
    apply continuousAt_pi.mpr
    intro r
    apply continuousAt_pi.mpr
    intro c
    fin_cases r
    all_goals fin_cases c
    all_goals simp only [rotation_def, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one,
      Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
    all_goals fun_prop
  have hSecant := stageSigmaAlong_continuousAt i hτ hSlope hζ hη hτ0
  have hSecantInv : ContinuousAt
      (fun y ↦ (stageSigma i (τ y) (X y) (ζ y) (η y))⁻¹) z := by
    fun_prop (disch := assumption)
  have hM := continuous_stateMatrix.continuousAt.comp_of_eq hX rfl
  have houter : Continuous (fun d : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) ↦
      Matrix.vecMulVec d.1 d.2) := continuous_fst.matrix_vecMulVec continuous_snd
  have hwv := houter.continuousAt.comp_of_eq (hw.prodMk hv) rfl
  have hvw := houter.continuousAt.comp_of_eq (hv.prodMk hw) rfl
  have hww := houter.continuousAt.comp_of_eq (hw.prodMk hw) rfl
  have htranspose : Continuous

  have hRT := htranspose.continuousAt.comp_of_eq hR rfl

          stateMatrix (X y) *
            (1 - (stageSigma i (τ y) (X y) (ζ y) (η y))⁻¹ •

            Matrix.vecMulVec (stepW i (τ y) (X y) (ζ y) (η y))

    fun_prop

items.label: StageFeasibility.eventually_regularState

theorem eventually_regularState {E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E]
    {X : E → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ} {z : E} (hX : ContinuousAt X z) (hx : regularState (X z)) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, regularState (X y) := by
  have hA : ContinuousAt (fun y ↦ (X y).1) z := continuousAt_fst.comp_of_eq hX rfl
  have hCV : ContinuousAt (fun y ↦ (X y).2) z := continuousAt_snd.comp_of_eq hX rfl
  have hC : ContinuousAt (fun y ↦ (X y).2.1) z := continuousAt_fst.comp_of_eq hCV rfl
  have hV : ContinuousAt (fun y ↦ (X y).2.2) z := continuousAt_snd.comp_of_eq hCV rfl
  have hdet : ContinuousAt (fun y ↦ (X y).1 * (X y).2.2 - (X y).2.1 ^ 2) z := by
    fun_prop
  filter_upwards [hA.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hx.1),
    hC.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hx.2.1), hdet.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hx.2.2)] with
    y hyA hyC hydet
  exact ⟨hyA, hyC, hydet⟩

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: strict scalar regularity is preserved
on a neighborhood along every continuous normalized state germ.

items.label: StageFeasibility.eventually_regularCycle
items.leanCode:
theorem eventually_regularCycle (L κ A : ℝ) (hA : A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet) :
    ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) in 𝓝 (0, TwoCycle.evenState A),
      regularState z.2 ∧ regularState (cycleStage L κ 0 z.1 z.2 z.2) ∧
        regularState (twoStep L κ z.1 z.2) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 2, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ cycleSecant L κ i z.1 z.2) ∧
            ∀ i : Fin 2, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
              normalizedRadiusFactor i z.1 (cycleInput L κ i z.1 z.2) := by
  have hE := regularState_evenState A hA
  have hO := regularState_oddState A hA
  have hCNext : (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) (TwoCycle.evenState A)).2.1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [limitAngle_zero, TwoCycle.evenToOdd A hA]
    exact hO.2.1.ne'
  have hfirst := firstStage_continuousAt L κ (TwoCycle.evenState A) hE.1.ne' hE.2.1.ne'
  have htwo := twoStep_continuousAt L κ (TwoCycle.evenState A)
    hE.1.ne' hE.2.1.ne' hCNext
  have hfirstRegular : regularState
      (cycleStage L κ 0 0 (TwoCycle.evenState A) (TwoCycle.evenState A)) := by
    rw [firstStage_zero_evenState L κ A hA]
    exact hO
  have htwoRegular : regularState (twoStep L κ 0 (TwoCycle.evenState A)) := by
    rw [twoStep_zero_evenState L κ A hA]
    exact hE
  have hsecants : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) in 𝓝 (0, TwoCycle.evenState A),
      ∀ i : Fin 2, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ cycleSecant L κ i z.1 z.2 := by
    apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
    intro i
    have hlim : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < cycleSecant L κ i 0 (TwoCycle.evenState A) := by
      rw [cycleSecant_at_zero]
      norm_num
    exact ((cycleSecant_continuousAt L κ i (TwoCycle.evenState A)
      hE.1.ne' hE.2.1.ne' hCNext).eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hlim)).mono fun _ hz ↦ hz.le
  have hradii : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) in 𝓝 (0, TwoCycle.evenState A),
      ∀ i : Fin 2, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
        normalizedRadiusFactor i z.1 (cycleInput L κ i z.1 z.2) := by
    apply Filter.eventually_all.mpr
    intro i
    have hlim : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < normalizedRadiusFactor i 0
        (cycleInput L κ i 0 (TwoCycle.evenState A)) := by
      rw [normalizedRadiusFactor_zero]
      norm_num
    exact ((cycleRadius_continuousAt L κ i (TwoCycle.evenState A)
      hE.1.ne' hE.2.1.ne' hCNext).eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hlim)).mono fun _ hz ↦ hz.le
  filter_upwards [eventually_regularState
    (continuousAt_snd : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.2)
      (0, TwoCycle.evenState A)) hE,
    eventually_regularState hfirst hfirstRegular, eventually_regularState htwo htwoRegular,
    hsecants, hradii] with z hx hy hz hsec hradius
  exact ⟨hx, hy, hz, hsec, hradius⟩
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: near a genuine even cycle all three
actual states are regular and both secant and radius factors have the fixed
positive lower bound `1/2`.
items.title: StageFeasibility.eventually_regularCycle

items.label: StageFeasibility.exists_uniform_regularCycle
items.leanCode:
theorem exists_uniform_regularCycle (L κ A : ℝ) (hA : A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-δ) δ,
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState A) r,
        regularState x ∧ regularState (cycleStage L κ 0 t x x) ∧
          regularState (twoStep L κ t x) ∧
            (∀ i : Fin 2, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ cycleSecant L κ i t x) ∧
              ∀ i : Fin 2, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
                normalizedRadiusFactor i t (cycleInput L κ i t x) := by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hbound⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (eventually_regularCycle L κ A hA)
  refine ⟨ε / 2, half_pos hε, ε / 2, half_pos hε, ?_⟩
  intro t ht x hx
  have htAbs : |t| ≤ ε / 2 := abs_le.mpr ht
  have hxDist := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hx
  apply hbound (y := (t, x))
  rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
  constructor
  · simpa only [dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs] using
      htAbs.trans_lt (half_lt_self hε)
  · exact hxDist.trans_lt (half_lt_self hε)
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: one fixed compact even-state ball and
one scale threshold give actual two-stage regularity, with positive secants
and radius factors uniformly bounded below independently of `j₀`.
items.title: StageFeasibility.exists_uniform_regularCycle

theorem stateMatrix_stage (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (ζ η : ℝ) :
    stateMatrix (stage i t x ζ η) = stageMatrix i t x ζ η := by
  have hsymm : stageMatrix i t x ζ η 1 0 = stageMatrix i t x ζ η 0 1 := by
    simpa only [star_trivial] using (stageMatrix_isHermitian i t x ζ η).apply 0 1
  rw [stateMatrix_def, stage_apply, RealSymmetric2.matrix_eq]
  ext r c
  fin_cases r
  · fin_cases c
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · fin_cases c
    · exact hsymm.symm
    · rfl

items.leanCode:
theorem regularState_rescale (t : ℝ) (x : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) (hx : regularState x) :
    regularState (rescale t x) := by
  have hρ : 0 < rescaleFactor t := by
    rw [rescaleFactor_def, unitRoot_def]
    positivity
  rw [regularState_def, rescale_apply]
  refine ⟨mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hρ) hx.1, mul_pos hρ hx.2.1, ?_⟩
  calc
    0 < rescaleFactor t ^ 2 * (x.1 * x.2.2 - x.2.1 ^ 2) :=
      mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hρ) hx.2.2
    _ = (rescaleFactor t ^ 2 * x.1) * x.2.2 - (rescaleFactor t * x.2.1) ^ 2 := by
      ring

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the exact boundary change of scale
preserves positive determinants and positive off-diagonal entries.

items.label: StageFeasibility.exists_uniform_stageFeasibility
items.leanCode:
theorem exists_uniform_stageFeasibility (L κ A : ℝ) (hA : A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∃ d > 0, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-δ) δ,
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState A) r,
        (stateMatrix x).PosDef ∧ 0 < x.2.1 ∧
          (stageMatrix 0 t x 1 (feedback L κ t x)).PosDef ∧
            0 < (cycleStage L κ 0 t x x).2.1 ∧
              (stageMatrix 1 t (cycleStage L κ 0 t x x) (feedback L κ t x) 1).PosDef ∧
                0 < (twoStep L κ t x).2.1 ∧
                  (stateMatrix (Normalized.map L κ t x)).PosDef ∧
                    0 < (Normalized.map L κ t x).2.1 ∧
                      (∀ i : Fin 2, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ cycleSecant L κ i t x) ∧
                        (∀ i : Fin 2, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
                          normalizedRadiusFactor i t (cycleInput L κ i t x)) ∧
                            ∀ i : Fin 9, d ≤ |denominators L κ t x i| := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, δ₀, hδ₀, hregular⟩ := exists_uniform_regularCycle L κ A hA
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-δ₀) δ₀ := ⟨neg_nonpos.mpr hδ₀.le, hδ₀.le⟩
  have hfirst : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState A) r,
      0 < x.1 := fun x hx ↦ (hregular 0 hzero x hx).1.1
  have hoff : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState A) r,
      0 < x.2.1 := fun x hx ↦ (hregular 0 hzero x hx).1.2.1
  have hnext : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState A) r,
      0 < (leadingStage (limitAngle 0) x).2.1 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := (hregular 0 hzero x hx).2.1.2.1
    simpa only [cycleStage_zero] using h
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, d, hd, hdenom⟩ := denominators_uniformOn L κ
    (Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState A) r) (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    hfirst hoff hnext
  refine ⟨r, hr, min δ₀ ε, lt_min hδ₀ hε, d, hd, ?_⟩
  intro t ht x hx
  have htAbs : |t| ≤ min δ₀ ε := abs_le.mpr (Set.mem_Icc.mp ht)
  have ht₀ : t ∈ Set.Icc (-δ₀) δ₀ := by
    exact Set.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le.mp (htAbs.trans (min_le_left _ _)))
  have htε : t ∈ Set.Icc (-ε) ε := by
    exact Set.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le.mp (htAbs.trans (min_le_right _ _)))
  have hgood := hregular t ht₀ x hx
  have hxPD := (regularState_posDef x hgood.1).1
  have hfirstPD := (regularState_posDef _ hgood.2.1).1
  rw [cycleStage_even_apply, stateMatrix_stage] at hfirstPD
  have hsecondPD := (regularState_posDef _ hgood.2.2.1).1
  rw [twoStep_def, cycleStage_odd_apply, stateMatrix_stage] at hsecondPD
  have hmap : regularState (Normalized.map L κ t x) := by
    rw [Normalized.map_def]
    exact regularState_rescale t _ hgood.2.2.1
  exact ⟨hxPD, hgood.1.2.1, hfirstPD, hgood.2.1.2.1,
    hsecondPD, hgood.2.2.1.2.1, (regularState_posDef _ hmap).1, hmap.2.1,
    hgood.2.2.2.1, hgood.2.2.2.2, hdenom t htε x hx⟩

items.label: StageFeasibility.exists_uniform_rawCycleFeasibility
items.leanCode:
theorem exists_uniform_rawCycleFeasibility (L κ A : ℝ)
    (hA : A ∈ TwoCycle.normalizationSet) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∃ d > 0, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) δ,
      ∀ Z : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, Z.IsHermitian →
        coordinates t Z ∈ Metric.closedBall (TwoCycle.evenState A) r →
          Z.PosDef ∧ 0 < Z 0 1 ∧
            (rawFirstStage L κ t Z).PosDef ∧ 0 < rawFirstStage L κ t Z 0 1 ∧
              (rawSecondStage L κ t Z).PosDef ∧ 0 < rawSecondStage L κ t Z 0 1 ∧
                (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ sigmaOf Z (stageAngle 0 t) 1
                  (feedback L κ t (coordinates t Z)) ∧
                  (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ sigmaOf (rawFirstStage L κ t Z) (stageAngle 1 t)
                    (feedback L κ t (coordinates t Z)) 1 ∧
                    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ radiusRatioOf Z (stageAngle 0 t) ∧
                      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ radiusRatioOf (rawFirstStage L κ t Z) (stageAngle 1 t) ∧
                        ∀ i : Fin 9, d ≤ |denominators L κ t (coordinates t Z) i| := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, δ, hδ, d, hd, hfeasible⟩ := exists_uniform_stageFeasibility L κ A hA
  refine ⟨r, hr, δ, hδ, d, hd, ?_⟩
  intro t ht Z hZ hx
  have htBoth : t ∈ Set.Icc (-δ) δ := by
    constructor
    · linarith [ht.1]
    · exact ht.2
  rcases hfeasible t htBoth (coordinates t Z) hx with
    ⟨hxPD, hxC, hfirstPD, hfirstC, hsecondPD, hsecondC, _, _, hsec, hrad, hden⟩
  have hfirstCoordinates := cycleInput_one_coordinates L κ t Z hZ ht.1
  rw [cycleInput_one] at hfirstCoordinates
  have htwoCoordinates := twoStep_coordinates L κ t Z hZ ht.1
  have hZFirst := rawFirstStage_isHermitian L κ t Z hZ
  rw [hfirstCoordinates] at hfirstC hsecondPD
  rw [htwoCoordinates] at hsecondC
  have hrawFirstPD : (rawFirstStage L κ t Z).PosDef := by
    rw [rawFirstStage_def]
    exact (stageMatrix_posDef_iff 0 t Z 1 (feedback L κ t (coordinates t Z)) hZ ht.1).mp hfirstPD
  have hrawSecondPD : (rawSecondStage L κ t Z).PosDef := by
    rw [rawSecondStage_def]
    exact (stageMatrix_posDef_iff 1 t (rawFirstStage L κ t Z)
      (feedback L κ t (coordinates t Z)) 1 hZFirst ht.1).mp hsecondPD
  have hsecEven := hsec 0
  have hsecOdd := hsec 1
  have hradEven := hrad 0
  have hradOdd := hrad 1
  rw [cycleSecant_zero_eq_sigmaOf L κ t Z ht.1] at hsecEven
  rw [cycleSecant_one_eq_sigmaOf L κ t Z hZ ht.1] at hsecOdd
  rw [cycleRadius_zero_eq_radiusRatioOf L κ t Z ht.1] at hradEven
  rw [cycleRadius_one_eq_radiusRatioOf L κ t Z hZ ht.1] at hradOdd
  exact ⟨(normalized_posDef_iff t Z hZ ht.1).mp hxPD,
    (normalized_offDiagonal_pos_iff t Z ht.1).mp hxC, hrawFirstPD,
    (normalized_offDiagonal_pos_iff t _ ht.1).mp hfirstC, hrawSecondPD,
    (normalized_offDiagonal_pos_iff t _ ht.1).mp hsecondC,
    hsecEven, hsecOdd, hradEven, hradOdd, hden⟩
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: one fixed normalized neighborhood
makes the actual first and second physical updates positive definite, with
positive off-diagonal entries, positive secant scalars, and positive radius
ratios uniformly bounded below, independently of `j₀`.
items.title: StageFeasibility.exists_uniform_rawCycleFeasibility

theorem one_le_unitRoot (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : 1 ≤ unitRoot t := by
  have hbase : 0 < 1 + t ^ 3 := by positivity
  have hcube := unitRoot_cube t hbase
  have hroot := unitRoot_pos t
  by_contra h
  have hlt : unitRoot t < 1 := lt_of_not_ge h
  have hfactor : 0 < (1 - unitRoot t) * (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) := by
    positivity
  have hidentity :
      (1 - unitRoot t) * (unitRoot t ^ 2 + unitRoot t + 1) = 1 - unitRoot t ^ 3 := by
    ring
  rw [hidentity] at hfactor
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg ht 3]
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the cubic root is at least one at
nonnegative scales.

    t - t ^ 4 / 3 ≤ nextScale t := by
  have hbase : 0 < 1 + t ^ 3 := by positivity
  have hcubic : t ^ 3 = unitRoot t ^ 3 - 1 := by
    rw [unitRoot_cube t hbase]
    ring
  have hfour : t ^ 4 = t * t ^ 3 := by ring
  have hidentity :
      t - (t - t ^ 4 / 3) * unitRoot t =

    rw [hfour, hcubic]
    ring
  have hnonnegative :

    have hroot := unitRoot_pos t
    positivity
  rw [nextScale_def]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (unitRoot_pos t)).mpr

theorem hasDerivAt_scalarStep (G : ℝ → ℝ) (K t b : ℝ)
    (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ G (K + b)) :
    HasDerivAt (scalarStep G K t) (1 + t ^ 3 * deriv G (K + b)) b := by
  have hshift : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ ↦ K + x) 1 b :=
    (hasDerivAt_id b).const_add K
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_id b).add ((hG.hasDerivAt.comp b hshift).const_mul (t ^ 3))
  have hfun :
      (id + fun y : ℝ ↦ t ^ 3 * (G ∘ HAdd.hAdd K) y) = scalarStep G K t := by
    funext x
    exact (scalarStep_apply G K t x).symm
  rw [hfun] at hd
  simpa only [mul_one] using hd

`1 + t ^ 3 * deriv G (K + b)`.

items.label: TubeBounds.scalarStep_control
items.leanCode:
theorem scalarStep_control (G : ℝ → ℝ) (K r rate D t : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hsmall : D * t ^ 3 ≤ 1) (heq : G K = 0)
    (hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (K - r) (K + r), DifferentiableAt ℝ G x)
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (K - r) (K + r),
      -D ≤ deriv G x ∧ deriv G x ≤ -rate) :
    MonotoneOn (scalarStep G K t) (Set.Icc (-r) r) ∧
      0 ≤ 1 - rate * t ^ 3 ∧
      ∀ b ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r,
        |scalarStep G K t b| ≤ (1 - rate * t ^ 3) * |b| := by
  have htranslate : ∀ b ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r, K + b ∈ Set.Icc (K - r) (K + r) := by
    intro b hb
    constructor
    · linarith [hb.1]
    · linarith [hb.2]
  have hd : ∀ b ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r,
      HasDerivAt (scalarStep G K t) (1 + t ^ 3 * deriv G (K + b)) b := by
    intro b hb
    exact hasDerivAt_scalarStep G K t b (hdiff _ (htranslate b hb))
  have hnonnegative : ∀ b ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r,
      0 ≤ 1 + t ^ 3 * deriv G (K + b) := by
    intro b hb
    have hlower := (hderiv _ (htranslate b hb)).1
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlower (pow_nonneg ht 3)
    nlinarith
  have hupper : ∀ b ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r,
      1 + t ^ 3 * deriv G (K + b) ≤ 1 - rate * t ^ 3 := by
    intro b hb
    have hbound := (hderiv _ (htranslate b hb)).2
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (pow_nonneg ht 3)
    nlinarith
  have hcontinuous : ContinuousOn (scalarStep G K t) (Set.Icc (-r) r) := by
    intro b hb
    exact (hd b hb).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hdifferentiable : DifferentiableOn ℝ (scalarStep G K t)
      (interior (Set.Icc (-r) r)) := by
    intro b hb
    exact (hd b (interior_subset hb)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  have hmonotone : MonotoneOn (scalarStep G K t) (Set.Icc (-r) r) := by
    apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _) hcontinuous hdifferentiable
    intro b hb
    rw [(hd b (interior_subset hb)).deriv]
    exact hnonnegative b (interior_subset hb)
  have hzeroMember : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r := ⟨neg_nonpos.mpr hr, hr⟩
  have hcoefficient : 0 ≤ 1 - rate * t ^ 3 :=
    (hnonnegative 0 hzeroMember).trans (hupper 0 hzeroMember)
  refine ⟨hmonotone, hcoefficient, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  have hwithin : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r,
      HasDerivWithinAt (scalarStep G K t) (1 + t ^ 3 * deriv G (K + x))
        (Set.Icc (-r) r) x := by
    intro x hx
    exact (hd x hx).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hnorm : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r,
      ‖1 + t ^ 3 * deriv G (K + x)‖ ≤ 1 - rate * t ^ 3 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hnonnegative x hx)]
    exact hupper x hx
  have hbound := (convex_Icc (-r) r).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
    hwithin hnorm hzeroMember hb
  have hzero : scalarStep G K t 0 = 0 := by
    rw [scalarStep_apply]
    simp only [add_zero, heq, mul_zero]
  simpa only [hzero, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: two-sided drift derivative bounds make
the scalar update increasing and contractive toward its equilibrium, for one
fixed sufficiently small scale.
items.title: TubeBounds.scalarStep_control

items.label: TubeBounds.fastBarrier
items.leanCode:
theorem fastBarrier (γ C N t q qNext : ℝ)
    (hγ : 0 ≤ γ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hN : 0 ≤ N) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqin : q ≤ N * t ^ 3)
    (hmargin : (C * N ^ 2 + N) * t ^ 3 ≤ N - γ * N - C)
    (hupdate : qNext ≤ γ * q + C * t ^ 3 + C * q ^ 2) :
    qNext ≤ N * Normalized.nextScale t ^ 3 := by
  have hquadratic : q ^ 2 ≤ N ^ 2 * t ^ 6 := by
    have hbound := pow_le_pow_left₀ hq hqin 2
    simpa only [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, Nat.reduceMul] using hbound
  have hlinear := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqin hγ
  have hsquare := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hquadratic hC
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmargin (pow_nonneg ht 3)
  have hpre : qNext ≤ N * (t ^ 3 - t ^ 6) := by
    nlinarith [hupdate]
  exact hpre.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Normalized.nextScale_cube_lower t ht) hN)
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: a fixed cubic fast margin absorbs both
the quadratic fast error and the decrease of the prescribed cubic scale.
items.title: TubeBounds.fastBarrier

items.label: TubeBounds.slowBarrier
items.leanCode:
theorem slowBarrier (G : ℝ → ℝ) (K rate Ccross Cslow N M t q b bNext : ℝ)
    (hcross : 0 ≤ Ccross) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hq : q ≤ N * t ^ 3) (hb : |b| ≤ M * t)
    (hcoefficient : 0 ≤ 1 - rate * t ^ 3)
    (hcontract : |scalarStep G K t b| ≤ (1 - rate * t ^ 3) * |b|)
    (hmargin : Ccross * N * t ^ 2 ≤ (rate - 1 / 3) * M - Cslow)
    (herror : |bNext - scalarStep G K t b| ≤ Ccross * t ^ 3 * q + Cslow * t ^ 4) :
    |bNext| ≤ M * Normalized.nextScale t := by
  have htriangle : |bNext| ≤ |bNext - scalarStep G K t b| + |scalarStep G K t b| := by
    have hsum := abs_add_le (bNext - scalarStep G K t b) (scalarStep G K t b)
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hsum
  have hfast := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (mul_nonneg hcross (pow_nonneg ht 3))
  have hslow := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hcoefficient
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmargin (pow_nonneg ht 4)
  have hpre : |bNext| ≤ M * (t - t ^ 4 / 3) := by
    nlinarith [htriangle, herror, hcontract]
  exact hpre.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Normalized.nextScale_lower_quartic t ht) hM)
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: a restoring rate above `1 / 3` absorbs
the fourth-order slow error and cubic coupling to a fast cubic tube.
items.title: TubeBounds.slowBarrier

items.label: TubeBounds.existsFastWidth
items.leanCode:
theorem existsFastWidth (γ Cfast : ℝ) (hγ : γ < 1) (hC : 0 ≤ Cfast) :
    ∃ N > 0, γ * N + Cfast < N := by
  let N := (Cfast + 1) / (1 - γ)
  have hdenom : 0 < 1 - γ := sub_pos.mpr hγ
  have hnumerator : 0 < Cfast + 1 := by linarith
  have hN : 0 < N := div_pos hnumerator hdenom
  have hidentity : (1 - γ) * N = Cfast + 1 := by
    dsimp only [N]
    field_simp [hdenom.ne']
  refine ⟨N, hN, ?_⟩
  nlinarith

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the fast width can be fixed with a
strict cubic margin before any slow width or initial scale is chosen.
items.title: TubeBounds.existsFastWidth

items.label: TubeBounds.existsSlowWidth
items.leanCode:
theorem existsSlowWidth (rate Cslow : ℝ) (hrate : (1 / 3 : ℝ) < rate)
    (hC : 0 ≤ Cslow) :
    ∃ M > 0, Cslow < (rate - 1 / 3) * M := by
  let M := (Cslow + 1) / (rate - 1 / 3)
  have hdenom : 0 < rate - 1 / 3 := sub_pos.mpr hrate
  have hnumerator : 0 < Cslow + 1 := by linarith
  have hM : 0 < M := div_pos hnumerator hdenom
  have hidentity : (rate - 1 / 3) * M = Cslow + 1 := by
    dsimp only [M]
    rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hdenom.ne']
  refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩
  linarith

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the slow width can be chosen with a
strict margin over the fourth-order error once the restoring rate exceeds
`1 / 3`.
items.title: TubeBounds.existsSlowWidth

items.label: TubeBounds.existsScaleThreshold
items.leanCode:
theorem existsScaleThreshold (N M Cfast Ccross D r ρ marginFast marginSlow : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hfast : 0 < marginFast) (hslow : 0 < marginSlow) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ε ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ ε →
      M * t ≤ r ∧ N * t ^ 3 ≤ ρ ∧ D * t ^ 3 ≤ 1 ∧
      (Cfast * N ^ 2 + N) * t ^ 3 ≤ marginFast ∧
      Ccross * N * t ^ 2 ≤ marginSlow := by
  have hone : (0 : ℝ) < 1 := zero_lt_one
  have hslowRadius := smallScalePolynomial_lt M r hr 0
  have hfastRadius := smallScalePolynomial_lt N ρ hρ 2
  have hderivative := smallScalePolynomial_lt D 1 hone 2
  have hfastMargin := smallScalePolynomial_lt (Cfast * N ^ 2 + N) marginFast hfast 2
  have hslowMargin := smallScalePolynomial_lt (Ccross * N) marginSlow hslow 1
  have heventually : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝 0,
      M * t ≤ r ∧ N * t ^ 3 ≤ ρ ∧ D * t ^ 3 ≤ 1 ∧
      (Cfast * N ^ 2 + N) * t ^ 3 ≤ marginFast ∧
      Ccross * N * t ^ 2 ≤ marginSlow := by
    filter_upwards [hslowRadius, hfastRadius, hderivative, hfastMargin, hslowMargin] with
      t hsr hfr hd hfm hsm
    refine ⟨?_, hfr.le, hd.le, hfm.le, hsm.le⟩
    simpa only [Nat.zero_add, pow_one] using hsr.le
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hbound⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp heventually
  refine ⟨min 1 (δ / 2), lt_min hone (half_pos hδ), min_le_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro t ht htε
  have hnear : dist t 0 < δ := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos ht]
    exact (htε.trans (min_le_right _ _)).trans_lt (half_lt_self hδ)
  exact hbound hnear
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: after the fast and slow widths and
their strict margins have been fixed, one common positive scale threshold
keeps the tube in its neighborhoods and absorbs all remaining errors.
items.title: TubeBounds.existsScaleThreshold

items.label: TubeBounds.existsInvariantTubeConstants
items.leanCode:
theorem existsInvariantTubeConstants (G : ℝ → ℝ)
    (K γ Cfast Ccross Cslow rate D r ρ : ℝ)
    (hγnonnegative : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ : γ < 1)
    (hfast : 0 ≤ Cfast) (hcross : 0 ≤ Ccross) (hslow : 0 ≤ Cslow)
    (hrate : (1 / 3 : ℝ) < rate) (hr : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (heq : G K = 0)
    (hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (K - r) (K + r), DifferentiableAt ℝ G x)
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (K - r) (K + r),
      -D ≤ deriv G x ∧ deriv G x ≤ -rate) :
    ∃ N > 0, γ * N + Cfast < N ∧
      ∃ M > 0, Cslow < (rate - 1 / 3) * M ∧
      ∃ ε > 0, ε ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ ε →
        M * t ≤ r ∧ N * t ^ 3 ≤ ρ ∧
        ∀ q qNext b bNext : ℝ, 0 ≤ q → q ≤ N * t ^ 3 → |b| ≤ M * t →
          qNext ≤ γ * q + Cfast * t ^ 3 + Cfast * q ^ 2 →
          |bNext - scalarStep G K t b| ≤ Ccross * t ^ 3 * q + Cslow * t ^ 4 →
          qNext ≤ N * Normalized.nextScale t ^ 3 ∧
            |bNext| ≤ M * Normalized.nextScale t := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hNmargin⟩ := existsFastWidth γ Cfast hγ hfast
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hMmargin⟩ := existsSlowWidth rate Cslow hrate hslow
  have hfastMargin : 0 < N - γ * N - Cfast := by linarith
  have hslowMargin : 0 < (rate - 1 / 3) * M - Cslow := sub_pos.mpr hMmargin
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεone, hthreshold⟩ := existsScaleThreshold N M Cfast Ccross D r ρ
    (N - γ * N - Cfast) ((rate - 1 / 3) * M - Cslow) hr hρ hfastMargin hslowMargin
  refine ⟨N, hN, hNmargin, M, hM, hMmargin, ε, hε, hεone, ?_⟩
  intro t ht htε
  obtain ⟨hslowRadius, hfastRadius, hDsmall, hfastSmall, hslowSmall⟩ := hthreshold t ht htε
  refine ⟨hslowRadius, hfastRadius, ?_⟩
  intro q qNext b bNext hq hqin hbin hfastUpdate hslowUpdate
  have hb : b ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r := abs_le.mp (hbin.trans hslowRadius)
  have hcontrol := scalarStep_control G K r rate D t hr.le ht.le hDsmall heq hdiff hderiv
  constructor
  · exact fastBarrier γ Cfast N t q qNext hγnonnegative hfast hN.le ht.le
      hq hqin hfastSmall hfastUpdate
  · exact slowBarrier G K rate Ccross Cslow N M t q b bNext hcross hM.le ht.le
      hqin hbin hcontrol.2.1 (hcontrol.2.2 b hb) hslowSmall hslowUpdate
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: fix the source estimates and a compact
restoring neighborhood, then select the fast width `N`, the slow width `M`,
and finally one scale threshold. These constants give both one-step tube
barriers for every update satisfying the explicit fast and slow estimates.
items.title: TubeBounds.existsInvariantTubeConstants

items.label: TubeBounds.restoringDrift_compact_deriv_lower
items.leanCode:
theorem restoringDrift_compact_deriv_lower (νStar : ℝ) (𝒦 : Set ℝ)
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦)
    (hregular : ∀ A ∈ 𝒦, A ≠ 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter A) :
    ∃ D > 0, ∀ A ∈ 𝒦, -D ≤ deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A := by
  have hcontinuous : ContinuousOn (deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar)) 𝒦 := by
    intro A hA
    have hbranch := hregular A hA
    have hanalytic := TwoCycle.restoringDrift_analyticAt νStar A hbranch.1 hbranch.2
    have hsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A := hanalytic.contDiffAt
    have horder : (0 : ℕ∞ω) + 1 ≤ ω := le_top
    exact (hsmooth.derivWithin horder).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := h𝒦.bddBelow_image hcontinuous
  have hD : 0 < |B| + 1 := by positivity
  refine ⟨|B| + 1, hD, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  have hbound : B ≤ deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A :=
    hB (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hA)
  linarith [neg_abs_le B]

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the actual scalar restoring drift has
a finite lower derivative bound on every compact regular inverse-branch set.
items.title: TubeBounds.restoringDrift_compact_deriv_lower

items.label: TubeBounds.existsRestoringDerivativeBounds
items.leanCode:
theorem existsRestoringDerivativeBounds :
    ∃ rate > (1 / 3 : ℝ), ∃ δ > 0,
      ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + δ),
        νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ r > 0, ∃ D > 0,
          TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar (cycleK νStar) = 0 ∧
          ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r),
            ContDiffAt ℝ ω (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A ∧ 0 < A ∧
              -D ≤ deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A ∧
              deriv (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A ≤ -rate := by
  obtain ⟨rate, hrate, δ, hδ, hrestoring⟩ := TwoCycle.restoringSlowDrift
  refine ⟨rate, hrate, δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hνStar
  obtain ⟨hparameter, r, hr, _, _, _, _, heq, hbranch⟩ := hrestoring νStar hνStar
  have hregular : ∀ A ∈ Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r),
      A ≠ 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ω TwoCycle.inverseParameter A := by
    intro A hA
    exact ⟨(hbranch A hA).2.2.1.ne', (hbranch A hA).1⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hlower⟩ := restoringDrift_compact_deriv_lower νStar
    (Set.Icc (cycleK νStar - r) (cycleK νStar + r)) isCompact_Icc hregular
  refine ⟨hparameter, r, hr, D, hD, heq, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  have hproperties := hbranch A hA
  have hsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ω (TwoCycle.restoringDrift νStar) A :=
    (TwoCycle.restoringDrift_analyticAt νStar A hproperties.2.2.1.ne'
      hproperties.1).contDiffAt
  exact ⟨hsmooth, hproperties.2.2.1, hlower A hA, hproperties.2.2.2.1⟩

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the accepted slow-drift theorem gives

items.title: TubeBounds.existsRestoringDerivativeBounds

items.label: TubeBounds.tubeBounds_of_barriers
items.leanCode:
theorem tubeBounds_of_barriers (t q b : ℕ → ℝ) (N M ε : ℝ)
    (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ht : 0 < t 0) (hsmall : t 0 ≤ ε)
    (hscale : ∀ j, Normalized.nextScale (t j) = t (j + 1))
    (hqzero : q 0 = 0) (hbzero : b 0 = 0)
    (hbarrier : ∀ j, 0 < t j → t j ≤ ε → q j ≤ N * t j ^ 3 → |b j| ≤ M * t j →
      q (j + 1) ≤ N * Normalized.nextScale (t j) ^ 3 ∧
        |b (j + 1)| ≤ M * Normalized.nextScale (t j)) :
    ∀ j, 0 < t j ∧ t j ≤ ε ∧ q j ≤ N * t j ^ 3 ∧ |b j| ≤ M * t j := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨ht, hsmall, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hqzero]
        exact mul_nonneg hN (pow_nonneg ht.le 3)
      · rw [hbzero, abs_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg hM ht.le
  | succ j ih =>
      obtain ⟨hpositive, hthreshold, hfast, hslow⟩ := ih
      have hnext := hbarrier j hpositive hthreshold hfast hslow
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hscale j]
        exact Normalized.nextScale_pos (t j) hpositive
      · calc
          t (j + 1) = Normalized.nextScale (t j) := (hscale j).symm
          _ ≤ t j := Normalized.nextScale_le_self (t j) hpositive.le
          _ ≤ ε := hthreshold
      · rw [← hscale j]
        exact hnext.1
      · rw [← hscale j]
        exact hnext.2
items.statement:
Helper for lem:polar-continuation: one-step barriers propagate along the
original next-scale recurrence from zero initial errors, keeping every later
scale below the same fixed threshold. This is an abstract tube induction.
items.title: TubeBounds.tubeBounds_of_barriers

items.label: TubeBounds.tubeBounds_on_prescribedScales
items.leanCode:
theorem tubeBounds_on_prescribedScales (p : Parameters) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (q b : ℕ → ℝ) (N M ε : ℝ) (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hsmall : p.scale 0 ≤ ε) (hqzero : q 0 = 0) (hbzero : b 0 = 0)
    (hbarrier : ∀ j, 0 < p.scale j → p.scale j ≤ ε →
      q j ≤ N * p.scale j ^ 3 → |b j| ≤ M * p.scale j →
      q (j + 1) ≤ N * Normalized.nextScale (p.scale j) ^ 3 ∧
        |b (j + 1)| ≤ M * Normalized.nextScale (p.scale j)) :
    ∀ j, 0 < p.scale j ∧ p.scale j ≤ ε ∧
      q j ≤ N * p.scale j ^ 3 ∧ |b j| ≤ M * p.scale j := by
  have hstartReal : 0 < (p.startIndex : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hstart
  have ht : 0 < p.scale 0 := by
    rw [Parameters.scale_def]
    simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hstartReal (-(1 : ℝ) / 3)
  exact tubeBounds_of_barriers p.scale q b N M ε hN hM ht hsmall
    (Normalized.nextScale_scale p · hstart) hqzero hbzero hbarrier

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the abstract tube induction applies
to the source's prescribed `Parameters.scale` sequence without replacing its
scale construction. The hypothesis is the explicit one-step barrier.
items.title: TubeBounds.tubeBounds_on_prescribedScales

items.label: TubeBounds.existsFixedNormTube_of_estimates
items.leanCode:
theorem existsFixedNormTube_of_estimates (G : ℝ → ℝ)
    (K γ Cfast Ccross Cslow rate D r ρ : ℝ)
    (hγnonnegative : 0 ≤ γ) (hγ : γ < 1)
    (hfast : 0 ≤ Cfast) (hcross : 0 ≤ Ccross) (hslow : 0 ≤ Cslow)
    (hrate : (1 / 3 : ℝ) < rate) (hr : 0 < r) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (heq : G K = 0)
    (hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (K - r) (K + r), DifferentiableAt ℝ G x)
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (K - r) (K + r),
      -D ≤ deriv G x ∧ deriv G x ≤ -rate) :
    ∃ N > 0, γ * N + Cfast < N ∧
      ∃ M > 0, Cslow < (rate - 1 / 3) * M ∧
      ∃ ε > 0, ε ≤ 1 ∧
        ∀ p : Parameters, 0 < p.startIndex → p.scale 0 ≤ ε →
        ∀ (u : ℕ → Fin 2 → ℝ) (b : ℕ → ℝ), u 0 = 0 → b 0 = 0 →
          (∀ j, 0 < p.scale j → p.scale j ≤ ε →
            FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) ≤ N * p.scale j ^ 3 → |b j| ≤ M * p.scale j →
            FastContraction.fixedNorm (u (j + 1)) ≤
              γ * FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) + Cfast * p.scale j ^ 3 +
                Cfast * FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) ^ 2 ∧
            |b (j + 1) - scalarStep G K (p.scale j) (b j)| ≤
              Ccross * p.scale j ^ 3 * FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) +
                Cslow * p.scale j ^ 4) →
          ∀ j, 0 < p.scale j ∧ p.scale j ≤ ε ∧
            FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) ≤ N * p.scale j ^ 3 ∧
            |b j| ≤ M * p.scale j ∧ FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) ≤ ρ ∧ |b j| ≤ r := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hNmargin, M, hM, hMmargin, ε, hε, hεone, hstep⟩ :=
    existsInvariantTubeConstants G K γ Cfast Ccross Cslow rate D r ρ
      hγnonnegative hγ hfast hcross hslow hrate hr hρ heq hdiff hderiv
  refine ⟨N, hN, hNmargin, M, hM, hMmargin, ε, hε, hεone, ?_⟩
  intro p hstart hsmall u b huzero hbzero hupdates
  have hqzero : FastContraction.fixedNorm (u 0) = 0 :=
    (FastContraction.fixedNorm_eq_zero (u 0)).mpr huzero
  have hbarrier : ∀ j, 0 < p.scale j → p.scale j ≤ ε →
      FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j) ≤ N * p.scale j ^ 3 → |b j| ≤ M * p.scale j →
      FastContraction.fixedNorm (u (j + 1)) ≤ N * Normalized.nextScale (p.scale j) ^ 3 ∧
        |b (j + 1)| ≤ M * Normalized.nextScale (p.scale j) := by
    intro j ht htε hqin hbin
    have hupdate := hupdates j ht htε hqin hbin
    exact (hstep (p.scale j) ht htε).2.2
      (FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j)) (FastContraction.fixedNorm (u (j + 1)))
      (b j) (b (j + 1)) (FastContraction.fixedNorm_nonneg (u j)) hqin hbin
      hupdate.1 hupdate.2
  have htube := tubeBounds_on_prescribedScales p hstart
    (fun j ↦ FastContraction.fixedNorm (u j)) b N M ε hN.le hM.le hsmall hqzero hbzero hbarrier
  intro j
  obtain ⟨ht, htε, hfastBound, hslowBound⟩ := htube j
  have hneighborhood := hstep (p.scale j) ht htε
  exact ⟨ht, htε, hfastBound, hslowBound, hfastBound.trans hneighborhood.2.1,
    hslowBound.trans hneighborhood.1⟩

Helper for lem:polar-continuation: the source fast and slow estimates
give a tube on the prescribed scales in the fixed fast norm. The widths and
threshold are chosen before `Parameters` and its initial index. This theorem
is conditional on the stated update estimates and does not assert feasibility
of the actual polar matrix sequence.
items.title: TubeBounds.existsFixedNormTube_of_estimates

theorem cycleW_sub_cycleZ (ν : ℝ) (hν : ν ∈ parameterSet) :
    cycleW ν - cycleZ ν = ν := by
  -- Clear the common positive denominator of the rational coordinates.
  have hb := parameterSetBounds ν hν

items.leanCode:
theorem hasDerivAt_cycleK_baseAngle :
    HasDerivAt cycleK (3 / (4 * baseAngle ^ 3)) baseAngle := by
  -- Specialize the quotient derivative and normalize its coefficient.
  have hleft : 2 * baseAngle - baseAngle ≠ 0 := by
    linarith [baseAnglePos]
  have hright : baseAngle + baseAngle ≠ 0 := by
    linarith [baseAnglePos]
  have hd := (hasStrictDerivAt_cycleK_of_ne baseAngle
    baseAnglePos.ne' hleft hright).hasDerivAt
  have hvalue :
      (2 * baseAngle ^ 3 + 2 * baseAngle ^ 2 * baseAngle -
        5 * baseAngle * baseAngle ^ 2 + 4 * baseAngle ^ 3) /
        (baseAngle * (2 * baseAngle - baseAngle) *
          (baseAngle + baseAngle)) ^ 2 = 3 / (4 * baseAngle ^ 3) := by
    field_simp [baseAnglePos.ne']
    all_goals ring
  exact hd.congr_deriv hvalue

`3 / (4 * baseAngle ^ 3)`.

    linarith [baseAnglePos]
  have hright : baseAngle + baseAngle ≠ 0 := by
    linarith [baseAnglePos]
  have hd := hasStrictDerivAt_cycleK_of_ne baseAngle
    baseAnglePos.ne' hleft hright

theorem startSlope_neg (p : Parameters) (k : ℕ) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)

    rw [startSlope_eq p k hr (ne_of_gt hW)]

    (r ^ 2 / 2 - (r / W) ^ 2 / 2) / (ζ * r ^ 2 * q * Real.sin δ / W) =

  field_simp

    |ζNext * r ^ 2 * Real.sin δ / W ^ 2 * (Real.sin δ - q * Real.cos δ)| /
        |-(ζ * r ^ 2 * q * Real.sin δ / W)| =
      (ζNext / ζ) * |q * Real.cos δ - Real.sin δ| / (q * W) := by
  simp only [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_neg, abs_pow, abs_of_pos hr, abs_of_pos hω,
    abs_of_pos hζ, abs_of_pos hζNext, abs_of_pos hsin, abs_of_pos hW]
  rw [abs_sub_comm (Real.sin δ) (q * Real.cos δ)]
  field_simp

quotient.

items.label: WolfeRatios.armijoRatio_eq
items.leanCode:
theorem armijoRatio_eq (p : Parameters) (k : ℕ) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hr : p.radius (k + 1) = p.radius k / p.radiusRatio k)
    (hradius : 0 < p.radius k) (hω : 0 < p.omega k) (hW : 0 < p.radiusRatio k) :
    armijoRatio p k = (p.radiusRatio k ^ 2 - 1) /
      (2 * p.zeta k * p.omega k * Real.sin (p.angleIncrement k) * p.radiusRatio k) := by
  rw [armijoRatio_def, modelValue_def, modelValue_def,
    startSlope_eq p k hr (ne_of_gt hW), hr]
  exact armijo_scalar _ _ _ _ _ (ne_of_gt hradius) (ne_of_gt hω)
    (ne_of_gt (PhysicalRealization.zeta_pos p k))
    (ne_of_gt (PhysicalRealization.angleIncrement_sin_pos p hstart k)) (ne_of_gt hW)

items.label: WolfeRatios.curvatureRatio_eq
items.leanCode:
theorem curvatureRatio_eq (p : Parameters) (k : ℕ) (hstart : 0 < p.startIndex)
    (hr : p.radius (k + 1) = p.radius k / p.radiusRatio k)
    (hradius : 0 < p.radius k) (hω : 0 < p.omega k) (hW : 0 < p.radiusRatio k) :
    curvatureRatio p k = (p.zeta (k + 1) / p.zeta k) *
      |p.omega k * Real.cos (p.angleIncrement k) - Real.sin (p.angleIncrement k)| /
        (p.omega k * p.radiusRatio k) := by
  have hstartEq : startSlope p k = -(p.zeta k * p.radius k ^ 2 * p.omega k *
      Real.sin (p.angleIncrement k) / p.radiusRatio k) := by
    linarith [startSlope_eq p k hr (ne_of_gt hW)]
  rw [curvatureRatio_def, hstartEq, endSlope_eq p k hr (ne_of_gt hW)]
  exact curvature_scalar _ _ _ _ _ _ hradius hω (PhysicalRealization.zeta_pos p k)
    (PhysicalRealization.zeta_pos p (k + 1))
    (PhysicalRealization.angleIncrement_sin_pos p hstart k) hW

gradients.

theorem regularRatios_analyticAt (ν : ℝ) (i : Fin 2)
    (hQ : RadiusExpansions.referenceSlope ν i ≠ 0) :
    AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : Fin 4 → ℝ ↦ (regularArmijo i z, regularCurvature i z))
      (referenceData ν i) := by
  have hzero : referenceData ν i 0 = 0 := by simp [referenceData_def, ratioData_zero]
  have hcoord (j : Fin 4) : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : Fin 4 → ℝ ↦ z j)
      (referenceData ν i) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 4 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).analyticAt _
  have hconst (c : ℝ) : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun _ : Fin 4 → ℝ ↦ c) (referenceData ν i) :=
    analyticAt_const
  have hS : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : Fin 4 → ℝ ↦ Normalized.sinFactor i (z 0))
      (referenceData ν i) :=
    (Normalized.sinFactor_analyticAt i).comp_of_eq (hcoord 0) hzero
  have hδ : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : Fin 4 → ℝ ↦ Normalized.stageAngle i (z 0))
      (referenceData ν i) :=
    (Normalized.stageAngle_analyticAt i).comp_of_eq (hcoord 0) hzero
  have hcos : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : Fin 4 → ℝ ↦ Real.cos (Normalized.stageAngle i (z 0)))
      (referenceData ν i) := Real.analyticAt_cos.comp hδ
  have hWanalytic : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : Fin 4 → ℝ ↦ regularRadius i (z 0) (z 1))
      (referenceData ν i) := by
    simpa only [regularRadius_def] using
      hcos.fun_add ((((hcoord 0).fun_pow 4).fun_mul (hcoord 1)).fun_mul hS)
  have hq : referenceData ν i 1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [referenceData_def, ratioData_def] using hQ
  have hzeta : referenceData ν i 2 ≠ 0 := by
    simp [referenceData_def, ratioData_two]
  have hW : regularRadius i (referenceData ν i 0) (referenceData ν i 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hzero, regularRadius_zero]
    exact one_ne_zero
  have hden : 2 * referenceData ν i 2 * referenceData ν i 1 *
      regularRadius i (referenceData ν i 0) (referenceData ν i 1) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hzeta) hq) hW
  have hdenCurv : referenceData ν i 1 *
      regularRadius i (referenceData ν i 0) (referenceData ν i 1) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hq hW
  have hnumA := (((hconst 2).fun_mul (hcoord 1)).fun_mul hcos |>.fun_sub hS).add
    ((((hcoord 1).fun_pow 2).fun_mul ((hcoord 0).fun_pow 4)).fun_mul hS)
  have hdenA := (((hconst 2).fun_mul (hcoord 2)).fun_mul (hcoord 1)).fun_mul hWanalytic
  have hnumC := ((hcoord 3).fun_div (hcoord 2) hzeta).fun_mul (((hcoord 1).fun_mul hcos).fun_sub hS)
  have hdenC := (hcoord 1).fun_mul hWanalytic
  simp only [regularArmijo_def, regularCurvature_def]
  exact (hnumA.fun_div hdenA hden).prod (hnumC.fun_div hdenC hdenCurv)

in scale, normalized source slope, and the two original feedback multipliers.

items.label: WolfeRatios.analyticErrorOfLinearInput
items.leanCode:
theorem analyticErrorOfLinearInput {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (f : E → F) (x₀ : E) (hf : AnalyticAt ℝ f x₀) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < δ → ∀ x : E,
      ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ B * t → ‖f x - f x₀‖ ≤ C * t := by
  obtain ⟨K, s, hs, hLip⟩ := hf.hasStrictFDerivAt.exists_lipschitzOnWith
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hs
  have hbase : x₀ ∈ s := mem_of_mem_nhds hs
  have hBOne : 0 < B + 1 := by linarith
  have hKOne : 0 < (K : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  refine ⟨((K : ℝ) + 1) * (B + 1), mul_pos hKOne hBOne,
    ε / (B + 1), div_pos hε hBOne, ?_⟩
  intro t ht htδ x hx
  have hsmall : (B + 1) * t < ε := by
    nlinarith [(lt_div_iff₀ hBOne).mp htδ]
  have hin : x ∈ s := by
    apply hball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    have hBt : B * t ≤ (B + 1) * t := by nlinarith
    exact hx.trans_lt (hBt.trans_lt hsmall)
  calc
    ‖f x - f x₀‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) * ‖x - x₀‖ :=
      (lipschitzOnWith_iff_norm_sub_le.mp hLip) hin hbase
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * (B * t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx K.coe_nonneg
    _ ≤ (((K : ℝ) + 1) * (B + 1)) * t := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg K.coe_nonneg ht]
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-wolfe-asymptotics: an analytic map sends a uniformly linear
input error to a uniformly linear output error on a fixed neighborhood.
items.title: WolfeRatios.analyticErrorOfLinearInput

  have hfirst : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.1) (0, x₀) := analyticAt_fst
  have hstate : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.2) (0, x₀) := analyticAt_snd
  have hAmp : AnalyticAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) ↦ z.2.1) (0, x₀) :=

theorem feedbackErrorOfStateBound (L κ : ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)
    (hA : x₀.1 ≠ 0) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :

theorem actualFeedbackEstimates :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ νStar ∈ Set.Ioo baseAngle (baseAngle + η),
      νStar ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet ∧ ∃ C > 0, ∃ J : ℕ, 0 < J ∧
        ∀ j₀ ≥ J, ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin 2,
          let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
          |p.zeta (2 * j + (i : ℕ)) - 1| ≤ C * p.scale j ∧
            |p.zeta (2 * j + (i : ℕ) + 1) - 1| ≤ C * p.scale j := by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hTube⟩ := Continuation.actualTube
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨hparameter, hbranch, N, hN, M, hM, J₀, hJ₀, htube⟩ := hTube νStar hnear
  obtain ⟨B, hB, δs, hδs, hstate⟩ :=
    RadiusExpansions.stateBoundOfTube νStar M N hparameter hbranch hM.le hN.le
  have hK := TwoCycle.cycleK_bijOn_parameterSet.mapsTo hparameter
  have hE := (StageFeasibility.regularState_def _).mp
    (StageFeasibility.regularState_evenState (cycleK νStar) hK)
  obtain ⟨C, hC, δf, hδf, hfeedback⟩ := feedbackErrorOfStateBound
    (4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar)) (cycleK νStar)
    (TwoCycle.evenState (cycleK νStar)) hE.1.ne' B hB.le
  obtain ⟨J₁, _, hscale⟩ := Continuation.existsStartThreshold
    (min δs δf) (lt_min hδs hδf)
  refine ⟨hparameter, C, hC, max J₀ J₁, hJ₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro j₀ hj₀ j i
  let p := Parameters.of j₀ νStar
  have hstart : 0 < p.startIndex := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.of_startIndex] using
      hJ₀.trans_le ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀)
  have ht := ScaleTails.scale_pos p hstart j
  have hsmall : p.scale j < min δs δf :=
    (ScaleTails.scale_antitone p hstart (Nat.zero_le j)).trans_lt
      (hscale νStar j₀ ((le_max_right J₀ J₁).trans hj₀))
  have hactual := htube j₀ ((le_max_left J₀ J₁).trans hj₀) j
  have hslow : |(p.normalizedEvenState j).1 - cycleK νStar| ≤ M * p.scale j := by
    simpa only [p, Parameters.kStar_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter] using hactual.1
  have hx := hstate (p.scale j) ht.le (hsmall.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
    (p.normalizedEvenState j) hslow hactual.2.1
  have hfb := hfeedback (p.scale j) ht.le (hsmall.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
    (p.normalizedEvenState j) hx
  have hL : p.feedbackRate = 4 * baseAngle / (9 * νStar) := by
    simp only [p, Parameters.feedbackRate_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  have hκ : p.kStar = cycleK νStar := by
    simp only [p, Parameters.kStar_def, Parameters.of_cycleParameter]
  rw [← hL, ← hκ, feedback_prescribed] at hfb
  exact zeta_phase_errors p j C hfb i

Helper for eq:polar-wolfe-asymptotics: the actual original feedback multipliers

items.label: WolfeRatios.regularRadius_eq

theorem regularRadius_eq (i : Fin 2) (t q : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    regularRadius i t q = Real.cos (Normalized.stageAngle i t) +
      t ^ 2 * q * Real.sin (Normalized.stageAngle i t) := by
  rw [regularRadius_def, Normalized.sinFactor_eq_sin_div i t ht]
  field_simp

Helper for eq:polar-wolfe-asymptotics: the normalized radius is the original radius at slope
`t²q`.

items.label: WolfeRatios.sin_stageAngle_eq
items.leanCode:
theorem sin_stageAngle_eq (i : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Real.sin (Normalized.stageAngle i t) = t ^ 2 * Normalized.sinFactor i t := by
  rw [Normalized.sinFactor_eq_sin_div i t ht]
  field_simp

Helper for eq:polar-wolfe-asymptotics: the source sine factor retains its exact quadratic

items.label: WolfeRatios.radius_square_sub_one
items.leanCode:
theorem radius_square_sub_one (i : Fin 2) (t q : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    regularRadius i t q ^ 2 - 1 = t ^ 4 * Normalized.sinFactor i t *
      (2 * q * Real.cos (Normalized.stageAngle i t) - Normalized.sinFactor i t +
        q ^ 2 * t ^ 4 * Normalized.sinFactor i t) := by
  have htrig := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (Normalized.stageAngle i t)
  rw [sin_stageAngle_eq i t ht] at htrig
  rw [regularRadius_def]
  nlinarith

Helper for eq:polar-wolfe-asymptotics: the identity `cos²+sin²=1` cancels
the fourth-order numerator in the original Armijo ratio exactly.

items.label: WolfeRatios.armijo_normalization
items.leanCode:
theorem armijo_normalization (i : Fin 2) (t q ζ ζNext : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (hS : Normalized.sinFactor i t ≠ 0)
    (hW : regularRadius i t q ≠ 0) :
    (regularRadius i t q ^ 2 - 1) /
        (2 * ζ * (t ^ 2 * q) * Real.sin (Normalized.stageAngle i t) * regularRadius i t q) =
      regularArmijo i (ratioData t q ζ ζNext) := by
  rw [radius_square_sub_one i t q ht, sin_stageAngle_eq i t ht,
    regularArmijo_def]
  simp only [ratioData_zero, ratioData_one, ratioData_two]
  field_simp
items.statement:
Helper for eq:polar-wolfe-asymptotics: exact common-factor cancellation gives the regular
Armijo quotient.
items.title: WolfeRatios.armijo_normalization

items.label: WolfeRatios.curvature_normalization
items.leanCode:
theorem curvature_normalization (i : Fin 2) (t q ζ ζNext : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (hW : regularRadius i t q ≠ 0) :
    (ζNext / ζ) * ((t ^ 2 * q) * Real.cos (Normalized.stageAngle i t) -
        Real.sin (Normalized.stageAngle i t)) / ((t ^ 2 * q) * regularRadius i t q) =
      regularCurvature i (ratioData t q ζ ζNext) := by
  rw [sin_stageAngle_eq i t ht, regularCurvature_def]
  simp only [ratioData_zero, ratioData_one, ratioData_two, ratioData_three]
  field_simp

Helper for eq:polar-wolfe-asymptotics: the signed source curvature quotient
has exact cancellation of its common quadratic factor.

items.label: WolfeRatios.referenceSlope_gt_angle

theorem referenceSlope_gt_angle (ν : ℝ) (hν : ν ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet) (i : Fin 2) :

  have h := RadiusExpansions.referenceSlopes_gt ν hν

items.label: WolfeRatios.referenceSlope_pos
items.leanCode:
theorem referenceSlope_pos (ν : ℝ) (hν : ν ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet) (i : Fin 2) :

items.label: WolfeRatios.curvatureLimit_pos

theorem curvatureLimit_pos (ν : ℝ) (hν : ν ∈ TwoCycle.parameterSet) (i : Fin 2) :
